Akane_SkillDes.GA_Akane_Passive1_des:
<TextHLT>Remora Enhancement</>: Grants Akane Rin an enhancement that lasts until she leaves combat after the team triggers Remora for the first time. Applies Remora to the target affected by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">Overtone</> and to all enemies within <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">Reverb Field</> every <NumGreen>3</>s.
Deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> (counts as Redirect Skill DMG) equal to <NumGreen>150%</> of Akane Rin's ATK whenever the team reapplies Remora to an affected target. Increases this DMG by <NumGreen>20%</> for each <NumGreen>1</>s of Remora duration remaining on the target, up to <NumGreen>160%</>.
Calculates each target's remaining Remora duration independently. Triggers this DMG no more than <NumGreen>once</> per target every <NumGreen>1</>s.

Akane_SkillDes.GA_Akane_Skill_instead_des:
Enables Synced Resonance when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneChordEnergy">String Energy</> reaches <NumGreen>30</> and an active <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">Overtone</> or <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">Reverb Field</> is present. Press Redirect Skill to cast Synced Resonance and trigger enhanced effects based on the current form:
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">Overtone</>: deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of massive single-target <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to the affected target.
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">Reverb Field</>: deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of massive <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to all enemies within range.
Consumes <NumGreen>30</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneChordEnergy">String Energy</> when Synced Resonance hits and consumes none if it misses. Preserves the existing <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">Overtone</> or <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">Reverb Field</> without refreshing its remaining duration. Akane Rin gains invincibility and immunity to hitstun while casting Synced Resonance.
Synced Resonance has no independent cooldown and does not affect Rhythm Wave's normal cooldown.
Prevents Synced Resonance from being cast when neither <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">Overtone</> nor <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">Reverb Field</> is active, requiring pressing or holding Rhythm Wave to establish a form first.

<Italic>"Captain Baicang still isn't here? This is urgent!"</>

Cang_SkillDes.GA_Cang_UtraSkill_background: <Italic>No one understands the power of words themselves better than Baicang. Until the very last moment, no one knows whether those waveforms taking shape in the air represent curses or blessings. Perhaps—only by glimpsing into the heart can one truly discern.</>
Cang_SkillDes.GA_Cang_Passive_2_background: <Italic>Sure, we're all a bunch of eccentric weirdos who do our own thing, but we have our moments of perfect teamwork too. Spend enough time together, and your body starts to remember each other's habits and movements. What was that just now? Why, that was ETD-4's passionate combo, of course!</>

CharacterTeachGuide.Exe_des:
Exe is a <red>ranged</> <red>DMG dealer</>.

The fifth attack in his <red>Basic Attack</> combo and certain other moves consume <red>Frames</> to summon <red>Digital Echoes</> that perform coordinated attacks.
Hold <red>Basic Attack</> to perform <red>Network Penetration</> and reset his Basic Attack combo.
Casting his <red>Redirect Skill</> consumes a large number of <red>Frames</> to summon multiple <red>Digital Echoes</> and rapidly increase his <red>Rating Level</>.
Casting his <red>Ultimate</> puts Exe into the <red>Shader Compile</> state. While Shader Compile is active, all his attacks can consume <red>Frames</> to summon <red>Digital Echoes</>.
While <red>Shader Compile</> is active, his <red>Network Penetration</> can execute non-Boss enemies whose HP falls below a certain threshold. Executing an enemy extends the duration of <red>Shader Compile</>.

CharacterTeachGuide.Akane_des:
Akane Rin is a <red>DMG dealer</> who can adapt her attacks based on the number of enemies on the field.
Hitting enemies with Basic Attacks builds <red>String Energy</>. When <red>String Energy</> is full, her Skill is enhanced into the corresponding <red>Detonation</> based on her current state.
Press Rhythm Wave to apply <red>Overtone</> to a target and focus on a single enemy. Hold Rhythm Wave to create a <red>Reverb Field</> and attack multiple enemies at once.
<red>Overtone</> and <red>Reverb Field</> do not coexist. Depending on her current state, Basic Attacks transmit DMG to the enemy affected by Overtone or to enemies within the <red>Reverb Field</>.
When <red>String Energy</> is full, cast the enhanced skill <red>Synced Resonance</> to detonate Overtone for heavy single-target DMG, or detonate the <red>Reverb Field</> to deal Spread DMG to enemies within it.
Casting Sonic Boom launches its first instance and puts Akane into the <red>Solo Cadenza</> state. Once <red>Solo Cadenza</> is past its halfway point, Akane Rin can cast the second instance of Sonic Boom to deal DMG to enemies.

CharacterTeachGuide.Elyms_des:
Elyms strengthens her combat abilities by increasing her <red>Connection Strength</>. She also grants allies <red>ATK Bonuses</> and performs <red>off-field coordinated attacks</>.
Elyms has three <red>Connection Strength</> levels. At <red>Weak Connection</>, she performs a five-instance Basic Attack combo. Performing the <red>fifth instance</> or casting <red>The Ones Who Left</> activates <red>Intermittent Existence</>, which is also available at the start of combat.
Casting <red>The Ones Who Left</> instantly fills <red>Cycle Energy</> to maximum. Casting <red>Intermittent Existence</> or a <red>Support Skill</> raises her Connection Strength from <red>Weak Connection</> to <red>Medium Connection</> and grants 1 stack of <red>Optical Illusion</>.
At <red>Medium Connection or Strong Connection</>, her Basic Attack combo has three instances. Performing the <red>third instance</> activates <red>Goodbye to You</>. Casting Goodbye to You raises her Connection Strength to <red>Strong Connection</> and consumes all <red>Optical Illusion</> stacks to increase the skill's DMG Ratio for that cast.
When casting <red>Intermittent Existence</>, <red>Goodbye to You</>, or the <red>Support Skill</>, she scans nearby enemies to determine whether her Ultimate uses its <red>single-target or AoE form</>. At <red>Weak Connection</>, the Ultimate defaults to its AoE form.
After casting her <red>Ultimate</>, Elyms grants the whole team an <red>ATK Bonus</> and enters the <red>On the Line</> state. Once you switch to another character, Elyms automatically performs a <red>coordinated attack</> while off-field, based on the Ultimate's form and her Connection Strength when it was cast. DMG dealt by this attack counts as <red>Follow-up Attack</> DMG.
CharacterTeachGuide.Trial_Elyms_3_guide_1: Elyms's <Yellow>Connection Strength</> has three levels: <Yellow>Weak Connection</>, <Yellow>Medium Connection</>, and <Yellow>Strong Connection</>. Increasing Connection Strength changes her Basic Attack and gradually unlocks Enhanced Skills.

CharacterTeachGuide.Fadia_TotalDes:
Fadia is a <red>Survival character</> centered around <red>Damage Redirect</>. When Fadia's current HP is <red>greater than 1 point</>, she can use her Esper Ability to redirect damage for teammates before it hits their shields.
Using Redirect Skill: Existence applies Destructive Experience to the enemy with the highest Max HP within range. During this effect, when Fadia takes damage, the target will <red>share</> part of the damage Fadia receives.
After using Ultimate: Agony to Euphoria, Fadia enters Lilith state and <red>recovers HP</>. While in Lilith state, using Basic Attack: Wordless Rejection again allows up to five follow-up attacks, with each follow-up dealing <red>Mental DMG</>.

CharacterTeachGuide.Xun_TotalDes:
Hotori is a <red>Support</> who provides <red>damage buffs</> while also having significant Burst DMG potential. When added to the team, the Non-Closed Timepiece begins to accumulate energy over time.
When the Timepiece has accumulated energy and Hotori is <red>out of combat</>, holding Basic Attack activates the Frozen Snow Ritual, slowing time to a near standstill.
Once the Timepiece has at least half of its energy, casting Present Replay <red>observes and records</> all <red>Support Skills</> and <red>Redirect Skills</> cast by the team for a set duration.
When the Timepiece is <red>fully charged</>, casting World's Tide switches Hotori to katana attacks and nearly halts time in the surrounding area. During this time stop, the Timepiece pointer continuously rewinds. Katana attacks build combo stacks, and reaching 10 stacks triggers <red>Ultimate DMG</>. At that time, or when the pointer rewinds to its minimum, the time stop ends.
CharacterTeachGuide.Xun_Phase4_ForceGuide1: Hotori's Ultimate will stop time in the surrounding area and replay all recorded Esper Cycles and Redirect Skills once.

Linko is a <red>DMG dealer</> who specializes in <red>coordinated attacks</>.
Use Basic Attacks and <red>Critical Ripostes</> to build up<red> Modulation Points</>. Hold <red>Basic Attack</> to trigger the Branch Attack <red>Spectral Smack</>.
When Linko casts <red>Full-Frequency Pulse</>, select an ally or Xiaozhen to perform a Synced Strike. <red>Modulation Points</> are consumed to increase the damage dealt by the <red>Synced Strike</>.
While Linko is off-field, Xiaozhen attacks enemies every 8s and applies the <red>Hit 'Em Here!</> mark. When the active character breaks the mark with a Redirect Skill, Linko performs a <red>Synced Strike</>.
After casting <red>Oversync</>, Linko enters Overdrive and summons a Resonance Field for a set duration, allowing allies to perform up to 3 <red>Synced Strikes</>. When Overdrive expires or Oversync is pressed again, Linko deals Anima DMG to enemies within Resonance Field. This DMG increases based on the number of different debuffs on the target.

CharacterTeachGuide.Iroi_3_2: Hold to charge, consuming Imagination based on the charge duration to summon up to 3 lambs to perform Daydream
CharacterTeachGuide.Iroi_5_2: Hold to cast Redirect Skill. Cause all other allies to enter Regression state, transforming them into lambs that assist in battle

CharacterTeachGuide.BaiCang_Phase6: Cast <DefaultOrange>Redirect Skill</> after dodging to generate the Power Word <DefaultOrange>"Silence."</>
CharacterTeachGuide.Adler_TotalDes:
Adler is a <red>Survival-type</> <red>ranged character</>.
Casting Redirect Skill: Evil's Bane deals <red>Incantation DMG</> and grants a <red>Shield</> Blessing to the Team.
Hitting enemies with Basic Attack: Deliverance or Basic Attack: Liberation generates <red>Karma Marks</>. When Adler casts Evil's Bane with Karma Marks, all marks are consumed to greatly increase its damage.
CharacterTeachGuide.VO_Gacha_Char_ADL: Alois V. Adler, at your service.
CharacterTeachGuide.Normal_Phase1: Approach an enemy to start the tutorial
CharacterTeachGuide.Common_Phase4_ForceGuide3forTouch: <Yellow>Throughout the entire duration</> of the Warning Ring, use <Orange>Redirect Skill</> to immediately trigger <Yellow>Parry Attack</>.
CharacterTeachGuide.Common_Phase4_ForceGuide3: Throughout the entire duration of the Warning Ring, press to use Redirect Skill to immediately trigger Parry Attack.
CharacterTeachGuide.Trial_Blackbird_2_guide: Using <Yellow>Fleeting Shadow</>, <Yellow>Lingering Affliction</>, the Critical Riposte <Yellow>Avian Instinct</>, or the Parry Attack <Yellow>Last Word</> builds <Yellow>Malice</>. Cast <Yellow>Requies Animarum</> to transform into the Witch of Deliverance. While in the Witch of Deliverance state, hitting enemies consumes <Yellow>Malice</> to deal additional DMG.
CharacterTeachGuide.Trial_Blackbird_4: Cast Requies Animarum to transform into the Witch of Deliverance.
CharacterTeachGuide.Trial_Blackbird_5_guide_1: Land the 5th hit of <Yellow>Pyreflame</> while in the Witch of Deliverance state to activate the Skill.
CharacterTeachGuide.Trial_Blackbird_5_guide_2: Deal DMG to enemies while in the Witch of Deliverance state to consume <Yellow>Malice</> and deal additional DMG.

Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_Skill_background: <Italic>Frontispiece of the Pink Paws Bank Employee Handbook: In tribute to the great Lord Ladon.</>
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_UltraSkill_background: <Italic>I will be the only one to win this battle.</>
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_QTE_background: <Italic>No matter where she is, Chiz is always the most agreeable one around. Whatever you ask of her, she'll do her best to help, even if it means wearing herself out.</>
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_Melee_background: <Italic>Jade for good times, grain for lean times.</>
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_Passive1_background: <Italic>Longing… it's a white bird rising from a wound. If only you could see.</>
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_Passive2_background: <Italic>The past is a bottomless ravine. No matter how many stones you throw, not a single echo ever returns.</>
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_Passive1_des: <TextHLT>Charge Enhancement</>: Grants active characters 4 additional Ultimate Energy.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_Passive1_des_tidy: <TextHLT>Charge Enhancement</>: Grants active characters 4 additional Ultimate Energy.
Chiichan_SkillDes.ChiichanSkill_2_des: Hit DMG Ratio of Half Grain
Chiichan_SkillDes.ChiichanSkill_2_Heterochrome_des: Hit Cycle Energy of Half Grain
Chiichan_SkillDes.ChiichanSkill_2_loop_des: Per Instance DMG Ratio of Half Grain
Chiichan_SkillDes.ChiichanSkill_CostCoin_des: Per Instance Cost of Half Grain
Chiichan_SkillDes.ChiichanSkill_2_loop_Heterochrome_des: Per Instance Cycle Energy of Half Grain
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_starExtra1_des: Increases Grain acquisition efficiency by an extra 50% while in the Debt state.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_star3_des: Increases the chance of a Grain Price increase by 50%.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_star1_des: Increases the storage capacity of Grain and Grain Loan by 10%.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_star6_des: Increases the Bonus Cosmos DMG of Grain by 15%.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_UltraSkill_des:
No turning back, max the leverage. Throws Brown Sugar Boba to strike, dealing AoE <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> once and entering Grain Market for 7s. During this time, the first Grain Settlement DMG is guaranteed to Crit.
Converts all remaining <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes4">Grain Loans</> into <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grains</> and enters the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes2">Surplus</> state after casting Zero-Sum Game. Invests all Grains into the Grain Market. Afterward, press Pink Paws Priority Principle to gain Grains based on current <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes5">Grain Price</> fluctuations during <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes6">Grain Settlement</>. Hold Pink Paws Priority Principle to trigger Grain Settlement once based on the Grain Price on first activation.
Leaves the Grain Market and prioritizes repaying Grain Loans with all available Grains when Grain Market duration ends.
Grants access to the Grain Market while in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes3">Debt</> state and holding any Grain Loans.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_star3_name: If There Were No Rainy Days
Chiichan_SkillDes.Buff_Chiichan073_Branch_Cheat_des: Cooldown: 2.5s. Prevents using Blighted Vale during this period.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_Skill_des_tidy:
Redirect Skill can accumulate up to 3 charges.

Press consecutively to cast 3 instances of the skill, consuming corresponding skill charges and dealing additional <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to the target based on current Grain count. Cannot Crit.

Hold to consecutively cast 3 instances of the skill, consuming corresponding skill charges. During the second instance, <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grain</> is continuously consumed, dealing consecutive bonus <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> based on the Grain consumed. Cannot Crit.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_Skill_des:
The more, the merrier; the more, the better. Stacks Redirect Skill attempts, up to 3 stacks

Press Redirect Skill to consume 1 stack and cast No Grain, dealing Cosmos DMG once. Press Redirect Skill consecutively to consume stacks and cast No Grain, Half Grain, and Full Grain in order, up to 3 times in a row.
Press to cast Pink Paws Priority Principle while in the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes2">Surplus</> state, dealing bonus <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> based on available <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grains</> using Redirect Skills. Cannot Crit.

Hold Redirect Skill to consume 2 stacks and cast No Grain and Half Grain. Continuously consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grains</> while Half Grain is active, dealing consecutive bonus <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> based on available Grains. Cannot Crit. Consumes all available Grains (including all <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes4">Grain Loans</> from the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes3">Debt</> state) when Half Grain ends. Press Redirect Skill again to consume 1 stack and end Half Grain early, allowing Full Grain to be cast without consuming Grains. Hold Redirect Skill to consume 3 stacks and use all available Grains (including all Grain Loans from the Debt state). Casts No Grain, Half Grain, and Full Grain in order.
Hold to cast Pink Paws Priority Principle while Surplus is active, dealing bonus <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> with No Grain based on remaining Grains. Cannot Crit.
Chiichan_SkillDes.ChiichanRes3_des: Chiz enters this state when Grain is not available.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_star5_des: Grants Chiz Grain equal to 100% of the Grain storage limit upon entering combat.
Chiichan_SkillDes.ChiichanRes1_des: A special combat resource possessed by Chiz after joining the team. Generates Grain when using Exiled Swordplay, Blighted Vale, Bountiful Grain, Minsky Moment, or through interest.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_Passive2_des: Increases Chiz's Charge Efficiency by 20% while on the field.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_Passive2_des_tidy: Increases Chiz's Charge Efficiency by 20% while on the field.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_starExtra2_des: Reduces the target's Cosmos Resistance by 10% upon Chiz dealing damage.
Chiichan_SkillDes.ChiichanRes2_des: Chiz enters this state when Grain is available.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_Melee1_des: Swings the short staff to perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>. Grants <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grain</> on hit.
Chiichan_SkillDes.ChiichanRes4_des: A special combat resource possessed by Chiz after consuming all Grains. Deals DMG by consuming Grain Loan.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_Melee3_des: Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing 1 instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area upon impact, while granting a certain amount of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grain</>. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_Melee2_des:
Press Blighted Vale to throw Brown Sugar Boba to devour the target, dealing 2 instance of Cosmos DMG, granting a certain amount of Grain and Fons. Triggers up to once every 2.5s.
Hold Blighted Vale during any instance of Exiled Swordplay attacks to create a branch attack, dealing 2 instance of Cosmos DMG and granting a certain amount of Grain and Fons.
Grants bonus Fons if this skill defeats the target.
Up to 250,000 Fons can be earned this way. Increasing the Tycoon Level to 25 raises the cap to 500,000 Fons. Grants 1 Fons per use once the daily cap is reached. After reaching the total limit, no more Fons can be obtained this way.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_QTE_des:
Hope I can m-make it in time…
Brown Sugar Boba carries Chiz and crashes into the target, dealing 1 instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_star2_des: Grants 10% of current Grain as interest per second while Chiz is in the Surplus state.
Chiichan_SkillDes.Chiichan_melee_coin1_des: Per Instance of Normal Attack: Grain Count
Chiichan_SkillDes.Chiichan_branch_coin4_des: Branch Attack: Grain Count (Press Basic Attack)
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_PerfectEvade_des: Triggers when pressing Basic Attack after a Critical Dodge. Leaps to evade and swings the staff, sending Brown Sugar Boba crashing into the target, dealing 1 instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>, reducing Break, and granting <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grain</>.
Chiichan_SkillDes.ChiichanRes6_des:
Press Redirect Skill after entering the Grain Market to settle based on the current Grain price shown on the chart, gaining the corresponding amount of Grain. Hold Redirect Skill to settle all current Grain, dealing bonus Cosmos DMG based on the amount of Grain consumed.
Each press of Redirect Skill triggers one Grain Settlement. Holding Redirect Skill triggers only one Grain Settlement.
Chiichan_SkillDes.ChiichanRes5_des:
Displays a fluctuating price chart upon entering the Grain Market, showing the current Grain price. The chart forecasts price trends every 0.5s for the next 3.5s.
While the chart is active, the Grain price randomly fluctuates within a range of −50% to +50% based on the previous price.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_Melee1_des_tidy: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>. Grants <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grain</> on hit.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_Melee3_des_tidy: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>. Grants <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grain</> on hit.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_PerfectEvade_des_tidy: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>. Grants <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grain</> on hit.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_Melee2_des_tidy:
Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>. Grants <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grain</> on hit. Grants Fons on the first hit against the same target. Grants bonus Fons if this skill defeats the target.
Fons obtained through this method has a daily limit and a total limit. Increase acquisition limits by raising Tycoon Level.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_UltraSkill_des_tidy:
Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> and enters the Grain Market for 7s. During this time, the first Grain Settlement DMG is guaranteed to Crit. Immediately grants <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes4">Grain Loan</>.

Press Redirect Skill to settle the current Grain amount based on the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes5">Grain Price</> on first activation. Triggers <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes6">Grain Settlement</> when starting the next Redirect Skill 

Hold Redirect Skill to settle the current Grain amount based on the Grain Price on first activation. Grain Settlement will not be triggered when starting the next Redirect Skill.

Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_UtraSkill_background:
<Italic>"I have lost everything. What exactly am I supposed to toast to?"</>
<Italic>"Do you need a reason to toast? Well… then let's toast to absolute despair, to skies we've never seen, and to the one and only narcissus blooming in the heart of this lake."</>
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_QTE_background: <Italic>The bodyguard at Eibon Antique Shop has always been reliable. Her clean, efficient skills inspire confidence that, as long as she‘s trusted, any problem can be solved with ease.</>
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_Skill_background: <Italic>A girl trapped in a beautiful garden was no more than a prisoner in a cave. Only after gaining kaleidoscope eyes that could see through all things did she feel her way along the walls and stumble into a new world.</>
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_Passive_2_background: <Italic>She once wandered the gray borderlands like a machine, but now she has somewhere to call home.</>
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_Passive_1_background: <Italic>Beneath her expressionless façade, fleeting moments of tenderness may appear, like sunlight dancing on snow.</>
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_Passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Discord Enhancement</>: Further reduces the target's Break cap by 10% for 30s while affected by Discord and restores it to normal upon leaving combat. Stacks Discord Enhancement effects up to a maximum reduction of 20% of the target's initial Break cap.
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_Passive_2_des: Increases <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillQTE">Phantom Step</> DMG by 80%.
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_starExtra1_des: Increases the skill level of Still Waters, Resonance, and Witness This Finale by 1.
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_Skill1_des: Resonating with the blade. Deals damage to the target. Grants Resonance stacks and increases damage when any team member casts a Support Skill. Increases Resonance's DMG and Break per Support Skill cast, up to 2 stacks. Enhances Resonance and replaces it with Echoes when stacks reach the maximum.
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_Melee2_des: Light and shadow exist in separate realms. Daffodill's Break Damage contribution is increased by 20%.
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_star1_des: Increases allies' Resonance's DMG by <NumGreen>100%</> and Break by <NumGreen>250%</> per Support Skill cast.
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_Skill2_des: Resonance carries sound, echo responds in kind. Swiftly shifts her stance, swinging her blade with the rope to deal <An>Chaos DMG</> to the target.
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_Daffodill_Melee4_des: Press dodge to trigger the special dodge action Displaced Edge during Still Waters. Grants invincibility during the action and does not interrupt the current combo.
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_Daffodill_Melee4_des_Tidy: Press dodge to trigger a special dodge action during basic attacks. Grants invincibility during the action and does not interrupt the current combo.
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_star2_des: Deals high damage to the target, generates Break, and fully charges Finale with the final attack if <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillQTE">Phantom Step</> fails to Parry Attack the target.
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_star4_des: Increases Break DMG by <NumGreen>15%</> for each stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillInsight">Insight</> when a target enters Break while under the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillInsight">Insight</> effect.
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_star5_des: Deals <NumGreen>1</> additional instance of Break Damage per stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillInsight">Insight</> if the target enters Break while affected by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillInsight">Insight</>.
Daffodill_SkillDes.Daffodill_DongCha_des: Deals additional Break Damage and removes the Insight effect if the target enters Break while affected by Insight.
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_Melee1_des: Her heart is as calm as still waters, long accustomed to battle. Wields her twin blades to perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <An>Chaos DMG</>.
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_Melee3_des: I am here. Hold Basic Attack to trigger. Dashes forward, performing a whirlwind slash and leaving behind marks, dealing <An>Chaos DMG</>.
Daffodill_SkillDes.Daffodill_ZhiYuan_des: Automatically casts Phantom Step when switching to Daffodill from another character during battle while targets are present. Deals high damage and Break and instantly charges Finale to full if Phantom Step successfully performs a Parry Attack on a target. Casts Crossed Blades first when it is present upon switching to Daffodill, then automatically casts Phantom Step. Treats a successful Parry Attack from Crossed Blades as a successful Phantom Step Parry Attack in this case.
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_QTE_des: Leave the rest to me. Swings her blade in a slashing motion, dealing 1 instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to the target.
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_starExtra2_des: Reduces a target's Chaos Resistance by <NumGreen>15%</> when they enter Break.
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_star3_des: Prevents <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillInsight">Insight</> from being removed once applied, except when the target is neutralized or leaves combat. Allows repeated applications to stack, up to <NumGreen>2</> stacks.
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_PerfectEvade_des: Triggers when using Still Waters after performing a Critical Dodge. Instantly lifts her foot, pulling the rope to swing her blade toward the target, dealing 1 instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> and reducing Break.
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_Daffodill_Melee5_des: Wields her weapon while airborne and plunges, dealing 1 instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_star6_des: Ignores <NumGreen>15%</> of the target's DEF when dealing damage.
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_UtraSkill_des: Casts Finale, dealing <An>Chaos DMG</> to enemies in an area. Unseals her left eye, increasing damage and inflicting <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillInsight">Insight</> on nearby enemies for the duration. Unlocks the skill <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillQTE">Phantom Step</>, which can be used up to 2 times. Casting Finale resets Phantom Step charges.
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_Skill1_des_Tidy: Deals <An>Chaos DMG</>. Grants Resonance stacks and increases damage when any team member casts a Support Skill, up to 2 stacks. Enhances Resonance and replaces it with Echoes when stacks reach the maximum.
Daffodill_SkillDes.GA_daffodill_UtraSkill_des_Tidy: Deals <An>Chaos DMG</> and unseals the left eye, increasing damage and inflicting <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillInsight">Insight</> on nearby enemies for the duration. Unlocks the skill <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillQTE">Phantom Step</>, which can be used up to 2 times. Casting Finale resets Phantom Step charges.

DefendNS.MonAbility_BOSS_1_desc: The two Bosses are linked by Symbiosis. If one is defeated and the other remains alive within a certain time, the fallen Boss revives and restores some HP.
DefendNS.Red_6_desc: Increases all allies' stamina cap by <Green>50</>.
DefendNS.Red_5_desc: Increases all allies' Break Intensity by <Green>7%</>.
DefendNS.Blue_3_desc: Deals Fixed DMG equal to <Green>50%</> of the attacking ally's ATK to an enemy every second for <Yellow>5</>s after the enemy takes DMG from an ally. (Multiple selections do not extend the duration.)
DefendNS.Blue_1_desc: Reduces an enemy's Movement Speed by <Green>10%</> for <Yellow>10</>s when damaged by an ally. (Multiple selections do not extend the duration.)
DefendNS.Blue_2_desc: Generates additional aggro toward the player for <Green>5</>s when an ally attacks an enemy. (Multiple selections do not increase the extra aggro generated.)
DefendNS.Red_2_desc: Increases all allies' Crit Rate by <Green>4%</> and Crit DMG by <Green>12%</>.
DefendNS.Red_3_desc: Increases all allies' Cycle Intensity by <Green>72</>.
DefendNS.Green_1_desc: Increases all allies' Max HP by <Green>17.5%</>.
DefendNS.Red_4_desc: Increases all allies' Movement Speed by <Green>20%</>.
DefendNS.Blue_4_desc: Restores HP equal to <Green>5%</> of the DMG dealt whenever the active character attacks an enemy.
DefendNS.Green_2_desc: Restores <Green>5%</> of the active character's Max HP every second.
DefendNS.MonAbility_Common_1_desc: Attacking an enemy briefly increases its aggro toward you.
DefendNS.Green_5_desc: Increases Coal Lump's Max HP by <Green>20%</>.
DefendNS.Green_4_desc: Immediately restores <Green>25%</> of Coal Lump's Max HP.
DefendNS.MonAbilityUp_2_desc: Restores <Red>20%</> of Max HP to certain enemies when their HP falls below <Red>30%</> of Max HP.
DefendNS.EliteAbilityUp_2_desc: Some enemies have an aura that continuously deals DMG to characters.
DefendNS.EliteAbilityUp_1_desc: Some enemies are protected by a shield that breaks after 15 hits. They take no DMG while shielded.
DefendNS.MonAbilityUp_3_desc: Increases certain enemies' All Resistances by <Red>10%</>.
DefendNS.MonAbilityUp_1_desc: Increases certain enemies' Movement Speed by <Red>10%</>.
DefendNS.MonAbility_BOSS_3_desc: The Boss periodically summons enemies (Summoned enemies do not count toward your score). Elite enemies will also appear.
DefendNS.MonAbility_BOSS_2_desc: The Boss periodically summons enemies nearby (Summoned enemies do not count toward your score.).
DefendNS.EliteAbilityUp_3_desc: Bosses have an aura that continuously slows characters.

Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_Melee_background: <Italic>Edgar believes there must be a more humane way to contain them. Until that solution is found, he is forced to rely on rougher methods.</>
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_Passive_1_background: <Italic>Like many geniuses, Edgar carries a quiet pride. Unlike most, his brilliance is gentle and understated, guiding him through every challenge he has faced.</>
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_UltraSkill_background: <Italic>Always curious, always questioning. Edgar often slips into deep thought without warning. Pulling him out of his complex musings is no easy task.</>
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_Passive_2_background: <Italic>Whenever Edgar sees the warm lights of Eibon, comfort rises in his heart. In an ever-changing world, this warmth remains a constant.</>
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_Skill_background: <Italic>Healing is important work. Edgar realized that the rules he learned from games apply in real life as well.</>
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_Passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Charge Enhancement</>: Grants 120 Ultimate Energy instantly when a character triggers Charge using a Support Skill. Disables Ultimate Energy gain from Vita Pistils when hitting Slowed targets afterward. Cooldown: 30s.
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_Passive_1_des_tidy: <TextHLT>Charge Enhancement</>: Grants 120 Ultimate Energy instantly when a character triggers Charge using a Support Skill. Disables Ultimate Energy gain from Vita Pistils when hitting Slowed targets afterward. Cooldown: 30s.
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_starExtra1_des: Increases the skill level of Wild Current, Finnegan's Wake, and Weight of Knowledge by <NumGreen>1</>.
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_star3_des: Increases Wild Current's healing effectiveness for allies with current HP below <NumGreen>30%</> by <NumGreen>15%</>.
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_star6_des: Grants <NumGreen>15%</> DEF to all allies in the range of Finnegan's Wake.
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_star1_des: Grants Edgar 1 <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&EdgarKey">Key of Truth</> whenever any teammate casts a Support Skill.
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_star5_name: Guardian of the Antique Shop's Light
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_UltraSkill_des: Immerses in his own thoughts, unleashing a labyrinthine domain for 10s. Deals 1 instance of AoE <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>. Heals the current character over the domain's duration.
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_Melee1_des: Applies what he learned in Twinkle School of Espers' physical education class to perform up to 5 consecutive attacks that deal <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_Melee2_des: Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_star2_des: Caps the max cooldown extension from Wild Current at <NumGreen>3</>s.
Edgar_SkillDes.EdgarKey_des:
Obtained by casting Redirect Skill Wild Current or Support Skill Weight of Knowledge after unlocking Passive Unchanging Warmth.
Each Key of Truth extends the duration of Ultimate: Finnegan's Vigil by 1s.
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_Melee3_des:
Triggers when using Combat Practice after a Critical Dodge.
Charges toward the target and uses his backpack to unleash a Flow attack, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area and reducing Break.
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_QTE_des: This bag is really heavy. Edgar charges toward the target and swings his bag with all his might, dealing 1 instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area.
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_UltraSkill_des_tidy: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> and heals the current character continuously.
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_Skill_des_tidy: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>, heals the teammate with the lowest HP.
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_Passive_2_des:
Cast Redirect Skill Wild Current or Support Skill Weight of Knowledge to gain a Key of Truth, up to 3 keys.
Each Key of Truth extends the duration of Ultimate: Finnegan's Vigil by 1s.
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_Passive_2_des_tidy:
Cast Redirect Skill Wild Current or Support Skill Weight of Knowledge to gain a Key of Truth, up to 3 keys.
Each Key of Truth extends the duration of Ultimate: Finnegan's Vigil by 1s.
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_Skill_des:
Hold to enter a channeling state, continuously casting Current at the target, dealing <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> and continuously healing the teammate with the lowest HP.
The CD of Redirect Skill: Wild Current increases based on the duration of use.
Edgar_SkillDes.GA_Edgar_starExtra2_des: Edgar's thoughts are stirred by his allies' safety. Converts <NumGreen>3%</> of any teammate's Max HP lost into <NumGreen>1</> Charge for Finnegan's Vigil, up to <NumGreen>20</> Charges. Resets after casting Finnegan's Vigil.

Elyms_SkillDes.GA_Elyms_Passive_1_background: <Italic>"The signal's too weak! Let me crank up the power!"</>
Elyms_SkillDes.GA_Elyms_Passive_2_background: <Italic>Of course we've gotta get in tip-top shape before a big battle!</>
Elyms_SkillDes.GA_Elyms_QTE_background: <Italic>"Do you remember me? I've been here all along."</>
Elyms_SkillDes.GA_Elyms_Skill1_des:
<Italic>Like the one yet to arrive.</>
Controls the Dreamworn Terminal, dealing <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to targets in an area.
Allows Elyms to cast Intermittent Existence directly within a limited time after casting this skill while at <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Weak Connection</>.
Elyms_SkillDes.GA_Elyms_UltraSkill_background:
<Italic>Just another ordinary day. We booted up the game we still hadn't finished, hung out, laughed at the silliest little things, stopped by our usual spot, said our goodbyes, and promised to meet again.</>
<Italic>The same routine, playing out just like yesterday.</>

<Italic>Nothing has changed, and nothing ever will. If only things could stay this way…</>
<Italic>To confirm, press 1. To confirm, press 2. To confirm, press 3. To confirm, press 4. To confirm, press 5. To confirm, press 6. To confirm, press 7. To confirm, press 8. To confirm, press 9. To confirm, press 0. To confirm, press #.</>
Elyms_SkillDes.GA_Elyms_Melee1_des:
<Italic>A longing for an immediate response.</>
Elyms's connection has varying levels of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Connection Strength</>. Controls the Dreamworn Terminal to perform up to five consecutive attacks when she is at the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Weak Connection</> level, dealing <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.
Allows Elyms to activate Intermittent Existence directly for a short time after performing the final instance of Instant Glitch.
Elyms_SkillDes.GA_Elyms_Melee2_des:
<Italic>A regret that time cannot fade.</>
Controls the Dreamworn Terminal to perform up to three consecutive attacks when she is at the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Medium Connection</> or <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Strong Connection</> level, dealing <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.
Allows Goodbye to You to be activated directly for a limited time after Elyms performs the final instance of Crosstalk while in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Medium Connection</> or <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Strong Connection</>.
Elyms_SkillDes.GA_Elyms_Melee5_des:
<Italic>Falling in a dream once again.</>
Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, by up to <NumGreen>100%</>.
Elyms_SkillDes.Elyms_propNoun2_des:
<Italic>Even if hope is only an illusion layered upon another…</>
Grants the time-limited <TextHLT>Optical Illusion</> buff when Connection Strength increases from <TextHLT>Weak Connection</> to <TextHLT>Medium Connection</>.
Consumes all <TextHLT>Optical Illusions</> to increase the skill's DMG Ratio based on the number of stacks when casting Goodbye to You.
Elyms_SkillDes.GA_Elyms_QTE_des:
<Italic>Online!</> Controls the Dreamworn Terminal, dealing <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.
Upgrades her <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Weak Connection</> state to <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Medium Connection</> after casting I'm Here while she is active. Checks the number of targets within a certain range and automatically switches Do You Get Deja Vu between its single-target and AoE forms accordingly.
Grants the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun2">Optical Illusion</> for a limited time when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Weak Connection</> is upgraded to <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Medium Connection</>.
Elyms_SkillDes.GA_Elyms_UtraSkill_des:
<Italic>The ordinary moments of our lives may be miracles still unfolding.</>
<Italic>Whose fleeting shadow will you glimpse in a scene from yesterday?</>

Features both single-target and AoE forms.
Defaults to the AoE form at <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Weak Connection</>.
At <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Medium Connection</> or <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Strong Connection</>, automatically switches between the two forms based on the target-scan results of the Intermittent Existence, Goodbye to You, and I'm Here while she is active.
The DMG Ratio of Do You Get Deja Vu is determined by her <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Connection Strength</> at the time of casting. After casting or leaving combat, her <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Connection Strength</> resets to <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Weak Connection</>.

Grants the whole team an ATK Bonus based on her Base ATK after casting Do You Get Deja Vu, increasing their Follow-up Attack DMG for a limited time.
Grants the <TextHLT>On the Line</> buff. While this buff is active, <TextHLT>Remembrance</> automatically triggers as a coordinated attack if Elyms is off-field.
<TextHLT>Remembrance</> takes the same single-target or AoE form as the preceding Do You Get Deja Vu, with its DMG Ratio determined by her <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Connection Strength</> when that skill was cast.
<TextHLT>DMG dealt by Remembrance</> counts as Follow-up Attack DMG.
<TextHLT>The On the Line</> buff ends when <TextHLT>Remembrance</> reaches its use limit.
Elyms_SkillDes.GA_Elyms_PerfectEvade_des:
<Italic>High five! Fist bump! Friends for life!</>
Triggers when pressing Basic Attack after performing a Critical Dodge, dealing <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.
Elyms_SkillDes.GA_Elyms_Skill3_des:
<Italic>The unknown world is a midsummer mirage, and even you are a distant phantom.</>
Allows Elyms to activate Goodbye to You directly for a short time after performing the final instance of Crosstalk at <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Medium Connection</> or <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Strong Connection</>.
Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to targets in an area. Consumes all existing <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun2">Optical Illusion</> stacks when cast, increasing this skill's DMG Ratio based on the number consumed.
After casting, advances her Connection Strength to <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Strong Connection</> if she is in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Medium Connection</>. Automatically scans nearby targets and switches her Ultimate between its AoE and single-target forms based on the number detected.
Elyms_SkillDes.GA_Elyms_Skill_background:
<Italic>There's no band, and yet… we can hear music.</>
<Italic>There's no band at all! It's just… a recording.</>
<Italic>There is no &^%$#@!@#$%^&*&^%$#@!@#$%^&*&^%$#@!@#$%^&*&^%$#, it's all</>
<Italic>■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■</>

<Italic>Silence…</>
<Italic>Silence?</>
<Italic>Silence.</>
<Italic>My friend.</>
Elyms_SkillDes.GA_Elyms_Skill2_des:
<Italic>Continuity is the past pressing ever forward, slowly eroding the future.</>
Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to targets in an area. Increases her Connection Strength from Weak Connection to <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Medium Connection</> after casting Intermittent Existence at <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Weak Connection</>. Automatically switches Do You Get Deja Vu between its AoE and single-target forms based on the number of targets within range.
Grants <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun2">Optical Illusion</> for a limited time when her Connection Strength increases from <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Weak Connection</> to <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Medium Connection</>.
Elyms_SkillDes.GA_Elyms_Melee_background:
<Italic>Observation Note #■■■</>
<Italic>Research Subject: Instant Messaging</>

<Italic>Instant messaging arose from the human desire to "get an immediate response." A sender can type out "something they want to get off their chest" and receive a reply from the recipient.</>
<Italic>Such connections are unstable. The recipient interacts with the sender's digital avatar, but whether they get a response depends on the human original.</>
<Italic>An experiment involving Test Subject #■■■ found that a brief loss of connection between a digital avatar and its human original significantly increased satisfaction on both sides.</>
<Italic>This research is ongoing.</>
Elyms_SkillDes.GA_Elyms_Melee4_des:
<Italic>Let's… remember it once more…</>
Press Aim at any <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Connection Strength</> level to cast Memory Anchor, dealing <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.
Elyms_SkillDes.GA_Elyms_Melee3_des:
<Italic>It's still a little blurry…</>
Hold Basic Attack during Instant Glitch while she is at <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Weak Connection</> level to trigger Interference, dealing <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.

Elyms_SkillDes.Elyms_propNoun1_des:
As a being from the electronic world, Elyms's connection to reality is measured by <TextHLT>Connection Strength</>, which has three levels: <TextHLT>Weak Connection</>, <TextHLT>Medium Connection</>, and <TextHLT>Strong Connection</>.
Increases Connection Strength to <TextHLT>Medium Connection</> after casting I'm Here or Intermittent Existence while at <TextHLT>Weak Connection</>.
Increases Connection Strength to <TextHLT>Strong Connection</> after casting Goodbye to You while at <TextHLT>Medium Connection</>.
Resets <TextHLT>Connection Strength</> to <TextHLT>Weak Connection</> after casting Do You Get Deja Vu or leaving combat.
Elyms cannot increase <TextHLT>Connection Strength</> while off-field.

At <TextHLT>Weak Connection</>, performing the final instance of Instant Glitch or casting The Ones Who Left allows Elyms to cast Intermittent Existence directly within a limited time. This opportunity ends when she casts Intermittent Existence or leaves <TextHLT>Weak Connection</>.

Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_UltraSkill_background: <Italic>"Since the Director chose to exploit this instability, my duty is to observe and restrict it—to ensure such dangerous volatility stays within controllable bounds."</>

Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_Passive_3_background:
<Italic>When Skia and Lacrimosa passed by Tamamochi Street after a mission, Lacrimosa went into a 2-Four Convenience Store. She thought she'd walk out with arms full of free tomato jelly packets, just like how Fadia always gets showered with gifts…</>
<Italic>In the end, all she got was a reward that Skia bought right there and then.</>
Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_Passive_2_background: <Italic>If you want it, go grab it.</>
Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_Passive_1_background: <Italic>More… MORE! Fill this void—if you can!</>
Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_Melee_background: <Italic>The most laughable thing about being alive is how you bow to self-evident meanings and submit to the power of orders. So why not laugh at you pitiful worms?</>
Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_Passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Nova Enhancement</>: Allows all allies to drain Max HP from the target when Nova ends. The target loses Max HP equal to 200% of Fadia's base Max HP, and each ally gains Max HP equal to 10% of Fadia's base Max HP. Total drained cannot exceed 50% of Fadia's base Max HP. Restores both parties' stats upon exiting combat.
Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_star4_des: Increases Fadia's healing ratio to <NumGreen>30%</> of Max HP while in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">Lilith</> form. Further increases the healing ratio to <NumGreen>60%</> of Max HP when her lost HP is greater than or equal to the <TextHLT>Destructive Threshold</>.
Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_star5_des: Increases Fadia's CRIT Rate by <NumGreen>50%</> while in Lilith state.
Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_star6_des: Inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">Destructive Experience</> on up to <NumGreen>10</> targets within range. Each <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">Destructive Experience</>'s duration and damage cap are calculated individually.
Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_starExtra1_des: Increases the skill level of Wordless Rejection, Existence, and Agony to Euphoria by <NumGreen>1</>.
Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_Skill_des:
Come, have a taste of this. Deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area and inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">Destructive Experience</> on the enemy with the highest Max HP in the area for a period.
During the duration, when Fadia takes damage, the target shares a percentage of the damage taken.
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">Destructive Experience</> ends when the duration expires, when the Redirection DMG taken by the target reaches its cap, or when the target and Fadia leave combat.
Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_UtraSkill_des:
Without pain, life closes in on itself. Enters <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">Lilith</> state, dealing <NumGreen>6</> instances of Mental DMG and restoring HP. Recasts Wordless Rejection while in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">Lilith</> state to perform up to <NumGreen>5</> follow-up attacks, each dealing Mental DMG.
Fully restores the energy of Agony to Euphoria when lost HP reaches the <TextHLT>Destructive Threshold</>. Increases the damage and HP restored by Agony to Euphoria when it is cast with lost HP greater than or equal to the <TextHLT>Destructive Threshold</>.
Exits <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">Lilith</> state when the duration ends, all 5 follow-up attacks are performed, characters are switched, or other skills of Fadia are used.
Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_Passive_2_des: Like a baby yearning for nourishment from mommy. When Fadia is in the team, increases team max HP by <NumGreen>10%</>.
Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_starExtra2_des: Grants all team members 10% ATK while Fadia is on the team.
Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_Melee2_des:
When Fadia's current HP is greater than <NumGreen>1</>, she redirects a portion of damage taken by her teammates to herself before any shield mitigation is applied. Redirected damage cannot be further redistributed.
Once Fadia's current HP drops to <NumGreen>1</>, she ceases to redirect damage. At this point, if Fadia receives damage, she will share it with surviving teammates before any shield mitigation, and will absorb the remaining damage herself.
Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_Skill1_des:
Shares a percentage of the damage Fadia takes with the target during the duration.
Removes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">Destructive Experience</> when the duration ends, when the Shared DMG taken by the target through <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">Destructive Experience</> reaches its cap, or when the target and Fadia leave combat.
Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_star2_des: Increases the damage ratio enemies take through <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">Destructive Experience</> to <NumGreen>600%</> and raises its damage cap to <NumGreen>25%</> of Fadia’s Max HP. Deals immediate damage equal to the difference between the damage already taken and the damage cap when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">Destructive Experience</> is removed.
Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_Melee3_des: Swings her cross shield in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_Passive_3_des: Allows Fadia to receive special gifts from shopkeepers who take a liking to her while exploring the city.

Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_QTE_des: Swings her cross shield, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area.

Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_star1_des: Fadia's damage redirect ratio is increased to <NumGreen>75%</>.
Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_UtraSkill_des_Tidy:
Enters <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">Lilith</> state, dealing 6 instances of Mental DMG and restoring HP. Performs up to 5 follow-up attacks while in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">Lilith</> state, each dealing Mental DMG.
Fully restores the Ultimate's energy when lost HP reaches the <TextHLT>Destructive Threshold</>. Increases the damage and HP restored when casting the Ultimate with lost HP greater than or equal to the <TextHLT>Destructive Threshold</>.
Fadia_SkillDes.Fadia_Skill_des: A special effect that Fadia attaches to the target. Causes the target to share a percentage of the damage Fadia takes during the duration.
Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_PerfectEvade_des: Triggers when casting Wordless Rejection after a Critical Dodge. Charges toward the target at high speed and deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area, reducing Break.
Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_star3_des: Upon entering combat, Fadia increases her base Max HP by <NumGreen>30%</>. After leaving combat, she loses the increased Max HP.
Fadia_SkillDes.GA_Fadia_Skill1_des_Tidy: Deals <Hun>Psyche DMG</> and inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">Destructive Experience</> on the enemy with the highest Max HP.

Female_SkillDes.GA_Female_Passive_2_background: <Italic>Where will this ability to read and understand anomalies lead me?</>

Female_SkillDes.GA_F_Melee1_des: Swordsmanship in second nature. Performe up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks.
Female_SkillDes.GA_Female_UtraSkill_des: As I dance, I'll be sweeping away Nexus lines that only I can see. Deals multiple instances of damage.
