Female_SkillDes.GA_Female_star5_des: After triggering any Cosmos Esper Cycle, the character's ATK is increased by <NumGreen>15%</> for 20 seconds.

Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_Skill_background: <Italic>O owl of the quiet, moonlit forest depths, I, Haniel, hereby forge a contract with you! …Come on, Hootie, work with me here.</>
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_QTE_background: <Italic>Haniel loves catching every Easter egg. Even when the theater lights come up early, she stubbornly watches until the very last second of the film.</>
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_Passive_1_background: <Italic>For Haniel, she'd rather hear lively stories about companions than lonely tales of heroism. Even a bunch of hot-headed fools would be fine.</>
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_UltraSkill_background: <Italic>You won't find Genesse Girls' Academy on any map of Hethereau, and naturally you won't find the Paranormal Department either. This story begins with Haniel's first serialized novel…</>
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_Passive_2_background: <Italic>Sports anime makes you want to play sports. Band anime makes you want to learn an instrument. Battle anime… well, I wouldn't recommend trying that.</>
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_Melee_background: <Italic>The difference between magic tricks and real magic? As long as you believe, it exists… Like conjuring orbs with your bare hands?</>
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_Passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Nova Enhancement</>: Allows all allies to drain ATK from the target when Nova ends. The target loses ATK equal to 4% of Haniel's Base ATK, and each ally gains ATK equal to 8% of Haniel's Base ATK. The total drain is capped at 16% of Haniel's Base ATK, and the target cannot lose more than 20% of their initial ATK. Restores both parties' stats upon exiting combat.
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_star1_des: Increases Plot Armor's max stacks to <NumGreen>6</> and raises Paranormal Cannon's ricochet limit to <NumGreen>6</>.
Haniel_SkillDes.Haniel_Skill_des: While Hootie is active, grants Hootie <NumGreen>1</> stack when the current character attacks, with a maximum of <NumGreen>1</> stack gained every <NumGreen>0.5s</>, up to <NumGreen>4</> stacks.
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_starExtra1_des: Increases the skill level of Genesse Technique, Silent Moonlit Forest Guardian, and A Melody Named Haniel by <NumGreen>1</>.
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_star2_name: Legendary! The g'old back row window seat!
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_QTE_des: Don't be so boring! How about a little easter egg? Fires <NumGreen>1</> magic projectile at the enemy, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_Melee2_des: Hold Basic Attack during the 1st hit to charge, then fire <NumGreen>a</> charged cannon forward.
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_Melee1_des: Fires magic projectiles and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_Melee3_des: Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_UltraSkill_des_short: Haniel enters Paranormal Ace state, enhancing Hootie's effects and boosting her own abilities.
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_star3_des: Increases Haniel's Crit Chance by <NumGreen>20%</> while in Paranormal Ace state.
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_starExtra2_des: Increases the team's Crit DMG by <NumGreen>12%</> while in the Paranormal Ace state.
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_star5_des: Increases Haniel's <Hun>Psyche DMG</> by <NumGreen>30%</> while in Paranormal Ace state.
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_star4_des: While in Paranormal Ace state, if Haniel triggers <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">Ensemble</>, her next attack's additional DMG increases by <NumGreen>100%</>.
Haniel_SkillDes.Haniel_Passive_2_des: Grants Haniel <NumGreen>1</> stack of <TextEXPL>Plot Armor</> when the current character triggers <TextEXPL>Ensemble</>, increasing the ricochet cap of Paranormal Cannon. Grants <NumGreen>1</> stack of <TextEXPL>Plot Armor</> <NumGreen>per</> <TextEXPL>Ensemble</> trigger.Grants <NumGreen>2</> stacks of <TextEXPL>Plot Armor</> <NumGreen>per</> <TextEXPL>Ensemble</> trigger while Haniel is in Paranormal Ace state. Can accumulate up to <NumGreen>4</> stacks of <TextEXPL>Plot Armor</>.
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_Passive_2_des:
Grants Haniel <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielPassive2">Plot Armor</> when the current character triggers <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">Ensemble</>, increasing the ricochet cap of Paranormal Cannon. Grants <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielPassive2">Plot Armor</> <NumGreen>per</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">Ensemble</> trigger.
Grants <NumGreen>2</> stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielPassive2">Plot Armor</> <NumGreen>per</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">Ensemble</> trigger while Haniel is in Paranormal Ace state.
Can accumulate up to <NumGreen>4</> stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielPassive2">Plot Armor</>.
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_star1_name: New here! Genius transfer student reporting in!
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_Skill_des:
"O owl of the quiet, moonlit forest depths, answer my call!" Throws her portable speaker Hootie, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area.
Grants the Team an ATK bonus based on Haniel's Base ATK while Hootie is active.
Grants Hootie <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielSkill">Four-Part Harmony</> when the current character attacks, up to <NumGreen>1</> stack every <NumGreen>0.5s</>. Accumulating <NumGreen>4</> stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielSkill">Four-Part Harmony</> triggers <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">Ensemble</>, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to enemies in an area around Hootie.
Only <NumGreen>1</> Hootie can exist at a time. Casting again refreshes Hootie's duration. Hootie remains when switching characters.
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_UltraSkill_des:
Genesse Girls' Academy Paranormal Department! Assuming control! Releases an enhancement field centered on herself and gaining the Paranormal Ace effect for a period of time.
Grants the Team an ATK bonus based on Haniel's Base ATK.
Triggering <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">Ensemble</> simultaneously triggers 1 additional Ensemble - Symphony effect around the character with increased DMG and range. Ensemble - Symphony does not grant <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielPassive2">Plot Armor</> for Haniel. When triggering <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">Ensemble</>, the current active character's next attack deals additional damage for <NumGreen>3s</>. Effect does not stack.
While Paranormal Ace is active, Hootie's duration timer is paused until the end of the effect.
Haniel_SkillDes.Haniel_Ultraskill_nounsexplanation: Triggers after accumulating <NumGreen>4</> stacks of <TextEXPL>Four-Part Harmony</>, dealing AoE <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to enemies within range.
Haniel_SkillDes.Haniel_UltraSkill_des: Triggers after accumulating <NumGreen>4</> stacks of <TextEXPL>Four-Part Harmony</>, dealing AoE <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to enemies within range and causing the current character's next attack to deal additional damage for <NumGreen>3s</>.
Haniel_SkillDes.Haniel_UltraSkill_ExtraAtk_des: Grants the current character's next attack additional DMG for 3s when Ensemble is triggered. Effect does not stack.
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_PerfectEvade_des: Triggers when using Genesse Technique after a Critical Dodge. Being this slow will get us customer complaints, you know? Dodges the attack and fires a missile, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</>, and reducing Break.
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_Melee2_des_short: Deals <Hun>Psyche DMG</> and ricochets up to <NumGreen>4</> times.
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_Skill_des_short: Deploys Hootie to remain on the field and provide buffs, while dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</> with attacks.
Haniel_SkillDes.GA_Haniel_star3_name: Assemble! The hero team is formed!

Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_Melee_background: <Italic>Legend speaks of a secret art mastered only by Elite Couriers who have completed tens of thousands of flawless deliveries. With an almost instinctive striking rhythm, they tear through any obstacle blocking the delivery route, all to ensure a single successful delivery without breaking promises or trust.</>
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_Passive_1_background: <Italic>Can't risk the delay. I'll handle it.</>
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_Skill_background: <Italic>To ensure delivery within the time limit, forcibly eliminating enemies along the way is also one of the basic principles of the job.</>
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_star2_des: Grants Hathor <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> when <TextEXPL>Excellent Rating Lock</> and <TextEXPL>Five-Star Tracking</> naturally expire.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_Skill2_des_short: Consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> to cast this skill while in <TextEXPL>Emergency Delivery</> status, unleashing a combo on the target. Increases DEF.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_Passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Remora Enhancement</>: Extends the target's Remora duration to 12s and increases Crit Rate by 10% when the whole team attack a target affected by Remora.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_starExtra1_des: Increases the skill level of Rapid Delivery, Aerial Command, and Rider Express by 1.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_Passive_3_background: Deal with the risks in the process, so the results can be perfect.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_QTE_des_short: Performs an aerial dive kick on the target, dealing <NumGreen>2</> instances of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_star1_des: Holding the Redirect Skill button for the first time in battle grants <NumGreen>6</> stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</>.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_UltraSkill_des:
Get out of the way. Summons a motorcycle made of thorns and circles around targets, charging at enemies ahead with increased speed. Launches into the air and dive-bombs the ground, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area.
Enters <TextHLT>Emergency Delivery</> state for a period after skill activation and stops gaining <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</>. Upgrades Aerial Command to Cyclone Strike in this state. Increases Movement Speed and grants ATK bonus based on <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> stacks. Ends <TextHLT>Emergency Delivery</> state immediately when switching characters during this period.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_UltraSkill_des_short:
Summons a motorcycle and deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.
Enters  <TextHLT>Emergency Delivery</> state after casting and stops gaining <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</>. Upgrades Aerial Command to Cyclone Strike in this state. Increases Movement Speed and grants ATK bonus. Removes <TextHLT>Emergency Delivery</> state immediately when switching characters.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_star3_des: Hathor deals <NumGreen>15%</> increased damage to non-Boss targets.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_Melee1_des: Displays superior martial arts, performing up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_Passive_2_des: Grants <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> after defeating a target.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_Melee2_des: Plunges from the air, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
Hathor_SkillDes.HathorAnger_des: The energy required for Hathor to cast Cyclone Strike can be obtained through various methods. Grants Hathor 5 Ultimate Energy for each stack gained.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_Skill2_des: Consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> to cast this skill while in <TextEXPL>Emergency Delivery</> status. Summons a motorcycle of thorns and unleashes a rapid combo on the target. Increases DEF while the skill is active.
Hathor_SkillDes.Buff_HathorAnger_GazeEx_des: Grants 3 stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> if the target actively attacks during the effect's duration.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_starExtra2_des: Ignores <NumGreen>10%</> of the target’s DEF while in <TextEXPL>Emergency Delivery</> state.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_star4_des: Increases the Crit Chance of the next Cyclone Strike by <NumGreen>25%</> each time Cyclone Strike is successfully cast while in <TextEXPL>Emergency Delivery</> state. This effect is cleared when the current <TextEXPL>Emergency Delivery</> state ends.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_star6_des: Increases Crit DMG by <NumGreen>30%</> while in <TextEXPL>Emergency Delivery</> state.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_Passive_3_des:
Triggers <TextHLT>Excellent Rating Lock</> when Hathor is in the team and enemies remain nearby for more than <NumGreen>5s</>.
<TextHLT>Excellent Rating Lock</>: Lasts <NumGreen>5s</> after activation. If a target under this status attacks your team during this duration, <TextHLT>Excellent Rating Lock</> is removed, and Hathor gains <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> (up to <NumGreen>6</> stacks).
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_QTE_des: The time has come. Strikes from the air, kicking the target to trigger an impact, dealing <NumGreen>2</> instances of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_UltraSkill_4_des: Express Delivery Power ATK Bonus per Stack
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_star5_des: Increases damage against targets by <NumGreen>1%</> for <NumGreen>every</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> gained. This effect stacks up to <NumGreen>15%</> and is removed upon leaving combat.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_Melee3_des_short: Knocks the target up and slams them down, dealing <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>. If the target cannot be knocked up, Final Dispatch is triggered instead.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_Skill1_des:
Target locked, time to wrap this up quickly. Leaps into the air and slashes the target in front with wings, gaining <NumGreen>2</> stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</>.
Hold to enter charge status, increasing the power of Aerial Command and inflicting targets in range with <TextEXPL>Five-Star Tracking</> effect. The charge lasts up to 5s, during which Hathor constantly deals AoE <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> while the skill range gradually expands. The effect ends when the skill button is released, concluding the charging phase.
<TextHLT>Five-Star Tracking</>
Lasts for 5s. Grants 3 stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> when the target attacks or hits Hathor or an ally during this time.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_PerfectEvade_des: Triggers when using Rapid Delivery after a Critical Dodge. Launches a lightning-fast counterattack, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area, reducing Break, and gaining <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> on hit (up to <NumGreen>1</> stack every <NumGreen>5s</>).
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_PerfectEvade_des_short: Triggers when using Basic Attack after a Critical Dodge. Deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>. Grants <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> on hit. Cooldown: <NumGreen>5</>s.
Hathor_SkillDes.Buff_HathorAnger_Gaze_Menu_des: Grants <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> when a target under this status actively attacks your team during the duration.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_Skill1_des_short:
Casts to deal damage and grant <NumGreen>2</> stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</>.
Hold to enter charge status, increasing the skill power and inflicting all targets within range with <TextEXPL>Five-Star Tracking</> effect. Charge lasts up to 5s. During this time, continuously deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> while the skill range gradually expands. Release the button to end the charge.
<TextHLT>Five-Star Tracking</>
Lasts for 5s. Grants 3 stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> when the target attacks or hits Hathor or an ally during this time.
Hathor_SkillDes.GA_Hathor_Melee3_des: Hold Basic Attack to trigger. Sweeps around the target at high speed to knock them up, then restrains and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area on impact. Performs Final Dispatch if the target cannot be knocked up.

Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_Melee_background:
<Italic>"Finally, someone clueless comes along who actually wants to buy something from the shop, but if it wasn't for Hotori refusing to budge, hmph… this month's sales wouldn't be a big fat zero."</>
<Italic>"That little brat, didn't you see what kind of price he was trying to haggle? He's treating our Eibon like we're some charity case! I was being nice not calling Daff over to rough him up!"</>
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_Passive_2_background: <Italic>Cheers! Celebrate! Let's… let's celebrate again! My treasures… my precious treasures… they're all mine now! Deal… deal! Hehehe… hic… guard them all… for me… zzZ…</>
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_QTE_background: <Italic>For Hotori, this is merely a small display of her abilities, but difficult customers who threaten to complain will learn exactly why this humble little shop dares to impose such strict terms.</>
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_Passive_3_background: <Italic>Walk alone outside of time, and see the truth of time.</>
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_Passive_1_background: <Italic>At least when this proprietress, who can usually chatter on endlessly about every penny, finally quiets down and sits peacefully sipping wine while admiring the moon, you can still notice… she is an elegant and graceful person.</>
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_Passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Blossom Enhancement</>: Prevents Vita Bud attacks from pausing during Time Stop.
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_UtraSkill_des_Tidy: Casts World's Tide when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> energy is fully charged, dealing <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>, drawing the katana, and slowing surrounding time to near standstill. Builds combo stacks with katana attacks, and triggers <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to end Time Stop when reaching <NumGreen>10</> stacks.
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_Skill1_des_Tidy: Casts Present Replay when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> energy is greater than <NumGreen>60</>, dealing <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> and recording Support Skills and Redirect Skills used by allies for the next <NumGreen>5s</>.
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_Skill1_des:
Requires no cooldown for Present Replay.
Allows Hotori to spend <NumGreen>60</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> energy to cast Present Replay when energy is greater than <NumGreen>60</>. Deals <NumGreen>7</> instances of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area. Records Support Skills and Redirect Skills used by allies for the next <NumGreen>5</>s, appreciating up to <NumGreen>3</> timings per use, with each character recorded at most once.
Rewinds the Non-Closed Timepiece pointer continuously during use. Stops recording after the pointer rewinds a certain amount, and continues rewinding a fixed amount if recording completes early. Clears records when entering or leaving battle. Overwrites existing records when using Present Replay again.
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_starExtra1_des: Increases the skill level of Misty Moon Style, Present Replay, and World's Tide by 1.
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_UtraSkill_des:
Has no cooldown or Ultimate Energy cost for World's Tide.
Allows Hotori to unleash World's Tide when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> energy is fully charged, dealing <NumGreen>10</> instances of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area. Draws a katana from the umbrella handle and changes attack mode. Slows surrounding time to near standstill for a period, disabling character switching. Cleanses any received time control debuffs and grants immunity to time control debuffs during Time Stop. Replays all attacks recorded by Present Replay <NumGreen>1</> time and clears the records if any exist.
Rewinds the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> pointer continuously during Time Stop. Builds combo stacks with Hotori's katana attacks, increasing damage per hit. Deals Finisher DMG when combo stacks reach <NumGreen>10</>. Ends time stop when the pointer rewinds completely or when Finisher DMG is dealt.
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_Passive_2_des: Increases World's Tide's Finisher DMG Ratio by <NumGreen>100%</>.
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_starExtra2_name: The Ultimate Treasure of Clear Understanding
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_star3_des: Recovers the energy spent on Present Replay after using it and completing the recording. Triggers at most once every <NumGreen>60s</>. Interrupts energy restoration if energy is spent during the recovery process.
Jin_SkillDes.Jin_SpecialSkillUnableTips: Special skill effects are disabled in the current mode
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_Melee4_des: Hold Basic Attack in combat to trigger. Gracefully dashes forward and attacks, dealing <NumGreen>4</> instances of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area.
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_star6_des: Hotori ignores <NumGreen>30%</> of the target's DEF during Time Stop.
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_star2_des: Increases Hotori's damage by <NumGreen>20%</> during Time Stop.
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_star4_des: Grants an additional <NumGreen>10</> energy to the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> for every <NumGreen>1</> target defeated by the Team while the pointer is not rewinding, up to <NumGreen>3</> times. Resets the count when casting World's Tide.
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_star1_des: Increases Hotori's damage during Time Stop by <NumGreen>12%</> for each recorded Support Skill or Redirect Skill.
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_Melee2_des: Displays a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> when Hotori is switched in. Rotates its pointer slowly clockwise over time, accumulating energy. Caps the energy the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> can accumulate at 120.
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_Melee2_des_Tidy: Displays a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> when Hotori is switched in, accumulating energy over time.
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_star5_des: When Hotori is deployed, if there is only <NumGreen>1</> enemy on the field, the entire team's damage against that target is increased by <NumGreen>15%</>. This effect is lost when Hotori is down.
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_Passive_3_des_Tidy: Slows the surrounding time to near standstill when Hotori is outside of battle and the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> has accumulated energy greater than 0 while holding Basic Attack.
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_Melee3_des: Wields the weapon mid-air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_starExtra2_des: Grants all team members 30% ATK while Hotori is on the team and alive.
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_Melee1_des: Wields her weapon and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_Time_des: Hotori's special energy bar for casting Time Skills.
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_PerfectEvade_des: Triggers when using Misty Moon Style after a Critical Dodge. Raises the umbrella to counterattack opponents instantly, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> and reducing Break.
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_QTE_des: Time to teach these rude guests some manners. Throws the umbrella, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area.
Jin_SkillDes.GA_Jin_Melee5_des:
Let the snow fall slower still. Activates time manipulation when Hotori is outside of battle and the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> has accumulated energy greater than <NumGreen>0</>. Slows the flow of time while holding Basic Attack, causing the surrounding time to approach a standstill. Removes any received time control debuffs and grants immunity to time control debuffs during Time Stop.
Rewinds the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> pointer continuously during Time Stop. Prevents Hotori from using other time-affecting skills. Ends Time Stop when the pointer fully rewinds, holding Basic Attack, entering battle, switching scenes, or performing other actions.

Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_Passive_1_background: <Italic>Went as smoothly as I thought it would.</>
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_Melee_background: <Italic>"She glides through the city like a phantom, where light and shadow dance. Weaving secrets from whispers and fleeting leads, every move is a quiet vow to seal each deal in flawless harmony."</>
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_QTE_background: <Italic>Don't worry, I've always had an excellent memory.</>
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_Passive_2_background: <Italic>People say opportunities are rare, but I've always been good at seizing them.</>
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_UltraSkill_background: <Italic>A faint stir in the air. Alas… merely a fleeting foe.</>
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_Passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Blossom Enhancement</>: Spawns 1 additional Vita Bud and increases Vita Bud limit on field to 6.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_star2_des: Increases <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</> DMG Ratio by <NumGreen>100%</>. Restores HP to the entire team equal to <NumGreen>5%</> of the total damage accumulated by that Rose Pact whenever <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaBudBoom">Pact Settlement</> is triggered by casting Final Reckoning.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_starExtra1_des: Increases the skill level of When Secrets Take Shape, Intel Hunter, and Final Reckoning by 1.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_BranchPower_1_des: Per Instance DMG Ratio of Rose Pact Bullet
Kuhara_SkillDes.KuharaBudBoom_des:
Triggers Lethal Rose Pact Settlement stage when hit by Rose Pact Bullets or the last instance of Final Reckoning, dealing high attachment-type <Ling>Anima DMG</> and greatly increasing Settlement DMG from Final Reckoning, and granting Jiuyuan massive Ultimate Energy.
Automatically triggers Pact Settlement after timeout if Lethal Rose Pact is not activated, dealing attachment-type <Ling>Anima DMG</> to the target.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_star4_des: Increases DMG Ratio by <NumGreen>50%</> and affects targets within range when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaBudBoom">Pact Settlement</> is actively triggered.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_Melee1_des: Dual-wields to perform up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>. Grants <NumGreen>2</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</>. Establishes a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</> with the target when the final hit strikes.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_star5_des: Jiuyuan's DMG against targets bound by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</> increases by <NumGreen>8%</>.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_Melee2_des: Wields her weapon while airborne and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_QTE_des: Fires a curved bullet, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> and granting <NumGreen>2</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</> upon hit.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_Skill_des: Dashes across the battlefield, pulling the target into the range of control and attacking. Deals multiple instances of <Ling>Anima DMG</> and grants <NumGreen>4</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</> while establishing a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</>.
Kuhara_SkillDes.KuharaPowerBullet_des:
Available when Jiuyuan uses When Secrets Take Shape, Intel Hunter, Turning the Tide, or Intel Lock-On. Fires via Info-Guided Arts to trigger Pact Settlement on Lethal Rose Pact targets.
Accelerates Lethal Rose Pact into the settlement stage if the target cannot be settled.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_UltraSkill_des:
Dashes across the battlefield at high speed, continuously firing on surrounding targets before ending with a large-scale explosion, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>.
Triggers Final Reckoning, causing all <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</> targets within range to enter a stage where <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaBudBoom">Pact Settlement</> can be triggered, executing all settlements simultaneously on the final hit.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_Passive_2_des: Binds targets not affected by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Fatal Rose Pact</> when Vita Pistils hit them. Triggers an additional settlement on targets already bound, causing them to take an extra <NumGreen>15%</> × <Ling>Anima DMG</>.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_star1_des: Increases Jiuyuan's ATK by <NumGreen>5%</> for each target on the field bound by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</>, up to <NumGreen>15%</>.
Kuhara_SkillDes.KuharaAttachment_des: A type of attachment. Devours the target's HP continuously while active. Forces the target into the stage where Pact Settlement can be triggered after <NumGreen>5</>s. Lasts for <NumGreen>25</>s.
Kuhara_SkillDes.Buff_Kuhara_Seed_des: A type of attachment. Cannot initiate Pact Settlement in early stage.
Kuhara_SkillDes.Buff_Kuhara_Bud_des: A type of attachment. You can now initiate Pact Settlement.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_star6_des: Deals <NumGreen>200%</> DMG Ratio to targets bound by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</> each time they cast a skill. This effect has a <NumGreen>5s</> cooldown.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_Melee4_des: Press Aim to enter Aim mode. Fires a bullet that deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to the enemy in the crosshair.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_starExtra2_des: Reduces Anima Resistance of targets bound by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</> by <NumGreen>10%</>.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_Skill_des_short: Gathers targets, deals damage, grants <NumGreen>4</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</>, and establishes a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</>.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_PerfectEvade_des: Triggers when using When Secrets Take Shape after a Critical Dodge. Swings both arms and fires in a cross pattern at targets in front, binding them with <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</> while dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</>, reducing Break, and granting <NumGreen>2</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</>.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_PerfectEvade_des_short: Deals <Ling>Anima DMG</> with Basic Attacks after a Critical Dodge. Grants <NumGreen>2</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</>.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_Melee3_des_short: Deals <Ling>Anima DMG</>. Consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</> for continuous fire and prioritizes targets with <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</>.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_QTE_des_short: Deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> and grants <NumGreen>2</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</>.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_UltraSkill_des_short: Deals large-scale <Ling>Anima DMG</> and causes all targets within range bound by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</> to undergo <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaBudBoom">Pact Settlement</>.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_star3_des: Deducts an additional <NumGreen>4</> Break from the settlement target when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaBudBoom">Pact Settlement</> is triggered by casting Final Reckoning.
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_Branch_1_des: Hold Basic Attack - Shooting DMG Ratio
Kuhara_SkillDes.GA_Kuhara_Melee3_des: Hold Basic Attack to trigger. Auto-targets and fires a bullet, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</>. Consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</> for continuous fire and prioritizes targets with <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</> when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</> are available.

Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_Skill_background:
<Italic>"Ah. Lacrimosa… didn't mean to…"</>
<Italic>"Haha, nice work there, Mosa! Let's have Skia buy you some ice cream!"</>
<Italic>"Baicang, nosy. Ice cream… three scoops…"</>
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_Passive_3_background: <Italic>"Lacrimosa can fly. But glass… always hit it. Hate it. And when Lacrimosa sleeps… down from the sky!"</>
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_Melee_background: <Italic>At first, there were no roads. Then Lacrimosa made lots of vehicles and road signs, and suddenly roads appeared. The problem? Too many signs with contradictory rules. How are you supposed to turn left and right at the same time?</>
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_QTE_background: <Italic>Lacrimosa couldn't care less about villain arcs and tragic backstories. She just wants to clock out and go home to sleep.</>
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_Passive_1_background:
<Italic>Weekday morning alarms… magic, mess with memory.</>
<Italic>"So this is your excuse for being late?"</>
<Italic>"Alarm 1, Alarm 2, Lacrimosa turned them all off. But… ah… Lacrimosa can't remember…"</>
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_UltraSkill_background: <Italic>A friendly reminder from Barracuda, BAC's Professional Maintenance Staff: ETD-4 has exhausted their free maintenance quota for this month. Future repair costs will be deducted from the performance bonus of those who file the requests. CERTAIN team members are kindly reminded to take better care of Bureau property, especially non-reinforced glass items and sensitive electronic equipment. CERTAIN team members needing items from the vending machine should seek assistance from their squad captain or lieutenant.</>
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_Passive_2_background: <Italic>One person's sweet dream can be another's nightmare. Makes you wonder… why don't people wake themselves up with their sleep talking?</>
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_Passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Discord Enhancement</>: Deals additional DMG equal to 400% of ATK to the target when Discord is triggered, if the target is already Broken.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_star6_des: Increases the DMG Ratio of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> to <NumGreen>{0}%</> at the current skill level.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_starExtra1_des: Increases the skill level of Sweet and Sour, Morning Tomato, Devilish Gift, and Working Day Judgement by <NumGreen>1</>. Reduces the Stamina cost to <NumGreen>85%</> while flying in bat form.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_Melee_Switch_des:
Flavor Variation can be used at any time via the Aim button.
Tosses her Frying Pan and performs a flying kick forward when using Tomato Metal, dealing 1 instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to each target hit. Switches her attack module to Tomato Percussion.
Leaps into the air and slams the ground, dealing 1 instance of AoE <An>Chaos DMG</> when using Tomato Percussion. Switches her attack module to Tomato Metal.
The current Basic Attack style determines the attack pattern of Working Day Judgement.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_Skill2_des:
Lacrimosa... can do it too.
Lacrimosa uses her Esper Ability to copy and cast an enemy's skill, triggering the corresponding additional effects. The skill duration matches that of the original owner. During the cast, Lacrimosa cannot move, but she can manually cancel the cast or switch to another character. Lacrimosa takes damage if she is attacked during the cast.
Casting Devilish Gift grants Lacrimosa a percentage of the original skill owner's ATK.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_Passive_3_des: Lacrimosa transforms into a bat in her dream, flying freely. When out of combat, hold dodge to enter flight. Flight costs stamina.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_Melee3_des: Manipulates Esper Ability Constructs in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_Melee4_des:
Swings her Frying Pan, performing up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <An>Chaos DMG</>.
The projectile generated by the 2nd attack can be shattered by subsequent attacks, causing an explosion and dealing extra <An>Chaos DMG</>.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_Melee_des: Manipulates Red Jelly, performing up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <An>Chaos DMG</>.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_Melee_dot_des:
Inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> on the target when attacks hit, up to 10 stacks.
Inflicts 1 stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> per damage instance when a single Basic Attack deals multiple instances of damage.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_star2_des: Increases Lacrimosa's damage dealt by <NumGreen>15%</> for <NumGreen>15</>s when she switches in using a Support Skill.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_star5_des: Reduces the target's Max HP by <NumGreen>200%</> of the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> DMG dealt when dealing <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> DMG. Restores her HP every <NumGreen>3</>s based on the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> DMG dealt during that period, restoring HP equal to <NumGreen>1.5%</> of the total <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> DMG dealt. Prevents <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> stacks from being removed when the target is healed.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_starExtra2_des: Lacrimosa's damage ignores <NumGreen>20%</> of the target's DEF. Reduces the Stamina cost to <NumGreen>70%</> while flying in bat form.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_star1_des: Allows Lacrimosa to automatically cast her Support Skill and trigger the corresponding cycle without Cycle Energy accumulation when switching to her from any character that can trigger Esper Cycle: Nova, Scorch, or Discord within <NumGreen>5</>s after casting Devilish Gift. Triggers up to <NumGreen>once</> per <NumGreen>5</>s.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_UtraSkill_des:
Controls the Truck when using Tomato Metal, dealing 10 instances of <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area and inflicting <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> on all targets in range.

Dismantles the Car when using Tomato Percussion, dealing 5 instances of <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area and inflicting <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> on all targets in range.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_Passive_2_des: Grants <NumGreen>1</> additional attempt of Morning Tomato after Lacrimosa uses Tomato Metal or Tomato Percussion <NumGreen>5</> times during the skill cooldown. Activates only <NumGreen>1</> time per skill cooldown.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_Melee_dot_short_des: Attacks inflict <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> on hit.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_Melee1_des:
Tomato Metal

Swings her Frying Pan, performing up to 5 consecutive attacks. The projectile generated by the 2nd attack can be shattered by subsequent attacks, causing an explosion and dealing extra <An>Chaos DMG</>.

Tomato Percussion

Manipulates Red Jelly, performing up to 5 consecutive attacks.
Triggers the Nightmare status when Lacrimosa's Basic Attack hits, dealing damage equal to x% of Lacrimosa's ATK per second for xs.
Nightmare can stack up to 10 times.
Inflicts 1 stack of Nightmare for each damage instance that hits when a single Basic Attack deals multiple instances of damage. Removes 1 stack of Nightmare when the target receives healing.

Flavor Variation can be used at any time via the Aim button.
Tosses her Frying Pan and performs a flying kick forward when using Tomato Metal, dealing 1 instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to each target hit. Switches her attack module to Sweet and Sour.
Leaps into the air and slams the ground, dealing 1 instance of AoE <An>Chaos DMG</> when using Sweet and Sour. Switches her attack module to Tomato Metal.

The current Basic Attack style determines the attack pattern of Working Day Judgement.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_dot_des:
Deals 1 instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to the target per second for 3s.
Removes 1 stack of Nightmare when the target receives healing.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_Switch_short_des: Press Aim to switch attack style, dealing <An>Chaos DMG</>.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_star3_des: Triggers all accumulated <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> effects on the target at once when the <NumGreen>5</>th hit of Tomato Metal or Tomato Percussion lands.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_QTE_des: Lacrimosa get this done, and Lacrimosa get to sleep… Manipulates Esper Ability Constructs, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_PerfectEvade_des: Triggers when using Basic Attacks after a Critical Dodge. Seizes the opening created by the enemy's missed attack and violently hurls a large amount of Red Jelly onto the enemy's head, dealing <NumGreen>6</> instances of <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area and reducing Break.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_Skill1_short_des: Deals <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area and inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</>.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_Ultraskill_short_des: Deals <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area and inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</>.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_Melee2_des:
Hold to enter Aim mode. Deals 1 instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to an enemy in the crosshair and learns their combat technique.
Temporarily forgets Morning Tomato and uses the learned technique upon successful learning.
Learned techniques are stored permanently in Lacrimosa's memory. New techniques can be learned to replace existing ones, or Lacrimosa can actively forget a technique on the Skill page to recall Morning Tomato.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_Melee2_short_des: Hold to enter Aim mode. Deals <An>Chaos DMG</> and learns the enemy's skill.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes.GA_Lacrimosa_Skill1_des:
Ah… Achoo! Throws a barrage of unfinished Esper Ability Constructs, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to all targets within the area and inflicting <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> on the targets.
Combos into the <NumGreen>5</>th instance of Tomato Metal or Tomato Percussion after casting Morning Tomato.

Lacrimosa_SkillDes_Mon.GA_mon_037_Steal_Skill03_Collection: ReroRero Phone Booth gathers power and slams the ground, dealing 1 instance of damage to an area.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes_Mon.GA_mon_019_Skill03_2_Steal_Collection: Saddy Teddy gathers power and forcefully slashes forward, dealing 1 instance of damage to targets within the area.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes_Mon.GA_mon_01_act01_Steal_BP_Collection: Whisper Spawn fiercely claws forward, dealing 1 instance of damage to targets within the area.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes_Mon.GA_mon_05_act02_Steal_BP_Collection: Leech Spawn slams the ground powerfully with its hand, dealing 1 instance of damage to targets within the area.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes_Mon.GA_mon_14_act05_Steal_BP_Collection: Decomposer sprays its trash from the can, dealing up to 8 instances of damage to targets in a cone.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes_Mon.GA_mon_016_act03_2_Steal_BP_Collection: Haunted Vending Machine falls forward and smashes the ground, dealing 1 instance of damage to targets within the area.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes_Mon.GA_mon_029_Skill01_Steal_Collection: Haunted Record throws records forward, with each record dealing 1 instance of damage.
Lacrimosa_SkillDes_Mon.GA_boss_33_act10_1_Steal_BP_Collection: Nestbound Bird lets out a piercing shriek, dealing damage to an area.

Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_QTE_background:
<Italic>"What if some creep comes after me when you're not around…?"</>
<Italic>"Run. Those tiny legs of yours can really move."</>
<Italic>"No way! Wait, I know. I'll hit them with the TV!"</>
<Italic>"No. Absolutely not. Under any circumstances."</>
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_Melee_background:
<Italic>"Xiaozhen, Xiaozhen, I've got an idea… What if you threw punches like Ora Puncher? So fast, your fists would be nothing but afterimages!"</>
<Italic>"…Why bother? Wouldn't it be faster to knock them out with one good punch?"</>
<Italic>"You just don't get it! It's an art form!"</>
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_Skill_background:
<Italic>"Watch this! Our red-hot tag-team finisher…"</>
<Italic>"…Wait, kid. Did we even know that person?"</>
<Italic>"Didn't catch who it was, but the combo worked!"</>
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_SpecialAbility_background:
<Italic>"Shoot, we're late! Xiaozhen, fire up the emergency launch system! Aim for the BAC's second-floor window!"</>
<Italic>"…Or you could just take the phone booth like a normal person."</>
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_UltraSkill_background:
<Italic>No signal is ever truly lost. No one is ever beyond reach. No call goes unheard, and no distance can keep us apart…</>
<Italic>The airwaves will always bring us together, until meeting for the first time feels like finding each other again.</>
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_Passive_2_background: <Italic>Words could never come close to expressing what we feel. But in this moment, our souls finally meet without distance between them.</>
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_Passive_1_background:
<Italic>The faint static in that frequency felt like a crack no one else could see. How had it formed? And why did it refuse to heal?</>
<Italic>Sometimes, for just a moment, the thought left her quietly heartsick.</>
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_Passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Hexed Enhancement</>: Increases the base DMG of additional Follow-up Attacks from Hexed to 30% while Linko is on the team. Targets affected by Hexed take 10% more Follow-up Attack DMG.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_starExtra2_des: Extends Resonance Field's duration by <NumGreen>5</>s and increases all allies' Anima and Incantation DMG by <NumGreen>30%</> while it is active.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_star5_des: Allows <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strikes</> triggered by Full-Frequency Pulse to trigger Cycle effects. Increases this <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>'s DMG by <NumGreen>50%</> if the selected ally cannot trigger a Cycle with Linko.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_LinkoLTE_des:
Synced Strike is a special Support Skill. Its DMG is considered Follow-up Attack DMG and matches the attribute of the character who initiates it. If Xiaozhen initiates Synced Strike, it deals Anima DMG.
Normally, Synced Strike does not trigger Esper Cycle. Its DMG is based on Linko's stats and Support Skill Level.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_xiaozhenMark_des: Hit 'Em Here! is a mark inflicted on an enemy. When an ally deals damage to the marked target with a Redirect Skill, the mark is consumed, causing Linko to perform a Synced Strike against the target and build up Modulation Points and Cycle Energy. Only 1 Hit 'Em Here! mark can exist on the field at a time. Each mark lasts for 10s.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_starExtra1_des: Increases the skill levels of Spectral Cross, Full-Frequency Pulse, and Oversync by <NumGreen>1</>. Increases Linko's ATK by <NumGreen>20%</>.
Linko_Skilldes.Linko_power_melee_name: Poltergeist CQC builds up Modulation Points.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_Melee2_des_short: Hold Basic Attack during Poltergeist CQC to deal <Ling>Anima DMG</>.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_Melee2_des: Hold Basic Attack during Poltergeist CQC to make Linko strike the current target with both palms, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_star2_des: Increases the DMG Ratio of Oversync's <Ling>Anima Burst DMG</> by <NumGreen>30%</>.
Linko_Skilldes.Linko_lteteammate_num: Based on Linko's Support Skill level
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_star4_des: Deals 1 additional instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> in an area each time a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> is triggered within Resonance Field. DMG Ratio at the current Oversync Skill Level: <NumGreen>{0}%</>. Allows this attack to consume a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoXiaozhenMark">Hit 'Em Here!</> mark and trigger a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>.
Linko_Skilldes.Linko_power_perfectevade_des: Critical Riposte builds up Modulation Points.
Linko_Skilldes.Linko_power_yinji_des: Consumes marks to build up Modulation points
Linko_Skilldes.Linko_heterochrome_yinji_des: Consumes marks to build up Cycle Energy
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_QTE_des:
Strikes the target together with Xiaozhen, dealing 1 instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> in an area.
Summons an ally to perform a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> by breaking a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoXiaozhenMark">Hit 'Em Here!</> mark, casting Full-Frequency Pulse, or casting Oversync. Scales <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>'s DMG Ratio with Spectral Cross's skill level.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_star6_des: Increases allies' <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> Crit Rate by <NumGreen>25%</> while Linko is on the team. Grants allies' <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strikes</> the Charge effect.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_star1_des: Reduces Spectral Rush's appearance interval by <NumGreen>25%</> while Linko is off-field.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_Melee4_des_short: Periodically inflicts a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoXiaozhenMark">Hit 'Em Here!</> mark while Linko is off-field.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_Melee4_des: Sends Xiaozhen to ambush the target every 8s while Linko is off-field, causing Xiaozhen to attack once and inflict a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoXiaozhenMark">Hit 'Em Here!</> mark.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_Melee3_des: Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing 1 instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> in an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height by up to 100%.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_UtraSkill_des_short:
Press to deploy a Resonance Field for a set duration. Press Redirect Skill to call on allies to perform <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strikes</>, up to 3 times. Press Ultimate again to deal <Ling>Anima DMG</> in an area.
While within Resonance Field, allies' Support Skills are considered <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strikes</>.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_Skill1_des_short: Press to deal <Ling>Anima DMG</>, select Xiaozhen or an ally on the team to perform a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> that deals DMG of the corresponding attribute, and consume all accumulated Modulation to increase this <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>'s DMG.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_Passive_2_des: Reduces the target's Esper Ability Resistance corresponding to the attribute of the character who triggers <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> by 8% for 12s. Resistance Reduction effects for different attributes can coexist on the same target. Effects of the same attribute inflicted by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> do not stack. Resets the duration when triggered again.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_PerfectEvade_des: Triggers when using Poltergeist CQC after a Critical Dodge. Charges toward the target, dealing 4 instances of <Ling>Anima DMG</> in an area and building up Modulation.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_QTE_des_short:
Deals <Ling>Anima DMG</>.
Scales <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>'s DMG Ratio with Spectral Cross's skill level.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_Melee1_des_short: Deals <Ling>Anima DMG</> and builds up Modulation points.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_PerfectEvade_des_short: Deals <Ling>Anima DMG</> and builds up Modulation points.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_Skill1_des:
Channels Esper Ability upon casting Full-Frequency Pulse, bombarding the target with ghost energy to deal up to 4 instances of <Ling>Anima DMG</> and calling Xiaozhen or an ally to perform a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>. Opens a selection wheel to choose Xiaozhen or an ally, then performs the selected character's <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>, dealing DMG of the corresponding attribute. Grants this <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> a DMG Bonus and consumes all accumulated Modulation, converting it into an additional DMG Bonus.
Briefly pauses the battle timer while selecting the attacker and initiating the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>.
Replaces an ally's position on the wheel with Xiaozhen if the ally is unable to act or is not on the team. Grants Xiaozhen's <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> an additional DMG Bonus for each additional Xiaozhen on the wheel.
Enable Auto-Cast Skills under "Settings > System Features" to have the first ally in the team perform <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> by default.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_Melee1_des:
Casts Poltergeist CQC to perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>. Builds up Modulation points with each hit.
Casts Full-Frequency Pulse to consume Modulation points and enhance the triggered <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_star3_des: Resets Full-Frequency Pulse's cooldown upon casting Oversync.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_UtraSkill_des:
Enters Overdrive upon casting Oversync, deploying a Resonance Field for a set duration and Syncing with up to 3 allies. Allows Redirect Skill to be pressed to call on Synced allies in sequence to perform <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strikes</>, up to 3 times. Deals 1 additional instance of <Ling>Anima Area DMG</> when a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> is performed within Resonance Field.
Ends Overdrive when its duration expires or when Oversync is pressed again, releasing an overloaded noise burst that deals multiple instances of <Ling>Anima Area DMG</> and 1 instance of <Ling>Anima Burst DMG</> to all enemies within Resonance Field. Increases this <Ling>Anima Burst DMG</> based on the number of different debuffs on each target.
Extends Resonance Field for a set duration after Overdrive ends. Counts Support Skills triggered by allies within Resonance Field as <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strikes</>, treats their DMG as Follow-up Attack DMG, and grants them the bonuses from Precision Tuning, Starlit Whispers, and The World Answers.
Enable Auto-Cast Skills under "Settings > System Features" to have allies perform <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strikes</> in sequence by default.
Linko_Skilldes.GA_Linko_SpecialAbility_des: Hold Basic Attack while out of combat to charge up using Xiaozhen's ghostly arm. Release to launch Linko forward. Increases launch force with charge time, up to a maximum charge time of 2s.

Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Skill_background: <Italic>"Ice cream is cool, mint is cool, so mint ice cream from Blizzi means double the happiness! Ooha… I'm already shivering just thinking about it!"</>
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Melee_background: <Italic>"First place in the Containment Simulation Exam: Mint, from CSU-2."</>
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Passive_1_background: <Italic>"Watch closely now! I'm not the same as before! You're now face-to-face with an elite operative!"</>
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Passive_2_background:
<Italic>There's always that extra burst of energy when work's almost done, especially when putting out new arrivals…</>
<Italic>"Five minutes till close! Line up nicely and get nullified!"</>
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_UtraSkill_background: <Italic>The full name is "Mint's Ultimate: Super Duper Ultra 360 Whirlwind Slash", but I had to shorten it to what it is now because people wouldn't stop laughing about it.</>
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Blossom Enhancement</>: Expands Vita Pistils' damage area on hit.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Passive_1_des_tidy: <TextHLT>Blossom Enhancement</>: Expands Vita Pistils' damage area on hit.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_star2_des: Redirect Skill: Ultimate: Super Claws damage increases by <NumGreen>40%</>.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_starExtra1_des: Increases the skill level of Perfect Containment, Ultimate: Super Claws, and Ultimate: Thunderous Whirlwind Slash by <NumGreen>1</>.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_star1_des: Resets the cooldown of Ultimate: Super Claws when Caramel Crisp hits an enemy. Triggers once every <NumGreen>3s</>.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_UtraSkill_des: Are you ready! Channels the surrounding wind into her dual blades, transforming them into wind blades that deal multiple instances of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area. Lands with a final hit that deals massive <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_starExtra2_des: Grants an additional <NumGreen>2</> Cycle Energy after successfully casting Ultimate: Super Claws.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Skill_des: Time to cool things down! Dashes forward, then returns to her original position, dealing <NumGreen>2</> instances of AoE <Ling>Anima DMG</> to enemies along the path.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_QTE_des: Perfect finishing work from an elite member! Charges and leaps into the air, performing a penetrating attack on enemies, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Passive_2_des: While Mint is on the field, her DEF is increased by <NumGreen>20%</> and her resistance to Interruptions is increased by <NumGreen>30%</>.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_star5_des: After casting Redirect Skill: Ultimate: Super Claws, Mint's CRIT DMG increases by <NumGreen>25%</> for <NumGreen>6s</>.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Melee2_des: Wields her weapon in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_star4_des: Increases Mint's Crit Chance by <NumGreen>12%</> when dealing damage to the last enemy on the field.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_star6_des: Mint deals <NumGreen>15%</> increased damage to targets below <NumGreen>40%</> HP.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Melee1_des: Wields her weapon and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_star3_des: When any character triggers Blossom or Hexed against an enemy, Mint's ATK is increased by <NumGreen>15%</> for <NumGreen>15s</>.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_PerfectEvade_des: Triggers when using Perfect Containment after a Critical Dodge. Leaps up to dodge an attack, seizes the enemy's opening, and swiftly swings her weapon, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area and reducing Break.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Passive_3_des_tidy: Hold Basic Attack to continuously deal <Ling>Anima DMG</> for 4s.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Passive_3_des: Hold Basic Attack to make Mint dance and spin, forming a tornado that continuously drains Stamina and deals continuous <Ling>Anima DMG</> to surrounding enemies.

Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_QTE_background: <Italic>Unafraid of the noise around her, she follows only the beat within—clear, strong, and unwavering, like a bold dissonance in a score. Deep down, Aurelia secretly wishes she could be that kind of person.</>
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Melee_background:
<Italic>Vocal technique is key for any conductor, so I keep practicing. Engage the core, relax the jaw, let the sound flow from the back of my head and out through my brow…</>
<Italic>"Ah—ah—"</>
<Italic>…Why does it feel like even my own voice is slipping away?</>
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Skill_background: <Italic>If she hadn't joined the Tamamochi Street Resident Association, Aurelia might have ended up as an administrator on Cadenza Street instead. In the end, perhaps it's all just a matter of fate.</>
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Passive_2_background: <Italic>Strong… stronger… Super Sound… Ultimate Sound! Want it even louder? Then the drummer will just have to throw themselves into the drum headfirst!</>
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Passive_3_background: <Italic>Being unable to take a single step doesn't mean you can't keep moving forward. Let your heart be as free and boundless as the world—once you set out, there's nowhere you can't reach.</>
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_UltraSkill_background: <Italic>Whether it was the school choir or that short-lived, chaotic band, these were Aurelia's most cherished memories. Even a brilliant solo would feel far too lonely.</>
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Passive_1_background:
<Italic>How do you prove that sound is a wave? Toss a stone into water and see the ripples spread; toss a stone at someone, and you’ll hear wave after wave of noise.</>
<Italic>"…Am I supposed to laugh?"</>
<Italic>"Aurelia's jokes aren't funny at all—"</>
<Italic>"No way! People used to eat that up… you kids just have your humor standards way too high."</>
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Passive_1_des_tidy: <TextHLT>Nova Enhancement</>: Deals damage 3 times to the target when their Nova state ends.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Nova Enhancement</>: Deals 3 instances of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to the target after their Nova status ends, each equal to 50% of ATK.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_starExtra1_des: Increases the skill levels of Cappella, Cadenza Aria, and Canon Chorus by <NumGreen>1</>.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_star5_des: Increases Canon Chorus's Crit Rate by <NumGreen>15%</>.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_star6_des: Increases the maximum stacks of Crescendo to 20. Grants 10 Crescendo stacks after casting Cadenza Aria.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_QTE_des: True command means never mistaking the timing. Commands the jellyfish to strike, dealing 1 instance of AoE <Hun>Psyche DMG</> on hit.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_star4_des: Increases Aurelia's DEF by <NumGreen>20%</> when casting Staccato.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_star1_des: Increases Crit Rate by <NumGreen>15%</> while in the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&MitsukiSkill">Cadenza</> state.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_star3_des: Increases Canon Chorus DMG by <NumGreen>20%</> while in the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&MitsukiSkill">Cadenza</> state.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Skill_des: Transform the everyday into a rainbow melody and let it roar across the skyline. Deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of AoE <Hun>Psyche DMG</> and enters the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&MitsukiSkill">Cadenza</> state for <NumGreen>12</>s.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_star2_des: Enters the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&MitsukiSkill">Cadenza</> state for <NumGreen>5</>s after a successful Critical Dodge or casting Dissonance. Extends the duration by <NumGreen>5</>s if the state's already active. The <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&MitsukiSkill">Cadenza</> state lasts for up to <NumGreen>12</>s.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_UltraSkill_des: Let's play the next verse together. Gathers nearby jellyfish, dealing 6 instances of AoE <Hun>Psyche DMG</> and slightly pulling targets together.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Passive_2_des: Increases Aurelia's ATK by <NumGreen>1%</> for <NumGreen>5</>s when a jellyfish blast hits a target, up to <NumGreen>10</> stacks.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Passive_2_des_tidy: Increases Aurelia's ATK by <NumGreen>1%</> for <NumGreen>5</>s when a jellyfish blast hits a target, up to <NumGreen>10</> stacks.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Passive_2_level6_des_tidy: Increases Aurelia's ATK by <NumGreen>1%</> for <NumGreen>5</>s when a jellyfish blast hits a target, up to <NumGreen>20</> stacks.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Passive_3_des: Aurelia rides a jellyfish, gliding effortlessly through the city's streets and alleys. She can't climb or vault over obstacles, but her jump is higher, and she gains special gliding and swimming abilities.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.MitsukiSkill_des: Deals an additional <NumGreen>70%</> damage with jellyfish blasts and inflicts AoE DMG to enemies around the target.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.PerfectEvadeAttackEvade_des: Special Critical Riposte Projectile DMG Ratio
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Melee2_des_tidy:
Hold Dodge while moving to enter a special state. Generates a jellyfish blast at intervals, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.
Performs a special Dodge in this state, and Syncopation automatically fires four jellyfish blasts.
Ends automatically when stamina drops low.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Melee2_des:
Sing loudly and fully! Hold Dodge while moving to ride a jellyfish, sprinting at high speed for the duration. Generates a jellyfish blast at intervals when targets are nearby, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.
Performs a special Dodge in this state, and "Critical Dodge Riposte: Syncopation" automatically fires four jellyfish blasts.
Ends automatically when stamina drops below a certain amount.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Melee1_des: Sing smoothly and naturally! Wields her weapon and performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Melee3_des: Sing clearly and beautifully! Wields the weapon mid-air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_PerfectEvade_des:
Triggers when casting Legato after a Critical Dodge.
Think you can handle my rhythm? Wields her weapon to deal <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area and reduces Break.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_starExtra2_des: Increases all allies' <Hun>Psyche DMG</> by <NumGreen>8%</> for <NumGreen>15</>s when entering the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&MitsukiSkill">Cadenza</> state or when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&MitsukiSkill">its</> duration is extended. Resets the duration when reapplied.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_UltraSkill_des_tidy: Deals <Hun>Psyche DMG</> and pulls enemies together.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Skill_des_tidy: Deals <Hun>Psyche DMG</> and enters the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&MitsukiSkill">Cadenza</> state.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.EvadeBranchPowerCost_des: Hold Dodge - Stamina Cost per Second

Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_UtraSkill_background: <Italic>"A proper gang leader will give her goons some room to shine in the spotlight… I can't fight without my goons?! Ahem, are you having doubts about my strength?"</>
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Passive_2_background: <Italic>"Hey, hey, hey! The duel's already started! Running soooo far away… Chickening out, huh?"</>
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Passive_1_background: <Italic>The First Rule of Gang Wars: "Watch your back."</>
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Melee_background: <Italic>Said to be a secret combat technique passed down in the Coluccis, though it clearly incorporates many street-fighting elements from Hethereau.</>
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_QTE_background: <Italic>Got a problem? Come find Nanally - I've got you covered!</>
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Skill_background: <Italic>Mint tried to learn this move from Nanally, but the moment she saw that Nanally's hair went rough, curved, split, and knotted, she gave up the idea. Adler is not with her in the Bureau of Anomaly Control to take care of her hair, after all.</>
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Blossom Enhancement</>: Fires 10 Vita Pistils with Vita Bud, reducing the interval between each shot to 1s.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_star6_des: Extends the duration of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&NanallyWalkOnWall">Ichi-daime's Authority</> state to <NumGreen>15s</>, and further extends it to <NumGreen>20s</> when out of combat.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Cat_des: Underboss fights alongside Nanally. Underboss deals Anima DMG and is considered a follow-up attack.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_starExtra1_des: Increases the skill level of Colucci Secret Skill, Colucci Howling Technique, and Colucci Ultimate Technique by 1.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Cat_ExtraAtk1_des: Underboss Heavy Basic Attack: 1st Instance DMG Ratio
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Cat_ExtraAtk3_des: Underboss Heavy Basic Attack: 3rd Instance DMG Ratio
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Cat_ExtraAtk2_des: Underboss Heavy Basic Attack: 2nd Instance DMG Ratio
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Cat_Melee1_des: Underboss Basic Attack: 1st Instance DMG Ratio
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Cat_Melee3_des: Underboss Basic Attack: 3rd Instance DMG Ratio
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Cat_Melee2_des: Underboss Basic Attack: 2nd Instance DMG Ratio
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Cat_Melee5_des: Underboss Basic Attack: 5th Instance DMG Ratio
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Cat_Melee4_des: Underboss Basic Attack: 4th Instance DMG Ratio
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Skill_des_12:
Hehe, surprise time! Deals <NumGreen>5</> instances of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to surrounding enemies and wraps herself in Anima Esper Ability, gaining the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&NanallyWalkOnWall">Ichi-daime's Authority</> effect.
Lasts <NumGreen>12s</> or until Nanally is switched out.
Ends <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&NanallyWalkOnWall">Ichi-daime's Authority</> early when recast.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_star3_des: Applies <NumGreen>1</> <TextHLT>follow-up attack</> to a single enemy, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</> of <NumGreen>{0}%</> ATK whenever Nanally deals damage to an enemy while she's in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&NanallyWalkOnWall">Ichi-daime's Authority</> state. DMG Ratio scales with Basic Attack skill level, reaching <NumGreen>107.9%</> at Lvl 11. Triggers <NumGreen>once</> per second.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Passive_2_des_short: Performs a <TextHLT>follow-up attack</>, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</> whenever the team triggers Esper Cycle DMG while Nanally is in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&NanallyWalkOnWall">Ichi-daime's Authority</> state. Maintains a minimum trigger interval.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Passive_2_des:
Applies <NumGreen>1</> <TextHLT>follow-up attack</> to a single enemy, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</> of <NumGreen>60%</> ATK whenever any ally deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of Esper Cycle DMG while Nanally is in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&NanallyWalkOnWall">Ichi-daime's Authority</> state. DMG Ratio scales with Basic Attack skill level, reaching <NumGreen>129.5%</> at Lvl 11.
Triggers <NumGreen>once</> every <NumGreen>2s</>.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Melee3_des: Swings her claws in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Melee1_des: Bares her fangs and brandishes her claws, performing up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>. Dodging does not interrupt the combo.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_star1_des: Grants Nanally <NumGreen>2.5</> Ultimate Energy for <NumGreen>each</> <TextHLT>follow-up attack</> she performs. Triggers at most <NumGreen>once</> every <NumGreen>1s</>.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Melee2_des: Enters aim mode, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of single-target <Ling>Anima DMG</> to the enemy in the crosshair.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_ExtraAtk1_des: Heavy Basic Attack: 1st Instance DMG Ratio
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_ExtraAtk3_des: Heavy Basic Attack: 3rd Instance DMG Ratio
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_ExtraAtk2_des: Heavy Basic Attack: 2nd Instance DMG Ratio
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_WalkOnWall_des:
Increases Nanally's CRIT DMG by 30%.
Nanally can ignore gravity and walk on any surface.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Melee_des:
Colucci Secret Skill
Bares her fangs and brandishes her claws, performing up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>.

Heavy Hitter!
Triggers by holding Basic Attack. Performs up to 3 powerful attacks, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>, which can be triggered after Critical Riposte and the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 5th attacks of Colucci Secret Skill.

Colucci Secret Gundo
Hold to aim, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to enemy in the crosshair.

Grand Entrance!
Swings her claws in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area upon impact.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_star5_des: Increases Nanally's ATK by <NumGreen>2%</> for <NumGreen>each</> <TextHLT>follow-up attack</> she performs, up to <NumGreen>20%</>. Disappears when Nanally leaves the battlefield or exits combat.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_UtraSkill_des:
I'm way stronger than them! Deals <NumGreen>7</> instances of <Ling>Anima DMG</> immediately to surrounding enemies and summons Underboss to fight alongside her.
Creates a small pull effect on surrounding enemies with Nanally's attacks while Underboss is active, and coordinates with all of Nanally's attacks to launch strikes, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</> that also counts as <TextHLT>follow-up attack</> damage.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_QTE_des: Time to get serious! Charges with a spinning motion, delivering a kick and dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_PerfectEvade_des: Triggers when using Colucci Secret Skill after a Critical Dodge. Charges toward the target at full speed, planting one hand on the ground, delivering a roundhouse kick that deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area, and reducing Break.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_UltraSkill_des_short: Deals <Ling>Anima DMG</> and summons an Underboss to fight alongside her. The Underboss deals <Ling>Anima DMG</> and counts as a <TextHLT>follow-up attack</>.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Skill_des_short: Deals <Ling>Anima DMG</> and enters <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&NanallyWalkOnWall">Ichi-daime's Authority</> state.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Melee4_des: Triggers by holding Basic Attack. Performs up to 3 powerful attacks, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>. Chains after Critical Riposte and the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 5th attacks of Colucci Secret Skill. Dodging does not interrupt the combo.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Melee3_des_short: Hold Basic Attack to deal <Ling>Anima DMG</>.

NewStringTable.rankmailtext001:
The value of collectibles lies not only in the items themselves, but also in the discerning eye that gives them meaning. At this Treasure Ship Auction, your keen eye made all the difference, and you returned with a huge haul. Each drop of the hammer was made all the more meaningful by your attentive gaze. The Ebisu Auction House extends its sincerest congratulations and has prepared a small gift in the hope that this Treasure Ship Auction gave you a few moments worth remembering.
As the next Treasure Ship Auction is about to begin, we warmly invite you to join us again, and sincerely hope it will bring you even more delightful surprises.
