<title>Full Tank Ahead Event Rules</>
Fire up your tank and roll into battle! Join the TerraX Iron Ogre special event for an action-packed tank free-for-all! Hunt down powerful shells, fight over rare supplies, and blast rival tanks to bits! Make the most of different elemental shells, seize control of the Tank Core, and rack up points to rule the battlefield!

<title>Basic Match Rules</>
1. Use matchmaking on the event page to enter the Full Tank Ahead battlefield. Each match is a <orange>4-player tank free-for-all on a large map</> and lasts <orange>8</> minutes.
2. The match begins once all players have entered the battlefield. Players battle using the tank skins they've customized in the open world.
3. Drive around the map, gather supplies, and attack enemy tanks with different elemental shells. Destroying enemy tanks, collecting supply crates, and dealing damage all earn you points.
4. If your tank is destroyed, you must wait for the respawn timer to run out before rejoining the fight. Once you respawn, you can jump back into battle and keep climbing the rankings.
5. Supplies keep spawning around the map throughout the match. Drive to a pickup and stay within range long enough to collect it. Collected items go into the item slots at the bottom of the screen.
6. Your tank gains a shield that blocks a certain amount of damage when you first spawn or respawn.
7. If your tank is destroyed, you lose all active item buffs and any unused items in your slots. Only your starting shells are retained.
8. The match ends as soon as the timer runs out. Final rankings and rewards are determined by each player's total points.

<title>Tank Core Contest Rules</>
1. The Tank Core is a high-value contested zone at the center of the battlefield. It activates 2 minutes into the match. A warning appears 10s before activation: "Tank Core activating soon! Head to the center of the map!"
2. Once the Tank Core activates, high-tier supplies spawn at the center of the map. These supplies are guaranteed to include elemental shells and defensive items.
3. Shells deal increased damage when fired from within the contested zone.

<title>How to Earn Points</>
1. Destroy an enemy tank to earn <orange>100</> points.
2. Deal DMG to enemy tanks to earn points. For every <orange>1,000</> DMG dealt, earn <orange>80</> points.
3. Pick up a red ammo crate to earn <orange>50</> points.
4. Pick up a green or blue item crate to earn <orange>75</> points.
5. Each player earns an extra <orange>400</> points for each of their first three enemy tank kills per match.
6. Destroy an enemy tank in the Contested Zone to earn an extra <orange>80</> points.
7. Pick up high-tier supplies in the central area to earn <orange>300</> points.
8. Players who complete the match earn an extra <orange>1,500</> points at the end of the match.

<title>How to Earn TX Tokens</>
At the end of each match, every 10 match points earn 1 TX Token.
TX Tokens can be exchanged for items at the TX Token Shop.
NewStringTable.SurvivalGamePlay_GamePlayDes:
<title>Runaway Echoes Event Rules</>
Enter the Rails of Delusion and gather the power of Echoes! Break past your level limits in endless battles, experiment with countless builds, and forge a combat playstyle all your own!

<title>Basic Run Rules</>
1. Enter <orange>Runaway Echoes</> to begin a run. Defeated enemies drop <orange>EXP Orbs</>. Collect EXP Orbs to gain EXP and raise your in-run level, up to <orange>Lvl 180</>. Levels gained during a run apply only to that run and reset when it ends.
2. <orange>Destructible Objects</> periodically appear on the map. Destroying them has a chance to drop <orange>Healing Items</>, which immediately restore the character's HP and help keep you in the fight.
3. Enemy strength scales with your in-run level. As your level rises, enemies become stronger and the challenge intensifies, but the overall rewards from the run also increase.
4. An Echo Boss appears every <orange>60</>s. Echo Bosses have high HP and unique mechanics. Defeating one grants a large amount of EXP and also drops a <orange>Magnet Item</>.
5. Defeated enemies have a chance to trigger a lightning strike at your location, dealing damage to your character.

<title>Card Build Rules</>
1. Each time your character levels up, you gain one card selection. You can use three card actions, <orange>Lock, Remove, and Refresh</>, to shape your build. Lock preserves a card you want when refreshing, while Remove takes an unwanted card out of the pool, increasing your chances of obtaining better cards.
2. There are three types of cards: <orange>Skill Cards</> that provide combat skills, <orange>Skill Upgrade Cards</> that enhance skills you already have, and <orange>Relic Cards</> that grant special passive bonuses.
3. You can equip up to <orange>6 Skill Cards</> at once. Skill Upgrade Cards and Relic Cards have no such limit. Once all 6 Skill slots are filled, unwanted Skill Cards that appear later can be manually replaced with <orange>Skill Upgrade Cards or Relic Cards</>, giving you more freedom to refine your playstyle.

<title>Run Results and Talent Tree Progression</>
1. At the end of each run, you receive <orange>Talent Points</> based on your performance. Talent Points can be used to activate various stat bonuses in the Talent Tree.
2. All bonuses unlocked in the Talent Tree <orange>carry over between runs</> and permanently apply to future Runaway Echoes runs, allowing your character to grow stronger over time.
3. After each run, a detailed results screen shows the performance of every skill used. You can review key data for each skill, including <orange>Uptime, Total DMG, and DPS</>, making it easy to see how much each skill contributed to your overall damage.

<title>Custom Assist Settings</>
1. You can enable <orange>Disable Auto-Pick on Level Up</> to save card selections earned from leveling up instead of using them immediately. Saved selections can then be used consecutively later, giving you greater control over the pace of your build.
2. You can enable <orange>Auto-Replace Effect Cards</>. Once all 6 Skill slots are filled, any Skill Cards that appear afterward will automatically be replaced with passive Effect Cards, streamlining the process of refining your build.

NewStringTable.rank009:
The Leaderboard runs on a 60-day cycle, with rankings active throughout the entire period. Appraisers are ranked based on the net profit they earn in Going, Going, Gone!
One hour before the cycle ends, leaderboard data will stop updating and the rankings will be locked. Once the cycle concludes, all rankings and rewards will reset.
After each cycle, the top 100 Appraisers will receive rewards based on their final ranking. Rewards will be sent by mail.

Oneiror_SkillDes.GA_Oneiroi_UltraSkill_background: <Italic>I heard the bell at both ends of the dream: once at the beginning, once at the end. But the bell only rang once. From hydrothermal vents in the deep sea to skyscrapers on land, that awful chime has followed everything. Oh my, it's been ringing for 3.8 billion years.</>
Oneiror_SkillDes.GA_Oneiroi_Skill_background: <Italic>I have to stay awake the night before my birthday. I believe that if I fall asleep, someone will come for the old me and leave a newly grown me in its place.</>
Oneiror_SkillDes.GA_Oneiroi_Passive_2_background: <Italic>My body lives on faithfully, covered in scars and never saying a word.</>
Oneiror_SkillDes.GA_Oneiroi_QTE_background: <Italic>Would you believe me if I said this is the sound of the Big Bang?</>
Oneiror_SkillDes.GA_Oneiroi_Passive_1_background: <Italic>Sometimes, my shadow gets there before I do.</>
Oneiror_SkillDes.GA_Oneiroi_Passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Blossom Enhancement</>: Generates a Vita Bud Copy when the current Vita Bud has existed for 3s. This copy cannot duplicate and does not count toward the Vita Bud limit. The copy produces 20 Copied Vita Pistils. Every 0.5s, one Copied Vita Pistil flies toward a target within range and explodes, dealing 37.5% of the original Vita Pistil's DMG.

Oneiror_SkillDes.GA_Oneiroi_Skill_1_desc: Redirect Skill: Three Lambs' Attack Ratio
Oneiror_SkillDes.GA_Oneiroi_Skill_des:
Redirect Skill: Self-Identity Extension
Press to activate. Summons lambs to heal all team members once and grant them an ATK bonus based on Iroi’s Base ATK.
Summons three lambs to attack respectively, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</> and pulling in nearby enemies.
Using this skill builds up <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</>.

Redirect Skill: Future Self Continuity
Hold to activate. Creates dreamlike illusions, causing 3 allies to enter the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes2">Regression</> state and assist in battle. Regression is automatically removed after leaving combat.

Passive: While Iroi is on the team and in combat, any ally who falls enters the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes2">Regression</> state.
Builds up <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</> when any fallen ally enters the Regression state.
Oneiror_SkillDes.OneiroiRes1_des:
How to build up Imagination: Collaboration, Wakey-Wakey, Reflexive Response, Future Self Continuity, Bang!, and any ally entering Regression after falling.
Consumes Imagination to charge up, unleashing Daydream and Lucid Dream.
Changes the effects of 3.8-Billion-Year Mirage based on Imagination accumulated. Continuously consumes Imagination during the skill.
Oneiror_SkillDes.GA_Oneiroi_UltraSkill_des:
Return to the first dream. Opens the gate to a dream and triggers different effects based on the amount of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</> built up.
If Imagination has not reached the required threshold: Iroi opens the Dream of the Horned Gate, continuously healing all allies.
If Imagination has reached the required threshold: Iroi opens the Dream of the Ivory Gate, continuously healing all allies and dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</> to enemies inside the dream. During this time, press and hold the avatar of a team member in the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes2">Regression</> state to temporarily revive them and restore a portion of their HP. This effect can revive up to 1 character during each dream.
The dream continuously consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</>. When Imagination is depleted, the dream ends, and the revived character returns to the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes2">Regression</> state.
While the dream is active, <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</> cannot be built up, but casting Daydream and Lucid Dream do not consume <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</>.
Oneiror_SkillDes.GA_Oneiroi_Melee5_des: Hold Basic Attack again after Iroi uses Basic Attack: Daydream to consume <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</>, summoning Morpheus to unleash sustained fire that deals <Ling>Anima DMG</>.
Oneiror_SkillDes.GA_Oneiroi_Passive_3_des: Interacts with small animals in the open world to obtain a random growth item, up to 3 times per day and 999 times in total.

Opens a dream and triggers different effects based on the amount of Imagination built up.
Below threshold: Continuously heals all allies.
At threshold: Deals continuous <Ling>Anima DMG</>. Switching to a character in Regression state during the dream revives that character and restores some portion of their HP.
The dream ends when Imagination is depleted. The revived character then returns to Regression.
While the dream is active, Imagination cannot be built up, but casting Daydream and Lucid Dream do not consume Imagination.

Press to activate. Heals all team members, grants them an ATK bonus, deals <Ling>Anima DMG</>, pulls enemies in, and builds up Imagination.

Future Self Continuity
Hold to activate. While in combat, causes 3 allies to enter the Regression state and assist in battle.

Passive:
Fallen allies enter the Regression state while Iroi is on the team and in combat.
Builds up Imagination when any fallen ally enters the Regression state.
Oneiror_SkillDes.GA_Oneiroi_PerfectEvade_des: Triggers when using Basic Attack: Collaboration after a Critical Dodge. Throws Phantasos at the target, dealing 1 instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> and reducing Break. Builds up <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</> on hit.
Oneiror_SkillDes.GA_Oneiroi_Melee4_des: Triggers when using Basic Attack: Collaboration after a Critical Dodge. Throws Morpheus at the target, dealing 1 instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> and reducing Break. Builds up <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</> on hit.

Oneiror_SkillDes.OneiroiRes2_des:
Regression: A state where allied characters are replaced in battle by the lambs Morpheus, Icelos, or Phantasos. Characters in this state are invincible, inherit Iroi's stats, and attack automatically. Characters in this state cannot use Revive Items.
Each lamb has 3 attack methods:
Morpheus
Sweet Dreams: Fires an anesthetic needle at the target, dealing DMG on hit. Cooldown applies. Counts as Redirect Skill DMG.
Deep Slumber: Fires multiple anesthetic needles at the target, dealing DMG on hit. Cooldown applies. Counts as Redirect Skill DMG.
Support Skill: Fires a powerful anesthetic bomb at the target, dealing AoE DMG on hit and triggering the Esper Cycle effect of the corresponding character's attribute. Press Morpheus's avatar to cast. Consumes Iroi's Cycle Energy. Counts as Support Skill DMG.

Icelos
Little Prick: Strikes the target with a syringe slash, dealing DMG on hit. Cooldown applies. Counts as Redirect Skill DMG.
Double Dose: Strikes the target with a whirling syringe dance, dealing DMG on hit. Cooldown applies. Counts as Redirect Skill DMG.
Support Skill: Launches a syringe-blast attack at the target, dealing AoE DMG on hit and triggering the Esper Cycle effect of the corresponding character's attribute. Press Icelos's avatar to cast. Consumes Iroi's Cycle Energy. Counts as Support Skill DMG.

Phantasos
Lullaby Time: Plays a burst of sound waves at the target, dealing DMG on hit. Cooldown applies. Counts as Redirect Skill DMG.
Off-Key: Plays a beautiful melody at the target, dealing DMG on hit. Cooldown applies. Counts as Redirect Skill DMG.
Support Skill: Performs a flock concert at the target, dealing AoE DMG on hit and triggering the Esper Cycle effect of the corresponding character's attribute. Press Phantasos's avatar to cast. Consumes Iroi's Cycle Energy. Counts as Support Skill DMG.

Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Skill_background: <Italic>"Sa… Sakiri, can I eat this?" "Moron, next time ask before you eat!"</>
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_QTE_background: <Italic>Kiroumaru, stop right there! Hm? Did you just bump into something?</>
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Passive_2_background: <Italic>Those on the naughty list… will be taken by ghosts… or perhaps eaten?</>
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_UtraSkill_background: <Italic>No prey escapes before Kiroumaru has its fill.</>
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Melee_background: <Italic>According to Mr. T, an oddity who survived the depths of Kiroumaru's belly and lived to tell the tale thanks to Sakiri's timely intervention, hints at an unexpected perk: Amidst the gloom, one might unearth a half-digested game console to while away the hours—a quirky, entertaining twist to an otherwise harrowing wait for rescue.</>
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Passive_1_background: <Italic>It's not time to start yet! Instead of swallowing whole… wouldn't it be better to add more ingredients? Can't let the fun pass!</>
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Scorch Enhancement</>: Increases DoT taken by the target by 25% for each type of DoT effect while in Scorch state, up to 100%.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_UtraSkill_des_Tidy: <TextHLT>Suppresses</> enemies, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>. Increases Team ATK (excluding Sakiri) based on her ATK.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_star5_des: Fully restores Feast of Gluttony's Ultimate Energy and resets its cooldown immediately when Devour Whole makes the target airborne.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_starExtra1_des: Increases the skill level of Kiroumaru Headbutt, Devour Whole, and Feast of Gluttony by <NumGreen>1</>.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_star2_des: Deals extra damage with Feast of Gluttony to airborne enemies, scaling with the target's mass and capped at <NumGreen>600%</> of ATK.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_star1_des: Extends the immovable effect inflicted by Feast of Gluttony to <NumGreen>6s</>.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Skill_des:
Redirect Skill: Burp
 Press to activate. Kiroumaru opens its mouth, pulling in nearby enemies. Kiroumaru then inflates and knocks down the enemy.

 Redirect Skill: Gravity Eater
 Hold to activate. Kiroumaru opens its mouth, pulling in nearby enemies. Kiroumaru then bites through the ground, devouring the gravity in that area, levitating enemies there (not effective against Boss).
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Skill2_des_Tidy: Pulls and levitates nearby enemies, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_star3_des: Increases Devour Whole and Feast of Gluttony damage by <NumGreen>6%</> for <NumGreen>each</> enemy defeated by the Team over the next <NumGreen>15s</>, up to <NumGreen>60%</>. Resets when out of combat.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Melee_des:
Basic Attack: Ram
Sakiri wields Kiroumaru and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks.

Basic Attack: Eating Mode
Hold to activate Eating mode with Kiroumaru.
Kiroumaru opens its mouth to continuously pull targets nearby within a cone. Movable objects in the scene will be destroyed, and weak enemies will be devoured.
Each <NumGreen>devoured enemy</> takes <NumGreen>180s</> to be digested and only <NumGreen>1</> target can be digested at a time.
When enemies being digested reach the limit, Kiroumaru remains free to move but can't pull or devour anymore.
Release to exit the mode.

Basic Attack: Swallow
Sakiri wields Kiroumaru in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area upon impact.
Sagiri_SkillDes.Sagiri_Eat_des: Moves continuously while riding Kiroumaru. Pulls in and devours weak enemies during this time. Takes time to digest each devoured enemy.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Melee3_des: Wields Kiroumaru in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Passive_2_des: Reduces enemies' DEF by 10% for 20s after inflicting Airborne or <TextHLT>Suppress</>.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Melee1_des: Sakiri swings Kiroumaru and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Skill1_des: Press to activate. Kiroumaru opens its mouth, pulling in nearby enemies. Kiroumaru then inflates and knocks down the enemy.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_starExtra2_des: For each negative effect on the target, Sakiri deals <NumGreen>3%</> increased damage to the target, up to <NumGreen>12%</>.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_QTE_des: Let's see which unlucky soul is about to get squashed? Sakiri slams the enlarged Kiroumaru heavily onto the target, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_PerfectEvade_des: Triggers when using Ram after a Critical Dodge. Leaps high into the air and strikes down hard with Kiroumaru against enemies left vulnerable by their missed attacks. Deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area and reduces Break.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_UtraSkill_des: No escaping this time! Kiroumaru spits out a large amount of Gravity Slurry from above, dealing <NumGreen>6</> instances of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area. Applies strong gravity to hit enemies, pressing them heavily to the ground (not effective against Bosses). Prevents <TextHLT>Suppressed</> enemies from moving for a period. Increases Team ATK (excluding Sakiri) based on Sakiri's Base ATK.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_star4_des: Increases Team ATK (excluding Sakiri) by <NumGreen>30%</> of Sakiri's Base ATK for <NumGreen>20s</> after casting Feast of Gluttony.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Melee2_des_Tidy: Hold to activate <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&SagiriEat">Eating Mode</> with Kiroumaru. Mounts Sakiri onto Kiroumaru, allowing movement.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Melee2_des:
Hold to activate <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&SagiriEat">Eating Mode</> with Kiroumaru. Mounts Sakiri onto Kiroumaru, allowing movement.
Opens its mouth to continuously pull nearby targets within a cone while Hungry. Destroys movable objects in the scene and devours weak enemies.
Takes <NumGreen>180s</> to digest <NumGreen>each</> devoured enemy, with only <NumGreen>1</> target digested at a time.
Becomes Full when the number of enemies being digested reaches the limit, remaining movable but unable to pull or devour enemies.
Release to exit the mode.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Skill2_des: Hold to activate. Kiroumaru opens its mouth, pulling in nearby enemies. Kiroumaru then bites through the ground, devouring the gravity in that area, levitating enemies there (not effective against powerful enemies).

Shinku_SkillDes.GA_Shinku_UltraSkill1_des:
Don't think you can pull something like that and escape unscathed… Consumes all <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">Defiant Spirit</> to enter the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</> state, then launches multiple attacks, dealing high <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to the target.

Shinku_SkillDes.ShinkuWatch_des:
Enters the Menacing Gaze state when Shinku is active in battle for more than 2s without actively initiating an attack, gaining stacks every second. Grants her <NumGreen>1</> additional stack of Menacing Gaze whenever Shinku successfully performs a Critical Dodge while this state is active.
Ends Menacing Gaze when Shinku initiates an attack and hits, causing her to perform Instant Strike and deal bonus DMG in addition to the original attack. Each stack of Menacing Gaze increases this bonus DMG by <NumGreen>100%</> (scales with Basic Attack level, reaching <NumGreen>215.9%</> at level 11) and grants Defiant Spirit, Fading Reason, and Cycle Energy.
Shinku_SkillDes.GA_Shinku_Passive_3_des:

Grants her <NumGreen>1</> additional stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuWatch">Menacing Gaze</> whenever Shinku successfully performs a Critical Dodge while this state is active.
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuWatch">Menacing Gaze</> stacks up to <NumGreen>8</> times. Switching characters removes the state and all stacks.

Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Melee_background: <Italic>"The doggo… This dark stuff comes out with doggo punches… pretty impressive."</>
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Passive_2_background: <Italic>Your body might be free to move, but your shadow is held in an iron grip, rendering you immobile… Quite the peculiar sensation.</>
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Skill_background: <Italic>Some nimble troublemakers might think they can escape ETD's pursuit… They should check what's lurking beneath their feet.</>
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Passive_1_background: <Italic>Usually, there's no need for physical intervention—Skia can subdue targets with just his shadows, keeping facilities undamaged. Plus, he helps with cleanup… According to a BAC cafeteria survey, 84% of staff welcome Skia at their work site—less hassle for them!</>
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Passive_3_background: <Italic>Fadia once asked Skia what position his body feels like when submerged in shadows. Unable to describe it, Skia told her to use her imagination. He'd rather not know what images that sparked in her mind.</>
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Remora Enhancement</>: Inflicts an additional Remora on a target when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> locks onto them in Remora state.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_star1_des: Increses the auto-attack DMG Ratio for <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> by <NumGreen>60%</>.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_star4_des: Extends the duration of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill1">Tailed</> to <NumGreen>12s</>. Increases Attachment DMG by 2% per second a target is <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&attach">attached</>, up to 40%.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_star6_des: Increases the Extra DMG Ratio of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> by <NumGreen>20%</> while in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</> mode when touching an enemy locked onto by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</>.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_starExtra1_des: Increases the skill level of Arresting Art, Shadow Hound Chase, and The Pack by <NumGreen>1</>.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Melee3_des: Splitting from Skia's shadow, these shattered shadows resemble the fangs of a giant beast. They automatically track and <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&attach">attach</> to targets, disappearing after dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.
Skia_SkillDes.skiamelee1_des: A state applied to targets on hit, up to 3 stacks. Disappears after dealing damage to the target.
Skia_SkillDes.Skia_SpecialSkillEffectUnableTips: Special skill effects are disabled in the current mode
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_starExtra2_des: Reduces the locked-on target's Lakshana Resistance by 2% per <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</>, up to 6%.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_star5_des: Increases the target's mass by <NumGreen>50</> and reduces its Movement Speed by <NumGreen>20%</> for each <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> locked onto it.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_QTE_des: The relentless shadows cannot be shaken off. Commands the shadow like a police canine to bite the target, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Melee1_des:
Performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks using steady martial arts techniques, dealing <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.
Splits <NumGreen>1</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> from his shadow to pursue <NumGreen>each</> target hit. Locks each target with up to <NumGreen>3</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> simultaneously.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Melee2_des: Strikes in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_star2_des: Increases Skia's Crit Chance by <NumGreen>10%</> and Resistance to Interruptions by <NumGreen>50%</> for <NumGreen>15s</> after casting Shadow Hound Chase.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_star3_des:
Skia's damage to targets locked by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> is increased by <NumGreen>4%</>.
If only one target is locked onto by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> on the field, Skia's damage to it is further increased by <NumGreen>4%</>.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_PerfectEvade_des: Triggers when using Arresting Art after a Critical Dodge. Strikes enemies with ink-splash shadows, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area and reducing Break.
Skia_SkillDes.skiaskill2_des: Deals additional <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> when touching targets marked by <TextEXPL>Fang Thrust</>. Deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to hit targets upon exiting.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_SneakAtkquit_1_des: Shadow Hound Gnaw Outro DMG Ratio
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Skill_des:
A workflow designed for pursuit. Enters the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill1">Tailed</> state, leaps into own shadow, and deals <NumGreen>6</> instances of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area. Splits 3 <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> from shadow for each target hit, then enters <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</> mode.

<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill1">Tailed</>
Prevents <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> from disappearing after dealing damage to targets during the state.

<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</>
Allows movement on ground or wall surfaces, similar to Shadow Hound mode.
Remains undetected when approaching enemy targets.
Grants immunity to certain attacks, but cancels the mode when hit by ground damage.
Triggers additional attacks from <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> whenever touching an enemy already marked by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">them</>.
Press Basic Attack or switch characters to exit this mode during its duration.
Moves forward at the edge of a high place to end this mode.
Deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area upon exiting the mode.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_UtraSkill_des:
A workflow designed for suppression. Throws a spinning lighter, causing his shadow to spread across the ground in all directions, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area.
Converges multiple shadows on a single location like well-trained canines, dealing <NumGreen>3</> instances of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area.
Increases <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</>'s damage after casting The Pack (including collision damage in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</> mode) and inflicts a control effect on targets with each attack.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Melee3_des_tidy: Deals 1 instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> then disappears.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_UtraSkill_des_tidy:
Deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.

After casting, <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</>'s damage is increased, and applies a control effect on each hit.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Skill_des_tidy:
Deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> and enters <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill1">Tailed</> state. Applies 3 <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> to the target on hit, then enters <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</>.

<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill1">Tailed</>
Prevents <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> from disappearing after dealing damage to targets during the state.

<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</>
Removes this state when hit by ground damage. Launches 1 additional attack from <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> when touching a target marked by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">them</>. Press Basic Attack or switch characters during the duration to exit this mode and deal 1 instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Melee1_des_tidy: Deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>. Inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> on a target when hit, allowing up to 3 per target.
Skia_SkillDes.attach_des: Certain skills can apply Attachments to targets. Attachments automatically detach after dealing 1 instance of DMG to the target.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Passive_2_des: Increases <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> damage by <NumGreen>10%</> for <NumGreen>15s</> after casting The Pack, including collision damage in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</> mode.
Skia_SkillDes.skiaskill1_des: Enters this state when casting a Skill. Prevents <TextEXPL>Fang Thrust</> from disappearing after dealing damage to targets during the state.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Passive_3_des:
Hold Movement and Dodge to enter Shadow Hound mode

Shadow Hound
Lurks within his shadow, allowing movement on ground and wall surfaces.
Cannot be detected by enemies.
Grants immunity to certain attacks, but ends if hit by ground damage.
Press Basic Attack or switch characters to cancel.
Reaching the edge of elevated positions and moving forward also cancels the mode.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Passive_3_des_tidy: Hold Movement and Dodge to make Skia enter Shadow Hound mode. Press Basic Attack or switch characters to exit.

ST_AbyssBattle.abyss_13_buff_01_des: Grants allies <lv>25%</> All Resistance Penetration. Grants the characters involved in triggering Esper Cycle a <lv>20%</> DMG Bonus for 12s. Resets the duration when triggered again.

ST_AbyssBattle.abyss_12_buff_01_des: Increases allies' Lakshana DMG and Psyche DMG by <lv>45%</>.

This effect can trigger at most once every <lv>0.5s</>, stacks up to <lv>10</> times, and each stack lasts <lv>15s</>. Switching the character off-field immediately clears all stacks.

ST_AbyssBattle.AbyssCard_T_002_des: Restores the current character's Ultimate Energy to maximum.

ST_AbyssBattle.AbyssCard_B_008_des: Increases Team Cycle Intensity by <lv>100</> for <lv>60</>s.

ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_Trinity_TrinityDlg_001_bubble_001: - OBSTACLE DETECTED, PLEASE CLEAR A PATH -
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_Trinity_TrinityDlg_015_bubble_002: With so many artists living in 144, it's not surprising to see Anomalies.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_Trinity_TrinityDlg_006_bubble_001: 59541… 59514… 591… Wait, what was the verification code again?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_070040_001: Seafood from 7-Oceans, prepped and ready to serve!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_013_002: …Brother, get ready to be beaten down by reality.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_007_001: I wonder what songs are popular these days.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_016_002: He'd love for us all to behave ourselves and not tarnish his performance.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_012_002: Your mom is so good. Do your best and get out of retirement soon to take care of her.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_006_001: How do you think the officer's complexion is today?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_009_001: You said… after I go out, will everyone look at me strangely?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_003_001: Your carpentry work is quite good.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_015_002: Your prediction is more accurate than the weather forecast; I'll have to be careful when hanging out the laundry tomorrow.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_008_002: Don't even mention it. My mom said that after I went in, half of my dad's hair turned white.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_010_002: Don't keep swiping; the more you swipe, the more anxious you become. Like me, I swipe once a week, and it makes time fly by.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_001_001: It's boiled potatoes and cabbage again. I could guess next week's menu with my eyes closed.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_003_002: Hey, I've never done this before, but now I've learned a skill that might come in handy when I go out.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_002_001: Two years for a single phone. What was I thinking?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_019_002: I just can't stand that person's arrogant attitude.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_014_002: We waste our time here while they age faster outside.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_011_001: After I leave, I want to find a job, work hard, and start over where nobody knows me.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_012_001: My mom said, "Don't think about anything, just focus on reforming yourself, and the family will wait for you."
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_004_001: My child wrote to say that the family dog seems to not recognize my scent anymore.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_008_001: was supposed to graduate from university this year. Now… my classmates are taking graduation photos, and I'm operating a sewing machine.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_002_002: I'm even more wronged than you. I only tried to stand up for him, and now that person is living a carefree life outside.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_014_001: My dad has so many more wrinkles in the video. He used to be such a meticulous person.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_015_001: My knee hurts; it's definitely going to rain tomorrow.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_013_001: The year I came here, pork was only a dozen cubic meters per pound.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_009_002: Hold your head high and straighten your back. You make your own life.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_011_002: That's good, I'm going back to my hometown.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_019_001: I told you not to fight! Do you want to be locked up in a dark room?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_004_002: It's okay, just spend a couple more days playing with it and it'll remember.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_006_002: He looks alright, at least he's not frowning like he did yesterday.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_001_002: Be content; at least it's better than that rock-hard loaf of bread from last week.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_007_002: The first thing I'll do when I get out is buy a new phone and replace my old one.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_005_002: It's alright, but the detective novels are all overdone. You'll have to wait in line if you want to read them.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_005_001: Does the library here have many books?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_016_001: The young police officer seemed even more nervous than we were.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_Trinity_TrinityVending_001_dlg_Player: <purple>An empty vending machine? What should we do?</>
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SA_NPC_S1002_004_Player_001: <purple>A powered-off cleaning robot. Should we activate it to help BAC with the cleaning?</>
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SA_NPC_001_A_Player_006: <purple>Maybe it just wants to wander around.</>
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SA_NPC_001_A_Player_003: <purple>I can't fully grasp what you're trying to say.</>
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_Trinity_NPC_001_A_001_dlg_Player_016: <purple>Eclipse seems to have fallen asleep. Is it because there's no sun?</>
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_Trinity_NPC_001_A_001_dlg_Player_017: <purple>Eclipse is resting. Let's not disturb her for now.</>
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_Trinity_NPC_001_A_001_dlg_Player_012: <purple>Eclipse is even brighter and flickering even faster.</>
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_Trinity_NPC_001_A_001_dlg_Player_013: <purple>Eclipse is so dazzling that it's becoming a blur.</>
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_Trinity_TrinityVending_001_dlg_Player: <purple>The vending machine dropped an empty can of a different drink.</>
<purple>The vending machine has another slot for items. What should I do?</>
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SA_NPC_001_A_Player_001: <purple>This is Eclipse, an Anomaly that signed a contract with the BAC…</>
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_Trinity_NPC_001_A_001_dlg_Player_002: <purple>You catch a glimpse of the amusement park via Eclipse's observations.</>
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SA_CNPC_001004_003: I will soon become the best of CSU.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_DSD_001_dlg_003: DSD is the pen name of artist Bichir Whites, whose creations span various fields, including trendy toys.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_DSD_003_bubble_004: DSD POP's new mystery box. There are twelve models in this box and I haven't gotten the one I want yet.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_DSD_001_dlg_001: DSD is not just a brand, but an unbound lifestyle. Hello.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA078_NPC050A_001: Captain Exe's got the relentless work ethic most Bureau workers could use. He's also one of the few who never questions my coffee. He's got good taste!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_005012_Player_002: Exile on Main St. Record Shop
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Noisybill_008: New Q³ styles just dropped! Come get yours!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_082002_002: Q³ clothes are 50% off! Not buying them is like throwing away Fons!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Noisybill_009: Q³ limited-time sale! Exclusive items up to 50% off!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_Graffitistreet_005_: Wow! Won't you look at that? Do it again! Now that's what I call street dance! I'm all fired up!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_SecondPhase_019_bub: Keep up the pace! Keep up the pace!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_simple_293_002: Livehouse tickets here! Special price—just 1,000 Fons each!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_MW_003_002: —Right, Santiago? Who's the luckiest little Fluffy in the world, huh?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_SCT_007_004: —You can't even tell a horn from a siren?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA073_NPC030_006: Oh! I know a few self-service photo booths around. If you have time, let's get some photo stickers together!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_MW_005_006: —My granddaughter's the cutest in all of Hethereau!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_TYG_007_003: —So can you explain what the hell this place has to do with the Anomaly case?!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA074_NPC030_006: They never planned to meet, yet they found each other in the enormous city—isn't this grand?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_MW_005_003: —So they won't even let my grandson enter? Are they afraid my precious boy would sweep the whole thing?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_TYG_CNPE010025_Player_004: —Not to mention, there are plenty of fans around your age here to watch the game.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_TYG_CNPC093006_005: —and most importantly, fight for playing time and a spot in the lineup.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC097008_001: …Sorry, I'm still thinking about that performance just now.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_363_005: …No, I definitely need to keep an eye on that old fool of mine.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_WA045_NPC1029_009: …But I'm actually kinda curious what it tastes like…? Alright, I'll take one, please!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_384_004: …What the heck?! What kind of lame story is that? It doesn't even make sense. You just wanted an excuse to say those words, didn't you?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_415_002: …What? There's a problem with the report? I'll head back right away to fix it…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_sitrest_004_dlg_001: The flowers in the flower shop look great and smell great today as well. I bought a sou… sou… how do you spell 'souffle'?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA060_NPC080A_004: Appraiser, you need to grill her some time too… By the way… when did you even show up…?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_364_003: …Hey, take it easy there, or you might end up flooring it straight into the lake…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_TYG_005_001: …Why are you looking all over the place? Can you focus for once?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_364_001: You want to practice driving here?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_425_001: …Do you think our agency's idols could ever make it to such a big stage?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_452_003: …Do you think these flowers will ever completely fall?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC022_ACT_010: You remember…? Then I don't have to mention it again.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_358_002: …keep running around like that, and you'll get nothing but lettuce for dinner tonight!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA072_NPC030_006: …but it was delivered to nowhere… that kind of feeling.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_NPC010_Deer_005: …So this is what was going on.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SA_CNPC_001004_004: It's… it's just temporary! Whatever, I'm not wasting time talking to you here—I have urgent matters to attend to at the CSU office…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_indoor_Flowershop_002_bubble_0: …The same flower with a different color has different meanings? Is that a thing?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_simple_271_Player_006: …Spit it out, now. The owner can't find their stuff and they're getting anxious.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_SCT_011_004: …Uh, why do you have to play beach volleyball barefoot? I'm not used to this kind of thing…

ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_340_003: You want to eat all that…?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC001_ACT_009: Wanna play a game of Mahjong at the Maid Café? I'm a Mahjong expert, by the way.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC026_ACT_011: I want to build a snowman… do you?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_BTArmy_003_bubble_0: Back when Blue Scarves went on that mission…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_simple_256_001: Back in my day, I was unbeatable! Everyone at the court would call me the "King of the Game"!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_SCT_009_010: That's a bit of a stretch…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC_054_A_007: If you want to become a chief mechanic, then your hands must be steady. When I first learned to hold a wrench, the old master told me—
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC015_ACT_009: Want to watch a movie? Well, I'd rather watch movies in a quiet place.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_walk_003_dlg_001: Want to hear a mysterious urban legend of Hethereau?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_segu_lvzhidian_001_dlg_004: It's not easy to take care of a potted plant. Let's start with the basics: watering.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_464_002: There are too many things I want… What should I even wish for?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA069_Player_004: There's more than one way to enter the academy.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_segu_tinchechang_002_bubble_00: Escape… such lonely night, tears coming down…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SA_NPC_001_A_Player_037: Would you like me to help you observe humanity?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_CNPC107001_001: I've been meaning to say this, but that Ferris wheel is ridiculously tall.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_CNPC070068_002: My disappointment is immeasurable, and my life is ruined…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC073020_004: Got any questions, Master? Lilyco can answer anything! Well, except for the Maid Code of Conduct!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_MW_CNPC_063018_006: If you're interested, come back again sometime!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_NPC_054_A_055: It feels like a perfect match for my skills! Turning a steering wheel and turning a wrench are pretty similar, right? Barra.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_072006_003: Seems like it's all just for show…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_segu_camp_007_dlg_003: I bet setting up a recycling station here would bring in a steadier income than an office job.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_simple_279_004: Feels like it's been ten years already…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_SCT_009_009: Perfect for clumsy people like us.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_Eibon_001_option_Pl: I don't think I want to know.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_segu_camp_007_dlg_001: I feel like I picked up more trash today than the gear they brought for camping.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_TBS_353_003: Feels like a good business opportunity… Hey, should we try running a B&B?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPE108001_Player_002: They seem to really love dancing.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_299_001: The new collections at Q³ Fashion are so trendy!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_376_001: I feel like clothing quality has really gone downhill lately.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC030_ACT_004: If you're tired, I know a nice shop around here. We can go sit there for a while.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_candystore_001_opti: I feel like I'm not that lucky!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_SecondPhase_014_bub: Feels like my heart's been cleansed.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC027_ACT_014: The design of these clothes aren't adventurous enough…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_357_001: The tofu shop owner's kind of cute—always cheerful…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC075011_003: Whoever that is must be a pretty odd person…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_noisybill_003_bubbl: Thank you for visiting. We hope you have enjoyed shopping with us.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_NPC07330_002: May Lady Luck smile upon you!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC015_ACT_013: Let's take it slow. There's still a lot of time. No need to rush.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_segu_musicground_003_dlg_005: Take care, this is where I belong.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_NPC006_C010021_001: If I became a star… I wouldn't have to sit in an office reporting to my boss anymore, right?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SA_NPC_001_A_018: Adults… rush… ███ young ones… learn… █ survive.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA014_NPC_009_Player_001: I… don't know much about antiques…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_SecondPhase_002_bub: Uh… isn't the weather nice today?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC034043_002: I… I haven't been going on about it…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_CNPC034043_001: I… I sent out a love letter yesterday…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC072022_001: I… I was just so hungry last night, so I had a tiny piece of cake…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_Graffitistreet_004_: I've never been formally educated in art… and I'd never dare face criticism.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_379_003: I-I did! You just didn't hear me!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_070024_003: I've always wanted to change my mediocre life, but my lack of talent has left me hitting walls everywhere. I'm in my thirties now and yet… I still haven't accomplished anything…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_070033_004: I work the night shift, so of course I sleep during the day! Is that so strange?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC001_ACT_003:
People at school think I'm a senior because I'm tall. It's kinda embarrasing…
Now that I think of it, it's not a big deal. I even wanna be taller!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_070031_004: Last time I was driving at night on the coastal highway, I suddenly heard the sound of a motorcycle behind me…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_WA045_CNPC076018_001: Aurelia, that's exactly what you told me before my last exam!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC029_ACT_027: I'm not used to being outside in this weather.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_Trinity_TrinityDlg_018_bubble_006: I hope I won't be answering calls in my sleep!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_070024_004: I can't go on like this anymore. I need to escape this life… even if I have to pay the Price for it…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_005012_002: I know nothing about records. If the conversation turns to music, I'll definitely be lost… What if my upperclassman thinks less of me… ugh…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC015_ACT_004: I'm not biased against motorcycles. It's nice to change things up from time to time.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_CNPC103019_002: I'm afraid to go near her… Bruh, can you go ask if she's okay?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_Gongjiaozhan_002_bu: I'm not here to interview you.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_WA049_NPC024_005: I haven't caught anything today. I can't leave just now…!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC039001_005: I can't take it anymore! Just imagining it… makes me want to faint!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_CNPC039001_002: I don't want power or wealth, I only want…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_NPC_006_Player_001: I don't need to skip work…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_indoor_Budori_011_dlg_009: No, I want to see just how terrible it can get.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_458_002: I don't know either, but maybe only strange trees like this can become wishing trees?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_025005_003: I'm not really sure myself. Some say he used illegal Anomalies in his dish designs. Others claim he's done all sorts of shady things…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_103004_003: I went to see it too. It was honestly the most thrilling race ever held at the Unheard Shores Circuit!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC078006_003: Hey, I just heard about it too!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_simple_225_003: I only got first place that one time, that's all.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.BSA_simple_170_005: I wish I had someone to play games with too…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_WA064_CNPC104003_003: I want to be a singer like you and perform on a dazzling stage!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA054_NPC028_001: Hamburger steaks don't sound too bad…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_Zhaoxiangguan_001_bubble_003: I'd like a nice photo taken of me, too. I'm graduating this year and about to start a new life, after all.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_segu_cinema_002_dlg_005: I bought it for a higher price myself. Seeing that fate has brought us together, I'll let you have it for an extra 20% more than the original price.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS471_004: I've never seen so many people in line before.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_SNPC_006: Me too! It'd be more fun if they flew a bit farther!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_segu_carcinema_004_bubble_011: It's my first time at a Drive-in Theater too.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_CNPC_083003_004: I made some decent money selling fireworks back then too…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_coffeetalk_001_bubb: Me too!!! How wonderful! Settyn deserves it!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS472_002: Same here, my legs feel like jelly.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_Lipindian_001_bubbl: I don't have many other hobbies… growing flowers is all I like. Feel free to ask me any questions you have if you're interested.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_385_002: I wanna go too! I wanna go too!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_070036_001: I mean, I thought the movie was touching too… but wasn't this supposed to be a detective thriller? Why are you crying?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_368_002: I bought a really special swimsuit.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_346_003: I bought a Novus M1000. Nothing special, just for daily use.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_CNPC070070_002: I should have checked my luck before going out!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_Trinity_TrinityDlg_021_bubble_001: When I checked the suggestion box today, I found many letters of complaint about Lacrimosa senpai.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC144001_002: I just came over from that red house over there and decided to take a walk around the beach.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_291_003: I've been running around here since I was a kid. I know this area like the back of my hand!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC024_ACT_013: I left the city when I was young. Hethereau was entirely new to me.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_049002_Player_004: I thought after the ads finished, the cartoons would start…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_061001_002: I used to be an office worker in the city. After quitting my job, I leased this plot of land. Now it's how I make my living.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_088001_003: I used to be a rather average Anomaly Hunter. My unusual friends and I opened an agency together.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_Graffitistreet_005_: I used to be in my school's Street Dance Club. Too bad that now I gotta work overtime every day… I have no time to practice.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_workingJTF_001_dlg_: We are mainly responsible for the daily maintenance of the Wertheimer Tower and monitoring the Wertheimer Index, ensuring the safety of Hethereau.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_TYG_005_004: We're already suspicious enough pretending to be a couple as is—now we have to film the match and bring it back to analyze…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_TYG_002_002: We've been keeping our real power under wraps for ages. They won't know what hit 'em.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA062_CNPC024027_001: There's a band competition in a few days. We wanted to step up our game.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_NPCS070_012_001: We just came from that way, and I didn't spot anything.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_285_002: We've been to the amusement park so many times already. I want to visit that tree on Yuanmu Hill instead…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBSL110410B_001: We're just testing the mics… We don't have to start chanting at the chorus, do we…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC010_Deer_010: We can simply follow one of them.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_TYG_005_002: We're here to scout the competition!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_sitrest_002_dlg_006: We are the most righteous organization of heroes in Bridge Crossings! All right, I need to get back to work.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_070025_002: We're here looking at the villas in Green Wall Slope, just soaking in that high society atmosphere…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_boduoli_002_dlg_002: Our signature dish, Secret Dancing Takoyaki, is so tasty that it'll make you boogie on the spot.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_272_003: We should probably get here even earlier next time, huh?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC022_ACT_028: Would we finally have the same views?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_070041_001: Isn't this exactly the vase we've been looking for? And look, they're selling it right here!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_BP_Police_Mass_Low_01: Security Office! Stop and drop your weapon immediately!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC030_ACT_022: Let's make a snow angel! A snow angel!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_segu_candystoreqijian_002_dlg_: We hand out free candy every week, hoping to bring a little bit of joy to everyone's life.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_CNPC1024_003: We will always be with you!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS470_007: No point arguing now. We've all lost big time.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC080006_001: All of this is because of Ms. Inanna's philanthropy. We should be grateful.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_segu_dianwancheng_002_dlg_003: We agreed to battle it out for three hundred rounds. He said he just left home three hours ago and claimed to be almost here two hours ago… and there's still no sign of him right now.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_WA050_CNPC016018_010: We've already contacted the Bureau. They told us no one there goes by "Exe."
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_sitrest_005_dlg_003: The fact that we can chat peacefully like this, the fact that nothing terrible is happening… doesn't it make this a wonderful day?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_BTArmy_001_bubble_0: Blue Scarves is still too low-key.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA069_NPC031_006: I prefer to follow the rules and not bother the students.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_TYG_CNPC093006_004: I'll help you find the right team, negotiate with the club, and keep you away from predatory contracts…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_segu_xibeiwanghongjie_002_bubb: I will continue to work hard.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_Trinity_TrinityDlg_017_bubble_006: I will treat you all to afternoon tea.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_070037_002: I live nearby, so I come here when I have nothing better to do—just to check out the luxury cars I'll never be able to drive myself…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_070039_002: Neither of us can cook! It's all on you tonight, big bro!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_WA005_NPC_00406_002: I'm fixing the TV. Mind your own business!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_MW_004_005: I'd really like to know how you got a Danzaburou to follow along with you, Captain…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPCS034_011_002: I can't wait to see just how handsome he is!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_SecondPhase_002_bub: I'll head back now. Things are hectic in the shop.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC00413_001: I don't have a friggin' Fons left… Why am I still being chased…?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_005010_Player_003: I don't actually listen to them that much…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SU_CNPC_075007_001: I'll go buy another bell just like it!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_Trinity_TrinityDlg_009_dlg_007: I'm going to pitch it to the director. It's going to be big!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA075_NPC030_001: I just treated Lacrimosa to Panda's new tomato hotpot!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_038013_002: I just visited him at the hospital. According to him, he was suddenly attacked by a large truck with tentacles…!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_simple_262_001: I'm at Clicky now, but I don't see you anywhere?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_376_003: The clothes I bought just six months ago feel super tight now! Some of them I can barely zip up halfway…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA079_NPC029_002: I was tracking a suspect's trail. I picked up your movements the second you stepped onto the roof.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_NPC_054_A_050: I'm gonna grab some of that new foundation to even out my skin, barra.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_SecondPhase_028_bub: It's not that I can't do it… I'm just lazy.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SD_CNPC_078004_003: I just want my bell back… I picked it out specifically because it's my favorite color! Waaah…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_segu_carcinema_001_dlg_003: I'm a repairman of theater projectors, not a repairman of cars.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS521C_001: I was just building what I felt like building…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_indoor_Newway_008_dlg_005: I just came in to enjoy the AC. That sales rep was really pushy! Gave me a whole bunch of coupons trying to convince me to buy a car. Look at all these…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPE001015_Player_003: I'm not a kid, you know.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC021_ACT_026: Can I hide in your pocket…? We'll go faster that way…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_segu_busstation_001_bubble_001: I drove two hours to see this movie, and that was it?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_025005_006: I tried it once and was truly impressed. I heard the menu was developed by the head chef alone! That's really something…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SU_S0111_NPC021_ACT_007: I hear the call of your heart. Appraiser… I'm here, just as you desired.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_378_002: Ooh, I heard they're planning to collaborate with new brands too…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_445_001: I heard the museum director has a display room for his private collection!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_070023_007: I heard it wanted to surprise its date, but then—haha, the poor little thing ended up being so unlucky!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_simple_268_025: My brother still isn't here, and he's not answering his phone either.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC111001_002: I like the layout they're featuring.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC144001_004: One of my favorite writers wrote a book about that Beacon Ray, so I guess this counts as some sort of fan pilgrimage, right?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC030_ACT_001: I'm back! What's my team doing?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_indoor_DrugStore_009_dlg_002: I'm tagging discounted prices on soon-to-expire items, feel free to check them out, they're a bargain!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_simple_261_001: I'm at the intersection. Just take a turn and you'll be here!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_CNPC010019_002: I saw another scary anomaly in the alley! Come save me right now!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC011_ACT_012: These fish… don't they get bored of seeing cars passing by everyday?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_297_002: I can't decide between red or blue… What do you think?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_simple_265_002: I'm looking for a better fishing spot.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA061_NPC023_002: I'm picking an album… What song do you listen to when you drive?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_sitrest_003_dlg_002: I was born in Hethereau and used to live in the New Herland District… you know, THAT building. I moved here when I got older.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA071_NPC031_002: I'm inspecting merchandise known as Mystery Boxes.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SA_CNPC_044001_002: I'm observing how people behave around here, gathering material for my next detective novel…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SA_CNPC_070001_002: I'm observing this sculpture, trying to remember which movie it appeared in… Hey, don't look at me like that! I know Bagel's Top 100 Hethereau movies list like the back of my hand…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA030_NPC016_002: I am looking at the bills this month… Too many expenses…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SA_CNPC_005001_002: I'm trying to write a poem about flowers. Some troubling things have happened recently, but looking at this flower bed is truly inspiring.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_CNPC103018_001: I'll wait for you by the street. You go to the convenience store and buy two cat-ear rice balls.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_NPC_054_A_014: I firmly believe that following a steadfast leader like that means good times ahead. Barra.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_simple_268_017: My brother's been having a rough time lately. Every vehicle he drives ends up in an accident…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_WA014_NPC_05702_001: I'd rather keep it than sell it cheaper!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_simple_254_002: I'd rather transfer to somewhere quiet like Hankaku Street… Even if the pay is worse, at least it'd be less stressful…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_SecondPhase_023_bub: I really can't drink anymore, though… maybe next time.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.BSA_simple_183_002: I hereby declare strawberry to be the best flavor!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_294_001: My kid loves worrying about me. He insisted on buying us some fancy massage chair! What a waste of money!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_295_004: I just added some new equipment to my game room. Why don't you come over this weekend for some LAN gaming?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_293_004: My dog can ride a motorbike!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_293_002: Well, my dog can guard the house! Dogs are the best!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_293_003: My cat can fix my AC!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_293_001: My cat can catch mice! Cats are the best!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_294_002: Mine's the same way: insists on celebrating my birthdays, brings all sorts of packages to my place, and even takes time off to visit…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.BSA_simple_181_002: My cat doesn't like it. What's your cat watching?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_Trinity_TrinityDlg_013_bubble_001: A Mysty got into my house, poured a whole bottle of soy sauce into my freshly cooked sweet soup, and I took a sip!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC001_ACT_006: I know the BAC inside and out. Remember? This is the place we met!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_TYG_004_001: I'm totally lost. What am I supposed to be looking at…?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_Trinity_TrinityDlg_008_dlg_004: So I clicked the link, and it showed I could exchange my points for a BAC exclusive Chuppa toy, but when I asked today, they said it was fake!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_288_009: I knew it! There's a family pulling all the strings from Hethereau's shady underworld… Ha! Haha! The movies were right all along!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_444_001: I want to go to Pukaland!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC063012_003: See, I told you! Even with the most clichéd plot, a great director can still make it captivating!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_369_001: I can't… run anymore… This feels… so painful…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC032_ACT_020: I'm already thinking about the explanation I'm giving to my captain.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SA_CNPC_001003_003: I've been working at the bureau for six years now, and I've never seen Agent.LUCK arrive late or miss a day of work.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SD_CNPC_076013_001: I've already missed several episodes, and now I have to listen to my classmates spoil it for me every day?!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_simple_268_015: I'm starting to worry that even my shoes might malfunction next…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_Zhaoxiangguan_001_bubble_008: I can't wait to start my new life!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_344_001: I picked up your kid from school for you…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_TakePhoto_001_dlg_0: I'm usually busy with work. When I have free time, I take my family out for a stroll.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_084004_002: When I was young, this place was a forest filled with life. Whenever we had time off from farming, my friends and I would always come here to play…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_CNPC1024_006: I really should find the time to give myself a break.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA070_NPC031_007: I love the scares that catch you off guard but still make sense. Each scare is a clever mix of lighting, sound, and buildup.
