ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_segu_tianqiao_001_dlg_002: And down there, the scenery gazes back up at me.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_307_001: Scenic spots, vacation tips, ask me—your all-knowing tour guide!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC10307_001: Fly away, little paper plane… Please carry my feelings to that person…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC07703_001: Over here! Fly this way! Haha, look! They're all following my lead!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_SCT_CNPC103027_014: You're about to reach the Advanced Arena… c'mon, just one final push! You got this!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_SCT_CNPC136001_014: You're about to reach the Advanced Arena… c'mon, just one final push! You got this!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_SCT_007_005: Someone's coming to give you what you deserve! I'm not getting out!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SA_CNPC_041004_002: The weekly meeting is about to start, but I left the important documents at my desk.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.BSA_NPC_S1002_004_003: Rejected. Priority permission acquired. Please leave immediately.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC040004_006: Ordinary people can't defend against every scammer's schemes…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS470_005: The cool, brooding rival… Why couldn't it be our cool, brooding rival…?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_450_001: The view from up high is amazing, you can see the entire Cape Park…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC_Sub_001_MapTransfer_012: High places have the best views.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA023_NPC_008_Player_001: If Kiroumaru can't use the shutter, I can take pictures for you instead.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA023_NPC_008_002: Kiroumaru! Zip it and pick up that camera!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_simple_271_Player_005: Kiroumaru, have you been randomly swallowing things again?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_simple_276_001: Wow, look at that fish! It's huge!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_SecondPhase_010_bub: Fish? They'll bite when the timing is right.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_CNPC092013_001: Microphone check, earpiece check, lighting check.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.BSA_simple_187_003: Radioactive bread, spicy apple stir-fry, and the blue nebula burst!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_indoor_DrugStore_001_bubble_00: The black is designed to take care of skin oil and exfoliates, which is often more helpful for men.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_sitrest_002_dlg_003: Oh! I'm a member of the Blue Scarves. Unrelated personnel, please leave immediately.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA075_Player_002: (But it's Elyms… I can picture her hanging out with anyone.)
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_NPC_004_Player_004: (Still, it's probably better not to mention this to Lacrimosa.)
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA056_Player_004: (You turn the shell over and study its pattern. A Fluffy's face seems to appear right before your eyes.)
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA056_Player_002: (You take what Shinku hands you… a seashell?)
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_simple_271_Player_009: (I should go back to Eibon and ask Kiroumaru about this.)
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_070038_Player_002: What a rich inner world they have…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_simple_269_Player_004: (Wait, is that right? It was just some title the appraiser came up with on the spot… I don't remember, but whatever…)
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_NPC_004_Player_003: (That must be the report Mint never turned in…)
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_simple_269_Player_008: (She's actually a fan of the Coluccis… If Nanally met her, she'd be over the moon.)
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_070032_Player_006: (Surely there couldn't be such a terrifying explanation… right…?)
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_NPC_006_Player_005: (I feel like I just said something I shouldn't have…)
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_NPC_Sub_003_Player_008: (What's actually being challenged here is the customer's physical tolerance limit…)
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_070036_Player_001: (Floe Cinema always has such excellent taste in movies…)
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_SecondPhase_007_bub:
Whose car is this?
So ****ing inconsiderate!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_024003_Player_003: (Looks like the café is about to get busier…)
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_025005_Player_003: It seems the Bureau of Anomaly Control hasn't revealed the full truth to the public… Perhaps they don't want to involve innocent people at the restaurant.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_070024_Player_004: Looks like the rumors about Pawn Moonlight have affected quite a few people.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_038013_Player_005: (Octopus and truck-topus… I guess they must be distant relatives.)
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_037005_005: (At least it's bigger than my dorm room at Eibon…)
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA078_Player_005: (If I remember correctly, Ms. Fei has a pretty unusual go-to recipe…)
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_070022_Player_005: Should I tell Taygedo that his lost love has become a legend now?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_070017_Player_002: (Could that be Nanally he's talking about…?)
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA053_Player_003: (Maybe it'd be best to leave her alone.)
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA079_Player_005: (I probably should leave him to his work.)
ST_AmbianceDialogue.BSA_simple_167_004: Huh? It's the first time I've seen someone humble-brag like that.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.BSA_simple_167_006: Huh? It's the first time I've heard someone insult me like that.

ST_Appearance.Fashion_1076_3_Desc:
A pro-grade racing swimsuit that reveals her competitive spirit. The beach has a way of drawing out one's true self—or perhaps that is simply the thrill of cutting through the waves.
"Go all out—even when you’re enjoying summer."
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1090_1_Desc:
*Changes the interface appearance when this outfit is equipped and its wearer is in your current lineup.

A throwback to a once-popular retro-futurist fashion trend. Holographic finishes! Fluorescent colors! Pixels! Retro tech!
"How wonderful! People once 'imagined' a dazzling, high-tech future with such hope and excitement—"
ST_Appearance.Fashion_Glide_1074_Desc: Exclusive Glider Livery for Exe. Hold this hand, and you can almost imagine traveling to any world.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1010_1_Desc:
Q³ holiday limited edition pajamas, perfect for listening to bedtime stories with friends.
"Once upon a time, there was a lonely little gray wolf in the forest who donned a velvet red cape, hoping to make friends."
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1003_1_Desc:
Q³ holiday limited edition pajamas, perfect for listening to bedtime stories with friends.
"A witch had a pumpkin field with squeaky clean magical pumpkins, and scruffy non-magical pumpkins."
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1019_1_Desc:
Q³ holiday limited edition pajamas, perfect for listening to bedtime stories with friends.
"Mary had a little black cat, with ears from her mother, a body from her father, and siblings as its limbs. Wherever Mary went, it would always follow along."
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1020_0_Desc: A support T-shirt for "Agent Gen Z - Red." Just wearing it should definitely attract fellow fans… right?
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1073_0_Desc: An updated Pink Paws Bank employee uniform, redesigned to match the brand's signature color scheme. Chiz spends at least an hour every morning ensuring her outfit is spotless and perfectly pressed.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1057_nighty_Desc: "If it's not worth doing, don't bother. If it is, do the bare minimum."
ST_Appearance.Pendant_8_Desc: Going out on your own sounds lonely. Take this with you!
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1010_2_Desc:
A fighting outfit with a unique design. Nanally specifically enrolled in a combat training class for this.
"When am I going to attend the training sessions? Uh… Next time for sure!"
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1076_2_Desc: Countless storms gather in her heart, and the dragonhunter sets forth on her quest.
ST_Appearance.Glide_2_3_Desc: Lacrimosa customized this glider with her favorite tomato motifs to help the Bureau-issued Chuppa get off work a little earlier. Chuppa is happy, and Lacrimosa is happy. That's what they call a win-win.
ST_Appearance.Pendant_7_Desc: Blackbird just snagged a huge Oracle Stone!
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1055_Nighty_Desc:
Jiuyuan's loungewear. Though it looks simple, this outfit was carefully tailored by a designer.
"Breathe in… breathe out… stretch your body, let your mind find peace…"
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1071_swimsuit_Desc: A dark figure races across the waves, carving out a route of his own. Where does it lead? Eh, he'll figure it out.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1019_swimsuit_Desc: A shiny candy wrapper catches the sunlight and shimmers with every color of the rainbow. This one's mint.
ST_Appearance.Pendant_2_Desc: Tonight, the lights shine one pixel brighter.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1019_rpg_level2_Desc: From the first fallen leaf to the final footprint, the hunt never ceases.
ST_Appearance.Glide_1_3_Desc: A glider livery designed after Officer Whisker. Its powerful tail keeps you safe as you soar through the skies.
ST_Appearance.Glide_2_2_Desc: A glider livery designed after Officer Whisker's vehicle. "Wee-woo, wee-woo! Maintaining order in the skies… Wait, this is a glider, right? What are these wheels even for?"
ST_Appearance.Glide_1_2_Desc: A glider livery designed after the Skyfish Banner. Today's forecast is cloudy, possibly overcast. Don't forget your umbrella!
ST_Appearance.Glide_1_1_Desc: A glider livery designed after the Ghostly Kite, increasing the risk of malfunction by 99%… Relax, it's just a joke.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1052_1_Desc:
A high-end Ghost Orchid–themed custom outfit that produces striking results in studio shoots.
But it would only have been within reach when Eibon first opened and funds were still plentiful.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1090_2_Desc:
A school uniform straight out of Neverland, where fairies live—a little touch of storybook magic.
"Winter's over, and spring is here! Why not head out and enjoy it with your best friend?"
ST_Appearance.Glide_6_Desc: Iroi's exclusive Glider Livery. Apparently—maybe, probably—only one kiddo is doing all the work.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1071_1_Desc: A casual streetwear look that pairs simple pieces with bold accessories to express true individuality.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1054_0_Desc: Dark clothing designed for concealment. Daffodill spends an hour each morning making sure every piece of fabric is perfectly in place.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1051_2_Desc:
Playful yet stylish attire with layers and eye-catching accessories, showcasing a carefree personality.
"A first-rate hunter should have first-rate fashion sense too!"
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1051_6_Desc: A playful overalls set full of childlike charm, featuring unique printed patterns and an asymmetrical design with loads of personality. Even if you get paint splattered on it, it'll just look like part of the print.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1039_0_Desc: An alluring, form-fitting outfit where desire blossoms from the chest. Best not to stare directly.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1036_2_Desc: Light shifts, and something stirs beneath the surface. When night overtakes reality, even the sweetest dreams may be quietly rewritten.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1057_3_Desc: Give it everything you've got, own the stage, and be the star everyone remembers.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1033_0_Desc: An outfit blending combat readiness with elegance. A butler's role: flawlessly handle every task, from security to preparing breakfast.
ST_Appearance.Glide_4_Desc: Chaos's exclusive glider livery is made from specially customized canvas. Sturdy and durable, it has a distinctive rugged beauty.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1071_nighty_Desc: Even on days off, training never stops!
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1090_nighty_Desc:
A fresh, comfortable casual outfit for dropping by a friend's place.
Add the glasses, and there's something almost dreamlike about the look—as though they're about to give a lecture… or tell another story about how people connect.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1057_1_Desc: An outfit saved for special occasions. "I only wear it a few times a year. Surely I can let the whole energy-saving thing slide, right?"
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1021_0_Desc: The wide collar can cover half the face, acting like a protective shell. Perfect for hiding uncertain expressions.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1025_0_Desc: A well-fitted motorcycle jacket that leaves plenty of room for wing movement.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1075_rpg_level2_Desc: The chant goes on, and the edge of the dream quietly stretches another inch.
ST_Appearance.Glid_All_Xiupa_des: A Chuppa-style glider, reportedly voted the second most beloved glider livery among Bureau of Anomaly Control staff.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1008_0_Desc: A practical outfit inspired by a suit design, modified for easier movement. Although Skia has left his former company, he's still accustomed to dressing this way.
ST_Appearance.Glide_11_Desc: The walls are made of bread, and the windows of candy… a chocolate-cookie plane sails the cotton-candy wind, flying forevermore.
ST_Appearance.Pendant_3_Desc: Night, murky and still as water.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1023_1_Desc: The best disguise is looking like you belong. Soft, simple, and easy to overlook—perfect for slipping into just about any neighborhood. Shh, keep your voice down. We're technically supposed to be working.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1075_rpg_level3_Desc:
She weaves the stars into the dreamscape.
As Iroi sleeps, the weight of a universe rests lightly upon her.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1010_nighty_Desc:
Nanally's loungewear. Thoughtful decorations have been added to a simple dress.
"Ever heard of 'adding wings to a tiger'? Tigers and wings are a perfect combo!"
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1020_1_Desc:
Studies and hobbies can totally go hand in hand!
"This is Orion from Gen Z! She may be the youngest of the three sisters, but she's still one seriously dependable agent! Especially in Episode 178, when she..."
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1010_3_Desc:
School uniform style clothing that balances both beauty and comfort. The armband was handmade by Nanally herself, and she's quite satisfied with it.
"Ahem, Colucci has its own standards of discipline!"
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1051_7_Desc:
Preppy academic attire with understated colors complemented by classic patterns, showcasing the refined aura of an honor student.
"Want to attend tomorrow's mixer together?"
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1004_nighty_Desc:
Lacrimosa's loungewear. Made of soft, cozy fabric that lets you fall asleep anytime, anywhere.
"One bat… two bats… three… zzz…"
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1074_nighty_Desc:
A rare sight: a workaholic finally taking a day off.
So why do they look even more miserable when they don't have to work…?
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1073_nighty_Desc:
Chiz's loungewear. Soft, skin-friendly material—staying at home is the right way to spend a day off.
"I'm not going out tomorrow either, but… I hope the sun still comes out!"
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1004_3_Desc:
Like night and day, some things in this world are simply black and white: espresso and latte, tuxedo cats and white cats, piano keys, Lacrimosa's everyday outfit, and the white dress she wears only once in a while.
"White dresses are pretty. But… they get dirty so easily."
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1003_0_Desc: An outfit that's undeniably adorable… though Sakiri wouldn't admit it. Comes with a hat, bow tie, and teddy bear backpack. But what's inside the bear's belly?
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1046_0_Desc: Clean, sharp tailoring. Perfect for everyday wear.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1051_0_Desc: Clean, sharp tailoring. Perfect for everyday wear.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1004_4_Desc: Happiness sometimes arrives without rhyme or reason, like a reckless hard landing. Just as the bat that foretells good fortune flies through the window lattice, it always comes with a crisp crash and shattered glass strewn across the floor.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1023_0_Desc: Custom uniforms crafted by the Bureau of Anomaly Control for every Enforcement Tactical Division member—yet only Captain Baicang actually wears one.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1019_0_Desc: An upgraded Bureau of Anomaly Control Containment Strike Unit uniform. Making it into the CSU was Mint's greatest stroke of luck.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1046_swimsuit_Desc: A paper plane rides the sea breeze toward distant shores. What will this summer leave behind?
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1051_swimsuit_Desc: A paper plane rides the sea breeze toward distant shores. What will this summer leave behind?
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1036_swimsuit_Desc: As fireworks bloom across the sky, the dazzling display can make reality feel like a dream. Is this moment real, or a beautiful illusion you never want to wake from?
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1004_0_Desc: A comfortable handmade dress. Though Lacrimosa stumbles through her days, her landlady grandmother's skilled hands can always restore it to perfect condition.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1051_rpg_level1_Desc:
Fasten the last button, straighten the collar.
Those setting out for the first time must learn such things before all else.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1051_4_Desc: Standard detention facility uniform with a well-fitted cut, comfortable fabric, and bright colors. If only I could wear it normally…
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1074_0_Desc:
His crossbody bag and coat are stuffed with all kinds of lightweight electronic warfare gear. Each piece is light enough on its own, but together? Not so much.
He even wears all that gear while working indoors at the Bureau… What exactly is he fighting?
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1052_0_Desc:
Rumored to be a custom outfit specially designed for Hotori by a famous designer. Its value could open ten more Eibons. 
"Under the bright moon, orchids weep in silence, mist drifts endlessly."
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1055_0_Desc: A rose-scented dress with a wide brim, revealing only a hint of the eyes beneath.
ST_Appearance.Glide_10_Desc: Exclusive Glider Livery for Akane Rin. On the days when you lose your way, the stars will remain your guide.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_Glide_1090_Desc: Exclusive Glider Livery for Elyms. Formed from the Dreamworn Terminal. Easy to use, too.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1075_nighty_Desc: The moon has fallen a thousand times. Has it truly been only a thousand?
ST_Appearance.Pendant_6_Desc: The moon: the brightest disco ball of all.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1075_rpg_level1_Desc: Arcane sparks dance at her fingertips, while Iroi writes the first page of a dream yet unfinished.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1051_5_Desc: A sharply tailored racing suit, as irreplaceable as the partner at your side.
ST_Appearance.Pendant_9_Desc: A cool piece of gear from some video game that boosts accuracy.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1010_swimsuit_Desc: The Coluccis are expanding into open waters, and Captain Nanally is ready to set sail! All aboard, for the family!
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1090_0_Desc:
A professional outfit with just the right "AI assistant?" vibe for the Bureau.
The staff badge features a photo from their first day on the job, though most people would swear it's completely covered in stickers.
ST_Appearance.Pendant_4_Desc: Welcome to "The Midnight" Cat… Er, human… N-no, cat… newsstand!
ST_Appearance.Pendant_1_Desc: Standing in the center of the spotlight, a halo crowns you.
ST_Appearance.Glide_7_Desc: Zankou's exclusive Glider Livery. Like crimson petals dancing on the wind, it leaves a scarlet afterglow that refuses to fade.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1036_0_Desc:
Zankou's usual attire. Now that The Scarlet Letter is gone, where will fate lead Zankou next?
"One moment, forever."
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1036_1_Desc: Zankou's attire from her days with The Scarlet Letter. When a job gets messy, she prefers something bold enough to turn every head. After all, getting noticed is part of the hunt.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1036_nighty_Desc:
Zankou's loungewear. A loose robe and wooden clogs, perfect for drifting into a long, uninterrupted dream.
"The night's still young… I wonder what it has in store."
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1036_3_Desc: Zankou's custom casualwear, created after studying modern fashion. It helps her blend into the city crowd, though whether it actually looks fashionable is still up for debate.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1042_1_Desc:
Those who read the stars spend their lives searching for meaning in every sign. To her, destiny is written in the endless dance of the heavens.
"Among all the stars above, I saw yours and mine bound to the same fate."
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1057_4_Desc: Every girl has a wild side she doesn't advertise. So maybe those old rumors about her running a protection racket at school weren't entirely made up. "Those were concert tickets! I was putting on a show!"
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1039_nighty_Desc:
Fadia's loungewear. Rather than prioritizing comfort, she prefers to use clothing to complement the night.
"The darkness will keep our secrets."
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1052_nighty_Desc:
Hotori's loungewear. Comfortable and lightweight—when lying around the house, comfort is paramount.
"Soft birdsong in the morning."
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1054_1_Desc: Hotori personally purchased this outfit to brighten up Daff's rather dull wardrobe. In response, Daffodill bought five different eye patches just to match it.
ST_Appearance.Glide_8_Desc:
Linko's exclusive Glider Livery. A terrifying evil spirit has descended upon the skies of Hethereau—look up and bow before its might!
"Pet Xiaozhen has unlocked a new skill: Carrying Passengers!"
"Keep it up and I'll drop you!"
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1072_0_Desc:
Linko's lightweight everyday outfit. The "TV" on her back is a bit heavy, but it makes more sense if you think of it as a pet carrier.
"Beep-boop. 'Pet' Xiaozhen is ready to go."
"How many times do I have to tell you? I'm an evil spirit! An evil spirit!"
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1072_space_Desc:
Linko's imagination knows no limits. Ever since she found this outfit, she's wondered whether she can tune in to signals from beyond this world.
Her backpack holds a tiny garden and the courage to keep going. Plants grow, and so does the journey.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1072_nighty_Desc:
Linko's loungewear. The loose, comfy fit gives her plenty of room to stretch.
"When inspiration comes knocking, you have to be ready to answer."
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1072_school_Desc:
Linko's school-inspired outfit. A crisp uniform, a spring in her step, and a route that never quite goes as planned.
"Take the scenic route. You might find a surprise or two."
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1074_2_Desc:
An eye-catching waterproof outfit that could get you mistaken for a killer on a rainy night—or even the Grim Reaper.
—Colors that won't wash away, for moments we refuse to let fade.
ST_Appearance.Glid_1070_des: A jellyfish unique to Aurelia, carrying you as you glide. The sky is its ocean.
ST_Appearance.Glide_5_Desc: Shinku's wings alone would not melt, even if they soared toward the sun—for they had long since been forged in flame.
ST_Appearance.Glide_3_Desc: A glider livery designed by Nanally. "I'm the underboss of the underboss. And since I'm the one gliding with you now, that makes you the underboss of the underboss of the underboss! Hahaha!"
ST_Appearance.Fashion_Glide_1052_Desc:
A glider livery designed by Hotori. Its delicate paper umbrella is perfect for riding the wind.
”The wind is rising.”
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1076_4_Desc: Shinku kept her head lowered, trying to vanish into the crowd. After all, if no one came close, then no one would get hurt… right?
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1076_nighty_Desc:
Shinku's loungewear for quiet days spent idling undisturbed among her treasures. Once a dragon has made up her mind, no force can shake her resolve.
"…No. I've already decided. I'm not going out today, no matter what."
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1074_1_Desc:
In fall and winter, a trench coat is the perfect extra layer for heading outdoors. Somehow, it just seems to go with a hot cup of coffee.
The scarf feels soft and light around your neck, yet keeps you surprisingly warm.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1073_1_Desc:
Performance outfit from Pink Paws Bank's annual gala. At the time, Mr. Giovanni had developed an unusual fascination with a particular black-and-white animal 
"Are we… are we partnering with Panda Hotpot now?"
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1075_0_Desc: Sheep are gentle creatures by nature, happiest among their flock.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1051_rpg_level3_Desc: Crowned in glory, the long night finds its light.

ST_Appearance.Fashion_1071_1_usedesc: Grants the exclusive Chaos Outfit & Avatar: Clear Skies.

ST_Appearance.Fashion_1019_nighty_Desc:
Mint's loungewear. Simple clothing that showcases the carefree and relaxed spirit of being a homebody.
"There's nothing better than staying home and sleeping in on a day off!"
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1076_0_Desc:
Shinku rarely concerns herself with what she wears, but this outfit suits midsummer perfectly.
"…It's easy to move in. Is there a problem?"
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1003_2_Desc: Sakiri may insist they're "way too childish," but really—who could say no to a sweet, fluffy Gingerbear Biscuit?
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1010_0_Desc: Typical streetwear with a twist of authority. As the boss of the Colucci family, her appearance sets the tone for the entire clan.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1036_swimsuit_Dye1_uesedesc: Available after unlocking the outfit Searing Lavender: Shiro.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1036_swimsuit_0_unlock: Available after unlocking the outfit Searing Lavender.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1076_1_Desc:
A neat, preppy outfit with the fresh charm of campus life. They say youth is spent either fleeing from one's inner shadow or chasing after it… and even those without a shadow will find a way to cast one.
"Don't read something that ridiculous into it… Ugh, whatever."
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1019_rpg_level1_Desc: Run, and the scent of freedom will reach the road before your footsteps.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1057_0_Desc: Catch the beat, steal the spotlight, and become the flash of gold everyone remembers.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1019_rpg_level3_Desc: Like a ghostflame before the wilds, the daughter of the wind was born to roam free and unbound.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1075_1_Desc: Hidden within a bright and colorful dreamscape, watching the long summer drift by.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1051_3_Desc: Light and fitted, clean and sharp styling that never goes wrong, helping you blend into crowds with ease.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1070_0_Desc: A loose outfit with emphasis on breathable fabric—when wearing it, it's almost as if you can hear the gentle rolling of waves.
ST_Appearance.Pendant_5_Desc: All a part of the plan.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1004_1_Desc: Things that shine are often heavy. Lacrimosa feels unusually tired flying to work today. Maybe it isn't just her imagination.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1004_2_Desc:
A decadent, ornate formal dress, perfect for a castle banquet.
"The night sky poured over the garden, soaking its roses in muted darkness. Years later, those flowers still bloom in silence, and the rest of the story has faded into shadow."
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1051_rpg_level2_Desc: The wind shall remember the swordsman's path.
ST_Appearance.Glide_9_Desc: Blackbird-exclusive Glider Livery. If you ever spot a bird like this, fortune awaits you.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1042_nighty_Desc: Blackbird's favorite loungewear. When she has time to kill, she likes taking perfectly ordinary clothes and giving them a distinctly Blackbird makeover. This set, somehow, has yet to be dethroned.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1042_0_Desc: Blackbird's everyday attire. "Pretty much exactly what everyone expects me to wear," Blackbird remarks.
ST_Appearance.Fashion_1042_2_Desc: One of the many outfits in Blackbird's collection. It's a bolder look than usual, with vivid crimson set against vintage tailoring—flashy, elegant, and hard to miss. Turns out Blackbird is every bit as discerning about clothes as she is about antiques.

I often feel that a city's most gentle vibes are tucked away in the corners that are willing to slow down.

This café I often visit captures that idea perfectly. On my day off, I love the window seat best. Bathing in sunlight, book in hand, sipping a latte, and stealing a half-day of leisure... It's a rare luxury to simply be alone with my thoughts.

Every so often, I catch the owner's hand-brewing coffee tutorial, and the shop takes on an entirely different vibe. Strangers sit in a circle, listening to the soft crackle of the coffee beans breaking apart in the grinder. Between the laughter and easy conversation, that perfectly measured sense of life has such a subtle warmth to it.

Well, it's more like a café + game room combo…? Anyway, I'll cut to the chase: it was the best spent Fons in my life!
The moment I walked in, a super cute maid sister greeted me ringing a bell, and I was instantly healed (*////▽////*) Even if you're super shy, you don't have to worry about running out of things to say—they'll take the lead and keep the convo going so it never gets awkward.
The food gets five stars too! I heard the coffee and desserts here are all blessed with heart magic, which is why they're ridiculously delicious! You can eat as you watch live stage performances too—us otaku finally have our own live spot!
But the real highlight is definitely the mahjong! It's the heart and soul of this place! I'd seriously recommend coming by if you want a real match or two. I'd say I'm pretty good at mahjong, but even giving it my all, I still couldn't beat the Head Maid qwq. Still, even if you lose, a gentle maid sister will cheer you up, so you don't have to worry about being laughed at—it's really newbie-friendly too. Long story short, win or lose, you'll have an absolute blast~

The only thing that caught me off guard was that once everyone gets serious about mahjong, their expressions look terrifying... As expected, people who really want to win don't have smiles on their faces!

ST_Bagel_TitleContent.Bagel_NPCB048_001:
I'd wanted a cat ever since I graduated. Recently, work finally started to settle down, so I did my cat-owning homework in advance and went to a Jingle Wrangle near my place to see if there was a kitten I clicked with. Turns out, I encountered a delightful surprise!

All the little animals in the shop were super healthy and adorable, and the Oddity staff were really patient too. One of them even let me pet them, and they were so fluffy and soft—absolutely super cuddly! If I hadn't already decided to adopt a cat, I honestly would've asked the owner and staff if they were for sale. The owner seems kind of cool and aloof, not very talkative, but incredibly efficient. You can tell she takes great care of every little animal. I'd only been there for a bit, and I could already see cats clamoring all over her…

I walked around for a while and finally fell for my lil baby. It felt like we were meant to be. It was asleep, but right as I approached, it woke up and came straight over to rub against my hand. I thought it was just naturally friendly, but the owner said it's usually very shy around strangers and has never been this affectionate with someone it doesn't know. I figured, this must be the kitten fated to come home with me, right?

This morning, when I left the house, it was still totally empty. Now there's a little one already bouncing around on the sofa, and I've never been happier! I'm finally not some cat-less wild thing anymore, I've finally fulfilled a tiny dream of mine :D

The owner is super nice and friendly, and if it's not too busy, they'll even give you some side dishes. But there are often many people in line, so if you want to eat here, make sure you come early!

ST_Clone.DiyBoss13_Des:
Sometimes, Anomalies join forces for their own gain. This time is no different: Mammon, the wealth-devouring Anomaly, lurks in Cardboard Castle, waiting for the next foolish hero to walk right into its trap.
"Who'll be the next challenger to come knocking…?"
ST_Clone.ResourceClone001_Des: The strange phone booth connects to a shattered, lost dimension, a place that may have once been a bustling, vibrant metropolis. The people of that past are long gone, and the lost beings wander forever in endless silence and desolation.
ST_Clone.Trailclone_exp_Des: "Five Years of Appraisal, Three Years of Practice," "Complete Guide to Anomalies," "38 Sets of Nexus Identification"… all in the "Anomaly Hunter Essential Collection."
ST_Clone.DLC_forkbreakthrough_005_Des: You stupid groundhogs! This just terrible! Granny Mary is definitely going to kick your butts! O-oh, hey there, old buddy! Want to try some new cans? They're just incredible!
ST_Clone.DLC_forkbreakthrough_004_Des: Ice cold and delicious treats - that's how they look, and can merchants never lie. That fuse? Oh, that's just decoration.
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_02_Recommend_01_Des: A protagonist who deserves no sympathy. His situation is entirely of his own making.
ST_Clone.DLC_forkbreakthrough_003_Des: The price of a sweet dream is quite expensive, but everyone wants a good night's sleep. Perhaps you'd like to watch sheep running? I hear humans all love counting sheep.
ST_Clone.CloneEnter_04_Des: A black rabbit fell into the hole, a gray rabbit fell into the hole, and a white rabbit looked at its pocket watch and said: "We're going to be late! We're going to be late!" So jump! Jump! Hurry and jump into the hole! The game is about to begin!
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_01_Recommend_03_Des: Today's parting cannot erase the love we once shared.
ST_Clone.Hospital_Ending_01_Des: He lied to us. At this rate, we'll all turn into monsters—and I can't allow that to happen.
ST_Clone.Hospital_Ending_04_Des: He remains there forever: forever waiting, forever lost.
ST_Clone.WeeklyClone_Des_01:
Who dares disturb her slumber?
Who lifts the hem of her dress?
Who… wishes to dance with her?
ST_Clone.DLC_equipment_005_Des: Pixels light up one by one. At the edge of consciousness, you see the rabbit…
ST_Clone.DLC_equipment_006_Des: The rabbit-headed train requires only one golden radish train ticket.
ST_Clone.DLC_equipment_003_Des: The rabbit said it would rain, and so it began raining along a single line of latitude.
ST_Clone.CloneEnter_01_Des:
As for Houdinii himself, the rumors are as spectacular as his magic. A young man skilled in card tricks, or perhaps a playful trickster adept at transformations? Could it be that this grand magician, famous for his escape acts, has already escaped Time's prison and become the freest dove of all?
No one knows for certain.
ST_Clone.DLC_levelbreakthrough_003_Des: Join us, appraise this world, and the truth will eventually appear before your eyes.
ST_Clone.CloneEnter_03_Des: Ms. Cassandra's famous play "The Red Tin Soldier and the Blue Tin Soldier" is now showing to great acclaim at Cape Dome! Show your ticket stub and enjoy half-price Bubble Cans! "Praise the most honest canned goods merchant! Praise the most beautiful Ms. Cassandra!"
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_01_Recommend_04_Des: Regret, remorse, guilt… These are all inseparable parts of life that we must learn to accept.
ST_Clone.DLC_equipment_004_Des: Chanting… Great Revival Spell! Battle for the radishes until the very end!
ST_Clone.ResourceClone001_CloneDesBody01: A rare stable fragment in the shattered lost dimension, almost completely unaffected by spatial turbulence.
ST_Clone.ResourceClone001_SpecialTips02: Engaging the enemy during skill cooldown is not a wise choice.
ST_Clone.DLC_talent_005_Des: Find the exit before the water reaches your neck!
ST_Clone.DLC_talent_002_Des: Enjoying delicious afternoon tea in the garden… White roses? There are none here.
ST_Clone.ResourceClone001_SpecialTips03: Switch between different characters to trigger Esper Cycle to deal higher damage.
ST_Clone.DLC_forkbreakthrough_002_Des: She is a genius, she is an artist. Within the spiral of intertwined words, my birth is the greatest symphony of this century.
ST_Clone.WeeklyClone_Des_03: The "debtor" who seeks to steal time merely runs in vain upon time's hamster wheel.
ST_Clone.Hospital_Ending_03_Des: The research must continue. I must find a way to rid myself of "it" before I turn, no matter the cost.
ST_Clone.Trailclone_gold_Des: Even the power of lies cannot turn a fake coin into a real coin.
ST_Clone.ResourceClone001_Introduce: Though the shattered dimension is fraught with danger, a stroke of luck might allow you to bring back treasures from other realms.
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_02_Des: We love hearing tales of heroes. We love hearing how they use their extraordinary strength and will to save the world. But these stories forget to teach us how to save ourselves, so when the heroes leave, we find ourselves lost.
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_01_Recommend_02_Des: How many people have we lost because we were too shy to express our love?
ST_Clone.DLC_talent_004_Des: I bet you're thinking right now: What should I have for lunch?
ST_Clone.ResourceClone001_SpecialTips01: Focus on the enemy's movements before attacks and dodge at the right moment to avoid damage.
ST_Clone.DLC_talent_003_Des: The prerequisite for drawing something good is that you have to reach your hand in.
ST_Clone.DLC_equipment_001_Des: The hands sometimes move forward, sometimes backward, so order and chaos coexist within the Rabbit Hole.
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_01_Recommend_01_Des: The protagonist of this story is a designer, and fittingly, the scene has a uniquely artistic flair.
ST_Clone.DLC_Hockshop_Introduce: Pawn Moonlight is a separate space created by the Anomaly Morphix; only those with strong desires can enter.
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_01_Recommend_05_Des: I hope I get to meet Patty in person someday. We have a lot in common to talk about.
ST_Clone.DLC_levelbreakthrough_001_Des: Come on, let's expose the fraud of the so-called greatest magician. This is merely the first step toward the truth.
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_02_Recommend_02_Des: Justice will prevail, and justice has stripped away this so-called hero's self-serving ambitions.
ST_Clone.WeeklyClone_Des_36: Mother planted me in the Garden. The sunlight was warm, the dew was sweet, and my brothers and sisters were there… But Mother, are people meant to be planted?
ST_Clone.DLC_bank_Safety_Des:
After the movie "Vault Heist" became a huge hit, many unknown criminals began eyeing Pink Paws Bank's vault… Though no one has ever seen the vault's entrance, someone smelled a business opportunity.

Dvořák has teamed up with renowned film director Cinema Lee to launch the reality show Pink Paws Heist, featuring a one-to-one recreation of the movie's sets for an immersive experience of a different kind of life, with generous rewards prepared for the winners! However, rumor has it that some "particularly capable" winners might find themselves on a rather strange list…
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_01_Des: A swing: a piece of recreational and athletic equipment. Wild roses: genus Rosa, cold-resistant, with numerous cultivated and wild varieties… Okay, enough beating around the bush. It's time to focus on what's really in front of us. Go on, express your love.
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_02_Recommend_04_Des: Putting on a character's costume doesn't mean you become the character themselves.
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_02_Name: Heroes don't always arrive in moments of glory.
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_02_Recommend_01_Name: Want to give it a name?
ST_Clone.DLC_equipment_002_Des: Do not look directly into the rabbit statue's eyes! Remember, there are no rabbit statues here!
ST_Clone.DLC_talent_001_Des: Oh white dove, symbol of peace, please don't steal my french fries.
ST_Clone.wpexp_des:
Midas Arc Dye, your great helper! Only 999 Fons!
Or just 0 Fons and a little game.
ST_Clone.Trailclone_Wpexp_Des: Midas Technologies partners with the greatest magician, Mr. Houdinii, to bring you a spectacular performance as dazzling as a Kaleidoscope!
ST_Clone.DLC_forkbreakthrough_001_Des: This can contains a poison apple with one bite taken, a rotten apple half-eaten, and one complete, sweet appleseed.
ST_Clone.CloneEnter_02_Des: This is a special bonus performance carefully prepared by the world's greatest magician, Mr. Houdinii! Oh poor little—I mean, cute, cute lucky one… choose whichever show you prefer. After all, this is the only thing you'll get to decide for yourself.
ST_Clone.Hospital_Ending_02_Des: Everything here belongs to the Sterling family—their sickness, their lives, and their deaths.
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_02_Recommend_05_Des: Even Garuda has his own convictions, but those swept away by fame and fortune have nothing at all.
ST_Clone.DLC_levelbreakthrough_002_Des: A magician? Ha, just a fame-seeking fraud. Building reputation by stepping on peers… No matter how great he claims to be, the stench of corruption sticks to him plain as day.

ST_Common.rankmailtext001:
The value of collectibles lies not only in the items themselves, but also in the discerning eye that gives them meaning. At this Treasure Ship Auction, your keen eye made all the difference, and you returned with a huge haul. Each drop of the hammer was made all the more meaningful by your attentive gaze. The Ebisu Auction House extends its sincerest congratulations and has prepared a small gift in the hope that this Treasure Ship Auction gave you a few moments worth remembering.
As the next Treasure Ship Auction is about to begin, we warmly invite you to join us again, and sincerely hope it will bring you even more delightful surprises.

ST_Date.D018_Des: In the endless sky, one cloud belongs to us.

ST_Date.D023_Des: The melody of the new song flows softly, and rare moments alone together are too precious not to remember—let's preserve this gentle moment of the city.
ST_Date.D006_Des: Rain or snow, Raindrop Court is always breathtaking, especially with you here.
ST_Date.D004_Des: Gear up for a high-stakes, heart-pounding Tetrominoes showdown—it's time to hit the arcade and show them what you're really made of!

ST_Date.D024_Des: Rally your pals and set off as tiny adventurers, hunting for thrilling treasure while hearts race!
ST_Date.D019_Des: Beautiful vistas and remnants of the past stir old memories and rekindle old grudges… Her silhouette appears in reply, waiting to reenact that dance of death with you.
ST_Date.D001_Des: Wanna go on a little adventure and defy gravity with me? They say a miracle happens when you reach the top of the Ferris Wheel.

ST_Date.D020_Des: Hethereau's best spot for stargazing. Share this sea of stars with your companion, and leave your worries and loneliness behind.

ST_Description.DMP01_04_0018:
November 31
Winter snow has blanketed the cherry trees.
Over the past few months, I have welcomed my "children" one by one. Bella was the first; she is flawless in managing the family, so perhaps one day I will entrust all our affairs to her. Then came Teresa, a gentle soul who breathed life into the stagnant courtyard, adorning the lifeless manor with fragrant flowers. Next was Elliot, my first son and the finest chef—no one knows my palate better than he.
Albert is a lively child. Unlike his older siblings, Albert is full of energy and obsessed with cleaning and repairs, often erasing the manor's imperfections before the servants even spot them. He and his two younger siblings—his little sister and brother—have also grown quite fond of games, though only within my sight. Yvette has such nimble hands; the very day she awoke, she inventoried my wardrobe and began sewing unique ornaments onto those dull fabrics. Erving was the last to wake—a quiet, good boy who loves to read and has a curious mind. Though he hasn't shown a specific talent yet, I know he will be just as brilliant as his older siblings.
There is still one child who has yet to wake. I want to give her the final, most unique purpose… a place in this family like no other. I have already chosen her name…
"Renee." Your mother is waiting for you to wake up…
ST_Description.DMP01_04_0015:
Early February.
My memories continue to slip away. Even the little things I can still recall are blurred now, like faded photographs. The passage of time barely registers; I can't even remember what day it is. Sometimes, when I host a banquet, it slips my mind and I forget to show up myself. The irony is that even with the host missing, the guests still carry on, pretending to have the time of their lives. Hardly anyone is actually offended by my absence. What binds them to me is profit and need—not respect, and certainly not loyalty. Even if I ignore them, they'll still come scrambling to attend the next one.
How tedious.
The curse of "immortality" has finally bared its fangs. As my old acquaintances grew older and passed away one by one, I was left only with those who wanted something from me. In their eyes, I am either a savior or a monster—but never a human. By now, I've stopped caring about the hushed whispers behind my back. In this frozen flow of time, everything has lost its meaning. Once the last traces of human warmth faded, all I've been able to feel… is an endless, icy void.
ST_Description.DMP01_04_0019:
March 27th.
Teresa hurt her hand while working in the courtyard. I completely lost my composure—such utter powerlessness is something I haven't experienced in decades. Yvette bandaged her up, and Teresa didn't show even a flicker of pain; instead, she apologized for "letting me down."
Letting me down? Once, I only wanted a "family" that was quiet, obedient, and loyal. That wish is what awakened the children, but now I see it became their shackles, too. They exist only to fulfill my desires. Even now, when I want them to live for themselves, it's already too late…
But Renee is different. She's sweet yet willful, like a curious little kitten. She ignores the "rules" born from my wishes. She has her own thoughts and her own desires—and because of that, she's more "human" than any of us.
Renee, you are my little petal, my treasure, and my hope.
All I can wish for is that you live your life as a ordinary person.
ST_Description.DMP01_04_0016:
A certain day in May.
Cordelein gave me a gift. He came in person, but I could barely recognize him anymore. In my memory, he was still a young man, chasing investors with nothing but a silver tongue and big ideas. That elder with the wrinkled face and unsteady steps… was that really Cordelein?
He brought me a set of "puppets"—seven in total, each one meticulously carved and lifelike. He said he hoped this gift would be of use to me, and he blessed me to find my desire.
What is it that I desire…?
I think I'd want someone to serve me, to be loyal to me. I'm tired of being surrounded by people from The Circle who only care for my wealth and making connections, putting on an act just to get close.
I want a "family." Quiet, obedient puppets… maybe that wouldn't be so bad.
ST_Description.DMP01_04_0017:
Early June. The 5th… or maybe the 6th?
For the first time in a long while, I have a day worth remembering. A wish I've carried for years has finally become reality. I've always treated these "puppets" as my true family, and this morning, one of them came to life! Her calling woke me, and she asked me what her name was. I bestowed a name upon my daughter—
"Bella."
She says she awakened solely to serve me, and has already begun putting the house in order. She gleams like a pearl, so vivid and alive. She does everything in her power for me with a pure heart—no complaints, no demands. Is this what a family's "love" feels like? Will the others wake up just as she did?
Bella, my daughter… The servants may need some time to get used to her… Not that it matters. If there's one thing I'm not short on, it's "time."

ST_Description.DMP01_04_0025:
B: Little Renee insisted on sitting on her brother's shoulders while we were taking the family photo, saying, "This way, I'll be the tallest person in the family!" Elliott never refused her requests, so of course he lifted her up—but mother didn't seem very pleased.
Mother called little Renee into the room, probably to scold her, as Renee wiped tears from her eyes during dinner.
Later, mother told me: if we always indulge Renee and continue to pamper her, she will never learn manners. She will never understand that she should respect and cherish her siblings.
I could tell it was important. Mother's expression was serious: whether it's her words or Renee's words, we don't always have to comply. First, we must strive to be "ourselves." Every person is equal, and each is an important part of the family.

I replied: fulfilling all your wishes is the mission we are born to carry.

Mother sighed and told me to get some rest early.

ST_Description.DSU01_08_0004:
SOS! If you're an Anomaly Hunter, please come help me! 

I'm a graffiti artist, and I've been tormented by the anomaly Graffiti Goof recently. It's completely ruined all my artwork walls with its random scribbling! No matter how many times I fix it, those ugly patterns appear again the next day… Day turns to night, night turns to day, day turns to night, night turns to day… I can't even remember how many hours it's been since I last slept. 

Because of this Graffiti Goof, my recent creative work has completely stalled, and I can barely make ends meet. But I won't let you work for nothing. You can come to my place and take any of my artwork that catches your eye. I can even come to your place and create live graffiti art for you, using the one thing I'm good at to repay you…

I live on the 3rd floor of Acorn Apartments on Fiscus Avenue. Please, come and nullify that damn Graffiti Goof!
ST_Description.Hospital_Clue_16:
V's gone insane—using that… that "thing" for such an incredibly dangerous experiment. I don't even know how the higher-ups approved it… But I have to admit, it's his style to a T: brazen and uncouth. Looks like he's trying to solve the Phantom Burn Syndrome in one fell swoop. At his age and with his talent, he could be the next prodigy in the medical field.
██/█/█
…Such a "great sacrifice" is necessary, huh? So that's what V said? Cold-blooded bastard. Even when I first joined this project, I had my reservations; he probably couldn't have cared less. Hmph—the Family will likely value him for that.
██/█/█
Couldn’t handle the psychological pressure after all, huh? The resignation was out of the blue—the higher-ups didn't even have time to reassign a new researcher, so everything fell onto Director N. Tough luck… Though I never expected Director N's methodology to be so similar to V's.
██/█/█
What's the death count at this time? These absolute maniacs… Constantly in a rush… What's N in such a hurry for? Is this serving the Family's interests?
…It was said again: "The Great Sacrifice" is a necessary evil—probably V telling him the same. Come to think of it, N is so much like V in every way; put a mask on him, and he'd be practically indistinguishable… though, frankly, I'm forgetting what V looked like.
██/█/█
I've never seen N this happy—he stormed out, saying he has to talk to K, so there must be a breakthrough in the research. Good. N's been on edge lately; get too close to him and he stiffens up into a brick wall. He looks completely worn out… Hopefully they approve him for some days off…
██/█/█
So the Phantom Burn Syndrome can be cured…? Unbelievable… my hunch was right—he's a total savant…
What a pity. K's really lost it—with a chance to make his name in the field right in front of him, he still worries about trivial matters of who's who, as if pretending not to know would stop anything. Hmph, he brought this on himself.
…No water, no power, and a bunch of specimens out there… survival is out of our hands now.
Is this the ending you wanted, V?

ST_Description.DMP01_04_0026:
Don't forget: tonight, we stay awake.

B: Little Renee hurt her knee while climbing a tree. She sat wailing so loudly that the whole manor could hear her cries, only stopping once I arrived with the first aid kit to bandage her wound. Mother, along with other siblings, were concerned about her injury, but her attention quickly shifted to the insects in the courtyard, and she seemed to forget all about the pain.
Little Renee is always like this—constantly following her impulses. One moment, she's pestering mother for a story; the next, she's clinging to Elliott for her favorite cake. Sometimes she follows Teresa and me, asking us endless questions; other times, she drags Yvette and Erving into games with her.
Mother told us that we could refuse Renee, that we should finish what we wanted to do first. She would also scold Renee, reminding her not to interrupt our work constantly. But I don't understand—wasn't Renee the one mother loves most? Why, then, does mother always look so conflicted whenever we set aside our tasks to entertain her mischief?
Renee has changed mother in so many ways. She smiles more often now, as if the "eternal" ice within her is slowly thawing. Though Renee constantly surprises us with her unpredictability, we have never resented her—after all, she is our little sister.
Mother said that tonight, after Renee falls asleep, she wants to have a talk with us. As always, we will meet her expectations.
ST_Description.DMP01_04_0023:
Don't forget: The tailor Mother invited will arrive tomorrow at 3 PM.

B: Aside from little Renee, who's always climbing trees and squeezing into corners, our clothes are all in great shape. The tailor really only needs to measure her, right? Yet Mother desires new outfits for everyone… could it be she's bored with the styles we're wearing now?
Remember to round everyone up early tomorrow. Little Renee always loses track of time when she's playing, so let's make sure we catch that little troublemaker first.
ST_Description.DMP01_04_0024:
Don't forget: Subscribe to some simple cookbooks.

B: Mother has suddenly developed a keen interest in cooking.
She says being able to make things for us with her own hands makes her happy. Even if the prep is a hassle… and she has to start from zero with no prior experience… Does that really make her happy? I don't quite get it.
She seems to be looking forward to the next time she cooks, saying she'll prepare dishes we'll like. Little Renee's tastes are easy to guess, but she hasn't managed to discern ours yet.
I told her the rest of us don't have any specific preferences, and she looked a bit disappointed.

ST_Description.DSU01_08_0002:
Hey buddy, how have you been?

Thanks to the Graffiti Goof, I've gotten more customers since resuming my art, and even some major commercial events have reached out to me… Pretty ironic, huh? But this time, I didn't reject them all like I used to. I've realized something—I need money. Not just to pay off my debts, but to take me to farther places.

Remember when you told me why the Graffiti Goof targeted me? The colors in my spray paint. My style was too rigid before, which came from isolating myself while creating. Graffiti is a dialogue between art and people, and I can't lose that ability to communicate. So, I've decided to travel the world, to listen to people, talk with them, and create colorful works with diverse styles. That's what I'm looking forward to.

I used to think I was the biggest unfortunate soul on Fiscus Avenue. But then you knocked on my door, and my luck turned around. That feeling is indescribable, and I'll never forget it. I'll use graffiti to capture this unforgettable experience in every city I pass through.

Ethan

ST_Description.Hospital_Clue_12:
Experiment ID: █-██-00
Researcher: V
Objective: Explore the potential application of the experimental Anomaly "Jigsaw" in ███ and cellular replacement therapy
Sample Source: ████████
Methods and Records:
It is known that under manual division, the sample can be split into multiple units, or "pieces". Each unit, after separation, retains basic activity and exhibits a tendency to move toward similar units. If the distance is excessive (>5m), units enter a low-metabolic dormant state; reducing any distance restores activity in the unit.

Active units placed in contact with the subcutaneous tissue of mouse hosts show clear fusion at the unit-host interface. No host rejection was observed. After 48 hours, units and host tissue were nearly fully fused; portions of host cells were replaced by unit-derived quasi-chimeric cells, and spreading. No rejection from the host was observed. When units were subsequently placed beyond active range, units re-entered dormancy while host activity markedly decreased, suggesting strong interference of the units with host consciousness.

Application to Use Specimen No. ███ and No. ███ may be requested for further study.

Archive Date: █/█
Note: This report is restricted to Group ██ internal review only and must not be disclosed to the public.

ST_Description.DMP00_01_0012:
Tips for Becoming a Top Photographer:
1. Plan well before taking photos. If the client has specified a style, try to learn more about similar styles. If it's a regular customer, try to understand their habits in advance. It's best to find pose references beforehand to improve shooting efficiency.
2. Most people have one side of their profile that looks better. Before shooting, ask the customer which side they prefer. If it's a regular customer, figure it out before the shoot.
3. When taking overhead shots, it's best to have the person sitting down instead of standing, as it can make them look short.
4. If the customer is not good at posing, let them move around freely and try to capture candid shots. However, note that the parameters for candid shots need to be adjusted more compared to those of fixed poses.

ST_Description.PillowDreams_Text_06: I've hated cutting in line ever since I was a child. It's just not right. But whenever someone cuts in front of me, I never know what to do. It's not exactly a big deal, after all, and arguing with them might cause an even bigger scene. But today, I somehow found the courage to tell the person off. The moment the words left my mouth, everything around me went quiet. I was terrified. Then, the line-cutter obediently went to the back of the line. The person behind me patted me on the shoulder. I guess I did the right thing. I felt pretty good about myself. I think I'll be happy about this little victory for quite a while.

ST_Description.Hospital_Clue_04:
To ██:
…
That's unheard of. We mistakenly held the anesthetist responsible, but who could have predicted that a fully sedated patient would wake up just because someone removed the bandages from his arm? These Anomaly disorders make absolutely no sense. As for that poor anesthetist, he's now become like the others who wrap themselves in bandages… At least they're still human, I suppose.
I don't know what exactly happened in V's operating room. I don't understand how it spreads. I suspect this shouldn't be classified as a disease, but rather a curse… Anyone would think the same if they saw a group of madmen wrapping bandages around themselves.
But silver lining: V got injured but wasn't infected. At least, I don't think so. He just looks like he's lost his soul. He's been on sedatives constantly. I don't know what that poor guy went through in there. I'm just relieved he can still be of use. Otherwise, I'd be the one who has to take over dealing with these terrifying monsters…
Once the hospital lockdown is lifted, I need to pick somewhere for a proper vacation… How about Hethereau?
N
██/█/11 20:13

Civilians should not attempt to confront or evade the Anomaly directly. When the shadow recedes, move away from any affected streetlights. Alternatively, use a suitable light source to disperse the shadow before leaving the area.
All Anomaly Hunters are advised that the Anomaly can assume the form of black mist and move rapidly between streetlights. Those without sufficient capability should not pursue it recklessly, as doing so may result in entrapment.
If you require assistance or have relevant information to report, please contact the Hethereau Bureau of Anomaly Control without delay.

ST_Description.DMU_cang01_0006:
Maiyue, age 15, resident of Fiscus Avenue district, first-year student in Class B of Clement Academy High School.

Situation Report:
1. Failed to return home after school yesterday, all contact lost, whereabouts unknown throughout the night. Highly unusual behavior.
2. Last sighted around 17:45 at Clement Academy's main gate.
3. Build slightly below average, appearing somewhat frail. Was wearing standard Clement Academy male uniform at time of disappearance.

Notes:
1. Maintains regular daily routine and healthy lifestyle. No unusual behavior observed prior to disappearance. No apparent conflicts with family or classmates.
2. Suffers from communication difficulties, never actively expresses personal thoughts. Family firmly believes that due to his introverted nature, the missing person would never cause trouble or make enemies.

ST_Description.Hospital_WaterRoom_1:
(Scrawled handwriting in a medical chart)
They're definitely after my box! I knew it all along!
Every night, his heels are outside, on the walls, on the ceiling, pacing back and forth, tick-tock, tick-tock, splash, splash…
When they mop the floor, they pour water everywhere, trying to flood my box and short-circuit it!
And the cameras! They hide cameras in my room every day! They want to film where I hide my key!
They want to steal my box, take my medical records, my medicine, my name, my life… my…
…What else… What else?!
ST_Description.SU103_des_3:

…secret… know… Fuzzy…

All answers…
ST_Description.DMP01_04_0021:
(This paper appears old and brittle, one corner stained by spilled ink, rendering the text illegible.)
The toll for trifling with fate has finally come due. I breathed life into the inanimate, yet I craftily evaded the price for doing so, only to summon the "Debt Collector" knocking to my door.
Ever since Bella awoke, the shadow of the end has loomed over me. Every night, at the exact same hour, it arrives to claim the debt I owe to fate, and I have no way to resist it. Wealth, fame, connections, power—all are pathetically fragile against the relentless collection of natural law. The decisive moment is closing in.
I must speak to Bella. No… I must gather all my children, I want… (The rest is obscured by ink stains.)
ST_Description.DMP01_04_0022:
(This paper looks old and brittle. The handwriting is bold and forceful, as if the writer had finally steeled her resolve.)
I've spoken with the children, and each and every one supports my decision. This only makes my heart ache all the more. If they had fought me on this, or told me I was no mother of theirs, perhaps it wouldn't hurt this much. But they simply accepted our fate with such quiet grace.
Bella. Teresa. Elliot. Albert. Yvette. Erving.
My dearest children, please forgive your mother's selfishness. Grant your mother this one final wish.
Where dead wood decays, new life shall bloom.
We leave the future to Renee.
ST_Description.DMP01_04_0020:
(The paper looks old and brittle, the lines steeped in sorrow and grief.)
It was the Esper Ability. The children awakened because my Esper Ability awakened… Even though I was… (the ink is smeared here, the words are illegible) …blessed, and the countdown of my "mundane life" was frozen, their awakening set that frozen time into motion once more. When that time hits zero, the children will fall back into slumber, leaving me alone in this world once again. Why is fate so cruel, granting me happiness, only to tear it away?
They all know this. But to them, the very reason they woke up was to fulfill my wish, so none of them complain—except Renee.
"If we die, we won't be with Mommy anymore! I don't want that! I want to stay with Mommy, Brothers, and Sisters!"
My Renee… (several words here have been crossed out)
There's still some time before that destined moment arrives. I can still think of a solution. Until then… even if it's as ephemeral as foam, I want to hold on to this happiness for just a moment longer.

ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0167_CNPC_084014_004_17: Oh, I'm just a lover of tales.

ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0006_Player_014: I trust fellow customers like you more.
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0130_CNPC063016_002: My favorite thing is watching my babies wash their wings with morning dew. They look just like little fairies.
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0057_NPC03404_003: My best friend loves strawberry cake too, what a coincidence!
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0006_03_NPC04414_003: DynamiK is my go-to soda. It's fizzy, and it replenishes electrolytes. Just one small sip will quench all the summer heat!

ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0111_NPC028_ACT_008: I dreamed of many people in your place. Some I know, some I don't.

ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0026_NPC04406_001: I'm trying to research what it is about those toys that makes my friends so obsessed…

ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0116_CNPC_100006_003: I send my entire paycheck home every month… but it's nowhere near enough.

ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0167_CNPC_068004_player_004: I don't have any more questions.

ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0126_CNPC080006_003: My own child loves this movie, so I thought the kids would probably all enjoy it. And also…

ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0068_NPC02312_003: I remember that day… I got home late from work, and was crying alone in the living room. Nekomaru saw me and served me a bowl of ramen without saying a word.

ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0113_NPC_S038_005_004: Sirius's music helped me through my darkest days. Their songs… they give you the strength to face anything.

ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0058_NPC_04503_005: Yeah. When I was young, I made some foolish career choices and wasted over a decade going down the wrong path…

ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0111_NPC008_ACT_004: Yep! He insists on following me around eating this and that. No matter how many times I scold him, he never learns!
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0060_CNPC_048006_002: Yes, I'm here to buy fish for my kitty again! She's incredibly picky and won't even glance at canned food. Last time I brought home fish from this shop and cooked it, she completely cleaned her plate! I'm sticking with this place from now on. Saves me so much worry!

ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0113_Player_029: Yeah, I think their songs are really special too.
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0056_CNPC073005_002: Yeah, we all really love this street. We make special trips here pretty often.
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_Prison_CNPC117022_002: Yeah, my deck got confiscated by the guards a while back. Broke my heart. After that, I learned my lesson and collected dozens of decks, just in case.

ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0116_CNPC_035004_002: Yeah, it snuck in yesterday. We need to get it out of here safely, ASAP!
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0057_NPC03404_009: Yeah, seeing customers smile after tasting my cakes makes me feel like learning to bake was truly worthwhile.
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0059_CNPC_070020_005: Yeah, they sometimes hand out promotional cards on Tamamochi Street that can be used at all shops around here. They don't hand them out on a fixed schedule, but if you're lucky enough to snag one you can save a decent bit of money.
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0132_CNPC038051_002: I thought so! You dress like someone browsing the property market.
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0116_CNPC_100002_003: Yeah, ever since word got out about some mysterious Anomaly, everyone's been on edge. Some folks can barely focus on their work anymore.
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0117_CNPC_098001_002: Yeah, this place is practically like a second home to me now, haha.

ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0044_CNPC_025010_Player_001: Is it because of the coffee?
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0114_NPC_S038_017_002: Is this a midnight snack? Could be dinner, could be lunch, might even be tomorrow's breakfast… I don't even know anymore.
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0113_NPC_S038_004_003: Maybe I didn't do a good enough job explaining why they're so great…
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0116_CNPC_100002_Player_002: Are you worried about the Anomaly?

ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0108_CNPC_083001_001: Are you here to sign up for training?

ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0167_CNPC_093007_003: Yeah, I guess. Back when I was alive, I always dreamed of seeing beautiful fireworks at an amusement park… Sorry, I'm rambling. Thanks for listening.
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0108_CNPC_033038_003: Yes! No matter which way I went, I couldn't leave Room 105! I got scared and started running, and accidentally stepped on a soda can.

ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0033_NPC04419_004: Here at Film Orbit Studio, we offer a wide variety of photography services and styles.

ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0117_CNPC_040003_002: Yes, we're doing pre-battle preparations. We used to waste a lot of valuable opportunities because we didn't plan ahead and just winged it. We failed quests that should have been easy to complete.
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0113_NPC_033_002: Yeah, we're a brand new band that just got off the ground!
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0026_NPC_02320_006: We're a chain store, after all. New items are released simultaneously across all locations.
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0068_NPC_10202_006: That's right, we're a branch location.
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0114_NPC_S034_010_002: Yes, I'm waiting for a boy…
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0126_CNPC_080006_004: Yes, I promised them that if they won the relay race, I'd bring them to see the Kokoro Rider movie…
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0002_CNPC_070009_003: Yes, I'm planning to propose to my partner, but I can't decide which flowers would be best… I'm so torn about it…
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0022_CNPC_038018_004: Yeah, I have an interview coming up… But I'm not a great communicator, so I always end up getting rejected…
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0132_CNPC100013_002: A lot of the facilities around here haven't been inspected in a while. But don't worry… the maintenance work should be finished soon.
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0029_NPC_05006_004: Yeah, this place started out as our boss's personal racing garage. After he retired from racing, he transformed it into this modification shop.
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0006_NPC_06008_002: Is that what's going on? Well, I'll ask them later if they want to adjust their order quantities.
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0038_CNPC_038010_002: That's exactly right. Buying a car isn't just a one-time payment—there are plenty of costs down the road too. Every bit you can save counts…
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0166_NPC08703_002: What'll it be—the sharp sword or the sturdy shield? The new staff's pretty tasty, too.

ST_Dialogue_Date.Date_D0029074T_NPC029_021: He left because he's unsure how long it'll take. I'm gonna make him pay for something…

ST_Dialogue_Date.SD_S0111_NPC022_ACT_027: You know, I kind of miss how cute you looked when you were fuming at me.
ST_Dialogue_Date.Date_D0030074T_NPC029_002: Not that urgent. I just thought I'd buy you a meal since you have time.
ST_Dialogue_Date.Date_D0030074T_NPC029_003: Not that urgent. I just thought I'd buy you a meal since you have time.
ST_Dialogue_Date.Date_D0030074T_NPC029_026: Efficiency lowered, but it's fine once in a while.

ST_Dialogue_Date.SD_S0111_NPC022_ACT_026: You're more aggressive than I expected… or is this your true nature?

ST_Dialogue_Date.D0041010T_NPC004_011: Appraiser, don't be sad. Next time, will catch one!
ST_Dialogue_Date.Date_D0029074T_NPC029_017: I'll see you off through the cameras till you get home.
ST_Dialogue_Date.Date_D0030074T_NPC029_024: That was a lot of food… It was a good meal, no?
ST_Dialogue_Date.Date_D0030074T_NPC029_025: That was a lot of food… It was a good meal, no?
ST_Dialogue_Date.D0041010T_NPC011_005: Ah, win some lose some. Besides, losing to me is nothing to be ashamed of. I'll go easy on you next time, I promise.

ST_Dialogue_Date.Date_D0030074T_NPC029_015: Alright, all you need to do is have a good meal today.
ST_Dialogue_Date.Date_D0030074T_NPC029_016: Alright, all you need to do is have a good meal today.
ST_Dialogue_Date.SD_S0111_NPC022_ACT_028: Fine, then let's… tear each other apart.
ST_Dialogue_Date.D0041010T_Player_001: You need both technique and luck to catch one.
ST_Dialogue_Date.Date_D0029074T_NPC029_012: Has it been a while since we talked…?
ST_Dialogue_Date.Date_D0029074T_NPC029_013: Has it been a while since we talked…?
ST_Dialogue_Date.Date_D0030074T_NPC029_010: You're already here, so kick back and relax. Even machines need time to recharge, right?
ST_Dialogue_Date.Date_D0030074T_NPC029_011: You're already here, so kick back and relax. Even machines need time to recharge, right?
ST_Dialogue_Date.Date_D0029074T_NPC029_015: It's a bit late. I should head back.
ST_Dialogue_Date.Date_D0029074T_NPC029_016: It's a bit late. I should head back.
ST_Dialogue_Date.Date_D0029074T_NPC029_004: Taking over. Let me handle this.
ST_Dialogue_Date.D0041010T_Player_002: Looks like it's my lucky day.
ST_Dialogue_Date.D0041010T_Player_003: I'm still a long way from becoming a claw machine pro…
ST_Dialogue_Date.D0211057_NPC023_002: Not bothering you with this music video, am I?
ST_Dialogue_Date.D0041072_NPC027_004: At last, the fated showdown with the Appraiser has arrived. Alas, young challenger, your climb to the top ends here!
ST_Dialogue_Date.D0041010T_NPC011_004: Do you want to play with me? I won't go easy on you!
ST_Dialogue_Date.SD_S0111_NPC022_ACT_031: While we're still having fun, do you want to rehearse how you intend to punish me?
ST_Dialogue_Date.Date_D0030074T_NPC029_013: I'll have this, this, and this… Hmm, and that too!
ST_Dialogue_Date.Date_D0030074T_NPC029_014: I'll have this, this, and this… Hmm, and that too!
ST_Dialogue_Date.Date_D0030074T_NPC029_018: This is good. Give it a try.
ST_Dialogue_Date.Date_D0030074T_NPC029_019: This is good. Give it a try.
ST_Dialogue_Date.D0211057_NPC023_001: This is a good angle. Get ready to record.
ST_Dialogue_Date.Date_D0029074T_NPC029_006: The latte art came out nice, don't you think?
ST_Dialogue_Date.Date_D0029074T_NPC029_007: The latte art came out nice, don't you think?
ST_Dialogue_Date.SD_S0111_NPC022_ACT_033: Then let's stop here. But don't forget… the real "me" won't stop just here!
