ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_073: You never know how or what we're gonna run into…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_002: Still manageable. Your sweet talk's as sugary as ever. What, here to mooch drinks again?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_023: There's no place for us to stand here. It's kind of hard to get up there…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_111: These flowers came popping up just now when he was talking…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_152: Hey there, sparkly little anomaly… Do you live here too?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_004: Lies and slander! I—Nanally, the Ichi-daime of the Coluccis—was born with the guitar spirit burning inside me!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Tcang01_NPC006_020: Well… life is gonna be hard for the kid…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_112: Why won't this thing sit still and listen!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_002: Exactly! That's what they call "an unspoken understanding"! I've actually been quietly brewing this plan for a while now. It's time I told you…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Tcang01_NPC006_029: Guess this is your Anomaly Perception at work?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_030: That's the spirit! Where to start?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_010: And this is Taygedo, Eibon's restorer.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_009: These are my friends from Hankaku Street. Coco, Eibon's appraiser.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_061: That's a bass. A lot of people can't pick out its sound, but the bass is the backbone of any band. It's the soul of the music.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_040: I see… but why? This is obviously affecting the operatives' ability to carry out missions effectively, and they are not doing anything about it?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_023: I see. Thank you for sharing that.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Group_02: So if we keep this up…?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_040: So if we keep this up…?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_097: So if we keep this up…?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC09601_002: We're not getting this done anyway. Might as well tell them what we know, right?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_005: That spirit runs deep—like the gut of Kiroumaru! Unfathomable, mysterious… awe-inspiring!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_107: I think this flower is more suitable when you're trying to thank your parents… and teachers.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_036: I've heard similar rumors during our investigation.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_083: Is this that invincible confidence only overzealous teenagers can summon? I'm almost impressed.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_043: It's a little dark here. Watch your steps.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_050: The plants here are overgrown… Probably happened when some kid came in not knowing better… and a new anomaly came into existence.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_106: I've seen this in anime! Bands always end up selling tickets themselves!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03901_012: Hey…! We're already causing so much trouble!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_024: When in doubt, don't be shy, talk to your partners, it's ok.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_109: Then… we'll get going for now…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_022: The missing boy has communication barriers, right?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC02702_002: The boy always puts his heart into it. Day after day.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC02303_003: The boy came here every week but never said a thing. He'd just point at the flowers he wanted, which is why we all remember him.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_033: I—! I'm sorry! I just couldn't hold back my burning desire for the stage!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_065: Well then, Taygedo and I should head back now. Good night.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_214: …You still come to every single one?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_214: …You still come to every single one?

ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU053_Player_012: You usually hits the nail on the head. I didn't expect you to find tea names so confusing.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU001_Player_18: Seems like this Fluffy is a difficult one to talk to.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU001_NPC04001_05: Thank you two for supporting our work.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU009_NPC00103_027: Thank you for helping nullify the anomaly.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU009_NPC00103_028: Thank you for your assistance in nullifying the anomaly. I'll take it from here.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU009_NPC03404_088: Slow down, Rabi! You're getting cream all over your hands, and you might choke…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU095_Player_010: Hold up. Do you really not know what a Fluffy is?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU009_NPC03404_142: I did it… I really did it!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_NPC01011_012: Now that we've identified the cause, how can we get him back to normal?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU090_NPC026_012: I'm… really busy with work. I don't have time to take care of any fish right now.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU091_NPC026_004: I… I'm not sure. You choose, Appraiser.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU001_NPC06301_15: I… I should have… made things clear… with him… beforehand…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU107_NPC022_001: I… am the Zankou you know within your mind—or rather, in your subconscious. The shadow in your periphery, seen by you alone.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_NPC03411_098: I-I definitely will! Your help is worth more than any Fons can buy!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU011_NPC06101_048: Hey, at least I've been keeping a low profile!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU091_NPC026_022: I-I don't mind… are you going to have more?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU091_NPC026_001: I-I've wanted to try this place for forever…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU059_NPC_03744_026: I… I just started! I haven't made a single Fons yet! You know what? The ad agency even charged me 8,000 Fons! I haven't done anything that bad… have I?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU090_NPC026_003: W-want to get some milk tea?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_NPC03411_035: I promise I won't cause you any trouble! I'll come up with a plan too! You know about anomalies, and you're so calm. You can do so many things I can't… I-I'm counting on you!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU021_NPC016_007: As soon as I smell it, I start sneezing.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU074_Player_018: I don't know all that much about perfume…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU094_NPC07704_002: Nope. I just came to see the jellyfish.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU122_Player_022: I'm not with the Bureau, though…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_Player_134: I was just helping a friend, no need to thank me.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU049_NPC010_006: I've known the Sunyas for many years. Having their companionship has been a blessing.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU063_NPC_005_015: When I still was at Leon International, I saw many newcomers like that, who get taken advantage of by clients because of their inexperience or personality
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU024_NPC011_002: I promised Boss I wouldn't get into fights anymore, but today…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU001_NPC007A_M_24: And that's when I became convinced that the Soultractor from the novel actually existed.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU096_NPC024_019: I don't know if that's going to happen or not, but he's never said anything wrong… I'm not sure if I should believe him.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU082_Player_003: I just got here too. It's rare to see you in such good spirits when you're outside.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU011_NPC06101_170: I was just kidding around. If I made a comeback, who would run the tofu shop? That would be a tragedy for Hethereau!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_NPC03411_057: I didn't want to use it!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU090_NPC026_027: I think so too! As long as y-you enjoyed it…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU011_NPC06101_144: I should tell the regulars that I have something important to deal with, so I won't be able to deliver their tofu before dawn…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU096_NPC024_025: I have the same question! I don't know how, but at that time, I thought there had to be a way, and we had to save the world.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_NPC00411_004: I've loved books since I was a kid. I even found my best childhood friend because of a book. Though I'm older now, my passion for books hasn't diminished. The more I read, the more I realize how little I know.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU065_Player_019: I had a great time too.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_Player_091: That's right. Let's help him out of this situation first.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU093_NPC02317_007: I'm at fault too. If I'd just explained myself properly, it wouldn't have been a problem. I yelled at you, and that's what caused the argument.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU082_NPC032_013: I didn't make you say it out loud. Don't worry. It will still come true.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU065_Player_020: I had a great time too, thanks for inviting me today, Lacrimosa.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU022_Player_018: Am I a member of the Coluccis now?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU107_Player_008: I've seen it too. Sometimes it even comes to speak with me…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU077_NPC028_004: The cats and dogs I get from the pet store always fall sick. We end up parting ways. It's been like that many times.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU064_NPC_05705_004: I thought it would be you. You know this is against the rules, Skia.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU068_NPC003_026: We fought recklessly… breaking ribs, sinking knuckles into bodies, yet we kept going, completely lost in the intoxicating rush of blood and destruction…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_Player_101: Let's take this chance to sort out what's been going on.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_Player_023: Let's head back to the newsstand. After running around so much this early, your tea is probably getting cold.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU009_NPC00103_004: We just contacted Myosotis, and they've given their approval.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU001_NPC06301_07: We might… need to reconsider… Sorry.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU001_NPC007A_M_56: We usually walk dogs on Hankaku Street. You're welcome to join us.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU074_Player_003: Our Shopkeeper is a loyal customer of this brand. She just bought a bottle from the same line. The bottle design is almost the same.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU001_Player_156: We're here for the Stardawg shoot.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU021_NPC016_034: We're such great partners, of course we'll always stay together! Naturally, our scent will last forever!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU019_Player_004: We really do make a great team!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU096_Player_015: The city we live in seems so small.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU011_NPC06101_075: The world of professional racing can be cruel.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_NPC00411_006: When we grew up, there wasn't much to do. My childhood friends would pool pocket money to buy books. We would read them for days and have a good time.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU091_NPC04602_005: We've got a drink here called "Deep in the Heart"—it uses that spice, actually.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU063_NPC_06301_004: We do have dog conditioners and volumizing sprays here. In theory, they can also be used for the fur of animorphic espers.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU068_NPC003_031: We're both gamblers staking our lives, yearning to dance with death.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU061_Player_028: We've known each other for how long now? Your ability isn't anything like that…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU001_NPC007A_M_66: Because we're posting missing cat posters.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU001_NPC007A_M_74: We are very particular about the quality of the ads we take. We want to buy a product from the manufacturer and experience it ourselves.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU093_NPC1029_018: No problem, I'll make even more! Next time, we can enjoy the cake somewhere a bit less… hectic.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_Player_124: I'll try to salvage the diary.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU078_Player_017: I'll continue to make wishes for Iroi.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU009_NPC00103_022: I'll contact the owner to confirm. Please stay safe.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU097_Player_003: I do want to ask, why are you here so early? You can't jog in this weather, can you?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU063_NPC_005_022: I don't mind either way, I just can't imagine what it'd look like… Still, I can handle any changes with an open mind. Let's go with your suggestion.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU081_Player_013: Actually, I got an idea. How about you invite them over to browse your collection? After that, the three of you could find a treasure worth collecting together, just like the secret variant earlier.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU081_Player_009: Shinku, that sounds pretty crazy. I'm curious about how many extra bowls you won though. Did you eat them all?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU093_NPC1029_009: I made way too many cakes—if we don't eat them now, they'll go stale. Why don't we all sit down and enjoy a few slices? You can argue after you finish eating.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU009_Player_132: Let me assess the situation first, don't worry.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU011_NPC06101_017: I need to answer this call. Take your time looking at the car!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU069_Player_009: Let me take a break… then I'll return to the food.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU068_NPC003_023: That's why I decided to "feast" with the madman.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU069_NPC003_013: I was born into the Lirnia family, which hammered into me the importance of following strict guidelines.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_NPC03411_003: When I was selling old books a few days ago, I accidentally mixed in an old diary… After I realized what I did, I rushed over here, only to find the stand in such a mess!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU043_Player_012: I thought there was a trash can around here, but I don't see it now?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU082_NPC032_002: It's not like I don't go out at all…! It's the weekends. I don't mind shopping around for a change of scenery.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU124_Player_015: I've noticed you like ending stories with a few questions and then leaving them unanswered, Elyms.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU123_Player_033: I was just here to keep it company and listen to what it had to say.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU011_Player_022: I'm just helping. The shop's really busy right now, and the owner couldn't get away.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU124_NPC03911_001: I'm just feeling a little out of it today…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU064_NPC_005_018: I'm not like you. I can't put a smile on my face for every job that comes my way.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU069_NPC003_021: I don't want people saying I bullied someone from Eibon and made them cry…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU109_NPC022_022: I can give you a more convincing illusion, a phantom you can almost touch—as kindling for the hatred and desire you're nurturing…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU061_Player_038: I wasn't lying, though I only told you the first half.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU079_Player_030: I promise I won't be scared away. So, Iroi, please trust me a bit more.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU045_Player_012: Me? I'm not great at taking care of goldfish… I'd feel bad if they died on my watch…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU078_Player_012: Me? This is your pet. You should do it.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU021_NPC016_029: When I'm with you, Coco, the wind blends our scents together, and it becomes like chocolate mint ice cream!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_NPC03411_104: I talked to my family. We think the diary should be yours.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU068_NPC003_025: I fought with that Savage for seven days straight, and we both got worked up beyond belief. You could say… we had a real good time.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU090_NPC026_021: At Hethereau Skytower—I reserved us a table…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU068_NPC003_029: I saw the exact same excitement in his eyes as mine—that lunatic, he was enjoying it too!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU042_NPC011_002: I was thinking about the stack of papers I threw away the other day.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU064_NPC_005_005: When I was with them, they were still orderly. But now… who knows.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU077_NPC028_011: I learned how to patch up injured oddities as well as animals.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU055_NPC013_013: I was afraid that one day, I would lose my sight completely.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU071_NPC016_004: I was curious about how it worked, so I paid for it.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU092_Player_007: I'm not very familiar with this place.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_NPC00411_096: When I was a child, nobody knew what Espers or anomalies were. Many of the major events that are considered to be significant all happened after I left Hethereau.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU108_Player_026: I'll pass, but if you want some, Boss, go ahead. If you get drunk, I can help you back home…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU011_NPC06101_104: Haha, I knew it! I might be more talented in tofu than racing!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU071_NPC016_009: I've already looked into the seller's info, but it was unfair to accuse them of scamming without more evidence.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU124_NPC030_028: I'd like to make it into a fizzy drink for you to try—something that tastes a little unusual, but has a fresh twist.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU076_Player_014: I take on some delivery tasks myself. I can kind of understand that feeling.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU063_NPC_005_032: I don't dislike that look… As long as I mentally prepare myself, I might not mind that much being seen by you.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU092_Player_009: Aurelia definitely understands Tamamochi Street better than I do.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU107_NPC013_021: I got one thing wrong… All these years, the reason my mind wasn't destroyed by her Esper Ability was because she deliberately held back.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU061_NPC_006_019: I was curious why she was so drawn to that particular drink, so without thinking much about it, I grabbed an extra bottle to try it myself…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU054_NPC013_006: I saw the flower once, but I only have a vague impression.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU054_NPC013_008: I want to know its name and see it again.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU091_Player_017: I'm all good, no problems here.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU091_Player_027: I'm all good, no problems here.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU080_Player_011: I'm having fun. You also got your secret variant. This is the best I could ask for.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU070_Sub007_003: I'm grateful for all the business Fadia has brought me!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU056_Player_011: I could've sworn you just wished for 100 million Fons to appear out of thin air…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU068_NPC003_017: I figured… someone that violent probably gets antsy if they don't fight for a few days.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_Player_044: That's not likely. But wait, you're the owner of that diary…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU011_Player_100: I'd like a bottle of champagne. Any recommendations?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU001_Player_123: I want to take a group photo with my friends here. Can we get a discount?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU059_Player_010: I'd like to see this ancestral anomaly you use for fortune telling.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU067_Player_023: What I am treasuring, are the memories I made with you. Even if I eat the tomato, I'll always remember: "Today, Lacrimosa gave me her most treasured prize."
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU059_NPC_03744_024: I-I-I-I haven't done anything wrong! At least not yet…! I had trouble finding work, so I thought I'd make some extra Fons by consulting…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU093_NPC1029_023: Most of what I do—what I can do—is just help calm everyone down. Like getting everyone to sit down together and have some dessert, for example.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU081_NPC032_002: I'm choosing some gifts, and I thought they should come out of my collection.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU011_NPC09406_005: I recommend the classic Reims Rose Sparkling Wine!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU011_NPC06101_180: The fried tofu I made is still warm in the pot. If you can't finish it, you can take it home and share my food with friends!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU058_Player_011: I want to be the Anomaly Hunter King!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_Player_116: I understand, Miles. I trust you.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_Player_012: I'm an Anomaly Hunter from the Eibon Antique Shop. If anything unusual happens, please contact me.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU050_Player_004: I'm Taygedo's family. Since you can't understand what he's saying, let me explain.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU050_Player_002: I am Taygedo's guarantor. What have you done to him?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU122_Player_032: Elyms invited me over to pet the cat.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU123_Player_012: I'm a little confused. Why do you have to stay at the Bureau to make friends with humans?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU043_Player_001: I didn't notice anyone particularly anxious on my way here either.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU094_NPC1029_003: Let's see… Ah, this is a discount voucher for Din's Roast Duck. Show this to them, and you'll get 20% off.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU041_Player_009: Let me.. Wait, where's the baked milk?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU097_Player_015: I'm already here. Of course I'll give you a hand.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_Player_007: I actually have a magazine I'd like to subscribe to. How should I do this?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU079_Player_013: It's okay. You don't need to worry about that.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU092_Player_008: I don't really frequent Tamamochi Street, so I'm not very familiar with the place.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU093_NPC02317_010: I've got no objections. But the night market's opening soon, so we'd better hurry up and wrap up the collaboration plans.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU063_NPC_005_009: I'm not saying you're doing anything wrong… If anything, the only thing you need to work on is this habit of always apologizing.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU124_Player_006: I didn't catch the whole conversation…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU023_Player_003: I never said I was interested…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_Player_130: I'm guessing the Old Diary exists to keep its owner's treasured memories from being forgotten. If the diary were destroyed, it wouldn't serve its purpose.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU055_NPC013_021: So maybe the life I have now could be considered happy.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU001_Player_137: I'm not really available right now…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU001_Player_127: I'm a little busy now. Let's talk in a bit.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU095_NPC024_027: Anyway, I still got work to do. Thanks for helping!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU077_NPC028_017: All my emotions are just an act. You don't need to believe them.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU001_Player_126: I'm a pretty good photographer, but I guess I'm going to have a pass on Yummers Bones.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU094_NPC1029_037: My jellyfish, hmm… to put it plainly, it's essentially a wheelchair.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU109_Player_012: I won't deny your illusions' impact on me. And I did come here to learn more.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU093_NPC1029_012: I don't think either of you meant to make things difficult for the other.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU042_NPC008_002: I took a look, but I can't tell these two apart. Take a look for yourself.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_NPC02339_005: You seem dazed and confused, so I was worried you might be a missing elderly person and was about to contact the Security Office. But you suddenly slammed your wallet on the counter and said you wanted takoyaki. I was confused, so I said, "Sir, you're at the wrong place—this is a gift shop, why would we have takoyaki?"
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU044_Player_010: Let me see… "How to Communicate with People"?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU124_NPC03911_003: For a moment, I almost thought…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU122_Player_018: I know about Mysties. They typically turn into small objects and animals to play tricks…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU095_NPC024_009: This is actually the first time I saw one. Are they common?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU091_NPC026_020: I first heard the name of my hometown from a street vendor.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU022_NPC011_005: I've been thinking hard until I realized… a good token requires more than one's heart—it needs to be liked too!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU107_NPC013_008: The only effect I can clearly perceive is "seeing her phantom"—or rather, hallucinating that I see her..
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU059_NPC_006_013: I'm not great with words, so I can't give you a good explanation. But even if you're still inexperienced, someone as perceptive as you should be able to sense it…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU011_NPC06101_135: I may be getting old, but I still have a good eye for talent. If you ask me, you got what it takes to defeat "Don't Stop Me Now!"
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU109_NPC022_019: I want you to burn me with all your fury, all of your anger… Let's see which of us is snuffed out first.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_NPC01011_018: If I had known this would happen, I'd have told you to ignore his wishes and nullify the anomaly.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU091_Player_005: I actually think it's pretty good.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU022_Player_008: I'm pretty sure they've buried a fair share of safety hazards too.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU069_Player_005: I give up, Fadia… My spice tolerance is nowhere at your level.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU094_NPC1029_007: I had her leave it at the Lost & Found by the plaza. Please take the person over there and have them confirm whether it's what they lo—
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU107_NPC009_004: I had Adler cook something restorative to help you recover. Take it easy today, and get some proper rest.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU090_NPC026_007: I'll have to write that down…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU001_NPC06301_04: Didn't we agree that the three of you would come together? What are you doing here all by yourself? Is this Buddy's new idea?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU079_Player_022: I remember you said all your emotions, your happiness and your sadness, were just acts.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU090_Player_020: I think there's a shop up the road called "Hillside Blooms". If you buy a plant there, they'll give you a complimentary plant care manual.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU045_Player_007: The staff member is a girl who adores fish. She must be happy when people appreciate the fish she's taking care of.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU107_NPC013_019: Oops, I misremembered—the Boss's got a Bureau car picking her up today, so I don't need to go pick her up.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU001_Player_17: Let me give it a try…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU109_Player_002: Where should I go for the meeting?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU081_NPC032_026: You're so slick! I was definitely getting you a gift too. The whole plan was to have you suggest ideas and then sneak in something you liked, but now my plan is…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU096_NPC024_024: I said we should do something to prevent that from happening, and he questioned me how could we even do that…?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU064_NPC_005_020: I thought I made myself clear: my rules haven't changed.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_NPC03411_045: I looked up Grandma's address from when she was young, and it turns out it's near the newsstand!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU041_NPC008_014: I didn't get a single bite! Spit 'em out at once!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU096_Player_020: I thought that someone like you would care about saving the world.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU079_NPC028_012: I thought you'd feel better if the tree grew tall.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU011_NPC06101_070: If I hadn't opened this shop, I would have wasted my talents in making tofu!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU011_NPC06101_029: My car has quite a few modifications. It's not for the average driver. Take care.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU094_NPC1029_031: I had a lot of free time back then. Besides rehab, I didn't have anything else to do. I saw her at the hospital, always busy with paperwork, so I eventually asked if there was anything I could help with.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU011_NPC06101_015: At my age, I'm long past chasing wealth and glory. All I want now is to make good tofu in peace.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU055_NPC04904_003: I asked if she wanted to wait for a restock, but she said she'd check another store.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU043_NPC06301_004: Or… maybe I should just ask the dog…?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU076_Player_021: Maybe you're jaded because you've seen too many places. But aren't there places where the longer you look, the more irreplaceable they become?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU009_Player_183: Maybe others wouldn't notice, but Alice can definitely tell when something's bothering you.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU072_Player_011: Maybe you could try a different transporation, like the bus.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU072_Player_009: Maybe you could try a different mode of transport, like the tram.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU020_Player_010: Maybe if you take more mock exams, you'll get less nervous and be able to remember more.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_NPC03411_097: {PlayerName}, maybe it's not a big deal for you, but it means a lot to me!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU079_Player_018: Maybe we planted the sapling in a dream?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU096_NPC024_008: Maybe we can somehow save ourselves?
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU094_NPC1029_032: Maybe she thought I was pretty good at clerical work. When I was discharged, the president asked if I'd be interested in coming to Tamamochi Street and helping out.

ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_M_05: Hahaha, thanks for the compliment. It's all so I can better integrate into life at Hethereau, but sometimes when I encounter words I don't know, I still replace them with "woof woof".
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC06301_03: Hahaha, the Yummers Bone ad isn't that big of a deal anymore.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_Anomaly043_016: As the butler of the Golden Apple Collection Hall, I can't help but notice rare finds! However—
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_103: Haha! Our Vice President's real Esper Ability is catching everything but fish… He's practically the Octowpus's worst nightmare! Hahaha!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU005_NPC02101_044: Haha, you're quite something, Anomaly Hunter of Eibon.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_M_04: Haha, we can see how we can do it differently if that makes you uncomfortable.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_Player_077: Haha, I did it on purpose.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC054A_074: Haha, look at me talking nonsense because I'm so hungry. Don't take it seriously, haha, haha… I'll just go ahead then?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU034_NPC02505_037: Haha, looks like you and Aurora just weren't meant to be after all!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_NPC08702_009: Haha, feel free to think that. And please thank the Frizzle for us—thanks to it, we got to relive those bittersweet memories from our younger days.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_NPC05005_023: Haha, then what do you see in this graffiti?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC054A_033: Ha! Who would've thought this was the new name of Acacia, the big boss of Acacian Aeronauts?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU137_NPC032_014: Ha, haha… why do I feel like I'm getting nitpicked this whole time…?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC06503_002: Ha, I knew he had other victims! That despicable fraud, I won't let him get away with it…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_124: Huh? What did you just say, brat…?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_168: Huh?! Why should a scruffy old man like you get to stand in the center! You'd ruin our Association's image!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU140_NPC021_025: Phew… we've been wandering around for so long. We've covered a lot of ground.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_Anomaly043_021: Oh my, oh my! I've been found out!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_122: Phew… Now that the monster's taken care of, we can finally get back to fishing! Tonight, I'm gonna fish till I drop!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC054A_048: Oops, slip of the tongue! Not teacup—coffee cup. Whatever you do, don't tell her I said that.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC050A_012: Oh my, oh my. I always admire folks with grand ambitions, but it's equally delightful to throw cold water on their unrealistic fantasies.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_NPC06109_034: Oh my! I confirmed with the stores that received the goods. Sure, everything was delivered, but weren't you a few minutes late…? Now I'll have to deduct something for that.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU101_NPC028_032: Oho, I just wanted to see if you dared to—
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_077: Well, it's not every day I get a chance like this… Appraiser, I'd like to pick your brain a bit. How tough is the Octowpus to deal with? Y'know, as an Anomaly Hunter or Bureau member…?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_NPC06002_02: Like, man. Who was the genius that came up with this event?!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_NPC06022_001: Whoa there, you didn't have to come all the way here in person to check on your order!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU006_NPC07001_001: Oh dear, it's hard to say. It's so damp everywhere.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC04302_02: Oh, he never misses a chance to sneak out. I'll have to give him a good talking-to when we get home.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC07902_009: Ahahaha… I laughed so hard I'm out of breath. Oh right, congrats on getting the right answer, {Gender}|gender(mister,miss)! Come hang out with us next time and wait for the President's next blunder!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_096: Hey! You're an Association member now, so have some confidence! We're gonna catch that beast today, so bring the energy!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_117: Hey! The Appraiser's part of the Association now. Helping out is a given, right? No need to bring payment into it…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_NPC04421_003: Ah, you're right. Yesterday was super unlucky for me all day long, but thankfully I ran into that Frizzle at the end, so at least my day wasn't a complete disaster.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU132_NPCS120008_001: Hey, adventurer, hold up a sec, baa! Maybe you're into chilly stuff, baa?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC07902_035: Huh? Is the association's biggest secret finally being revealed?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC07902_036: Huh? Is the association's biggest secret finally being revealed?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_NPC04307_020: Eh? Okay. Wait, you wouldn't be—
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC001_004: Huh?! Coco actually knows about my quest…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC050A_001: Well, well, well, well, well! Look who just walked in.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_103503_001: Oh hey, isn't this… what's the name again? You know, The one who spouts nonsense like "Justice always wins"?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC054A_070: Hey buddy, why don't you think about it some more? Besides Logistics, there are definitely plenty of other places that would suit you better.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC054A_014: You like that, buddy? Why not consider coming to work with us then?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC054A_020: First time here as your buddy's guarantor? If you're not familiar with how things work, feel free to ask me anything barra.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC054A_019: Why don't you go first, buddy? Sorry for taking up your time earlier. Hope this makes up for it a little.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC054A_059: Buddy! Come on, follow me barra.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU137_NPC028_007: Oh, so you did have your own personal agenda.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_Anomaly043_013: Oh, my little Snowman! You really think it's beautiful? Can you tell me what makes it so lovely?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC054A_040: Oh! Looks like it's my turn now, so let's end our chat here. See you around barra!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU138_NPC024_003: Ooh! This is great! Let's do our best!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_103502_030: Oh? You wouldn't be talking about the one we recorded when we first met, world you?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_NPC03708_20: Oh… there really is… You're right.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC054A_018: Ohhh! The assessment room is free now.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU137_NPC001_003: Ooh… legendary magic?! And ancient heroes…!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU102_NPCAS002_030: OOooOoh! Mah mind now sees the absolute truth: an even more ancient dominator, their truth dormant in olden origins…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU102_NPCAS002_017: OOOOOOOH! Thanks to your pristine savage powers, I can finally feel it! Mah mind is opening up to the truth!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_NPC06109_013: Aha! Let me guess again… There's a scene with salmon and tuna sashimi neatly arranged on display, then the camera zooms into mysterious but perfect slices of…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU104_NPC001_012: Ooh! Brushing, grooming, and hairball care? I've got that covered!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU138_NPC01905_001: Ooh! Are you having a vacation here for the first time?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU102_NPC001_001: Oooh! We'll have to punch with all we've got!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU104_NPCAS001_02_006: Ooh! You need this Fuzzy's creation to make a brand-new Fuzzy, baa! This Fuzzy's so excited! This Fuzzy's getting everything ready now, baa!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_Anomaly043_027: Oh goodness, oh my, don't say such things, please don't! Hughes, wait a moment, let me say one last thing to our guests—
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC02111_007: Oh right, the questions! I… I didn't prepare any. I'll just ask whatever comes to mind. Your answers d-don't really matter, so just… say what you'd like.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC00105_007: Oh! You mean that serial scam case. Quite a few shops on Hankaku Street have been hit recently, and we're investigating each one.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC054A_075: Oh! Right, right, almost forgot the important stuff. Even with my recommendation letter, you'll still need to pass the Bureau's written exam first, you know.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU103_NPCAS002_01_004: Oh! Melancholy Fuzzy seems to have slipped out of the village. Come to think of it, that's not something that happens very often, baa…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU005_NPC02101_009: Oh! Now that's what I call dependable!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_Blank_006: Oh! I haven't introduced myself yet. I'm Barracuda, a mechanic in the Logistics Department of the BAC.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC02304_010: Oh, that guy! I've seen him.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU101_NPCAS002_045: Ah, alright then. I'll go back now.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU101_NPCAS002_020: Aha, I see. Yes, that must be right!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU005_NPC02101_035: Oh, I see. That's fine then.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_Player_085: Oh? Is it because you discovered the Bureau of Anomaly Control isn't as great as you imagined? That becoming a big hero isn't so easy?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_NPC00403_03: Oh? Fluffy? Boy, my eyes just don't serve me like they used to.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC010_005: Oh? It seems Taygedo hasn't had a chance to tell you yet, Appraiser. He was hoping you could accompany him to the Bureau of Anomaly Control today.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC03909_045: Just knowing she was once here hurts so deep, I could almost drown in my resentment.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC010_027: Even if he secretly agrees with her point of view, he can't quickly adjust from that confrontational emotional state.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU138_NPC12616_002: You flatter me… Wait, I saw you on TV. You're that guy from the Bureau… I'm honored!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_NPC05005_017: Hmph… Returning sarcasm with sarcasm, I have no right to complain.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_110: Hmph… That's how it should've been from the start. Even if he apologizes, I'm not forgiving that dummy… At least not for a week!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_097: Hehe… You'll see when we get there! They've pretty much finished setting up. You two, follow me!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_080: Heh heh… Why don't you take a guess? Caltrop Lake is huge… So why did it come after me, of all people?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_094: Hehe, of course I knew. The Appraiser is an Angling Association member!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU133_NPCS120009_011: Hmph-hmph, once I've got herb lore all figured out, I can start cracking cases. Keep your eyes peeled for suspicious activity, adventurer—I'll decode the truth for you, baa!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU137_NPCAS002_51_005: Heh-heh, this Fuzzy knows plenty more than that.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC008_004: Hmph, what's so hard to understand? Isn't it obvious they first paid homage to someone popular and respected to rake in money and build a fan base, then did everything possible to distance themselves from the original?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC06503_029: Hmph, scammers who exploit people's feelings for their pets should reflect on what they've done in jail.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_NPC03707_11: Hmph, where did those guys go?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC10002_001: Ugh… I have to tear it down again… what a pain.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC001_028: Ugh… I'm still covered in Octowpus smell… I just wanna go home and shower.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC07902_003: Sigh… The new gear on the market lately has been so uninspiring. Maybe I should just get a custom batch made next time!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_178: Ugh… The dummies are talking about fishing again…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU134_NPCS120010_001: Ugh… what am I supposed to do, baa? Is my grand research really gon-naa be scrapped halfway through?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_035: Aw, come on! What's there to get all worked up about? Everything's been peaceful for so long. What could possibly go wrong…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_027: Aw, come on… Don't call me out like that, Vice President…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC08503_011: Oh my… This won't be easy to just smooth over…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_M_17: Sigh, maybe that's exactly the kind of dog I used to be.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC04903_032: Sigh, without Windbringer, I don't think Hillside Blooms can make it in time for the contest…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_NPC03708_32: Even if I clear the Fluffys from the lawn today, they'll reappear on the community lawn the next day. It'll never end…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_03821_027: Well, you should feel honored. Today, the righteous Kokoro Rider himself will serve as your guide through the hero's history. As for photos, since you're a fan, I'll only charge 18,888 Fons.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU006_NPC07001_005: My besties complain about the humid weather. They just don't get it.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_NPC06002_08: Sigh, had I known, I wouldn't have slacked off today. I should have cleaned the trash can earlier.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU006_NPC04002_017: Sigh, speaking of which… JTF patrols are usually done in pairs. With the frequent appearance of Rainmen lately, pressure has increased sharply for our patrols and we're short-staffed…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_NPC06002_47: Sigh, I'm exhausted. I need a good night's sleep when I get home tonight.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU138_NPC12603_001: Ugh, we lost. No one was ever able to beat us in the school club…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC001_018: Urgh! Such a strong fishy smell! And there's beer and fermented flour too… Ew… My fur's about to stand on end…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_NPC09405_007: Well… They're on the Bureau's "Whitelist of Edible Anomaly Products," so apart from having zero nutritional value, they should be perfectly safe to eat!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC02302_005: Um… I don't think so, sorry…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_172: Hmm… Don't my eyes look squinty? And my expression's so stiff…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC001_008: Mmgh… What am I supposed to do? I was never trained for underwater combat… I-if the Octowpus drags me under, Coco, you gotta come save me…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU138_NPC001_022: Umm… if that's the case… never mind…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC001_001: Urgh… A-anyway, I need to apply for a diving suit at the Bureau, and then practice my swimming…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_007: Whoa! How powerful… But talk's cheap! You're gonna have to show us what you've got…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU137_NPCAS002_60_013: Hm. Still, if you lost your magic to summon me here, then I baa-ear responsibility too.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU137_NPCAS002_60_028: Hmm… Your grasp of "rock" isn't quite up to snuff, baa.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU137_NPCAS002_60_037: Hmm… come to think of it, there are still some spare weapons.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU138_NPC011_003: Umm, that could work! But, but, but I wanna be the captain!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU140_Player_012: Hmm, all I can see is you waving at the camera. And… the weather's great, and Pukaland looks quite beautiful… today?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC012_005: Hmm, such theories do exist… Overall, the second season's ratings dipped slightly, but it attracted many non-tokusatsu fans. The production team likely increased the romantic subplot in season three as a strategy to expand their audience.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU129_NPCAS001_003: U-um, what I'm about to say might be a little sudden, baa-ut… I'll gather my courage! I want… I want to ask the adventurer for a favor!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU138_NPC01905_003: Well, there is one condition for participants…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU102_NPCAS002_005: You can only free yourselves from the shackles of civilization by fighting! And that is the very purpose of FFC—the Fuzzy Fighting Club!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_115: Ugh! That dummy! How could he even tell you that…?!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU034_NPC02505_001: Oh… hey there! I was just thinking about striking up a conversation.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU140_NPC021_035: Uh… I didn't mean to bother you… I just overheard you say you got a picture of some kind of door…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU140_NPC10606_005: Ah… saying it like that wasn't exactly what I meant. I'm making a fool of myself in front of you two.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_NPC04421_011: Oh shoot, my ride is here! I've got to run. Next time I'll treat you all to some Clicky Fries! Bye-bye!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_NPC04421_001: Oh wait, no, that's not right. The Frizzle from today might not be the same one from yesterday… It probably isn't the same one, right? I'm sorry, I must have confused two different oddities—
ST_Dialogue_Side.Shinku01_side01_NPC028_01: Aha, the Fuzzy just mentioned a purple-grade weapon.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_050: Ahaha… If she didn't say anything, most people wouldn't be able to tell. She's never had all that much respect for her elders. Learned it from her mother, calling me Sky this, Sky that…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC07902_006: Ahahaha! The President actually did that before! And he bought a sea fish! A sea fish from Caltrop Lake! Hahahaha!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC07902_008: Ahahaha! The President must think so too! Maybe that anomaly has it out for you specifically!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU140_NPC021_050: Ahaha, I'm suddenly starting to miss The Witch's House.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU138_NPC12612_001: Arghhhh, we lost! I knew I shouldn't have teamed up with you!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_NPC10201_001: Oh no! Did I overcharge you 500 Fons and forget to bring you your ramen?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_NPC10201_007: Oh, please don't gobble your food! Our ramen is served hot and fresh! Eating well is just as important as working well!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU126_NPC001_003: Ah! That shady Fuzzy Merchant's already ghosted!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU103_NPC001_001: Ah! It's Brawly Fuzzy! What's Brawly Fuzzy doing here?!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU106_NPC_026_009: Ah! P-please don't worry! I have… I have official certification from the municipality!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_03821_029: Ah! This piece of glass once reflected my magnificent figure!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_03821_030: Oh! This brick once became a step in my ascension to godhood!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC001_003: Ah! Could it be that the heavens saw me struggling with this quest and sent Coco to help me…?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_Anomaly043_005: Ah, visitor, you mean… too serious?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU140_Player_021: Ah, that's just my guess for now.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC012_009: Oh, Taygedo and Nanally have left.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_NPC09405_001: Ah, hello there! Welcome to Clicky!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU005_NPC02101_030: Ah, my record player. You managed to find it.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC02302_008: Oh, yeah, they are, but I don't think it's that serious of a contest.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_NPC02321_002: Ah, it's the Frizzle. Is there anything you need help with?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU034_NPC02505_020: Ah, what a rush! It's been so long since I ran this track, but it's still as thrilling as ever.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU137_NPCAS002_60_008: Ah, right, please pass on my thanks to her, baa.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU006_NPC04002_027: Ah, the rain has stopped. I should report back to the BAC.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU137_NPC032_019: Huh…? Hold on—didn't Wizard Fuzzy say they'd help?!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU137_NPC032_011: Tch… if there's really no other choice, I'll help her one more time.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_024: Tch… Just wait till I've got new bait. I'm gonna catch a monster fish quicker than you've ever seen, and you'll all be sorry!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC008_002: Tsk tsk tsk, Taygedo, you're so lame. All you can say is "no taste, no taste!" over and over. Boring.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_047: Tch! What a pain… You'd better keep your word! If you waste any more of our time, I'll curse you to no catches for a month… no, a whole year!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU137_NPC032_004: Tch, so in the end, it's just another mission…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU101_NPCAS002_002: Hey, I'm not a thing. Mind your language!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_033: Hey! What do you think you're doing?!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_103502_020: Oi! Tell me. Did this kid really come here on his own?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU005_NPC008_004: Hey! Don't you puke on me! Gross!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU137_NPC032_017: Hey, hey!…Looks like they just fainted.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU035_NPC05702_006: Here it is. As for the price, I'll give you a discount… 100,000 Fons. How about it?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU005_NPC02101_049: Here, the record I promised you.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU034_NPC02505_040: Take a look at this… Geed spoiler, extra-grip tires for sunny circuits… and Aurora was just sent to Novus a few days ago for full-package-maintenance!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC008_001: Look over there. Lucky you came just in time for the show—it's just getting to the good part.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU131_NPCAS001_001: Our entire brand identity revolves around accessorizing with cute mushroom skins, baa!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC10002_008: Ugh, in the past few days, we've already redone this wall three times, and she just came by again to ask us to redo it.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU137_NPC028_008: Hmm… let's put Mint aside for now. Anyway, go ask a person who's really in the know—and I just happen to know the perfect someone.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC07902_014: Hmm… It was like… gasoline and squid mixed together? A gross, fishy stench? Hahaha!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_NPC04421_008: Hmm—how should I put this? If we're talking about taste, honestly, it doesn't quite measure up to my beloved Clicky Fries…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU140_NPC021_037: Hmm… is it really that important to be famous on Bagel?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU140_Player_010: Hmm… There aren't any traces of an Anomaly around here—at least, not for now.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU006_NPC04002_024: Well… the BAC does not oppose cooperation with civilian organizations, and we often issue anomaly commissions.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_M_03: Well… you can just call me Buddy, like Auddy and Ruddy do.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC06503_009: Yeah… I probably need a lot more time to get over it… Wait, now's not the time to talk about this!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC08503_006: Hmm… My question is… How do you find a good fishing spot?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU131_NPCASS002_014: Mm… it's still not quite as good as ours…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU003_Player_037: Well… if getting familiar with the Manual would make your job easier, I'd be willing to learn.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_Player_003: Hmm… let me think about it.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU140_NPC021_019: Hmm… so even a dreamlike park like this isn't enough to satisfy them?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU101_NPCAS002_030: Mmm… I'm fully aware of that.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_Player_100: Hmm… I guess that must be the result of being at Hethereau.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU006_Player_050: Yes. During the fight, I noticed one of the Rainmen had soil on its sleeve.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU005_NPC02101_048: Hmm. The records need… some cleaning and maintenance too. It's fine, nothing major.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU005_Player_046: Yeah… with some Anomaly Hunter tricks…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_Player_079: Yeah. Even though you've only been in Hethereau for a day or two, your fries have brought happiness to so many people.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU006_Player_052: Hmm. Though it's just speculation… I think this leader Rainman might be the mastermind behind the Weather Vines.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_Player_100: Yeah. The seller of this model approached Eibon too, but our offer was way lower than what they wanted, so the deal didn't go through.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_003: Hmm? A new member? Well, if you wanna join the Association, you gotta get my approval first!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU104_NPC001_009: Mm-hmm… Melancholy Fuzzy's tears… Wait! Is that sugar water actually melted-down Melancholy Fuzzy?! Oh no, the existential dread is hitting me hard…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU104_NPC028_005: Mhm! But "Melted Sugar Water"? I feel like I've heard that somewhere…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU138_NPC01905_036: Hmm! You played so well, I can't believe you're new to this! I'm glad I waited for you.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_NPC08702_003: Mmhmm, that's exactly what you said fifty years ago too.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU138_NPC011_005: Mhm! This boss opens her arms to powerful recruits!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_113: Mhm! I'm real photogenic, aren't I? We definitely should've taken one with me in the center!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU131_NPCASS002_008: Mhm! The gift is your membership pass to the Glam Fuzzy Club, baa!
