ST_DialogueSumUP.L110035_3_SumUp: Fleur the Storyteller seems to be recounting old stories of the family that once lived in this mansion…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110037_SumUp: Fleur the Storyteller seems to be recounting old stories of the family that once lived in this mansion…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110038_SumUp: Fleur the Storyteller seems to be recounting old stories of the family that once lived in this mansion…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110136_SumUp_S: With nowhere left to run, the "Tomato Devil" finally dissolved into a puddle of ketchup as you and Lacrimosa struck together.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110113_SumUp: The "Tomato Devil" began as a misunderstanding around Lacrimosa's oddball behavior. But as more rumors began to swirl, the public's imagination actually gave form to a malicious Anomaly. You decided to protect the vending machines from being destroyed, hopefully calming the rumors and nullifying the Anomaly.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110117_SumUp: The "Tomato Devil" fled the scene, but several unscrupulous bystanders deliberately staged a scene for clicks. They posted the aftermath of the fight with a misleading headline distorting the truth. To avoid further trouble, Mint asked you to escort Lacrimosa home.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110002_SumUp_S: You learned about the "Wertheimer Index"—a value which measures a target's deviation from reality. The Bureau continuously monitors this value across the city's districts and responds rapidly.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110070_SumUp: Kodak, owner of "Film Orbit Studio," said an Anomaly appeared in the photo studio and turned the furnishings inside into photographs.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110118_SumUp: "Cake Sweeper" told you how she encountered Dandelion and the bird-form Anomaly "The Fire Phoenix." She accidentally entered the legendary "Pawn Moonlight," where "any wish can be granted for a sufficient price," and toured the place accompanied by twin brothers and Dandelion.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110481_SumUp: "Bella" said her appearance came from Renee's wish to escape everything, and that everything began with Renee's selfish betrayal. You feel that something about Bella's words seems wrong, is she truly a shadow from the past?
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110467_SumUp: "Bella" said Renee brought a curse upon the family. She received their mother's favor yet betrayed her family, bringing death upon them. She invited Renee to play hide-and-seek again.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110187_SumUp: "Imaginadough" is in place and everything is ready. Now it all comes down to Taygedo.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110228_SumUp: A girl who had also performed at "StarSign" before bought a ticket to support your show.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110112_SumUp_S: During the investigation, a strange bird and a strange dog burst in one after another and carried off a censer. Even Edgar could not find any information on them.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110415_SumUp: A taxi driver named Renee came with a commission: every night at exactly nine o'clock on the dot, a cloaked, scythe-wielding Anomaly called the "Debt Collector" attacks her, yet she feels no pain at all. You, Nanally, and Daffodill accepted the commission and followed Renee to "Food First" to ask her meal companion Fuuka for details.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110103_SumUp: A cold-looking customer seemed distracted and unintentionally cut in front of you and Taygedo…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q1101711_SumUp_S: The group met up with Tako. Nanally and the others pretended to be subordinates to reinforce Taygedo's "boss" persona.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110005_1_SumUp_S: The three of you rode the elevator together. Mint likes to name people by the scents she smells from them, and she has decided to call you "Coco."
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110448_SumUp: Three o'clock has arrived. The salon ends, and the guests dispersed. It is time to look for Dolores.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110320_SumUp: You met up with Jiuyuan and headed to Settyn's signing event together.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110049_SumUp: You met Adler, Eibon's butler, and Taygedo, an Oddity restorer, and joined Eibon as the "Appraiser" to assist in appraising anomalous antiques.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110434_SumUp: Meanwhile, Nanally and Daffodill entered the old, modern-day residence of the Constantine family. The two decided to investigate deeper and reunite with the Appraiser and Renee as soon as possible.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110599_SumUp:
You spoke with Hotori. Thyme's condition is stable, but the other Dreamwalkers could not return. It turns out Thyme is not human, but an Object Anomaly called "Dimension Visitor" that took the form of a contract bearer.
Iroi sent a letter and a gift to comfort Nanally, and you passed them on to her.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110492_SumUp:
You spoke with Daffodill under the moonlight in the backyard. It turned out everything Renee saw was an illusion created by Zankou, and the earlier auction theft was also the work of The Scarlet Letter. These actions show that The Scarlet Letter's influence has already spread to Hethereau.
Daffodill told you that she was once a member of The Scarlet Letter as well, and her "Mother" is the leader of The Scarlet Letter—the person she should have ended with her own hands.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110301_SumUp: After exchanging good mornings with Adler, a sudden visitor named Jenson arrived with a request.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110186_SumUp: You discussed Taygedo's "Operation Love Confession" with Adler. Adler suggested that you not only help Taygedo avoid regrets, but also remember to pay close attention to Tako's feelings.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110009_SumUp: Selwyn and Byron, who adopted the neighborhood flower bed with Maiyue, told you about Maiyue's love of tending flowers. Following this lead, you decide to search the florist for clues.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110233_SumUp: Before you took the stage, Akane saw how nervous you were and encouraged you in her own way.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110253_SumUp: To help fill the gaps in your performance experience, Akane asked Kiyosawa to lend out equipment and arrange a street performance for you. She even joined in to practice.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110005_SumUp: To get the story straight, you confirmed a few details with Maiyue's parents, Zhengzhi and Zhongchun.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110103_SumUp: To line his pockets a bit, Taygedo accepted a bounty commission to nullify the "Tomato Devil"—an Anomaly dedicated to destroying ketchup vending machines. Naturally, he dragged you into it…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110122_SumUp: To enter Pawn Moonlight, you took turns making wishes at the location Kenneth described…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110048_SumUp_S: To cut off the Anomaly's interference, Baicang communicated in sign language so that only Maiyue could reply. After finally learning Maiyue's true feelings, Baicang activated his Incantation Esper Ability and sentenced every plant in the manor to wither, bringing "autumn" upon them.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110418_SumUp_S: At exactly nine, the Debt Collector appeared, and Fuuka seemed to have been expecting it. Renee was pierced by the Debt Collector's weapon but suffered no injury, and you stepped in to respond.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110446_SumUp: Before the Debt Collector appears at nine o'clock, do your best to understand the Anomaly's rules.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110223_SumUp: Perhaps moved by your passion, Akane gradually began offering serious guidance, and Kiyosawa made a suggestion: warm up for the livehouse's next show to confirm the results of your recent practice.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110465_SumUp: The two discovered a "registry" recording family members' names and countdown numbers: everyone's number is "0," except Renee's, which is "-20088." Daffodill realized what the number means: Renee has lived more than fifty years past her due date. That is why the Debt Collector appeared.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110438_1_SumUp: From the guests' conversations at the farewell salon, you learned the name "Bella." Renee says it sounds extremely familiar, confirming that she does have an unknown connection to the family. Since the name also appeared on the puppet's card, you might as well confirm it with the mysterious woman.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110201_SumUp: You got a brief introduction to StarSign from Haniel…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110014_SumUp: You learned that Maiyue did not visit the florist yesterday, even though he had never broken that habit before…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110253_SumUp_S: From first "playing along with kids" to actually becoming invested in it, the practice sessions have gradually changed Akane's mindset as well. Perhaps now THE WHOOTS!!!! really does have what it takes to perform at "Night of Moondog"…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110045_SumUp: Eibon appears to be struggling as a business, tucked away in a remote alley. Mint went back to fetch a gift, so you headed into the shop alone.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110401_SumUp: Eibon received a package of unknown origin—a mysterious puppet. At the same time, rumors circulating on Bagel that "citizens have been turned into puppets by an Anomaly" spread panic throughout Hethereau. Daffodill and you accompanied Hotori to the Bureau of Anomaly Control to assist with the investigation.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110115_SumUp: Eibon's companions were highly wary of Jiuyuan at "Sterry Express." After a negotiation with her, you obtained intel pointing to your next destination: the strange bird from the earlier disturbance and the stolen censer had both appeared in the manga Tales of Nil.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110105_SumUp: The vending machines near Eibon do not seem to show any signs of damage.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110537_SumUp: Iroi said she saw the teddy bear that morning, and everyone headed to the sighting location. You also wanted to investigate the "disappearances" Blackbird mentioned, so you asked Hotori to look into the case at the Bureau.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110073_SumUp: Everyone analyzed that the reason the furnishings had turned into photos was likely connected to the camera. Just as you were about to continue investigating this clue, the camera attacked.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110087_SumUp: Everyone returned to Eibon. With the "Appraiser" now among them, more business may come knocking in the future.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110361_SumUp: Everyone's time resumed and you decided to chase the robber who "bought" The First Branch.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110082_SumUp_S: Everyone arrived at the darkroom, where Anomaly R-5791, "Film - MANISH," appeared.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110063_SumUp: Just as everyone was getting bored out of their minds, a customer showed up. Hurry downstairs and take a look!
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110330_SumUp: Everyone confirmed that the invitation can be used and agreed to act at six tomorrow night.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110192_SumUp: Everyone was finally about to finish cleaning up when Eibon received a postcard from Tako—addressed to Adler. Amidst laughter, Taygedo's first love seemed to come to an end just like that…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110597_SumUp:
Everyone discussed Daffodill's true purpose but reached no conclusion. You felt there had to be more to it.
The Scarlet Letter has seized another Anomaly, and the "game" they mentioned seems about to begin.
With new intel in hand, Alphard has formed the next plan of action.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q1101761_SumUp: Taygedo needs you to help use the claw machine as his "subordinate."
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110117_SumUp: As a complimentary service, Jiuyuan kindly drove you to the residence of the author of Tales of Nil…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110309_SumUp: You met everyone from Sterry Express, and Jiuyuan explained the commission: Ebisu Auction House is rumored to be auctioning a high-threat Anomaly with precognitive abilities, and they need your help to verify whether it is real. To bring everyone along, Jenson enlisted a business partner with a "replication" Esper Ability to forge an extra invitation.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110023_SumUp: You confirmed Maiyue's speech disorder again with members of the Garden Club, though nothing about his school life seemed likely to be related to his disappearance…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110027_SumUp: You discovered that this commission had coincidentally overlapped with ETD-4's mission. Drawn in by the rumor, Maiyue went to the manor where it began, unfortunately triggering a situation that ETD had to resolve…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110596_SumUp: You returned to the pier, where Mint, Hotori, and everyone from Eibon were waiting for you.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110104_SumUp: You met that strange customer again outside the bookstore. Judging from the reactions of Taygedo and those around you, it seems that in everyone else's eyes, this young man appears as a middle-aged man… But this is Hethereau, after all. Something like this is nothing unusual.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110123_SumUp: You reassured Lacrimosa that you would bring her ketchup until the situation calms down.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110219_SumUp: You soon discovered that the overconfident Nanally couldn't even tell a guitar from a bass, but that didn't stop her and Haniel from moving each other to tears as they put their all into practice, striving to become Hethereau's future superstar bassist and guitarist.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110046_SumUp: You found the bouquet Maiyue brought home every week to express his feelings to his parents, and tried to use it to awaken him…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110108_SumUp: You arrived at "Eden Apartments," where Toshi lived before his disappearance.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110036_SumUp: You went over the intel gathered so far: This manor has been abandoned by its former owners, the Serenetti family, and the Anomaly's influence now covers the entire estate. Every overgrown plant here bears a fierce malice toward you…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110014_SumUp: You seem to have a keen ability to sense the "Nexus," which Mint greatly envies.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110053_SumUp_S: You joined Eibon and got introduced to everyone in the shop.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110227_SumUp: You searched hard for passersby who might be interested in the performance…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110214_SumUp: Your casual band project with Haniel sparked Nanally's intense interest, and she decided to join as well.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110126_SumUp: You and Taygedo agreed to continue the investigation tomorrow.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110259_SumUp: You and Nanally set out in secret, hiding it from everyone at Eibon…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110004_SumUp: In the elevator, you met Mint, a lively and warm member of Containment Unit 2.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110591_SumUp_S: You realize that Thyme, the creator of the Corridor of Echoes, is also escaping from something. You decide to break the rules and steer the Helm of Theseus, which normally navigates to the past, into the opposite direction. You will be the one to bring everyone—including Thyme—out of the Corridor.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110002_SumUp: You accepted the couple's missing-person commission concerning their son, Maiyue, who vanished after school.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110035_SumUp: You underwent an unsettling experience, as the scent of the flowers conveyed broken words and phrases to you…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110009_SumUp: You gained your freedom and no longer need to be monitored for the time being. Until "Code Zero" appears again, the Director has placed you with the civilian Anomaly Hunter team, "Eibon Antique Shop."
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110545_SumUp_S: You try to put Teehee Bear under control, but it manages to break free. Things don't look good. Something is happening to the bear.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110580_SumUp_S: You chase after Nana Tiger. Meanwhile, the Scarlet Letter's schemes keep advancing, catching you in utter surprise. Threatened by the Scarlet Letter, Daffodill enters the Corridor of Echoes with a certain goal in mind.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q1103891_SumUp_S: The Anomaly is defeated, and Arachne takes its final bow.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110384_SumUp: The Anomaly ahead awaiting containment is unknown. Suddenly, the space undergoes a dangerous change.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110544_SumUp: It turns out "Teehee Bear" followed you back to Eibon. Late at night, it lured Nanally into searching for Daffodill and brought her to the entrance of the Anomalous Realm where the disappearances have been frequent. The entrance's location was provided by a mysterious woman.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110191_SumUp: It turns out that if "Imaginadough" is shaped into a living creature, there is a risk it will start moving on its own. Despite the accident, Tako still really liked the gift.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110369_SumUp: It turns out the thief had set up the Anomaly "Picky," which can automatically pick locks, in advance. By exploiting a gap in timing and violating the security rules, they trapped all pursuers within the auction venue. First, you must interrupt Mr. Picky's work.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110458_SumUp: It turns out the puppets were the original forms of Dolores's children. Why was Renee the only one who survived? "Bella" says everything began with Renee, and her sins are recorded in the "registry" in the study.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110305_SumUp: It turned out that Jenson is the owner of the intel organization Sterry Express. He requires the Appraiser's ability to complete a commission related to an "auction." Hotori demanded to accompany you, and Jenson invited you both to his shop to discuss the details.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110078_SumUp: Only the photos in the darkroom are clear. From this, Adler analyzed that the Anomaly is related to film, and everyone headed to the basement to investigate further.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110130_SumUp: You woke Lacrimosa up to carry out the plan…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110119_SumUp: Due to an upset stomach, Kiroumaru coughed up Dandelion's collar, which it had accidentally eaten at the manga artist's home.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110117_1_SumUp: A young man named Boomboom was shut out by the manga artist "Cake Sweeper," who mistook him for an editor chasing a deadline. You learned from him that after his dog Dandelion went missing, it appeared in Tales of Nil. You also discovered that Dandelion was the "strange dog" that had appeared in Toshi's home.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110332_SumUp: You reported your progress to Hotori, who answered the doubts in your mind, though this commission may not be so simple.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110210_SumUp: After greeting a drowsy Akane, Haniel energetically burst into the livehouse full of moxie and ready to practice…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110202_SumUp: Haniel introduced you to her friend Akane and also Kiyosawa, the owner of StarSign. After the performance, you and Haniel decided to stay behind and help clean up to thank them for their hospitality.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110242_SumUp: Ignoring Akane's warnings, Haniel and Nanally prepared to find a way to resonate with the Anomaly to earn a high score in "Night of Moondog." Their smug, flippant attitude toward both music and Anomalies made Akane angry in a way you had rarely seen…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110246_SumUp: Without telling you or Akane, Haniel and Nanally took it upon themselves to challenge the Graffiti Anomaly "Bopp" with music…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110314_SumUp: Back at Eibon, after catching everyone up, Hotori told you to go with Jiuyuan tomorrow to make contact with Settyn.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110250_SumUp: After returning to her senses, Akane realized that she had overreacted. She asked you to comfort Haniel and Nanally, while some desire of her own seemed to awaken once more…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110489_SumUp_S: While your fierce battle with Zankou was underway, Chaos tore through space and appeared alongside Nanally and Daffodill, who had also broken through. As the nine o'clock bell rang, the Debt Collector arrived again. Before retreating, Zankou turned to Daffodill and softly delivered "Mother's" greeting.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110201_F_SumUp: At Haniel's invitation, you went to the StarSign to catch a performance.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110484_SumUp: On the final night, Renee wished to her mother that she could live forever and be together forever, so Dolores gave her the Anomaly that sustained her own immortality, "Eternal Present." "Bella" said the family would forgive Renee's betrayal, as long as Renee willingly gives up "Eternal Present."
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110255_SumUp: With Kiyosawa's assistance, Akane finally agreed to join the band before "Night of Moondog."
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110011_SumUp_S: Outside the florist, you ran into Captain Baicang, who was lying in wait disguised as… a flower?
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110039_SumUp: Accompanied by Mint, you arrived at the Bridge Crossings where "Eibon" is located.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110127_2_SumUp: Edgar and Taygedo left a message saying they had already met up with Sakiri. Your companions are probably not far away.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110172_SumUp: Taygedo introduced his "subordinates," and everyone decided to go on a date at the arcade.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110158_SumUp: Taygedo seemed very satisfied with the suit. Next, you need to prepare a gift.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110156_SumUp: Taygedo used his ability to make a suit himself.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110151_SumUp: On "Bagel," Taygedo lied to an online friend named "Tako," claiming that he was the boss of a massive underground group in Hethereau. With the two of them about to meet soon, you decided to help Taygedo by planning "Operation Love."
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110109_SumUp_S: At the third vending machine, Taygedo was scared out of his wits by a miniature coffin. A sleepy little bat emerged from it and transformed into a girl. Mint, who hurried over, told you the girl's name—Lacrimosa.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q1101611_SumUp: Taygedo showed interest in diamonds, and the staff said this one was shaped with the Anomaly toy "Imaginadough."
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110071_SumUp: Taygedo turned a pile of televisions into copies of himself. It turns out his ability lets him break down and reassemble objects he touches, though only within the range of his own cognition.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110189_SumUp_S: Taygedo shaped Imaginadough into a figure of himself and Tako holding hands as part of the performance, preparing to confess right after. But then Imaginadough suddenly went haywire and began to rampage. Adler saved Tako in time, and you prepared to respond.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q1101641_SumUp: Taygedo successfully used "Imaginadough" to shape a "diamond" gift. You asked Adler about the limits of Taygedo's ability, and learned Taygedo cannot create things he does not understand.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110137_SumUp: Taygedo's live stream greatly weakened the power of the "Tomato Devil" as a Meme Anomaly. Although it was not nullified this time, it likely will no longer have much impact. Skia arrived to take over the remaining cleanup, bringing the incident to a smooth close.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110188_SumUp: Taygedo said he prepared a very special gift for Tako.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110128_SumUp: Taygedo tried to make a post speaking up for Lacrimosa, but it had the opposite effect. Still, his antics gave you an idea… Perhaps live streaming Lacrimosa's battle against the "Tomato Devil" could shed light on the truth?
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110437_SumUp: The hall is crowded with guests. It seems you can communicate with these guests from the past, so start by talking to them and figuring out the situation.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110133_SumUp: After causing another commotion, the "Tomato Devil" once again tried to escape. Lacrimosa transformed into a bat and took Taygedo, still streaming, along in hot pursuit…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110550_SumUp_S:
The fog dispersed as you entered a bizarre sea, with a large procession being held by the shore.
You believe this is the Anomalous Realm Nanally got lost in. Having lost your phone signal, you find a mysterious woman looking at you…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110129_SumUp: The long-missing Toshi personally cleared up the misunderstanding. It turned out that Kenneth, who wanted to void his contract, kidnapped Toshi out of fear that the truth would come to light, and Otro and Mismo rescued him.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110402_SumUp: Nelly explained that this operation would be handled by ETD-6, which specializes in "Anomaly Crime," and that she will introduce you to the person in charge.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110135_SumUp: Otro and Mismo did not explain the Esper Ability that grants wishes, instead only explaining that the true owner of Pawn Moonlight is Dandelion, the Anomaly Morphix. They are about to leave Hethereau, and Pawn Moonlight will never appear again.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110105_SumUp: The client, Bianca, mistook Taygedo and the young staff's unreliable appearance as a sign that she was being slighted. Hotori was unhappy that the staff had not received the respect they deserved, but Bianca offered a reward Eibon could not refuse…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110217_SumUp: Nanally was ready to set out early, and prepared an outfit that made her look even more "rock"…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110520_SumUp: Nanally quickly signed an agreement with a strange teddy bear Anomaly. The "two" seemed to feel a sense of familiarity with each other. Since it was getting late, you set out for the return trip, satisfied.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110453_SumUp: Nanally and Daffodill arrived beneath the withered cherry tree.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110182_SumUp_S: Nanally and the others retreated in defeat, as the Security Office arrived to check on the situation. For the moment, everyone chose to "keep a low profile."
ST_DialogueSumUP.q1105992_SumUp:
Nanally remains unconscious, but she has recovered her memories with Boss Tiger.
You made a gentle promise—when Nanally wakes up, everyone at Eibon will go to the seaside together to watch the sunrise.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q1105313_SumUp: Nanally may have gone to the resort, or may have set out alone to look for Daffodill. You split into two groups: Adler, Sakiri, and Taygedo headed to the resort, while you and Edgar decided to seek help from Blackbird.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110166_SumUp: Nanally and Sakiri joined the plan, and everyone discussed staging a "heroic rescue."
ST_DialogueSumUP.q1101801_SumUp_S: Nanally and Sakiri disguised as villains, claiming they would deal with Taygedo, "the mastermind boss who lives in the city's shadows."
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110463_SumUp: Nanally and Daffodill discovered the Debt Collector hidden in the study. They need to figure out the rules it follows before nine o'clock.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110513_SumUp: Nanally cannot serve as a guarantor for an Anomaly because she is underage. After hearing that Lady Inanna is inspecting the resort, Nanally decided to prove her ability to her.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110531_SumUp: Nanally has gone missing, so everyone went to her room to check whether she left any messages.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110501_SumUp: Nanally was wrought with worry over Daffodill's situation. Taygedo gave her the family activity package for "Sunward Resort" that he had won, and you accompanied her on a vacation to lift her spirits.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110528_SumUp: Nanally worried that Daffodill would drift farther away from everyone, and felt guilty that she was not strong enough to protect her family, leaving her deeply dejected.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110515_SumUp: Nanally said the Anomalies here felt familiar to her and insisted on becoming a guarantor. Inanna proposed that she look for an Anomaly she "clicks with" and become its "remote guarantor."
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110550_nnl_01_SumUp:
Nana Tiger sleeps beneath the tree, as if this place brings her peace.
Beyond the portal lies Nanally's room. The girl still has something she must do alone, and bids you farewell.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110018_SumUp: The school guard refused to let you in because you were outsiders, but Baicang suggested searching for another path…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110371_SumUp: The avatar of the Security Anomaly "Nantanì" appeared. Within its domain, rules are absolute. For now, you must follow it, obey the rules, and recontain the breached Anomaly.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110007_SumUp: After finishing your questions, you prepared to head out and investigate. You learned that Maiyue has a speech disorder, so sign language may be required to communicate with him smoothly.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110483_SumUp: In the banquet hall, old memories reappeared. Unlike her other siblings, young Renee feared death, and Dolores was heartbroken by it. Renee wanted to see "Mother" again.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110425_SumUp_S: In the opulent hall, an eerie dinner party is underway. A mysterious woman lights the candles, and you and Renee seemed to be discovered by her. The banquet dispersed, and an Anomaly appeared.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110178_SumUp: You gave the plush and the limited-edition candy to Tako, who explained that her ability makes toys move by replenishing sugar. Everyone headed to the next date spot, "Azure Vista."
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110479_SumUp: Although it seems to match Renee's memories, you still feel that something about the "whole story" Bella explained does not quite add up…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110266_SumUp: Although you failed to win this "Night of Moondog," scoring 60 points on your debut still left you pleasantly surprised. You decided to keep pushing "THE WHOOTS!!!!" and the band's dream as far as you can…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110221_SumUp_S: Although they seemed a bit too big for their britches, there was no denying their passion for practice. The band was improving, bit by bit…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110052_SumUp: Although Maiyue completely lost his voice after the Anomaly was nullified, he was otherwise unharmed. Later, he made flower cards by hand to thank you… It seems sincere feelings can be conveyed even without words.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110007_SumUp: Director Alphard had you sign a contract, and you will join the containment operation for "Code Zero." As you pursue it, perhaps you may also uncover your own mysterious "past."
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110550_nnl_found_SumUp:
Within layer after layer of dreams, you learned about Nanally's past. Seeing that she was still lost, you gave Nanally the kaleidoscope and let her glimpse her own essence.
What sustains a family is not one-sided protection, but each other's "true hearts."
Nanally no longer doubts herself. Now, you must head home with her.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110231_SumUp: The highly eager Haniel and Nanally had already been waiting onstage for quite some time…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110035_2_SumUp: The plants inside the manor reacted on their own when you mentioned the dim light during your conversation.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q1101621_SumUp: The staff explained that "Imaginadough" can create any visual effect the user imagines, but cannot be used as an actual tool.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110016_SumUp: The shop staff apologized and said they did not remember every customer who came in to read, especially a quiet one like Maiyue.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110048_SumUp_S: No one seems to be in the shop. Getting the staff to come out may require… a special method?
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110506_SumUp: Iroi, a resort volunteer, welcomed you on arrival. With Fluffy accompanying you, you headed to the resort.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110312_SumUp: The Esper "Michael Pay" pushed himself to his limits to forge an invitation. However, the copy can only become valid after coming into contact with another genuine invitee's invitation, so Sterry chose a pop singer named Settyn as their target.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110510_SumUp: The Anomalies live leisurely and freely at the resort, and you decided to look around…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110027_SumUp: The Anomaly was successfully nullified, and Mint was assigned to take you to "Eibon Antique Shop." Alphard noticed your unusual sensitivity to Anomalies.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110420_SumUp: The Anomaly withdrew and left behind a card marked "Renee" and "-20088." You recognized it as identical to the cards in the "citizen puppetization" case and immediately contacted Chaos who rushed over. He decided to visit The Witch's House and ask Blackbird for help.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110115_SumUp_S: The Anomaly's disturbance had kept Lacrimosa from getting a proper intake of tomato jelly. Unable to resist the vending machine, she happened to run into the "Tomato Devil" as it appeared to destroy it. During their clash, the ketchup vending machine was accidentally caught up in their attacks…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110048_SumUp: Though Maiyue was severely hurt by being parasitized by the Anomaly, thankfully his life is not in danger. Before heading back to wrap things up, Baicang made plans with you to "have tea together sometime."
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110010_SumUp: After learning about your current commission, Captain Baicang joined the investigation as if you were already old friends. His knowledge of sign language might come in handy.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110535_SumUp: After learning that the teddy bear Nanally came into contact with is a dangerous Anomaly called "Teehee Bear," you worried that it may have done something to Nanally.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110127_1_SumUp: Following the hints Edgar left behind, you confirmed your earlier suspicion that Kenneth had lied and further discovered that he may also be connected to Toshi's disappearance…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110449_SumUp: Dolores said she would stop hosting meaningless salons and focus on spending time with her family, including her youngest daughter—Renee. After Dolores finished speaking, she vanished, and "Bella" appeared, hinting that Renee had forgotten her family after choosing eternal life, inviting Renee to "go see them."
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110440_SumUp: Dolores is surrounded by the crowd and difficult to approach.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110120_SumUp: The chef Kenneth came to commission Eibon to retrieve the sense of taste that Pawn Moonlight had taken from him without cause. From his vague explanation, you learned that the entrance to the pawnshop is somewhere on Green Wall Slope.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110392_SumUp: Ebisu tried to shift responsibility onto Sterry and Eibon, but through Jiuyuan and Hotori's maneuvering, you were able to leave unscathed.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110226_SumUp: Getting carried away with her fantasies, Haniel wanted to practice in secret without telling the others and then wow everyone at "Night of Moondog," so she insisted on keeping it under wraps. As for the tickets for the warm-up show, she planned to pitch them to strangers, thinking it'd actually be easier to gain die-hard fans that way…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q1103801_SumUp: You successfully contained "Outside the Inner Door." Two Anomalies remain to be contained.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110128_SumUp_S: For some reason, Sakiri ignored your warnings and attacked one of the twins, Otro, until the younger brother Mismo appeared with the long-missing Toshi and Dandelion…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110547_SumUp_S:
After defeating the transformed bear, you got separated from the group. In a thick fog, you board a mysterious ferry.
A thought suddenly intrudes into your head… "Everything new is but forgotten."
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110491_SumUp: You defeated the Debt Collector, and everyone was safe. Chaos revealed Zankou's true identity—a core member of the criminal organization "The Scarlet Letter"—and asked Daffodill, who knows about The Scarlet Letter, to visit the Bureau tomorrow morning.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110550_dfdil_02_SumUp: The kind-hearted girl in the room said she could help you find the pink tiger.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110349_SumUp: The auction began. Out of spite, Hotori kept raising the price and won the first item: the "Narcissus Chain."
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110107_SumUp: Three Anomaly Hunters near the damaged vending machine told you that the "Tomato Devil" probably is not an Anomaly, but may actually be an ETD member. Regardless, you decided to keep investigating…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110021_SumUp: The students you met on the playground didn't know much about the introverted Maiyue either, but they at least told you that he belonged to the Garden Club.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110390_SumUp: With containment completed, the protective rules are lifted. The robber has probably already escaped, so recovering the auction item will require another plan.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110084_SumUp_S: The containment succeeded. As the newest member, you took a cheerful family photo with everyone.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110432_SumUp: The banquet just now seemed to be a reenactment of the past. Renee says she felt an inexplicable familiarity. As the one o'clock bell rings, you decided to check the entrance hall.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110127_4_SumUp: Sakiri seems to have clashed with one of the twins, Otro, over a transaction to grant a wish…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110264_SumUp: Akane reunited with Aurelia, her former bandmate from "LINES," and the knot in her heart was finally untied.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110213_SumUp: The fact that Akane hadn't listened to your performance at all only discouraged Haniel for a brief moment. Soon, her passion reignited, and she began thinking about tomorrow's practice.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110185_SumUp: You arrived at "Azure Vista," and Taygedo and Tako decided to look around.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110101_SumUp: When you arrived at Eibon, Adler asked Taygedo to buy the latest issue of Anomalies Guide from Moby-Dick Bookstore. At Adler's suggestion, you decided to go out with Taygedo and familiarize yourself with the area.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110085_SumUp: Kodak was very grateful and promised to take photos for you forever free of charge. The commission was completed successfully.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110503_SumUp: You checked tickets and waited for the boat. This event seems extremely popular and is sponsored by the famous philanthropist Lady Inanna.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110457_SumUp_S: Beneath the cherry tree, a joyful scene of family reunion from the past reappeared. "Bella" revealed the secret hidden behind it: in response to Dolores's wish, the puppets awakened as her "children," but her wish was never fully fulfilled. Her youngest daughter, Renee, brought a curse and destruction upon the family.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110056_SumUp: You officially became a member of Eibon. From now on, this will be your room.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110237_SumUp: The performance as a proper band put pressure on Haniel and Nanally. Then you saw Aurelia, the girl who had bought a ticket from you earlier. After telling her that you truly were enjoying the performance, she offered her sincere blessing.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110019_SumUp: The Oddity grows stronger as you close in on the "Nexus."
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110110_SumUp: Bianca met up with you in Toshi's room. Her apology finally eased the lingering hostility between you, and you began searching for clues…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110380_SumUp: The flowing water symbolizes the writer's maddened consciousness, whereas the lumps are the remnants of reason. Use them to shut off the source of the water—the "door."
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110353_SumUp: Hotori also took an interest in the second item, "Glittering Gold."
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110394_SumUp:
Hotori avoided your many questions, but told you that you could work with Sterry's people in the future.
However, this incident seems to conceal a deeper conspiracy—the true intentions of Ebisu Auction House remain unclear, and the motive of the mysterious girl who stole the item is still unknown… More mysteries have begun to surface.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110540_SumUp: Hotori said the recent missing persons had all suffered setbacks. Although they return on their own after a while, their personalities change drastically. For now, the Anomalous Realm's entrance is presumed to be random, and its location has not been identified. At present, the case does not appear connected to "Teehee Bear."
ST_DialogueSumUP.q1103501_SumUp: Hotori bought the collectible for a hundred million. Jenson is really going to feel that one.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110405_SumUp: Hotori was called to a private meeting with Alphard, while you and Daffodill followed Nelly to the temporary containment floor.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110240_SumUp: Aurelia's support meant a great deal to Haniel and Nanally. They began choosing songs for "Night of Moondog" right away, and also kept trying to recruit Akane as the fourth member of your band, which finally was named "THE WHOOTS!!!!"
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110235_SumUp: The unexpected mishaps during the performance did not dampen your optimism after your debut. Still, you noticed that Akane seemed to be deliberately avoiding topics like guitar technique and her band experience…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110235_SumUp_S: Your performance was finding its groove, but when the audience gathered below the stage, Haniel's nerves caused her to make a mistake. Fortunately, Akane stepped in just in time to help you complete the show.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110065_SumUp: The photo studio owner urgently commissioned Eibon to resolve the Anomaly in his shop tonight.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110136_SumUp: The cunning Kenneth will soon receive the punishment he deserves. While you discussed the unsolved mysteries surrounding Otro and Mismo, Boomboom finally reunited with his beloved dog and prepared to head home on the other side of the city.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110113_SumUp: The mysterious creatures and the censer, both suspected to be Anomalies, are clearly important clues. Nanally proposed looking for "Sterry Express," which quietly deals in intel, but their price is not cheap…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110022_SumUp: Baicang brought up club activities, so you took the chance to ask why he had learned sign language.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110423_SumUp: The destination held only a withered cherry tree. Beneath it, Renee recalled a memory of falling from the tree in her childhood—and then everyone was drawn into an Anomalous Realm.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110262_SumUp: Just before taking the stage, Akane realized that through her time with you all, she had quietly overcome the barrier in her heart and was ready to give her all onstage once more…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110206_SumUp: Seeing Haniel so fired up, Kiyosawa decided to let you to use the livehouse for practice before business hours every day. Haniel gave you no choice to refuse and you promised to meet up tomorrow.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110249_SumUp: The reckless actions taken seemed to stir memories of Akane's past, and she rebuked the two with unusual severity.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110550_dfdil_26_SumUp: Eyes filled the sky, serving as the airtight surveillance of "Mother." The girl was filled with intense hatred. Though she had killed "Mother" with her own hands, "Mother" had not truly died. The girl said that this time, she would stop her actions for certain.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110526_SumUp: At the pier, you unexpectedly ran into Daffodill. She adopted a distant, hostile stance and left with Poinsette, a member of The Scarlet Letter.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110327_SumUp_S: After confirming that the target has an invitation, Hathor appears and drives you speedily towards Settyn. Maintain proximity long enough to complete the invitation swap.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110168_SumUp: Confirm the plan and prepare to set out, Tayge!
ST_DialogueSumUP.q1103541_SumUp: The mysterious Target Anomaly, "The First Branch," appeared. Even though you could not see what was inside the container, you had already sensed intense Anomaly fluctuations, and Jenson decided to secure the item in one bid.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110363_SumUp: The spatial-loop security Anomaly was triggered, and Jiuyuan inferred that the cause was not the auction itself, but due to the collection room being tampered with.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110441_SumUp: Wait until the salon ends at three, then try again.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110325_SumUp: The signing event has already ended, and Jiuyuan's heads towards the exit.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110134_SumUp_S: Daffodill arrived just in time with Boomboom in tow…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110131_SumUp: At last, the "Tomato Devil" appeared. Fully prepared, Taygedo streamed the face-off between Lacrimosa and the anomaly, which sparked a heated debate in the live chat…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110413_SumUp: After your appraisal, you confirmed the puppets were not transformed humans. The true Anomaly-related clue lay in the black cards hidden in their pockets: each bore a name and the number "0."
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110108_SumUp: After encountering Mint, you learned that she and Lacrimosa from ETD-4 also came to investigate the "Tomato Devil" incident, but may be more going on behind the scenes…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110493_SumUp: Renee visited the next day and thanked you in person. Having lost "Eternal Present," she finally rediscovered the meaning of being "alive." To honor this hard-won new life, she decided to travel around the world, and came to say goodbye to everyone.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110028_SumUp: Skia and Baicang had a minor disagreement over how to proceed after entering the manor, but Skia ultimately accepted Baicang's claim that he would "actively test the nature of the Anomaly."
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110264_SumUp_S: Onstage, Akane put her all into a performance for the first time in ages, and the aurora-like vision under the starry sky represented "Night of Moondog"'s recognition of you.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110129_SumUp_S: Another complication arose: Kiroumaru suddenly spat out Dandelion's collar, which it had somehow secretly re-swallowed. This caused Dandelion to mistakenly believe its owner Boomboom had been eaten…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110590_SumUp:
Thyme appeared and stood in your way. She allows you to take only Nanally's copy away, claiming that people can live happily in reality by casting off escape and obsession. In exchange, their true selves must remain in the Corridor of Echoes, drowning in the past.
Thyme is the creator of the Corridor of Echoes and the culprit behind the disappearances. You do not agree with her ideals, but you realize she, too, seems to be running from something. Perhaps you can persuade her?
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110593_SumUp_S: Surprisingly, Thyme's projection is nullified by Daffodill. Thyme is stricken in pain. As the Dreamwalkers disperse, Nanally's body slowly becomes transparent. Amidst the chaos, members of the Scarlet Letter appear and snatch away the Helm of Theseus.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110360_SumUp_S: The instant the gavel fell, the scene suddenly froze. In the frozen time, a mysterious girl appeared, acquired the item with a single Fons, and swiftly vanished. Only your time resumed before the others, and you realized something had gone wrong.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110439_SumUp: Renee remembered that she is Dolores's child. "Bella" says all the answers lie dormant in Renee's heart. To unravel the mystery, first confirm things with Dolores.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110400_1_SumUp:
Renee regained the feeling of being "alive." To live… it is truly a happy thing. Renee decided to embrace life as a "human" and accept her end with peace.
"Thank you for giving me life, Mother."
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110485_SumUp_S: Renee became convinced that she was the betrayer, that she had caused her family's deaths. Under the crushing weight of it, she broke down and gave up "Eternal Present," which was stolen by "Zankou."
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110451_SumUp: Looking at the blooming cherry tree, Renee remembered trying to break off flowers for her sister and falling, but the memory abruptly cut off.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110042_SumUp: Mint introduced you to the Wertheimer Towers, facilities installed by The Circle, a global Anomaly-monitoring organization, to detect fluctuations in the Wertheimer Index.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110051_SumUp_S: Mint accidentally triggered the "Hospitable House," shrinking everyone. In Taygedo's eyes, the group looked like three cockroaches… Hold out under the insecticide until you return to normal!
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110009_SumUp_S: An Anomaly contained by Mint unexpectedly breached containment, and you entered the Anomalous Realm with Mint to contain it again.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110125_SumUp: After being transported to a secret room, Nanally remained full of confidence…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110040_SumUp: Maiyue has been trapped and parasitized by plants catalyzed by the Anomaly, and he resists your rescue through a haze of consciousness.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110204_SumUp: Caught up in the atmosphere of the performance, an excited Haniel couldn't resist slipping onto the stage. The owner Kiyosawa generously calmed Akane, who was eager to get off work, and also let you experience performing onstage…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110012_SumUp: To defeat the Surge Bio Anomaly, called an "Oddity," you must find the "Nexus" within the Anomalous Realm.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110127_SumUp: Many anomalous collectibles that gradually lost effect after fulfilling their contracts were piled throughout the pawnshop's rooms. The censer from Toshi's home, still carrying traces of an Anomaly, now seems deeply suspicious. In addition, the pawn tickets attached to the collectibles confirms that the chef Kenneth was not being honest.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110121_SumUp: Many people recognized Lacrimosa and gathered around, with some impulsive citizens even stepping forward to question her…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q1101541_SumUp: You asked the staff if they have a suit Taygedo can wear.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110106_SumUp: Bianca, PR manager for the luxury brand "Landric," asked Eibon to find the missing genius perfumer Toshi. Delighted, Hotori accepted the commission on the spot and assigned the task to you.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110425_SumUp: In the Anomalous Realm, you were separated from Daffodill and Nanally. This place seems to be the grand manor of the old Constantine family. Renee said it felt inexplicably familiar, perhaps investigating deeper will awaken more of her memories?
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110444_SumUp: Daffodill suspects the Anomaly's rules may be related to clocks or time, so perhaps you should pay close attention.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110594_SumUp:
Daffodill nullified Thyme's projection, and Inanna was revealed to be The Scarlet Letter's "Mother." She took the Anomaly that powers the rules of the past, the "Helm of Theseus." From the very beginning, you had stepped into The Scarlet Letter's conspiracy.
The space began to distort, and the Dreamwalkers gradually disappeared. Through Nanally's own will and your efforts, half of her soul was preserved, and she fell into slumber.
As the Corridor of Echoes collapsed, you escaped the space with Nanally and Thyme thanks to Twisty's help.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110463_5_SumUp: Daffodill said that the "Garden" where she once lived was somewhat similar to the Constantine family. But unlike Dolores, the "Mother" of the "Garden" did not see them as true children.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110422_SumUp: You returned to Eibon to rest. After a long day's investigation, there were more questions than answers. The next day, a forged card was found in Renee's mailbox, with the address of the former Constantine residence. Chaos surmised that Fuuka and the mastermind who sent the puppet to Eibon are part of the same group, and they are inviting Renee to go to that family mansion of her own accord.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110386_SumUp: There is one last Anomaly awaiting containment.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110260_SumUp: This will be the 99th edition of "Night of Moondog," featuring many powerful, well-known bands. It seems to be a worthwhile challenge for your group.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110139_SumUp: After the uproar, public opinion finally shifted but quickly fizzled out. For Lacrimosa, in an environment that gave this Meme Anomaly such fertile ground to grow, resolving the incident by "clearing up the misunderstanding" was undoubtedly the best possible outcome.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110553_SumUp: You entered a strange Anomalous Realm, and the mysterious woman Thyme called this place the "Corridor of Echoes." Nanally has become a "Dreamwalker." You recognized that the pink tiger plush is Nanally and immediately chased after it.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110346_SumUp: You entered the auction venue. As a precaution, Hathor and the other two have already blended in.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110123_SumUp: After entering Pawn Moonlight, your entry positions seemed to be random. You and Nanally, who entered a step later as well, immediately began searching for your companions scattered throughout the pawnshop.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110388_SumUp_S: You entered the Splendid Banquet Hall. Among the many dancing Anomalies, the mysterious and elegant Class V Anomaly "The Never-ending Arachne" appeared. Let the dance begin.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110015_SumUp: After spotting Skia, ETD-4's lieutenant, from a distance, Baicang hurriedly slipped away. You learned from Skia that Baicang was supposed to be preparing for work and was secretly slacking off.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110053_SumUp: After seeing Mint off, Adler showed you to your residence at Eibon.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110155_SumUp: High-end custom services for Oddities are expensive, but Taygedo seemed to have another idea.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110183_SumUp: After avoiding the crowd and returning to the planned route, Tako sighed that it had all been incredibly thrilling.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110174_SumUp: You bought limited-edition candy for Tako to support Taygedo's performance.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110017_SumUp: After regrouping with you, Baicang confidently defended himself.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110059_SumUp: Adler prepared a personal phone for you. Nanally and the others are on the second floor; you might as well go talk to them.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110125_SumUp: Adler went over how to deal with the "Tomato Devil" with you.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110365_SumUp: You'll need to obtain a "pass" from a staff member.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110046_SumUp_S: Facing the Anomaly as it used Maiyue's last remaining voice to refute you, Baicang stepped forward and verbally provoked it. Are Maiyue's true feelings really aligned with the malice shown by the manor?
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110221_SumUp: Following a poster that appeared out of nowhere in the livehouse, Akane recalled the legendary music festival—the Location Anomaly "Night of Moondog." Unexpectedly, Nanally and Haniel immediately began fantasizing about challenging the festival, and Kiyosawa's encouragement only set their fighting spirit ablaze…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110416_SumUp: Fuuka explained that the "cloaked person" who appears at nine every night seems visible only to Renee. She suspected an Anomaly was at work and had Renee commission Eibon. Fuuka said Daffodill had once resolved an Anomaly for her mother, but Daffodill said she had no recollection. Everyone headed to the parking lot to wait for nine o'clock.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110008_SumUp: Maiyue's neighbor Weihua spoke at length about how close-knit Maiyue's family is and how sensible Maiyue has always been, but there was not much info that could move the investigation forward…
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110025_SumUp: Maiyue seems to have heard a rumor the day before about a peculiar flower that can convey feelings across the barrier of language.
ST_DialogueSumUP.L110004_SumUp: Maiyue's father, Zhengzhi, is waiting anxiously outside their home…
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110421_SumUp: Blackbird performed a divination for Renee, and the result was a complete "blank," identical to Dolores, the Constantine family head from many years ago. Blackbird concluded that the Debt Collector is a Rule Anomaly, and the key to nullifying it lies in deciphering the rules it follows.
ST_DialogueSumUP.q110533_SumUp: Blackbird's divination reminded you of Sunward Island. Adler informed you the staff had not seen Nanally, nor could they find any information on "remote guarantor." In addition, Blackbird warned you that disappearances have been frequent lately, so you must be careful.

ST_File.F_NPC024_011:
The core strikeforce of ETD-6, the one who gets things done, the blade that swings at every anomaly crime.
"Can I really say that? Isn't that exaggerating a bit?"
"It's cooler than 'Your friendly ETD-6 member' for sure."

Most people's first impression of Chaos is "that weirdo with the mask." At first, they find Chaos unapproachable, but as long as they spend some time with him, they'd realize that he's joyful, cheerful, and easy-going. The moment you start talking to him, the conversation flows like a tide, until he catches himself talking too much, or the listener becomes impatient, or a new mission notification rings.
In combat, however, he transforms into a battle junkie. His willpower is as strong as iron; he never runs out of stamina, and he refuses to let go of his targets. Sometimes, he's so eager to catch a criminal, that he ignores everything else, such as the Bureau's rules and regulations. If you ask him about the rules, he'll likely admit that he's never figured out the Bureau's red tape or hierarchies. In fact, sometimes, he even forgets he works for the Bureau. Fortunately, he works for one of the most flexible units in the organization.
His teammates in Unit 6 don't mind his quirks. It helps that their all-capable captain can always handle the fallout, so Chaos's habit of ignoring processes has arguably improved the team's performance. The captain, who handles cleanups personally, has made no comment on the matter.

Chaos's Esper ability is summoning a mass of smoke that can be shaped into solid forms. The amount of smoke isn't fixed, but it never drops below a certain level. Chaos believes the output of his smoke corresponds to the past crimes of those around him, as he'd always generated more smoke in places with a criminal history. Still, that's only his theory. The actual mechanism remains unknown.
"Is that how my powers work?"
"Hey, why would you think I know your powers better than you?"

ST_File.F_NPC030_014:
From Dream Isle was a free text adventure released on PC by an anonymous solo developer. Nearly all traces of its origins and related information have been lost amid the internet's rapid evolution. What is known is that it was made roughly 20 years ago, though its exact release date is impossible to determine.
There is no shortage of fragmentary information about the game, though some of it may be fabricated. Today, no one can find a copy of a game that matches its description. In other words, no one can prove they've actually played it; only a few preserved screenshots and text fragments have made their way online.
Its description alone evoked a gentle, faraway atmosphere. And with the game itself lost to the ever-changing internet, that atmosphere has taken on a wistful, almost dreamlike quality… It remains a topic of discussion among retro game enthusiasts.

The game has only one character: an elf girl who lives alone on a tiny, isolated island. Her eyes glow like a bioluminescent sea, her hair is soft as clouds, and a big blue bow adorns her head. Though her life seems nearly endless, she retains an innocence and curiosity untouched by time.
The gameplay is just as unusual. You collect bottles washed up on the beach and read the messages inside. Using the choices and keywords you collect, you can write your own letters with considerable freedom, then send them out to sea in bottles and leave their delivery to chance. Years, or even decades, later, a reply arrives, revealing how the world has changed. This cycle continues for a thousand years, until the story reaches its ending.
The island's seasonal backdrops and the girl's character portrait barely change throughout the game. The art is sparse, but the sheer volume of text is staggering. The creator's intent was to show the outside world's development over long stretches of time solely through the messages in the bottles, while the girl, removed from the rest of humanity, imagined and judged the world she learned about in fragments with childlike wonder. The result was a sprawling, branching visual novel meant to be read at a leisurely pace.
The most fascinating part is that every letter sent out has a chance to set off a "butterfly effect," with each effect influencing the others and dramatically changing the story's course. A single word choice in a letter might end a war years earlier, for instance, while a different turn of phrase might delay a technological revolution by decades. Those changes then affect every letter received after that point, leaving the version of the "outside world" the girl reads about in bottles a thousand years later open to infinite possibilities…

In some endings, the girl continues to live on the island as always, but the world falls silent. Perhaps no one uses such a primitive means of communication as message bottles anymore. Perhaps the world has been destroyed. Either way, no new replies ever come. The girl becomes a "mystery."
In some endings, the girl never leaves, but one of her pen pals somehow finds the island and visits, bringing a whole box of wondrous things from the outside world and sharing in her joy. The visitor brings the world's fascinating variety to the little island. The girl remains an "elf."
In some endings, the girl accepts a pen pal's invitation and finally decides to leave the island, set sail, and meet them. At last, she forms a real connection with the vast world she had spent so long gazing at and imagining from afar, in a more direct and intimate way. The girl joins "humanity."
There's also a rumor—supposedly made up offhand by some internet user—about one of the game's hidden endings. Since it feels entirely unlike any of the endings above, it's considered extremely unlikely to be real:
A chain of butterfly effects leads to a sudden catastrophe. The girl and her island sink beneath the sea, and what happens after that is unknown. The ripples and bubbles left behind as she sinks, like her final message, set off one last butterfly effect… In a mysterious sea, a tremendous storm quietly begins to gather around that point. You could say it only stirs the air. But because it is air, it can travel, reach, fill, and sweep across the entire world.
The girl gave rise to a "monster."

ST_File.F_NPC022_016:
"…There's a rabbit in the corner of the backyard."
"I fed it some cabbage leaves. It ate them all, and it didn't bite me…"
Zankou listened to Daffodill speak, smiling, while her thoughts strangled her heart.
She didn't understand what was so appealing about a rabbit—it was just a gray vermin with red eyes. Nor did she understand how a mere rabbit could make her sister look that… happy.
But for the next few months, whenever it was time to go to the backyard for punishment, Daffodill would sneak glances at that rabbit, and Zankou would watch her. Even while enduring such unimaginable pain, her sister's gaze would soften considerably, directed towards that one corner of the garden. Sometimes, Zankou considered that, perhaps, such a gentle look was not something Mother would allow to appear in her eyes.
One day, Daffodill found only the rabbit's corpse in that familiar corner. She remained silent for the rest of the day. Before night had even fallen, she locked herself in her room.
Zankou knocked for a long while before the door finally opened. Her sister's hollow gaze hung low over the floor, her soul flickering wildly. Zankou caught a trace of bitterness in her sister's expression, something she had never seen before.
She tentatively reached out and slowly drew her sister closer. She felt Daffodill hesitate for a moment, then, as if shedding all her burdens at once, leaned her face against her shoulder without resistance. When their warmth met, Zankou sighed. Deep down, she was relieved that the rabbit had died.
"She might, perhaps, suspect that I was the one who did it."
On many nights after her sister fled, Zankou often thought of that dead rabbit.
But Daffodill never brought the matter up again.
Zankou never felt regret. She knew that the end of their road could only end in one way: death. When either one of them reached their final moments, using their final breath as a farewell might not… be so bad.
"Sister, I really didn't kill that rabbit."

ST_File.F_NPC010_012:
"Mr. Adler, are you cleaning the storage room again?"
"Yes."
As the young man holding cleaning supplies stepped aside, the neatly dressed maid quietly thanked him, kindly reminding him to watch his steps, then hurried off. This estate housed too many people like him, so even this small act of kindness felt precious. The blind young man stood quietly at the storage room entrance until the maid's footsteps faded, then entered the room, feeling his way around while wiping dust with a soft cloth. The other servants disliked cleaning here since it was such tedious work, but Adler didn't mind. Cleaning was actually quite easy work for him—no need to talk to anyone, and the quiet environment made him feel especially relaxed. Though his blindness meant he often needed more time, fortunately this storage room didn't contain anything too fragile, so he just needed to be careful. Adler treasured this hard-won job.
The artifacts silently watched the busy young man. He didn't favor any particular piece, cleaning each one thoroughly, but whenever he wiped down that suit of armor hanging high above, he would always clean it with extra care. Adler had heard stories about this armor. It was called "Enlightenment,"and people told tales of the armor, with its great power and invincible previous owners. Those stories burned in his thin chest. Perhaps he too might someday… Whenever he thought this, Adler would calmly polish each scale even cleaner.
The peaceful days continued until one snowy night, when the long-silent armor began glowing softly. Deer-like creatures called "Sunyas" emerged from Enlightenment, treading on falling snowflakes as they gathered around the sleeping young man.
"New… master?"
"I like him!"
"Familiar scent."
"…Mhm."
"In this old one's opinion…"
Their chatter didn't wake the sleeping person; they wanted to let his dream last a little longer—they would tell the young man about the good news when the snow cleared and the sun shone bright the next day.
ST_File.F_NPC028_011:
"Iroi called in sick again? Her paid time off and sick days ran out ages ago. Feels like her paycheck's been getting docked."
"She doesn't seem to care about her paycheck… She once said she wouldn't mind paying to work. It didn't sound like she was joking about it."
"That's so nice. She works pretty hard. I didn't know she was just working to experience the world…"

Iroi has been prone to sickness since childhood. She couldn't attend regular schools. Luckily, her family was well-off, so she had a private tutor all the time, and she became as educated as someone who has done general university coursework.
After finishing her studies, her parents wanted her to integrate into society, but her health couldn't handle the demands of a regular job. Iroi wanted to work at a social welfare organization, so her parents sent her to the Sunward, an anomaly charity house, to volunteer, where she also helped with the simpler anomaly intake work.
Iroi's current personality is deeply shaped by the vibes of the charity house. Before going there, she hadn't had much contact with others. Her tutor and butler were cold and rigid, always overly cautious, while her parents doted on her too much. Iroi understood that not all human beings were like them, so she instinctively chose to blend in with "everyone else."
Life on the island wasn't exactly smooth sailing. Things were a lot tougher than they were back home. Nevertheless, Iroi enjoyed that kind of environment much more, because she felt more alive.
During the Teehee Bear incident at the charity house, Iroi the volunteer provided significant help to the Bureau, and the Bureau staff took notice of this talented Esper. At the same time, Iroi found herself drawn to the Bureau's work. They came to an agreement and Iroi joined the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Given her strong control over her powers, she was recommended to join CSU-2.
Life has a way of moving on.

ST_File.F_NPC024_015:
"You will die with infamy."
Chaos found himself on the receiving end of such foretelling. When they were still building the Boulder, a mysterious old person stopped him suddenly and left him with these words.
Somehow, Chaos never forgot them. At times, he would tell himself that unfounded words aren't worth dwelling on, but whenever a mission goes wrong, the words would come back to haunt him. Every omen from that island has come true. Even in doubt of his own fate, he brought countless wrongdoers to justice.
That doesn't mean he pursues justice to defy the omens. He's had a passion for fighting evil and upholding good since he was young. The fortelling simply stirred a hidden, rebellious streak in him, making him more driven, until he became the relentless force against evil he is today.
ST_File.NPC004_chat_003: Duke K is strong… Duke K also breaks things and gets scolded by others… just like Lacrimosa.
ST_File.F_NPC005_013:
"It's like being a frog slowly boiled alive…"
While drinking, the man on his left complained to the bartender about his predicament. The man was troubled, trapped in a state where every fiber of his being couldn't relax due to workplace pressure. If he wanted to escape, he'd inevitably face brutal consequences. The man was deeply conflicted about this.

ST_File.F_NPC026_012:
"The outside world is dangerous." Chiz learned this when she was very young, back when food at home wouldn't just appear on the table. Sometimes, her older siblings would go out and never come back. And then Chiz reached the same age. It was her turn to go outside.
The number of wounds on her body grew faster than her height. The first wound was on her left arm, left by a branch that caught at her while she tried to flee an Anomaly. The second was on her right foot; she stepped in a trap while bumbling down the wrong path through the woods. The third was on her left thigh, where an Apocha bit her before becoming their family's dinner… Some wounds healed and disappeared. Others became scars. The last wound her homeland gave her was on her neck: a scar that remained deep even after healing. In the end, just like her siblings, Chiz went out and never came back.
Chiz boarded a ship headed who knows where; their routes were never fixed, after all. Chiz was unlucky: She became an Esper. But she was lucky enough to find a ship leaving the very next day. All of her mother's love became a thin stack of money pressed into the kind captain's hands. Leave, leave. Staying here will only bring more pain. Chiz began living on the ship with others from her homeland. Some were Espers like her. Others were ordinary people who could no longer bear the strain of staying. But they never really connected, even in such close proximity. One day, two days, three days… One month, two months… Then she lost count. People got on. People got off. The kind captain brought her to a clean, safe city. Chiz was almost landsick.
Chiz arrived at her new home. Here, there were lovely clothes, a warm bed. Delicious food appeared, almost magically, on the table. She sat quietly in a corner, eavesdropping, and learned this was the Dvořák family's orphanage. Chiz loved Dvořák. She loved the orphanage. She made new friends here, and every day they wore the same clothes and ate the same food.
"Why don't you wash your hands?" a friend asked Chiz one evening after dinner. "You should stay clean. You'll trouble the caretakers."
Chiz hid her sauce-stained hands behind her back in alarm. She finally realized that even wearing the same clothes and eating the same food, they were still different. She was a little mouse that had drifted for so long before being washed ashore here. "Mice are the dirtiest of all!" said the picture books. Of course, her friend was kind. She led Chiz to the bathroom and helped wash the sauce off her hands. Chiz was very grateful.
"You have to wash your hands. If you don't, people won't like you."
Chiz was smart. She remembered this. From then on, she washed her hands spotlessly clean every day. Three rounds of soap. No slacking. Clean between the fingers and under the nails. Wash before bed, wash after waking up, wash before meals, wash after meals, wash before playing with toys, wash after playing with toys… As time went on, just like those old wounds, Chiz's hands became wrapped in bandages. The caretakers cautioned her that she couldn't wash her hands so often. Her friends were worried too, gently blowing on her hands and asking if it hurt. Chiz smiled at all of them. "It doesn't hurt," she promised, saying she'll remember.
Much more time passed. Even after all the wounds on her hands had healed, Chiz still kept the habit of wearing bandages.
