ST_Item.Yahaha_Mu_Lamp01_LevelUnderGround_desc: A burnt handmade hair clip. It's stained with permanent scorch marks, barely retaining its original form.
ST_Item.Visions_furniture_14_UpMaterial_desc: Once, twice, even ten thousand times, until the fuel rushing through its veins is finally burned away.
ST_Item.Universal_stickers_1057_desc: A lone refrain that rings in the past, present, and future.
ST_Item.MemoryBread_desc: A slice of bread packed with… volleyball moves? Eat it to boost your talent. Just… don't eat too much, okay?
ST_Item.food_068_desc: A million vanilla seeds trapped in cream clouds—let your lips melt this soft sweetness!
ST_Item.Common_material_02_desc: A substance with highly unstable special properties. You never know what it will become the next time you view it.
ST_Item.Actbond_exp_desc: Let's give it our all, partner!
ST_Item.Prison_goodlunch_desc: A hearty lunch so delicious it makes you want to lick the plate clean. If you can get on the cook's good side- I mean really good side, enough for her to see you as her own troublemaking kid- you might just score a special meal like this.
ST_Item.Coupon_009_desc: 7-Oceans Seafood is giving back to new and returning customers on Hankaku Street, welcome to shop with us!
ST_Item.Businesscard_MBCollect_01_desc: Got one! This one's gonna be big!
ST_Item.Title_RacingRank_004_desc: A racer who can't even make tofu isn't cut out for the track.
ST_Item.Universal_avatar1_1070_desc: A star that doesn't shine — such a pity.
ST_Item.Prison_Spoon_desc: Many inmates firmly believe that "he who holds the spoon holds freedom." Because of this, cafeteria spoons vanish constantly, at a rate rivaling that of doctors' blue pens. Obviously, the number of successful spoon-based escapes is next to none. One might reasonably suspect that allowing inmates to keep spoons is actually a deliberate strategy by the guards to drain their enthusiasm for escape attempts.
ST_Item.Prison_Dart_desc: A dart stuck between the pages for a mysterious reason—perhaps left by some previous inmate. It somehow slipped past the guard's inspection.
ST_Item.zhanbu_oraclestone_desc:
Gems, carried by blind, lost ravens that are unable to land, their origins unknown to all.
Rumors say that those who pick up Oracle Stones will be struck by misfortune… Though, don't worry if you happen to find one; the mysterious lady from the Witch's House can dispel your misfortune.
ST_Item.RobBankItem_G025_desc: A vault pass of unknown origin. Want direct access to the vault? Take it with you.
ST_Item.Frame_Bidking_001_des: When fate offers a choice, do not let it slip from your grasp.
ST_Item.Universal_avatar1_1042_desc: You don't need a divination from Blackbird to guess this one.
ST_Item.Universal_stickers_1025_desc: Keeping the world at arm's length is just another way of staying connected to it.
ST_Item.Affection_usedesc: A token of friendship shared while traveling with your companions. Strengthen your bond, and you might even receive a gift in return.
ST_Item.Furniture_Ornament_035_desc: A professional treadmill with 15 incline settings. Just 10 minutes a day is enough to feel the joy of exercise.
ST_Item.food_054_desc: Cool and refreshing cold brew coffee, taking away the summer heat and workday fatigue.
ST_Item.Yahaha_Mu_Lamp01_Color_01_desc: Smooth outlining ink, perfect for drawing up design blueprints.

ST_Item.Furniture_draw_0012_desc: Wall decor that adds a fun touch. Neatly arranged fine lines create a simple, modern look, while the brown tones add warmth. Perfect for minimalist styles.

ST_Item.Furniture_draw_006_desc: Decorative art that adds a dash of fun to your home decor. Mainly blue and white tones, it gently conveys the tranquility of nature. Suitable for creating a warm and serene atmosphere.
ST_Item.Furniture_draw_001_desc: Decorative art that adds a dash of fun to your home decor. A collision of cartoon bears and simple geometry, full of modern artistic flair, suitable for decorating any type of vibrant space.
ST_Item.Furniture_draw_007_desc: Decorative art that adds a dash of fun to your home decor. Four droplet-shaped patterns form a circle, presenting a harmonious beauty like ripples, simple yet full of tension.

ST_Item.Furniture_draw_008_desc: Decorative art that adds a dash of fun to your home decor. Delicate white flowers bloom against a dark blue background, like floral shadows in a moonlit night. Elegant and serene, exuding a dreamy natural vibe.
ST_Item.Furniture_draw_004_desc: Decorative art that adds a dash of fun to your home decor. Black and white irregular shapes divide like cells, resonating with the rhythm of life.
ST_Item.Furniture_draw_003_desc: A decorative painting that adds contrast to home decor. The striking clash of black and red creates a minimalist yet profound piece full of mystery, perfect for artistic spaces with unique taste.

ST_Item.Title_FinalTower_004_desc: The first ray of dawn cuts through the silence of the long night and crowns you in light.

ST_Item.Scaled_Recipe_Useless_des: Don't get discouraged. Everyone makes mistakes—though it'd probably be best to throw this away before someone else tastes it…

ST_Item.Universal_BusinessCard_1036_desc:
Namecard of Zankou, a former member of Scarlet Letter and now a prisoner on Ghroth Island.
Truthfully, "Zankou" and "Red Nightshade" aren't the names she was given at birth. You know, names have a unique, strange power. They allow people to be forgotten, but also remembered in return. They give others a new life, while simultaneously making others lose theirs. Under the stormy skies, a "Red Nightshade", buried and forgotten, roots through the dirt and mud, awaiting a dazzling rainbow's light.
ST_Item.RobBankItem_063_desc: A lustrous pearl necklace, each perfectly round pearl gleaming like moonlight on the ocean floor. Even the legendary tears of mermaids couldn't compare.

ST_Item.food_038_desc:
Granny Chiyo's home-brewed, plant-fermented drink. Countless scratches can be seen on the old fermentation bucket, an explicit reflection of the Chiyo's sweat and toil… 
Hey hey hey! It's just made of wheat. How could you get drunk drinking sweet water?

ST_Item.Flower0022_des: Clusters of pink-purple hydrangeas. Sparrows chatter noisily, circling and singing around the flowers. The meaning behind it all is known only to the flowers and birds.
ST_Item.Flower0023_des: Clusters of blue-green hydrangeas. Elegant and fragrant, they refresh the mind and uplift the spirit of those who behold them.
ST_Item.Flower0021_des: Clusters of deep purple hydrangeas. The delicate flowers and tender leaves are like carved jade, bringing joy to the heart.

Among all the flowers, you are the sunflower: you pursue, you strive, you are wholeheartedly committed. 
And I only need to follow your lead, moving towards that blazing golden realm, burning with your passion, fiercely reaching for the sun.

Legend has it that a poor writer who couldn't afford paper and pen once practiced writing on household jars and bottles using charred wood. Over time, the black char became a permanent stain. People later crafted ink-stained jars to commemorate him.
ST_Item.RobBankItem_056_desc: A long-necked vase with an exterior as black as ink. Legend has it that a poor writer who couldn't afford paper and pen once practiced writing on household jars and bottles using charred wood. Over time, the black char became a permanent stain. People later crafted ink-stained vases to commemorate him.

ST_Item.PortableVision_Anomaly_060_desc: In the unnoticed cracks of walls dwells an anomaly called "Peepy." It has no complete form, and no one can even describe its outline. All witnesses can confirm is a single eye hiding behind the wall cracks. Peepy is obsessed with observing the minutiae of human life: steam rising from breakfast stalls, lovers' hesitant fingertips under streetlights, drunkards mumbling profanities at trash cans… All these vivid moments of life give it a kind of warm, tingling sensation. Unfortunately, this careful voyeurism is always perceived as an intrusion, followed by screams and angry shouts. Now… Peepy has gotten smarter. It has collected a pile of sunglasses, convinced they're the perfect disguise, fantasizing that it's wearing them and boldly blending into the bustling crowds.
ST_Item.food_104_desc: A signature super-sized takoyaki worthy of the "Taishou" title. Made with whole octopus for maximum impact, each piece is soft, chewy, and bursting with fresh flavor. Even takoyaki made by an actual octopus would be hard-pressed to match this incredible taste.

ST_Item.cookbook_14_desc:
An ordinary molten strawberry cake, adorned with cream and strawberries, has become surprisingly popular! If you hadn't baked it yourself, you'd suspect a witch had slipped a few drops of love potion into the ingredients.
"This is definitely not an Anomaly!" Mint said, scarfing down the last piece at BAC.
These cake samples were collected from Illusion Town residents, based on a recipe featured in a local magazine's Valentine's Day special—Strawberry Box Cake. The cake's online presence caught BAC's attention due to its unusually high success rate in love confessions.
If it's not an Anomaly, why does it always spark love in those who eat it?
ST_Item.BusinessCard_Characterawaken_akane_desc: A snapshot of Akane Rin. After the show, she and her companion rest back to back beneath the lingering stage lights. Between them, there is no need for words. Some bonds are quiet like that—felt rather than spoken. Beneath a full moon wreathed in stars, are you looking up at the same sky?
ST_Item.DefaultCard_1_desc: Your Choo-Choo maid is here. Choo! Please feel free to give me any orders.
ST_Item.DefaultRiichiStick_1_desc: Your Choo-Choo maid is here. Choo! Please feel free to give me any orders.
ST_Item.Universal_stickers_1019_desc: A member of CSU-2, not to be confused with a fugitive employee of Pink Paws Bank.
ST_Item.Title_bidking_season_01_desc: Is it a seashell or a pearl? You won't know until the gavel falls.
ST_Item.food_091_desc: A gigantic hamburger steak that will make you gasp! Tailored for meat lovers, it's the ultimate indulgence!
ST_Item.combat_lvup_name: Upgrade to Circle Bounty: Honor Hunter Supplies
ST_Item.fish_feed_basic_01_use: Standard fish food. Used to fill a fish's Hunger Bar.
ST_Item.skillbreakbox_02_name: Character Esper Ability Selection Box I

ST_Item.Figure_miniblack_01_002_usedesc: Gigafluff series figurine. Increases Collection with each piece. Display in a Figurine Cabinet at home to increase Comfort. Display in a café to increase Popularity by 50.

ST_Item.Transformer_Pukaland_01_des: Cookie Coo, the cheerful cookie who's the life of the party! With a blue-and-white striped party hat and a bright red nose, this cookie will always be popular.
ST_Item.BusinessCard_1090_Q_des: A snapshot of Elyms exploring a vibrant sea of data and sharing fun new discoveries with friends in real time. Want to keep up? Tap YES or NO.
ST_Item.RobBankItem_G024_desc: Grants direct access to the Collection Floor using this pass formerly owned by an employee.
ST_Item.ElevatorCard_Hospital_usedesc: An elevator card that once belonged to a staff member.
ST_Item.PortableVision_Anomaly_058_desc: Initially, The Guide was discovered during a rescue operation. An Anomaly Hunter who got lost in the wilderness encountered a floating ring of smoke in the dim forest. It silently shifted shapes, guiding the Hunter and leading him out of danger. Today, these smoke ring-shaped Guides can be seen everywhere, deployed in large shopping malls and tourist attractions, replacing traditional store assistants. When someone asks for directions, The Guide always knows a shortcut… though not necessarily a safe one.
ST_Item.BusinessCard_Bidking_001_desc: Final bid… sold! Congratulations, this lot is yours.
ST_Item.Universal_stickers_1010_desc: What's up? The big pink cat's got your back!
ST_Item.energy_addpotion_usedesc: An item that increases Character Pixels effectively. It loads the condition of the user's Character Pixels based on Character Photo Paper and fixes the sequential imbalance of Character Pixels with the sloshing sound of the specially programmed base solution, thus reducing the Noise in the Character Resolution Map under the Anomaly's influence. Grants 60 Character Pixels.
ST_Item.item_Fons_usedesc: A tech-packed credit card featuring a fountain motif. It marks the birth of the monetary economy and culture.
ST_Item.Coupon_005_desc: Friend, mourn not my body's passing! I am the Fons you've saved, accompanying you for life.
ST_Item.Universal_frame_1073_desc: The morning dew holds the world's reflection, and yet… and yet…
ST_Item.energy_desc: Character Pixels have a storage cap and recover over time, stopping at or above the cap. Exchange Annulith for more Pixels. Anomaly Furniture Dream Weaver's Knot increases the Character Pixels recovery cap.
ST_Item.BackupStamina_desc: Once Character Pixels reach their cap, Photo Paper Supply begins regenerating over time. It restores 1 point every 18 minutes, up to a maximum of 2,400 points, and can be converted to Character Pixels at a 1:1 ratio.
ST_Item.Furniture_Jukebox_003_desc: A simple, minimalist music player, perfect for quietly enjoying an old vinyl record on a lazy afternoon.
ST_Item.disc_0016_desc: Come on. Even if the road ahead is shrouded in darkness, walk beside me. May the stars guide us.
ST_Item.Doll_amusementpark_kettle_des: A little piece of a perfectly relaxing afternoon… probably.
ST_Item.Coupon_007_desc: Yakitori from Budoriya, a delicious taste that will never disappoint you!
ST_Item.Visions_furniture_11_unlock_desc: A wandering warrior from a foreign land could not grant it true liberation.
ST_Item.HauntedHouse_IcecreamKey_Desc: A special ice-cream-shaped item from Spooky Cookies.
ST_Item.HauntedHouse_DiamondKey_Desc: A special gem-shaped item from Spooky Cookies.
ST_Item.HauntedHouse_PuzzleKeyLeft_Desc: A special gem-shaped item from Spooky Cookies.
ST_Item.HauntedHouse_CakeKey_Desc: A special cake-shaped item from Spooky Cookies.
ST_Item.HauntedHouse_LeftHouseKey_Desc: A special item from Spooky Cookies.
ST_Item.Transformer_Pukaland_04_des: Waffly Waff, a square waffle topped with a slab of butter and drizzled with syrup—soft, chewy, and delightfully sweet.
ST_Item.food_010_desc: A burst of extreme coldness, as if gulping down the glacier.
ST_Item.food_024_desc: The perfect encounter between nut and chocolate. Each bite is a feast for your taste buds.
ST_Item.item_quest_K110358_desc: A newly developed pet head massager from a pet product manufacturer. It's said that no pet can remain rational under its claws! "Hmph! We dogs will never bow to this thing!" "Arf. Woof! Keep going, keep going! Don't stop! Woohoo!"
ST_Item.Prison_EMP_usedec: A specialized electronic device that hides the user's presence while under searchlight beams.
ST_Item.Prison_erodent_usedesc: The undiluted form of a highly corrosive disinfectant. Concentrated enough to corrode metal.
ST_Item.food_060_desc: Citrus and spices sketch out the contours of memories. People's pasts are torn apart and sewn back together, indistinguishable between genuine and insincere amidst clinking glasses. It's better not to distinguish.
ST_Item.item_quest_005_desc: A token of the Colucci Family. Unlike other tokens, the one you possess is truly a hidden exclusive.
ST_Item.Furniture_Chair_004_desc: The chair frame and sky blue cushion seamlessly meld together, creating a fresh and simple style that complements any setting.
ST_Item.DefaulTable_2: Tablecloth: A Fresh Find in Tomatoes
ST_Item.Universal_stickers_1023_desc: A butterfly in graceful dreams. Vivid, free, and light as can be.
ST_Item.Visions_furniture_10_Output_desc: Fluffy yawned and shed cotton fluff everywhere, as warm and cozy as sunshine.
ST_Item.Transformer_Pukaland_02_des: Snappy Snap—a long, mysteriously-filled biscuit sporting a black top hat and a white handlebar mustache. This biscuit is loaded with gentlemanly swagger, though its filling remains a secret.
ST_Item.Furniture_cabinet_0014_desc: A piece of furniture made from oak. A storage cabinet with a generous capacity, perfect for displaying decor and storing everyday odds and ends.
ST_Item.Title_bidking_seasonrank_01_desc: Once the gavel falls, the Treasure Ship will be yours to command, Captain.
ST_Item.Furniture_Chair_0011_desc: An ochre round soft stool, with a lightweight design to meet a multitude of needs.
ST_Item.food_093_desc: Welcome to Dream Island! After your little hero has recharged, try searching the store for traces of popular Anomalies! You'll get a super cool Anomaly figurine as a reward!
ST_Item.Universal_stickers_1070_desc: Sing of the sea, sing of time, sing of every star.
ST_Item.TankBattleItem_Bullet01_desc: The strong face every challenge head-on.
ST_Item.BusinessCard_Characterawaken_Zankou_desc: A snapshot of Zankou. The moment the blade clears its sheath, countless dreamlike visions bloom.
ST_Item.AdvVision_ticket_desc: Every victory deserves recognition… but could these cold, hard medals be traded for fluffy cotton candy instead?
ST_Item.Visions_furniture_13_UpMaterial_desc: On every cold armor plate that once burned hot, the king's name is engraved.
ST_Item.Coupon_002_desc: Weekly special offer! Whether you're feeling tired or enjoying your leisure time, 9°C is here to keep you company!
ST_Item.food_098_desc: A daily Zhu! Vitamin! for a perfect combo with a healthy lifestyle!
ST_Item.SpecialGift_Paper2_des:
Delivered on time every day, this paper brings you the latest news from Hethereau, including the lowest prices at today's market.
"Today's Headline: Snow Falls in Hethereau."
ST_Item.item_WorldMaterial_06_usedesc: Each time you open it, the books wrapped in the cover will be different. Although these books are not hard to come by, they are very convenient for people who just want to read aimlessly and casually. The only inconvenience is remembering not to close the book until you finish it.
ST_Item.SpecialGift_Paper1_des:
A gossip magazine even wilder than Pouch Mosquito. For those hungry for scandal, this issue has it all.
"Dvořák's eldest son got married again?! The most lavish wedding in history—but is there more to the story? Overzealous fans have gathered at Pukaland to protest once more. What kind of idol do we truly want?…"
ST_Item.Prison_Analgesic_desc: Rather than taking it yourself, think about how much useful stuff you could trade this "hard currency" for. That might actually be better for the pain… "When there's profit to be made, nothing hurts anymore!"
ST_Item.Furniture_draw_0013_desc: An early practice work by Bichir Whites. Though the brushwork appears somewhat immature, the color palette already shows hints of what would later become Mr. DSD's signature style. Just like the philosophy Mr. Whites has always adhered to: when he paints a glass of water, it is simply a glass of water.
ST_Item.FrokPiece_Mamen_desc: A fluffy, soft yarn ball. Even kitten Anomalies would purr with satisfaction from just a single touch!
ST_Item.food_008_desc: Bubbles and health can be a perfect combo! It is even healthier without sugar.
ST_Item.food_009_desc: A combo of bubbles and lemon brings you an unprecedented sour-sweet flavor! Put it in cold storage for an even better taste.
ST_Item.Flower0017_des: The eternally blooming peach rose. In dreams filled with floral fragrance, a traveler softly hums a song from home.
ST_Item.Flower0003_desc: The eternally blooming white rose is like a hymn that lingers on the first snow, growing purer as the sky darkens.
ST_Item.Flower0016_des: The eternally blooming pink rose. He takes the bouquet she had kissed and presses it against his heart, like a burning vow.
ST_Item.Flower0018_des: The eternally blooming purple rose. In the depths of the forest, tiny beings no bigger than a finger use the petals as their cradles.
ST_Item.Flower0001_desc: The eternally blooming red rose, dyed with the heart and song of a nightingale, comes from the little bird's burning love.
ST_Item.Flower0002_desc: The eternally blooming blue rose has its secret hidden in the smallest room under the castle, but you must never open the door.
ST_Item.Flower0000_desc: The eternally blooming golden rose, a legendary spring of gold that burns the covetous.
ST_Item.food_083_desc: Springy ramen in a rich soy-based broth, simmered with kombu and matsutake. Topped with crispy handmade tofu skin—both fragrant and irresistible!
ST_Item.FTGoldCoin_desc: The common currency of the Warren Continent. Despite its golden shine, it is not a chocolate coin—do not eat it!
ST_Item.Universal_frame_1029_desc: In the mountains' deep slumber, the soft murmur of falling snow.
ST_Item.bidding_cabinet_level2_desc: Moonlight washes the endless sea as mist curls around jade peaks.
ST_Item.Visions_furniture_10_unlock_desc: Boiling blue flames and the roar of midnight beat wildly within the heart.
ST_Item.Prison_Towerkey_usedesc: Key to the detention facility watchtower. Unlocks the gate to reach the rooftop.
ST_Item.BusinessCard_Characterawaken_fadia_desc: A snapshot of Fadia. For those who know her, whenever she wears that expression, it means the game has just begun.
ST_Item.Visions_furniture_09_UpMaterial_desc: Note: This product is intended only for Fluffy maintenances! We assume no responsibility for any adverse reactions resulting from direct consumption.
ST_Item.food_032_desc: As cute as snow, this pure and soft bean dish has seen struggles between the salty taste and the sweet taste. Why not try a spicy one?
ST_Item.BattleRaceCoin_usedesc: Used to exchange for desired items at the Bolt Shop during the event.
ST_Item.GingerbreadCoin_usedesc: Used to exchange for items at the Caramel Trading Post during the event.
ST_Item.MBCollectCoin_usedesc: Used to exchange for items at the Salvage Shop during the event.
ST_Item.Universal_stickers_1008_desc: The system is my hunting ground.
ST_Item.Furniture_Chair_0013_desc: A great house product combining aesthetics and practicality. The streamlined white chair body and layered baby blue base create a perfect contrast.
ST_Item.Furniture_Gacha_eri_004_name: Asahi Inori - Moon in the Mirror
ST_Item.food_045_desc: Rich cheddar cheese and creamy gouda cheese molten layer by layer on fresh beef patties—a cheesy showdown is about to erupt!
ST_Item.BusinessCard_Characterawaken_Jin_desc: A candid photo of Hotori. When she spots a rare treasure, price is never the question. She always knows when to make her move
ST_Item.SpecialGift_ticket_des: A limited-edition movie ticket for the Floe Cinema. Present this ticket to any usher for a free movie. "If you're unsure how to break the ice, perhaps this could be the 'ticket' to your wildest dreams!"
ST_Item.BusinessCard_Characterawaken_haiyue_desc: A candid photo of Aurelia. She still sometimes thinks of her closest friends, like a traveler glancing back at home.
ST_Item.worldboss_material_07_desc: Seawater, tears, or perhaps the sea's own tears?
ST_Item.Prison_Uniform_usedesc: A jumpsuit issued to detainees at the Hethereau Detention Facility.
ST_Item.Prison_BedSheet_usedesc: A bed sheet issued in the cells of Hethereau Detention Facility. Tear it apart to get cloth strips.
ST_Item.Sightseeing_Guide_10_desc: Every view in Hethereau is worth capturing.
ST_Item.Volleyball_1051_desc: The sun rises on one Hethereau, and sets on another.
ST_Item.food_060_01_name: Sea Salt Deep in the Heart
ST_Item.TankBattleItem_Bullet_Base_desc: A massive stockpile of usable ammunition is just as dangerous.
ST_Item.SpecialGift_1076_des: A GK kit in a special color scheme, walking the fine line between touching and embarrassing. Perhaps it is the perfect gift for someone who hides their true feelings… and whose reaction would be all the more amusing for it.
ST_Item.food_sp_004_desc: The hugely popular Clicky Fries that can easily hold their own against even the Frizzle.
ST_Item.item_WeaponUpMaterial_lv3_desc: A special arc dye. Enhances arc performance quickly without side effects, except for the high price.
ST_Item.food_089_desc: The perfect combination of fresh lemon slices and Acqua Frizzante al Limone, with a touch of mint leaves, brings a refreshing taste.
ST_Item.Furniture_Chair_0015_desc: A refreshing color scheme, perfect for sitting on the balcony and sunbathing.
ST_Item.food_002_desc: Light tea that unlocks a new refreshing chapter for you. TeaRealm T-Fusion brings you a different urban tea-drinking experience.
ST_Item.FTSheepCoin_usedesc: Mystery Button: Event token earned by playing the board game "999 Nights."
ST_Item.FTGoldCoin_usedesc: Warren Gold Coin: In-mode currency earned by playing the board game "999 Nights."
ST_Item.PukalandTicket_usedesc: Earn Puka Stars by participating in Pukaland attractions. Collect enough Puka Stars, then head to the Star Ticket Counter to exchange them for exclusive rewards and surprises.
ST_Item.food_074_desc: Sizzling, juicy meat skewers with the rich, intoxicating aroma of cumin. A temptation that haunts even the most dedicated fitness enthusiasts.
ST_Item.Prison_gameboy_desc: The scratched-up plastic casing is proof that it has survived countless surprise searches and chaotic brawls. The guards are thorough when they search, perhaps because those night shifts can be so hard to get through.
ST_Item.food_034_desc: A sushi boat with a variety of different handmade sushi, stocked with seasonal fresh ingredients, coupled with a small dish of wasabi soy sauce that carries your craving for food. To the faraway land, set sail!
ST_Item.PortableVision_Anomaly_061_desc: Drop into the left eye to see his chains, drop into the right eye to understand her loneliness. Anomaly product eye drops that, once applied, briefly allow you to enter another's view and borrow their eyes to re-examine the world. After using the eye drops, someone sitting on a park bench suddenly finds themselves on all fours, transformed into their own pet dog. Everything becomes blurry, the scenery fades, and the whole world turns dull gray. This is a dog's view after all, unable to even distinguish traffic lights. Miraculously, whenever they look at their "self" on the bench, everything turns bright yellow. It turns out that in a dog's eyes… their owner glows!
ST_Item.PortableVision_Hospital_Smoke_usedesc: When activated, creates a smoke screen that blocks line of sight, then dissipates after a short time.
ST_Item.Equipment_PurpleTicket_desc: Gray rabbits love shiny carrots that taste like the moon.
ST_Item.BusinessCard_Characterawaken_Radio_desc: A snapshot of Linko. "Mysterious frequency detected ahead!" Xiaozhen powers up as Linko charges forward!
ST_Item.Flower0004_desc:
The brilliantly blooming sunflower loves vivaciously and passionately, remaining as bright as the day it first bloomed, with its colors refusing to peel off like paint.
"After losing my ears, I only look at you, like a sunflower."
ST_Item.food_030_desc: Fried until golden, this dish is crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. Careful, it's hot!
ST_Item.Doll_amusementpark_ghost4_des: The candle flickers. The little ghost makes not a sound.
ST_Item.Universal_stickers_1071_desc: Smoke is naturally free-spirited and unruly, with no order to speak of. But hey, where there’s a will, there's a way.
ST_Item.cookbook_14_usedesc: The sold-out Valentine's Day dessert special unlocks the recipe for Strawberry Box Cake.
ST_Item.food_071_desc: Caramel and crunchy nuts jump on the tip of your tongue, as if reveling in a golden autumn harvest feast. Whoever counts calories at this moment, let them be forever alone!
ST_Item.flower_0001_desc:
Love is the paradoxical unity of beauty and fragility, the entanglement of the fleeting and the eternal. It is like a rose blooming in a garden, nurtured with care, reflecting those rich and passionate moments in life. 
My floral language speaks of intense love.
But also beware of the thorns that follow the tenderness.
ST_Item.flower_001_desc:
Love is the paradoxical unity of beauty and fragility, the entanglement of the fleeting and the eternal. It is like a rose blooming in a garden, nurtured with care, reflecting those rich and passionate moments in life.

ST_Item.Furniture_Ornament_040_des: A special commemorative trophy. Forged from pure gold, it's incredibly heavy to hold. The burst of stars across the top marks more than just a score—it bears witness to the bonds you forged. To lift it is to lift your very own "Jade Star".
ST_Item.Furniture_Ornament_052_pinfeng_desc: Made from distinctive acrylic, bringing a unique play of light and color to the home.
ST_Item.NewBieGoals_Display_02_usedesc: Available in bulk at Hunter Lvl 40!
ST_Item.food_064_desc: Nyanko spwash spwash >w<! Love in the shape of bobas meow! >.0
ST_Item.food_064_name: Nyanko Splash Black Sugar Boba Dirty Chai
ST_Item.food_065_desc: Mee-owww! Wun and hide meow! Nyanko hates sour tea! ;-;
ST_Item.Universal_frame_1021_desc: Among the bouquet offered to God, one flower has withered.

ST_Item.Coupon_003_04_name: Tamamochi Street Exclusive - Bubble Tea Shop Voucher

ST_Item.Coupon_003_03_name: Tamamochi Street Exclusive - Roast Duck Shop Voucher
ST_Item.Coupon_003_desc: The Tamamochi Street joint promotional event has begun! We look forward to your visit!
ST_Item.food_051_desc: Rose-flavored fresh fruit jelly and lychee flesh cream layer merge, presenting romantic floral and fresh fruity aromas. It's the store's romantic popular dessert!
ST_Item.Furniture_Ornament_004_desc:
A commemorative piece designed by modern art master Raman to celebrate the successful completion of The Kapé Grand Hotel. Based on the form of a bowl-like vessel, it can hold all things and gather all fortunes.
This commemorative set consists of 188 pieces in total, and this collectible is numbered [123].
ST_Item.Furniture_Ornament_004_usedesc: A commemorative piece designed by the contemporary art master, Raman. Increases Collection with each piece. Display at home to increase Comfort.
ST_Item.Visions_furniture_07_unlock_desc: You now know how to open wooden crates.
ST_Item.BidkingCoin_desc: Pearls gleam upon plates of bone, and gold runs bright within the goblets.
ST_Item.RobBankItem_061_desc: A precious necklace crafted from pure gold. Its unique design and gentle sheen make it feel like melted moonlight flowing along the neck.
ST_Item.Volleyball_1076_desc: The ball is harder than it looks—watch your head!
ST_Item.MBCollectCoin_des: The sea hears every longing sealed inside a bottle.
ST_Item.fish_feed_luxury_01_desc: Life's meaning is life itself. Here and now, the fish exists—and the tank is full of endless possibility.
ST_Item.PortableVision_Mu_Lamp_01_usedesc: A switch for toggling between the surface and hidden worlds. Interacting with it will switch to another world. Observing the world from a different view might lead to new discoveries.
ST_Item.WeaponGacha_usedesc: Used for participating in the Arc Research Program and exchanging for Arcs.
ST_Item.HauntedHouse_FinalKey_UseDesc: Use at the statue in the lobby to unlock the exit mechanism.
ST_Item.weakly_acidic_water_use: Used to manage fish tank water quality, raising the water's pH.
ST_Item.weakly_alkaline_water_use: Used to manage fish tank water quality, reducing the water's pH.
ST_Item.Scaled_Battery_usedesc: Used to power on the remote control.
ST_Item.Scaled_Dissolver_usedesc: Used to dissolve grime and dirt.
ST_Item.Scaled_Hacksaw_usedesc: Used to saw through wooden railings that may block your path.
ST_Item.Birthday_cake_usedesc: Baked to mark a very special occasion.
ST_Item.food_082_desc: Onions bring out the natural sweetness of the chicken, complemented by a rich yet light broth. Mashed potatoes, cream, and white pepper are whipped into a fluffy froth. When paired with a soft-boiled egg and ultra-fine golden potato shreds, the flavors come together superbly!
ST_Item.Title_RacingRank_003_desc: Lose gravity — only the wind of freedom remains.
ST_Item.Food_118_desc: Honey brewed from the drowsiness Wakeybees gather from others. Dilute with water before use to promote sleep and ease insomnia-related migraines.
ST_Item.SpecialGift_radio_room_des: A collage featuring ghosts, airships, comets, and more, brimming with imagination and heartfelt detail. It might make the perfect gift for someone fascinated by such things.
ST_Item.Scaled_BubbleWater_usedesc: Made by dissolving laundry soap in water—can be used to blow bubbles.
ST_Item.food_056_desc: Made of hot chocolate, double espresso, and fresh cream, it energizes and provides ample energy, giving you full vitality!
ST_Item.Furniture_auction_cuiren_desc: A decorative short dagger, handcrafted from jade with gold inlay by a renowned master artisan. Though it can't cut anything, it perfectly embodies the saying: "True luxury is often dangerous and alluring."
ST_Item.steal_gold_desc: Special commemorative coins issued by Pink Paws Bank, quite valuable for collection. Of course, when needed, these cute gold coins can also be exchanged for real Fons.

ST_Item.RobBankItem_046_desc: A diary with worn edges. You can tell it's been read countless times, its thin pages having been turned through the majority of someone's life.
ST_Item.Food_114_desc: The name "Nyanko" that Daffodill wrote down from memory sounds much more catchy than the milk tea's original name.
ST_Item.BusinessCard_Characterawaken_daffodill_d: A snapshot of Daffodill. Apart from her usual duties, Daffodill is responsible for making sure those picky eaters eat their veggies.
ST_Item.Universal_frame_1033_desc: Past, present, future—I am who I am.
ST_Item.StrengthMaxAdd_usedesc: A revolutionary energy bar developed by Midas Technologies in collaboration with the food giant Beverry Group. It is made by extracting the essence of a variety of super ingredients with a certain undisclosed anomaly active ingredient. Can significantly enhance the long-term physical performance of Espers.
ST_Item.item_WorldMaterial_01_usedesc: A household Anomaly decoration produced by Midas Technologies. The potted plant grows different plants based on the buyer's willpower. As a selling point, the pot may grow a pure gold cactus.
ST_Item.Title_bidking_season_02_desc: Luck and a keen eye, hand in hand.
ST_Item.SpecialGift_1090_des: A cute phone case inspired by old-school phone keypads. Maybe it'd be perfect for someone who loves retro tech… or just has way too many phones?
ST_Item.Title_DarkRacing_001_desc: This will be the darkest day in Hethereau racing history.
ST_Item.TankBattleItem_Defense02_desc: This won't work. Neither will that. None of it will.
ST_Item.Figure_yiluoyi_01_desc: Not for beverages, no matter how tempting.
ST_Item.Universal_stickers_1090_desc: "If it's this cute, there's no harm in replacing the real one!"
ST_Item.food_052_desc: The essence of this millefeuille is the daily-made persimmon jam and hand-peeled persimmon heart. Only 8 servings are available daily; come early if you want to taste it!
ST_Item.PortableVision_Anomaly_059_desc: This Anomaly product radio, wrapped in old vacuum tubes and frequency-hopping sparks, is forever searching for music that's "not vintage enough." When it captures melancholic melodies, its rusty knobs spin wildly, brutally transforming songs into the distinctive vintage crackle of vinyl records. Those "popping bean sounds" that enchant old music fans are the frequencies the radio preserves for distorted romance - the years that never rusted in time's torrential flow.
ST_Item.item_SkillUpMaterial_05_lv3_desc: In this performance, you will die and become your second self.
ST_Item.item_SkillUpMaterial_02_lv1_desc: In this performance, you take on the role of a recruit. Start with sentry duty.
ST_Item.item_SkillUpMaterial_02_lv2_desc: In this performance, you embody an officer. Please adhere to the code.
ST_Item.item_SkillUpMaterial_01_lv2_desc: In this performance, you embody a healthy white dove. Fly now, while your wings are still strong.
ST_Item.item_SkillUpMaterial_04_lv1_desc: In this performance, you are assigned the role of a participant. The card before you is the 3 of Hearts… Sorry, you guessed wrong.
ST_Item.item_SkillUpMaterial_04_lv2_desc: In this performance, you are assigned the role of a participant. The card before you is the 3 of Hearts… Congratulations, you guessed correctly.
ST_Item.item_SkillUpMaterial_04_lv3_desc: In this performance, you are assigned the role of the dealer. The card before you is either the 3 of Hearts or all cards.
ST_Item.item_SkillUpMaterial_05_lv1_desc: In this performance, you are assigned the role of an innocent spectator, a provider of shackles, and a future murderer.
ST_Item.item_SkillUpMaterial_02_lv3_desc: In this performance, you are the General. You will eliminate every white rose in the garden.
ST_Item.item_SkillUpMaterial_05_lv2_desc: In this performance, you are assigned the role of a blind follower. Together, you all hold your breath, attempting to hear the sound of a latch from the silent water.
ST_Item.item_SkillUpMaterial_01_lv1_desc: In this performance, you take on the role of a fragile nestling. Poor child, may you receive the most sincere blessings.
ST_Item.item_SkillUpMaterial_03_lv3_desc: In this performance, you are assigned the role of a gentleman hidden among tourists. Remove your hat, bow gracefully, and pay respects to this wonderful party.
ST_Item.item_SkillUpMaterial_03_lv2_desc: In this performance, you are assigned the random role of a frequent visitor. You already know what these empty boxes contain, yet you still reach out your hand.
ST_Item.item_SkillUpMaterial_03_lv1_desc: In this performance, you are assigned the random role of a tourist. Step right up, the box has everything you need.
ST_Item.item_SkillUpMaterial_01_lv3_desc: The ending of this performance is yours to decide. Will you declare it an ordinary day, or perhaps the opposite?
ST_Item.item_quest_012_desc: This photograph is the only connection left between you… You're not crying. There's just some snow in your eyes.
ST_Item.Prison_Towerkey_desc: A small key granting access to the detention facility's top. Up here, you can see beyond the walls, the wilderness and the sea feel almost within reach. Perhaps, for you, they truly are.
ST_Item.sticker_Musical_achievement_des: This is a story about friendship and bonds, the past, present, and future.

ST_Item.Yahaha_Mu_Lamp01CookFormula_desc:
Ingredients:
3 eggs, 35g corn oil, 40g milk, 50g cake flour, 30g granulated sugar, half a lemon
Instructions:
1. Separate egg whites and yolks into two bowls.
2. In a new bowl, add 35g corn oil and 40g milk, whisk until yogurt-like consistency.
3. Add egg yolks and cake flour, mix until smooth.
4. Take egg whites from refrigerator, add lemon juice, gradually add sugar in three portions and whip thoroughly.
5. Take 1/3 of the meringue and fold into the egg yolk mixture until evenly combined.
6. Pour the mixed cake batter into the meringue bowl and fold until evenly combined.
7. Pour cake batter into mold, use a toothpick to pop surface bubbles.
8. Bake in oven at 150°C for 60 minutes.

The group makes camp and rests. Shinku takes the night watch for everyone.
Shinku is curious about your powers and longs for a safe and handy ability like your grasp for Nexuses. You pick up on Shinku's emotions, and she admits her own powers have got her into a lot of trouble and heavily burden her. She used to wish she could just be normal, but that would only end up holding back her companions.
You ask Shinku what kind of life she wants. After thinking over, she realizes no other life would be better than this one. At least in this life, she's gotten to know everyone, and that makes her happy.

ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_Protect_NPC028_025: Alrighty! We'll have more time to talk after we leave this place!
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_Player_013: I’ll keep my thoughts to myself next time… just kidding, I won't.
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPC028_075: Don't forget me! I'll stand behind Mint senpai!
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_freetalk2_Player_029: Then let's count out Fuzzies in our dreams.
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPC028_021: I'll try to pick the lock.

ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPC001_049: That could be fun too! By the way, I let the dice choose for my first game and played the Ranger, which maxes Dexterity!
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPC032_162: That kind of life doesn't suit me after all.
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPC032_051: Why don't you just make new ones yourself?

ST_Legend_Shinku.TShinku01_NPC001_024: I can smell the treasure here!

ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPC032S_006: That's why you're a loner. Do you think as long as you stay away, you won't hurt them when you lose it?
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPC032_106: So that's why I felt something…

ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCASS001_024: Lean on this Fuzzy! You can surely get some good sleep!
ST_Legend_Shinku.L110308_QuestPanel: This weird sheep-like creature actually talks? It wants to take us to a village.
ST_Legend_Shinku.SUW_TBS_Simple_AS002_010: The adventurer who gets to meet the Ancestor is sure to succeed!
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPC001_024: By the way, that Containment Device you mentioned… I think I left it by mistake. I'll pick it up when I clock in tomorrow.

ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_freetalk_NPC032_005: Dark vision… Tch, it's not like I expected to have it.
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_008: (A floating, sweet cloud melts on your tongue. Just as you lean in to savor it further, the blissful taste vanishes without a trace. It seems the wool of Fuzzies are made of cotton candy.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_Player_131: (I'll prepare some gifts for Mint myself the next time I go there too.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_Player_062: (What can they be if they aren't canes…?)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_Player_089: (No, you fail to come up with an excuse to deny Mint's request…!)
ST_Legend_Shinku.SDW_AS00310_Player_007: (Then again this is a game. Maybe it's just some desperate creator's way of padding out the runtime.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_014: (It's plain to see that everyone is feeling uncomfortable. For Mint, however, this may prove to be a particularly difficult task.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_005: (The village elder, thoroughly delighted, is about to begin a long speech. Has he noticed that his fluffy and curly wool is giving off a strangely sweet scent? That scent stirs something in your long-dormant taste buds, and a greedy craving begins to swirl inside you…)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_010: (Did he notice? Was that turn a coincidence, or intentional? Either way, you'd do well to not try a second time. Now, return your attention to his speech and pretend nothing happened.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_041: …You're also hiding and suppressing something, right? Why don't you tell your companions about the real you?
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_025: (You also notice Iroi's intentions. Seems that she also has the same idea.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_018: (You stare at the box, which denies your attempts to open it. You realize that it's one of those boxes that only open when the time is right.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_024: (You catch the hesitation in Shinku's voice. There's clearly more she wants to say, and you think back to how she's held herself back before…)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_001: (You notice the flash of red across Mint's face, but there's something more behind that unease than embarrassment, like a cat whose tail was just stepped on.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_003: (You're on point. Are you really new to this game…?)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_028: (You can feel the longing. It craves your gaze, your response, your touch. Haven't you realized yet? This mahjong machine belongs to you. It exists because of you.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_Player_036: (Should I pluck some wool and taste it?)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_006: (That sweetness, melting in your mouth, got you intoxicated, but the cotton candy vanishes on your tongue as soon as it gets there. Hey, stop it already! Keep this up and the Cotton Candy Sheep will grow bald!)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_Player_031: (I just picked a response from one of the options.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_Protect_NPC032_018: (Sigh) It's more complicated than that… far more complicated than what the dumcat thinks.
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_034: (You gain one level after you eat it. Think about it. How much EXP do you need from level 99 to level 100? It's super OP!)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_Player_021: (Wow, I can even speak to the narrator.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_040: Is it because you're used to defying others?
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_021: (In her eyes, you're about as far from "esteemed" as it gets right now. Want to talk to her? Come back when you're at least level 3.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_023: (Nobody wants to hear what her "great" idea is! Quick! Do something! Stop her before everything freezes and the village gets buried in a blizzard!)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_035: (If it weren't valuable, the great heroine wouldn't have left it for you.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.SDW_AS00310_Player_006: (A ritual this powerful isn't something any ordinary Fuzzy could pull off. The Fuzzy in front of me is either hiding something, or there's an even more terrifying presence lurking behind it…)
ST_Legend_Shinku.TShinku01_Player_005: (Nanally has recovered well. I wonder if she can go outside… Let me check up on her.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_033: (It's not just your run-of-the-mill candy. It's a candy with mystical powers to boost someone's level.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_043: (That dragon could use some acting lessons, right?)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPC001_187: (Awkward laugh) I only remember trying to fix the shredding machine…
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_009: (Just as you reach out, the fluffy, sweet cloud turns to the side at precisely that moment. They say a compelling speaker always adds gestures to their words. Seems that Fuzzies are no exception.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_022: (What's going on? The air froze all of a sudden! Did the temperature just drop by several dozen degrees? Shinku and Iroi are shooting Mint with stares as cold as ice, yet Mint remains oblivious…)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_039: I didn't expect you to miss them so much! I thought you were annoyed by that lot and the village elder.
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_020: (Our adventurers hit a snag on the road: not everyone here is easy to deal with. Just look at the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant, who only serves customers she deems "esteemed.")
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_Player_115: (What did I do to be thanked by her…?)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_Player_020: (So my observation of Mint's actual feelings procced the dice to narrate.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_017: (Stay tuned! A good storyteller never spoils endings!)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_004: (Evidently, Mint's careless actions agitated the sheep-like creature. By the look of it, it's ready to attack at any moment, and you may be its next target.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_At01_Player_01: (The sweetest… What do they mean by that?)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_At01_Player_01_f: (The sweetest… What do they mean by that?)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_At01_Player_01_m: (The sweetest… What do they mean by that?)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_036: (While one of them is strategizing, the cat is brewing another great idea…)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_013: (Is this what they call "there are none so sleepy as those who pretend to sleep"?)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_012: (You better pretend everything is okay! You just made a friend. Behave yourself!)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_Player_090: (Mint, I trust that your cooking skills have improved!)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_Player_015: (Shinku seems to get the hang of it. Is she an expert at these games?)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_Player_085: (The food-like substance before you looks normal enough. Still, knowing Mint, you can't help but stay on high alert…)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_Player_030: (Wait, I actually don't know what to say.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_Protect_Player_046: (She still hasn't answered my question… but I don't think I should push it.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_011: (The Fuzzy rambles on, seemingly oblivious to your words. Or perhaps you were simply ignored. Shinku watches you in utter confusion.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_007: (The soft, sweet sensation on your tongue confirms your suspicion. Those fluffy wool are indeed cotton candy. Seems that the first creature you encountered in this world is a "Cotton Candy Sheep.")
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_002: (Mint's efforts to establish herself as a trustworthy senpai are on the verge of falling apart.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_Player_088: (Mint is staring at you in full anticipation.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_Player_086: (If I remember correctly, Mint's cooking skills…)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_026: (No words were exchanged, but you and Iroi are on the same page. You both do and say nothing. Now isn't the right time.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_Player_047: (If only I had a Picky with me…)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_Player_032: (What is going on with these options? Mint didn't mention them…)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_029: (Honestly, you four should just meet at Little Sparrow for some games! If you keep playing, I'm going to run out of lines!)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_freetalk2_Player_006: (I heard some cats eat grass… but it doesn't look like Mint is that kind of cat.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_030: (Are you even planning to return to my adventure story?)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_042: (This is not a simple "what if" question.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_038: You're in a dreamworld that belongs to you alone.
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_031: (Do you need me to explain mahjong? I haven't tried this side hustle yet…)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_016: (In contrast, I'm the best at storytelling.)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_019: (Well, if it only opens at the right time, isn't this the right time already?)
ST_Legend_Shinku.Shinku01_NPCRPGNarration_027: (An actual mahjong machine! The laughter it could bring, the rivalries it could spark… Is it right to leave such treasure collecting dust here?)

"Been having rotten luck lately? Lost your kitten? Need someone to take a look at the feng shui in your shop? Then come see the Witch! No matter the question, the Witch will have an answer!"
Deep in the woods lives Blackbird—known to all as the "Witch"—whose divination is as obscure as it is powerful. Those who have sought her prophecies claim she is quiet and reserved, with a calm, dignified air. Through her crystal ball, she can glimpse the fate of all things, and guide the lost back onto the right path.
Beyond that, no one knows a thing about her.
Rumor has it she first appeared here centuries ago. Her black birds are her emissaries, with the ability to fly into the past or the future, and through them she grasps the secrets of all things…

In Illica's otherwise smooth-sailing life, "getting along with her relative Haniel" was definitely not on the list. From major things like exam grades to trivial matters like who could eat the spiciest chili, everything was a competition. What should have been a farce that ended with graduation was now playing out once again at Sterry Express. The mysterious shop owner and underboss are just silent coworkers, and as for the secrets behind Sterry…
"Secrets? That doesn't matter. What matters most is that I can't lose to Haniel!"

ST_Likeability.H_NPC_01902_des:
There's a saying in Hethereau's racing circles: "An anomaly hunter who can't make tofu will never be a good racer."
Creating a perfect plate of fried tofu first tests a master's knife skills. The thickness of each slice determines the final texture. Next comes temperature control, where the heat can't be too high or too low. Finally, there's timing: three minutes to prepare the perfect fried tofu, three minutes to finish a race. While the engine cools down, tender fried tofu with secret sauce makes the perfect pairing.

ST_Likeability.1008_des:
Skia's first positive impression of the Bureau occurred when he was updating his resume.
He decided to give the job at the Bureau a try when he was invited to apply, but the formality of a resume was still required. Since leaving his previous job, he hadn't bothered to think of resumes and job applications… Now, he had no choice but to polish up his old resume.
 He uploaded a new ID photo, replacing the original one—he nearly didn't recognize the young man in the portrait anymore—then clicked submit.
 —This is usually where the systems tell him "face not detected, please upload an appropriate portrait" and what not. Strangely, the file was submitted without issue.
 Skia let out a quiet sigh of relief. Although he had long since stopped caring about facing prejudice based on his looks, having to make an extra trip to compensate for system inadequacies and disrupting his established workflow… that would have been truly intolerable.

Linko relaxed and slowly said what was on her mind: she confessed the loneliness she'd carried for so long, her longing to find someone on her wavelength, and the gentle, accepting frequency she sensed in the comet—the same kind she felt from the Appraiser.

ST_Loading.loading_5_2:
Esper Abilities are supernatural, non-reality abilities awakened in ordinary humans, which can generally be divided into six types based on different manifestations: Cosmos, Anima, Incantation, Lakshana, Psyche, and Chaos.
Not all Esper Abilities are powerful or possess battle capabilities. Some abilities are weak and some even somewhat comical.
ST_Loading.loading_2_2:
Anomaly is an umbrella term for all beings, objects, phenomena, places, and memes that possess supernatural attributes from a human perspective.
The origins of Anomaly manifestations are varied, but their very existence in this world is the greatest unsolved mystery.
ST_Loading.loading_10_2:
The Circle refers to the authorities on anomaly related matters.
Strictly speaking, the Circle usually refers to the five topmost authorities: the Bureau of Anomaly Control, the Celaeno Compound, the Yggash Court, the Zerogon Laboratory, Ghroth Island, and the Supreme Tribunal A6.
However, in a broader sense, the Circle also refers to various public institutions, as well as private Anomaly Hunters or Hunter organizations.
ST_Loading.loading_19_2:
These members of the Circle don't answer to any public authorities, but rather conduct anomaly investigation, containment, and nullification work under their tacit approval. Anomaly Hunters often form or operate under companies or businesses.
Their revenue comes from a wide variety of channels, including guilds and private commissioners.
ST_Loading.Hospital_1_2:
A nameless hospital abandoned after an unknown incident; an inescapable nightmare, ever-present yet never defined.
"Its name, its past, its truth… You will come to know them all."
ST_Loading.loading_22_2:
Generally speaking, Anomalies have Wertheimer Index values in the negative range below -1, while espers have values in the positive range above 1. The larger the absolute value, the greater the degree of deviation from reality.
Things that do not deviate from reality at all theoretically have a Wertheimer Index of 0. Since being affected by Anomalies or Esper Abilities in daily life is quite common, ordinary humans typically have actual Wertheimer Index values between -1 and 1.
ST_Loading.loading_29_2:
An Oddity that has a contract with the Dvořák family, whose time of appearance is beyond memory.
Legend says the Dvořák family's vast wealth comes from the mysterious Ladon. Please do not call it by any name other than "Ladon," and when necessary, use the title "Lord Ladon." As for nicknames like "udon"… no matter where you heard that, you must forget it immediately.
ST_Loading.loading_6_2: Individuals who have awakened an Esper Ability are called Espers. Theoretically, Espers have varying lifespans depending on the impact of their awakening. Some Espers are no different from ordinary people. Others may have a significantly shorter expected lifespan as the "price" of their awakening, while some may live longer, and some may even become effectively immortal.
ST_Loading.loading_23_2:
A comprehensive social media platform in Hethereau.
It covers all functions that support expressing opinions and sharing info with others, including forum posts, friends' feed updates, messaging, albums, rolls, live streaming, and more.
ST_Loading.loading_8_2: The more humans interact with Anomalies, learn about them, and become obsessed, the more likely they are to be affected physically and even mentally. This phenomenon is called Encroachment.
ST_Loading.loading_25_2:
Anomalies that integrate into society as Anomaly Citizens, enjoying civil rights while also bearing civil obligations.
Most Anomalies with citizen status are Oddities, but this is not limited to Bio Anomalies. Other types of Anomalies that have received sponsorship, possess self-awareness and autonomous behavioral capacity, have sufficient intelligence, and have passed evaluation can also become Anomaly Citizens.
ST_Loading.loading_15_2:
Real-time monitoring of Wertheimer Index fluctuations is an essential means of maintaining vigilance against high-level Anomalies manifesting in our world.
Large-scale measurements have already been popularized primarily through Wertheimer Towers, but more convenient and precise measurement technology has not yet been achieved on a technical level. Accurate measurement of Wertheimer Index values for specific targets requires quite complex procedures to accomplish.
ST_Loading.loading_3_2:
The critical point when a specific intervention is applied to an Anomaly, causing its internal or external manifestation to undergo drastic changes.
The Nexus is one of the core characteristics of an Anomaly, closely related to the Anomaly's form of existence, behavioral choices, and its response modes to external interventions. Current research has yet to provide a comprehensive explanation of it.
Each Anomaly's Nexus is unique, often playing a key role in the containment or nullification of the Anomaly.
ST_Loading.loading_17_2:
For some Anomalies with a certain level of intelligence, as well as some Anomaly owners, sponsorship means protection. Through sponsorship, the basic rights and safety of that Anomaly being allowed to exist in human society can be maintained.
Sponsorship is not mandatory, does not mean that the sponsored Anomaly necessarily has citizen status, does not mean that the sponsor and the Anomaly have necessarily signed a contract, nor does it contain implications of a master-servant power relationship. It has the broadest scope of coverage.
ST_Loading.loading_24_2:
"OP" refers to the "original poster" on Bagel.
You can see bagel-shaped barcodes covered with sesame seeds posted in places, called "Sesame Codes." You can scan these Sesame Codes to view the corresponding Bagel pages.
It's convenient in every way, and has become an indispensable platform in modern life.
ST_Loading.loading_18_2:
A domain constructed by an Anomaly using its own abilities that cannot be mapped to real-world coordinates.
The Anomalous Realm itself is, in most cases, one of the abilities of the main Anomaly. Therefore, what is commonly referred to as an Anomalous Realm generally cannot be considered an independent derivative Anomaly, and is thus distinguished from the concept of Location Anomalies that can be mapped to real-world coordinates.
ST_Loading.loading_16_2:
The influence that Anomalies have on real, ordinary things.
Minor Encroachment rarely manifests visibly. Major Encroachment manifests in various ways depending on the corresponding Anomaly.
Encroachment caused by the same type of Anomaly also manifests differently depending on the form of the real thing, such as living beings or objects.
ST_Loading.loading_9_2:
The city where the headquarters of the Bureau of Anomaly Control is located. It is an inclusive, open, and fashionable metropolis.
Since the establishment of the headquarters, this city has become a paradigm of public safety. Its influence can be seen in the city's design and atmosphere, placing Hethereau at the forefront of global Anomaly and Esper applications.
ST_Loading.loading_27_2:
A commercial bank under the Dvořák Group.
One of Hethereau's largest commercial banks with a long operating history and strong financial foundation. Its branches and ATMs are commonly seen throughout the city. The main building is located in the downtown area, and its Pink Paws logo originates from the anomaly Ladon, which has a Contract with the Dvořák family.
ST_Loading.loading_7_2:
All espers have paid a price for their abilities, be it mental, or physical, or something abstract and unfathomable like "karma" or certain weaknesses that had only surfaced after their awakening.
It is worth noting that the price may not follow the "law of equivalent exchange", and its effects are often unmeasurable.
ST_Loading.loading_online_1_2:
Play with up to 4 friends as you explore and adventure in the same world together.
In multiplayer, team up to take on fierce anomalies, challenge each other in arcade games, speed through the streets of Hethereau, visit other players' uniquely decorated homes, and much more.
ST_Loading.loading_6_4:
Espers can be divided into two categories based on when they acquire their Esper Ability: Espers from nature and Espers from nurture, who usually undergo a specific life-changing event.
In terms of appearance, some Espers have no obvious differences from ordinary people, while others exhibit features distinct from ordinary humans, such as animalistic appearances, horns, or neon-colored skin.
ST_Loading.loading_28_2:
A variety show funded and produced by the Dvořák family.
Inspired by the movie Vault Heist, the Dvořák family partnered with renowned directors to create a variety show called Pink Paws Heist, aiming to give citizens a chance to experience a different kind of life. However, while winners receive generous rewards, they also seem to be added to some mysterious list…?
ST_Loading.loading_26_2:
Chairman of Pink Paws Bank, eldest son of the Dvořák family, and Hethereau's renowned love poet.
Forever pursuing true love, he pays no attention to anything else he considers "trivial matters." Though passionate by nature, his relationship with his children seems rather strained.
ST_Loading.loading_20_2:
A confirmed product created or invented with the participation of one or more Espers using their abilities, where the inclusion of esper abilities is an essential and irreplaceable part of the product's creation process that cannot be substituted by ordinary materials or methods used by regular people.
These can be divided into two major categories: esper technologies and esper constructs.
ST_Loading.loading_13_2:
The act of collecting the remnants of Anomaly Activity and other Anomaly-related elements.
Apart from handing over the contained or temporarily contained Anomaly itself, sending the captured Anomaly-related elements to Midas Technologies may also assist in the research of the Anomaly. Based on contributions in this area, one may sometimes receive an "Arc" that carries part of the anomaly's abilities as a reward.
ST_Loading.loading_1_2:
Wertheimer Index is the value used to measure the degree of deviation from reality of a subject.
With this value, it is possible to determine whether a subject is an Anomaly or an esper.
The Wertheimer Index is also an important reference to classify Anomalies.
ST_Loading.loading_11_2: The act of temporarily restricting and isolating Anomalies is classified as "Temporary Containment". It is more common for Anomalies with lower or stable threats and is generally applicable to Anomalies that can be controlled by conventional technology, isolation facilities, or standard containment procedures. Sometimes it can be performed with Esper Abilities as well.
ST_Loading.loading_12_2: The act of restraining and isolating Anomalies through critical measures, preventing them from posing threats to reality or human society.
ST_Loading.loading_4_2: The act of critically erasing an Anomaly from the human world is classified as "nullification." However, nullification does not annihilate the Anomaly entirely, and it may still emerge into the human world.
ST_Loading.loading_14_2:
A newly developed city marked by rapid growth and a large population. 
Once criticized as being "well constructed in every respect, yet lacking character," the arrival of the Anomaly, "Hypervortex," has stained the city with an inescapable sense of abnormality.

ST_Loading_Quest.DLC_Hotel_Des_01: Ebisu Auction House has chosen this location to host an underground auction. Rumor has it the main attraction is a high-threat Anomaly with precognitive abilities.
ST_Loading_Quest.DLC_Museum_Lamp_Des_01: One of the Anomaly exhibits displayed in the Gold Apple Collection Hall. The lightbulb-headed storyteller… do you remember what he said? "When you lose your way in one world, try looking at it from another perspective."

ST_Main_BlackBird.Blackbird01_NPC021_139: Appraiser, the letter! The letter said there's something only I can do. It must be this!
ST_Main_BlackBird.Blackbird_Bookcontent_53:
……
The above is a summary I have compiled of witch-hunting anomaly cases from the past two hundred years, together with the nullification process for the witch-hunting anomaly (that is, the oddity known as the "Inquisitor") as learned through the report from Appraiser Zero. I have also appended the historical background in which the Inquisitor came into being, along with further historical detail on the witch trials.
Having analyzed the full course of these cases closely, I found it easy to associate the memetic witch-hunting anomaly with shifts in the collective will. This could explain the single greatest puzzle in its nullification process: why the oddity known as the Inquisitor appeared in Hethereau at this time. Merula claimed it was because her powers weakened, such that she could no longer keep the Inquisitor contained. But I believe she misunderstood her own powers, out of a lack of understanding of esper constructs.
First, Merula, like the other townsfolk of St. Arbor, was a devout believer in the faith of that era. Though she knew well the cruelty and absurdity of the witch trials, she never gave up her faith on that account. As she saw it, the Fleshbound Cage was not her esper construct, but rather some magical curse that she, as a witch, had bargained from the Devil. She did not know that an esper must train hard to master and strengthen their ability, and so she never once tried to take control of the Fleshbound Cage she created. In fact, she did not think of herself as its master at all. Otherwise, she might long since have left the Fleshbound Cage, and been spared her hundreds of years of burning torment.
She and the Inquisitor were trapped in the Fleshbound Cage for hundreds of years. Then, in recent years, Hethereau developed. Foot traffic through Starfall Bay grew, and guesthouses, hotels, and other services for travelers multiplied. Through all this, the memetic Inquisitor fed ceaselessly on the pain it drew from the people around it, growing its own power. So it was not that Merula's power was fading, but that the Inquisitor's was slowly building, until at last it could break free of the Fleshbound Cage.
Normally, this report would have ended here. But to help the Bureau's younger members better handle witch-hunting anomalies, I would like to append a few humble thoughts of my own.
In the witch trial the Appraiser experienced, I saw people in tremendous pain. They faced natural disasters they could not resolve, including plague and social upheaval beyond their control. To ease that pain, they chose to believe the Inquisitor: destroy the witches, and every problem would be solved. They cast about for any reason to accuse and harm the people they disliked: the weak and their rivals. Worse still, given the times, it was women who bore the brunt of it.
Though the changing of the times and the dwindling of the witch trials stripped the Inquisitor of the malice that sustained it, and it was at last nullified of its own accord, witch-hunting anomalies have never disappeared from our history. On the contrary, they have always haunted us like a specter we cannot shake…
As a matter of fact, change "witches" to something else, like "espers," then you get fertile ground for a new witch-hunting anomaly.
According to records from the Bureau and Fraxinus, five years after the great outbreak over forty years ago, there were eight witch-hunting anomalies on record, two of them Class IV. Investigation reports showed all eight arose from humanity's fear of anomalies and espers. In cities large and small, similar groups sprang up, each bent on wiping out espers, and so the era's witch-hunting anomalies were born. The espers of that time, like the witches the Appraiser encountered, were in ordinary eyes the source of every disaster, the object of fear, and so, naturally, the ones made to bear every accusation.
If we trace history back further, we'll find that beyond putting witches and espers on trial, we have coined many special words to define those we cast out. As though a single such word could rightfully expel them from the human race and reduce them to something lower than any beast. People believed, too, that once the outcasts were dealt with, all their own pain would vanish with them, so dealing with them by any means was reasonable, righteous, and even lawful.
But in truth, purging the outcasts only made people briefly forget their present pain. Such actions never truly resolved any of that pain, nor ever could.
If that's the case, why do we repeat such behavior again and again? In modern society, under present-day constraints, lawful and brazen killings as seen in witch trials are now uncommon, and high-level witch-hunting anomalies rarely arise. Nevertheless, similar things happen all around us, just in more subdued forms.
This was my first time studying so many witch-hunting anomaly reports in depth. Just as I sat helpless and bewildered at the repetition of these collective tragedies, I found a note in one of the older reports, left by a predecessor. His words gave me a small measure of comfort. Perhaps there is a way to end such things. It will only take a very, very long time. The predecessor's handwriting has grown faint, and those who study the reports after us will likely pass it over. So I want to quote it here, for them to read more easily, and to close with it:
"Evil does not always originate from those set on doing wrong. It can also come from those who cease thinking and merely follow orders. It is not that they cannot tell good from evil, but that they no longer care to bear the responsibility of making up their own minds. They surrender their choices to orders, to rules, and to the mob, until in the end they no longer know what they are doing. This is cause for sorrow, but also for comfort. For it proves, at least, that people are not bound only to obey. As long as people take up their responsibilities, and ask what they are doing before they act, witch-hunting anomalies will not easily come to be."
Alright, I originally thought Doggo pretty much said what's left to say and I meant to save the Bureau some paper, but after reading his BS conclusion, I had to throw in my two cents. (Mind your language) (Nah)
Doggo likes humans, that's the only reason he clings to that naive little fantasy. He still hasn't figured it out: contemplation is not a journey to answers, but the beginning of the acceptance of the lack thereof. Contemplation forces you to judge, choose, and own the mistakes you make, such that you face the unknown all by yourself. Nobody can give you answers, and nobody can bear the consequences of your own actions. That's freedom for you, and most people find the burden too heavy.
Humans crave freedom, yet they also crave someone to shoulder the pain that comes with freedom. Not everyone can savor pain the way I do. Those riffraff would pay any price to spare themselves such pain. Give them an answer and it doesn't matter in the slightest whether it's true, as long as they consider it beyond doubt. That's why they love it when an Inquisitor shows up and tells them: Trust me, kill the witches and everything will be fine. And that's how they'll eat up any nonsense the Inquisitor spoonfeeds them.
And here I thought he'd have figured it out ages ago, after we handled those two little witch-hunting anomalies together… For the era the Appraiser witnessed, what those people needed wasn't a deity but a miracle! As for people today, what they need isn't the freedom to think but a definitive answer!
Especially in the face of hunger, plague, and war, most people have no room to think at all. Doggo assumes that teaching people to think will set everything right, but he forgets that the freedom that enables thinking is something of a luxury—not everyone can afford its cost. And thus, people long for Inquisitors.
Submitted by:
Skia, ETD-4
Fadia, ETD-4

ST_Main_BlackBird.Blackbird_Bookcontent_02:
…Midwife Magda Müller, her hands bound, was cast into the Luther River by Matthew Hopkins. She did not rise for a considerable while; the blessed waters received her, thereby proving the purity of her soul.
By the inquisitor's verdict, Magda Müller was innocent. Upon her unfortunate drowning, her property shall pass to her children, Parham Müller and Sally Müller.
ST_Main_BlackBird.Blackbird_Bookcontent_01:
…The Diviner Dorothy Osborne, her hands bound, was cast into the Luther River by Matthew Hopkins. She floated to the surface; she, whom the sacred waters rejected, was indeed a sinner in league with the Devil.
By the inquisitor's judgment, though the witch Dorothy Osborne confessed, her soul had fallen too far, and even the Highest One could not forgive her for all she had done. She shall be burned at the stake on the morning of the autumnal equinox. Because of her betrayal of the Highest One, all her worldly possessions are to be confiscated by the village according to law and placed in the care of Audley von Eberhard, mayor and elder of Casco.

ST_Main_BlackBird.Blackbird_Bookcontent_06:

By the inquisitor's judgment, although the sinful warlock had confessed, his soul had fallen too far, and even the Highest One could not forgive him. At the next full moon, Matthew Hopkins was to be burned at the stake.
