ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC06804_007: Tonight's dinner service will be personally prepared by Mr. Selaruz, a La Palourde Blanche 3-star chef, for our esteemed guests.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00905_001: Any new faces in this year's La Palourde Blanche stars?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC028_034: I arrived at the resort for my shift around 9 this morning as usual. On my way, I spotted a teddy bear in the distance and thought someone had just abandoned it there.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC028_040: I arrived at the resort for my shift around 9 this morning as usual. On my way, I spotted a teddy bear in the distance and thought someone had just abandoned it there.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_071: We might have been too conspicuous at tonight's auction…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00301_023: Tonight, it's tonight! Solve it tonight and you will get your money!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC010_007: Allow me to introduce you to Bianca. Bianca is a new client who just came in with a commission.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_028: Let me introduce our couriers—Haniel and Illica.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC002_005: The puppet from Eibon has been transferred to Temp-con. Please follow me.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC016_014: According to information revealed by the surrounding guests, the next auction item is Glittering Gold.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_046: Immediately on my way back, I started working on the next chapter of "Tales of Nil." By the way, your dog—and all the anomalies I saw there—became my source material.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_030: I started working on the next chapter of "Tales of Nil" on my way home from the pawnshop. That dog, and all the anomalies I had just seen.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_037: From the intel we've gathered, there's no shortage of interest in the auction item.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00903_001: It's been ages since I've had a vacation… not since the New Helios incident…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_090: From what I know, any rule triggered prioritizes the safety of guests.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_078: Based on these pawn tickets… they're all anomalies that have fulfilled their contracts.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_012: After a while, I came to see them as nothing more than greedy beasts scrambling for scraps and pandering jesters making fools of themselves.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC09306_003: You started from scratch, paid off the astronomical debt left by the previous family head, then revived the family business… Your burden is far too heavy.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_095: Some thing feels off. Let me look closer…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_012: He never says a word, just swings this huge scythe at me. It's terrifying.
ST_MainDialogue.MT_DMP01_01_0021_07: He's unhappy, The kite said, even the blind cry.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_047: They… sent Renee a formal invitation and are waiting for us at the old Constantine family estate.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_075: Do you think they're in danger?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_061: These two aren't the villains either. The real villain is the evil chef!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00811_002: They're starting to work in all walks of life…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_080: It seems they've opted for a rather… clever approach that's budget-friendly but should still be reasonably effective…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_058: All their minds, boggled with ways to milk profit from anomalies. These thieves gave them a nice lesson on anomaly abilities.
ST_MainDialogue.MT_DMP01_01_0021_13:
They heard the church bells, 
Ringing for their pitiful love.
ST_MainDialogue.MT_DMP01_01_0021_06: They're hugging, The dove said, I'll officiate.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_018: I think they're trying to get on your good side but aren't sure how to go about it…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_101: Where are they? Mom and the others. Are they still home?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00702_007: His assistant realized that he had gone missing after he hadn't returned for several days.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_044: He should have the strongest body.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_047: He should have the most beautiful face.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_059: He wanted to pawn something again?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_057: He was worried you'd tell the owners of Pawn Moonlight about his plans, so he kidnapped you.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC05606_002: His cooking is decent enough… though he tends to bend the rules a bit.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC010_033: His words are somewhat contradictory. I feel like there's more to it.
ST_MainDialogue.MT_DMP01_01_0021_05: He can't see, The cardinal said, I pecked his eyes blind.
ST_MainDialogue.MT_DMP01_01_0021_09: He's really ugly, The thrush said, I won't sing at the wedding.
ST_MainDialogue.MT_DMP01_01_0021_01: He's getting married, The sparrow said, tomorrow.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00301_004: He said he'd come up with the best menu for me for the new season and help me win more stars in this year's La Palourde Blanche! And he even gave me this new knife for me to come up with new dishes.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_005: He said he'll pass for now.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00301_024: He said he could help my restaurant earn more stars in this year's La Palourde Blanche! Then he gave me a knife to use for practicing new dishes.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC01104_001: Arghh… Where can you find a good spokesperson nowadays?
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_006: Since we thought you would arrive later, Taygedo and I were organizing the storage room. I apologize for any inconvenience.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_116: …and the price she paid for this eternal moment… exiling herself out of the mortal world, living without worry or care, without joy or sorrow, without thought or feeling.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_019: From now on, as long as I am with you… As long as our family lives together in harmony…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC00813_001: I might not have another chance like this. Tch, I better make the most of this.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_013: I guess they sufficed as entertainment.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_064: Given how slick this crew is, Ms. Thief will vanish with the loot before we get ourselves out of here.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_098: The mission failed, but your expertise kept us safe. Let's meet up with Miss Hotori.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC028_029: Lady Inanna is pretty open-minded. I heard she often asks for advice from common folks.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC010_019: Eibon has always been rather peaceful. We were only more recently antagonized by the Scarlet Letter.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_007: Many of the items Eibon sells are anomaly artifacts, not just ordinary antiques. Rest assured, your ability will be put to good use here.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_066: Eibon accepted the commission. There's no reason to break our contract.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_020: If Eibon can't handle it, we might give you a little surprise…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_007: Eibon sometimes does business with them, but Hotori told us not to get too close…
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC001_016: Eibon's business isn't great, and Hotori senpai often ends up buying fake antiques at high prices, so the shop relies on accepting <blue>Anomaly Commissions</> from the city…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_016: Eibon's safety is my responsibility. This time… I left my guard down.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC01001_008: The owner of Eibon came too? Is it serious?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_003: Eibon's owner, I hope you've been well.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC001_014: Eibon's revenue… is only enough to cover renting a <blue>Grumble</> storefront on Hankaku Street.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC002_015: If anyone from Eibon discovers new leads, please contact BAC as soon as you can.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_073: Iroi, you said you saw a teddy bear. Can you tell us more?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_072: Iroi…? When did you get here?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_035: Illica, Haniel, and Hathor will go in as security and waitstaff.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1055_014: She's never, ever going to take anyone from me again.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_063: All creatures abide by the laws of nature: birth, aging, sickness, and death. Those who defy them must pay a price. Even Espers with near-infinite lifespans pay a price when they gain their abilities.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_066: Maybe… it needs to be opened from the other side?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_003: Maybe Kiroumaru learned how to shop online?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_043: Could this be how the Constantine family mansion looks now? The desolation we just saw could be an illusion to hide this place.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_075: I'm sharing these concerns with you, Appraiser, in hopes that we can work together during the upcoming "Operation Love Confession" and be prepared to adapt to any unexpected situations.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_025: Who would spread rumors on Bagel to cause panic?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_031: Talking white snakes, fish flying in the air… and other creatures whose names I can't even recall…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_010: People say this pawnshop only shows up on the night of the 15th of every month… and all your wishes can come true as long as you're willing to pay the price.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00201_004: A place that makes all your wishes come true for you as long as you're willing to pay the price.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_147: How are your wounds? You should rest earlier tonight!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_031: Forging an Ebisu invitation? If we're caught, it'll be bad…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_060: There seem to be a lot of clues, but there isn't a way to connect them together…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC012_003: Seems that… similar puppets appeared overnight in populated areas throughout Hethereau. There are five of them so far.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC020_009: Looks like it has nothing to do with you.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC021_020: But… I once performed a divination for another woman with the same result. Your might share similar fates…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_039: But it doesn't help much with the issue at hand.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_056: But the fight didn't last long. I was just getting started when he ran off!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC010_029: But at this point, if we don't take any action, we're only going to worry more.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_073: But you… just because he worried you'd get cavities and hid the candy jar on a high shelf, you complained to Mother that your brother was giving you a harsh diet.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_125: But you don't need to apologize to me. We'll forgive you, and Mother will still love you. You're still our adorable little one, our innocent troublemaker.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_030: You also suggested that she should seek help from Eibon.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_079: What you just remembered was from when you were little… If you can remember more, maybe we can get closer to the truth.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_008: But even though my goal was fulfilled long ago, these salons kept going, one after another.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_104: But she's also brave, passionate, and has a strong sense of camaraderie. Everyone appreciates how she gives it her all.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC021_026: But she still yearned for lasting companionship and loyalty, so she sought divination from me to find a way to change things.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_050: But she ruined all of this… When she was born, that cursed registry appeared in our home…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC086A_010: But that isn't what she needs.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_061: But fortunately, even when the numbers reach zero, you won't pass away.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1013_015: However, processes and rules are in place for a reason. If I make an exception out of this case, I would not be doing my job properly.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_011: We've been waiting to relive these moments with you.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_017: But I was a wanted person then and didn't really have the time to think it all through, and I pushed the door… and walked in!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC015_020: But I found the expense records of the "Tales of Nil" editor. Besides the publisher and home, he frequently visits a residential address…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_060: But I can feel this… ever since I got here, I've been having a sense of… nostalgia.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_232: But I still wanted to stop by and thank you in person.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_180: But that bright red… is like a warning.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_023: But… there seems to be quite a big gap between what this new client told us and what we heard from the manga artist before…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC04306_003: But for some reason, when I woke up the next day, I found the whole thing had collapsed into a puddle on the floor, back to its original formless state…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC06112_006: Just remember, no fish are allowed here!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_040: But just like Taygedo said, it'll be really hard to forget such a special performance in the future!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_038: But Mother still felt lonely. She was still yearning for more. As long as Mother's wish remained unfulfilled, more "children" would continue to come to her side…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_007: But this is your last chance… So, for both Taygedo and Tako, I'll do my best to help. At the very least, let's make this meeting as wonderful as you both imagined.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_010: But looking back now, the whole thing was pretty strange. The package was marked "fragile," and the delivery person told me to handle it carefully, but the packaging was flimsy.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_157: Hey. What matters now is that you're Daffodill from the Eibon Antique Shop.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Jin_00003: At least for now, {Gender}|gender(he,she) is on our side, right?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_049: It shouldn't be like this. As your creations, we are willing to warm your empty heart forever and bring you to the happiness you long for, until you no longer need us.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_211: But my family is still calling out to me. I still have a chance, right?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC011_022: But if that's the case, I wouldn't be the one who's connected to the anomaly.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_050: But it was so tall, and I was too scared to climb down the same way…
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Nelly_00010: Low threat anomalies are relatively safe, but please still be careful.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_078: As the <blue>strongest, supernatural, and intuitive duo</> of Eibon, the two of us teamed up and still made a mistake.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_005: Cheating doesn't count! Who broke my <TypingTitle titlename="Bicycle" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">Speedy Torny</> once!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_042: You don't know…? Weren't you there?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_001: H-hello? Is this Eibon? Are you anomaly… hunters?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_003: You… you put sweet sauce and hot sauce together?!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00301_020: You… do you have any questions?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_030: He-Hello. Sorry for disturbing you this late…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC09306_001: You must have finally found your peace and discovered what you truly desire.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_094: You didn't join us… Did you discover something else?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_107: You won't. You've always been selfish, greedy and reckless. You betrayed the very purpose we were born to follow: to love Mother, to be with Mother, and exist only to fulfill her wishes…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_209: I'm sure you do. You just don't want to think about it—you can't stand the idea that your act of goodwill is nothing but selfishness.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_004: You're done speaking! The Boss said no, and it's a no. Leave.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_108: You shouldn't apologize to me. Have you ever thought about… our Mother, our Mother who exists outside the flow of time? What could be her ultimate fate?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_110: Why did you want to kill her?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_032: Have you been to a signing event?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC011_003: Are you here today to ask for the protection of the Colucci family?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02201_011: Wait, have you guys seen Dandelion?! Could you just tell me where he is now? It's been 331 days since he went missing and I really miss him!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC01401_029: You can leave… If further investigation is needed, please… cooperate…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_160: Do you… all hate me? If that's true, why were you waiting under the tree to catch me?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_084: If you have trouble selling, you can consign it to Eibon. We only take a 5% commission!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_061: If only you two could be half as quiet as Hathor.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_049: Daffodill must come along. Others can join us too. I don't have stupid rules about not getting others involved.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02501_018: You can investigate freely, just please be mindful of the arrangement. I don't want his work disrupted.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC010_016: You're back. How was the trip?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009_043: You came back just in time, saved me the work of repeating it.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC028_001: Greetings! On behalf of the Sunward Resort, I sincerely thank you for visiting the island!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_029: One of you can stay behind.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC015_007: Didn't your boss tell you, in business, impatience is the enemy?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC02303_003: Haven't you heard? It's pretty popular lately. It's a new anomaly toy from DSD.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC009_013: You take care of her. I'll try to find a way.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00301_018: Just you wait. I'll sue you! I'll sue you all!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC009_012: See for yourselves, why don't ya?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_017: How about you go ask Fuuka? She also saw the anomaly in the parking lot that day… I think.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00301_017: If this freaks you out, I can totally take this somewhere else!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_088: You said the BAC found cards in the pockets of the puppets, and those cards were similar to the one I got… That means I'm connected to the puppets.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC015_021: Could it be the author's address?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC009_007: Now, who do we have to thank for all this, hmm?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_025: Hey, there is a lot more to manga drawing than meets the eye here!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_159: You! You threatened Daffodill, took the helm away from Thyme, and did a lot of bad things before this… What are you trying to achieve?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC009_011: I can tell you believe in her.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_041: That's one hell of a request to make.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_087: You used shapeshifting to exploit the utmost trust of a kid. How despicable.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_098: All you did was watch a replay of how our family met our demise. You must have enjoyed how we cursed ones relive our miseries day after day.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_115: Just keep in mind, if I'm not around and trouble brews, Sterry's folks are safe to work with.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_071: You heard what she said. Can we go now?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_043: So you heard it all, huh? Write down your contact info. I'll give your thing back to you when this guy pukes it out.
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC005_Alphard_00016: You appeared with an unknown anomaly, both undetectable by the Wertheimer Index. We have never seen anything like this.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_005: You fell asleep in that cramped cabinet. When you woke up, you were so groggy, that you forgot where you were and what you were doing…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_113: You could give us a better explanation.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_072: You ran around Elliott each day, saying you desperately wanted to grow as tall as he was, so he manged your diet and made sure you drank milk.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_122: Looks like you've had a bit too much…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_034: Hello, Jiuyuan, do I need to prepare anything?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00910_002: Hello there, interested in football as well?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_019: Hi, we have an appointment with Toshi.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Nelly_00005: To her, you probably smell like cocoa.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_086: Do you have memories of what we just saw?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_063: Stop avoiding my question! I know you're smart enough to have figured this whole thing out already!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_059: I shouldn't need to fetch you at Eibon, right?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_077: You must be somehow connected to the family. Whoever brought us here knows that.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_121: Are you really sure this is the whole thing?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1013_024: You're smart and tougher than I thought. Down to the final move, you almost threw the chessboard into chaos.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_039: You're shaking it too hard! Chill. Kiroumaru is probably going to puke again in a bit.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1054_002: How could you…? Since you went through all that trouble to find me, I can't refuse to go back…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_074: And how are you? Are you okay? Her Esper Ability can affect people's minds through auditory and visual hallucinations.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02501_003: So you assumed I'm Landric's PR just from the branding?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_082: You were always the worst at hiding. Anyone could find you easily.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_048: You wish! By the way, I was hoping to wake up as strong as Master Daffodill tomorrow!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_110: You're saying Renee chose eternal life, like Lady Dolores?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_103: You left all the painful memories of home with me, so you could live carefree in your blissful ignorance.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_032: Well, about that… I think it's found itself a job already!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_119: Are you angry with me? I was too naughty… I hope I didn't interrupt your salon…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_100: Have you ever wondered why you forgot this home—forgot us? Were you forced to forget, or were you unwilling to look back?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_024: You must be satisfied, but Jenson really took a big hit.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_066: You mean Fuuka, who witnessed our battle with the Debt Collector last night.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_024: Just like your first answer, you made a choice before. That choice allowed you to return here by yourself, but it also made you forget everything, including us.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_034: Your friend knows what's going on! What else did she say?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_166: Why would I believe anything spoken out of your mouth?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_037: You came at the right time! Your visit has inspired me. Mind if I borrow today's events as material?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_052: You are connected to this family after all.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_150: You don't respect their wishes. You're imprisoning them here just because you think you're doing something "good."
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC09306_004: You deserve all the happiness in the world… Bless you, my friend.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_041: Speaking of which, your "Tales of Nil" only just started gaining traction, right? Wait…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1049_005: Your master helped our family solve quite a few troubles in the past. Mother still can't stop talking about Daffodill's moves.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC020_017: Since you were able to open the door with your wish, then there is something in here that belongs to you.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_063: You really are different from your siblings.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_197: Look, another letter: R. I've always carried this puppet around. Why is there a red letter etched to it too?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_034: It's way past your bedtime, little troublemaker.

ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC04439_001: Hello there. What can I do to help you?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02301_006: Hello, is there anything you need help with?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1018_013: She would have to face them if you bring her out. Isn't that too cruel?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_062: You were long banished from this world by "that thing"… You have never lived in the "present." Even when the clock of fate dictated your end… as long as "that thing" offers you protection, you exist beyond the laws of nature.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC09001_001: Are you inquiring about… a men's suit that would fit this oddity's measurements?
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_020: So you want us to deal with the anomaly at the Photo Studio and reopen it as soon as possible?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1018_023: You seem to be angry… Why?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_015: So you're saying that your dog has been gone for about a year now and recently showed up in the manga?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_016: The Fire Phoenix from one of your works burned itself down to help its owner. Does that have to do with Pawn Moonlight?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC010_013: Please, have a seat and tell us more.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_003: Intel… wait, the Sterry Express that we worked with?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00803_005: Ebisu took on a big contract back then around New Helios. Unfortunately, luck wasn't on their side…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC01401_025: Ebisu always welcomes those who respect auction rules. However, those who disrupt the order are no longer our friends.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_089: Ebisu has the right to set the rules for Nantanì's space. Breaking them triggers Nantanì's security ability.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_058: Is Ebisu's security anomaly also a rule-based one? Nantanì is its name, right?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_032: Ebisu's auction, eh? The food and drinks alone will make the trip worth it.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_018: Auctions at Ebisu are always one of a kind.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_007: Are you out of your mind? Do you really think a shut-in manga artist would go out of her way to kidnap a dog when she barely even wants to go downstairs for food?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC01308_003: This is my last chance to find her source of immortality!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_065: Besides the good booze, tomorrow night's probably gonna be a headache. Best to turn in early.
ST_MainDialogue.MT01_04_NPC05612_001: Hey, get in line if you want to butter up the missus! Take turns like everyone else. You're not the only ones who need something from her!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_009: I apologize for not introducing myself first.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC012_021: It appears this plan was put together rather hastily, with many aspects left unchecked for feasibility. However, so far… things seem to be proceeding relatively smoothly.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC074A_008: Wanna know where she went? Psst, let me give you a hint, a kind woman told me about this secret place.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC09001_009: Trying on clothes is fine… but if any items are damaged, you'll be responsible for the cost…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_113: Do you remember now? That most selfish and greedy wish you made to our mother?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_032: Do you remember? About the time our family spent here?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_038: As expected, Michael Pay did his best.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC08901_012: If you're interested, why not try creating your own Imaginadough model in our demo area? If you like what you make, you can take it home with you! For checkout, please head to the front counter!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_055: Thanks for your help. You've worked hard.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Zero_00012: Thank you for your help. Mint, let's go.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00911_007: Thank you for your kindness… not many would spare a glance for a drunk in the corner.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_054: Thanks for giving it a try! I must get back to work now!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_025: Thank you for choosing Eibon. Please allow us some time to prepare and my colleague will be with you in a minute.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_018: Thank you for your understanding. We'll take our leave now.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_023: Thank you for your coffee, Adler.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC010_016: Thank you for choosing Eibon. The invoice has been sent to your shop owner's email address.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00401_013: Thank you, Jenson. Luck always favors those who keep their word!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_087: And he disappeared before it could—
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_091: I… don't understand. Do you mean there are rules I should follow here?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC086A_011: I… will carry a melancholy for what has befallen her. When does this future arrive? I cannot bear for that day to be close at hand.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC001_022: I… I… I'll be right back! And you're the most understanding person in the whole wide world, Coco—!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_098: I… I didn't mean to, big sis…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_039: I… I don't know. I don't remember.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02201_035: I… I don't know where Pawn Moonlight is exactly. After reading the manga, I came to Hethereau to visit Cake Sweeper Sensei and got a new clue about Dandelion.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02201_036: I… I will keep looking. I must find Dandelion!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_038: I… uhh… I'm in charge of ensuring your safety during the outing.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1018_048: Selfish…? What do you know about me? Have you ever been through pains you couldn't face, or losses you couldn't take back?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02201_026: I wanna go, too! Dandelion is waiting for me there.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC011_033: I'll do everything right without messing up again…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1049_015: I thought she was hallucinating at first, but on the way home, she told me that this weird thing happens every night at 9 PM. It didn't sound like she was lying…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_010: Though you might have forgotten or… abandoned us, we've been waiting for you all this time.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00301_022: I don't care how it's done. As long as the problem is solved, you'll get a handsome reward.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_131: …I wouldn't… I wouldn't know what I wanted, and I wouldn't know what I could do. I wouldn't even remember what I've ever done…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1055_005: I don't remember where I came from, but I remember what I need to do.
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC006_Zero_00003: I don't need to stay here for further observation?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00201_003: I met Kenneth at a corporate dinner party. A little while ago, he learned that I'd been troubled by my work with Landric, so he asked to meet up and told me about Pawn Moonlight.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC021_029: I'm not sure if this helped her, but I remember her face when she left… She seemed more at ease.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_145: And I woke up because of Mom's magic…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_025: I'll have the same! I don't know about the other stuff at this place, but I like the spicy chicken rice since it doesn't have those gross green peas.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_069: Something's going on. The way Nanally described it and how it appeared to me don't match.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_252: I lived a very different day today.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1018_043: What do I exist for in the world…? What is the meaning of life?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_162: I thought… you left me behind.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_189: I thought we were "it", so we can find my siblings.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_163: We are a family, and we'll always be together…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC010_039: We couldn't find you, so we called Mint. Luckily, she helped find—
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_080: Let's look around. Maybe we can find the key to your memories.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_054: We're not its target. Renee is.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_013: We also don't have any leads.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC06804_005: We traverse through history, seeking out beauty buried beneath the sands of time. By bringing these treasures into the light, we allow clients from all corners of the world to witness magnificent art.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_018: Whatever time we have left, we must treasure every moment together.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_014: We will look out for more leads.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_059: Let's split up. Adler, can you take a look at the resort? All Eibon members are registered for the ticket package. You should be able to enter without a physical ticket.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC008_002: We tried to calm her down, but Nanally insists that she was the reason why Daffodill got injured.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC019_005: We're just passing through. Strictly speaking, Dandelion is the real owner of Pawn Moonlight.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_018: We're covered with the disguise anomaly <blue>Lar</>. It can be… a bit unstable occasionally.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_104: There was one bell chime when we came in. The salon started at one o'clock.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_040: Our existence, our calling, and our purpose…
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Jin_00001: Our director is still as rigid as ever.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02501_013: We've searched everywhere, but there's no sign of him. While we can't completely rule out a kidnapping for ransom, no one has contacted us.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC011_011: We've done all we can. Now it's Taygedo's time to shine!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC008_018: We're always on a half-off sale…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_026: Fuuka, we'd like to ask about the strange thing happening to Renee. Can you tell us about it?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_032: We want to know about the bird.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_013: We want to pay a visit to the Sunward Resort on the island.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_037: All of us shared Mother's gift of eternity. In return, we brought her laughter and companionship. The happy times seemed to last forever.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00910_003: We're planning to organize an anomaly football league. The rules would be mostly the same as regular football, just with anomalies competing against each other.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_055: We don't know it's real name. Nanally has been calling it the "Debt Collector."
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_013: We have two important leads. First, the puppet was delivered to Eibon by a fake delivery person.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC022_008: We woke up together each day, combed each other's hair, patched up each other's wounds in the night… and when the moon shone on sister's skin, ahhh…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_111: Our findings regarding the owner of Pawn Moonlight align closer with the manga artist.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Zero_00022: We're getting closer to the source of all this noise.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Zero_00026: We're getting closer to the source of all this noise.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_010: Could the person we're looking for have been taken by that dog, like the bird?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_190: We'll tread in the water to see who makes the bigger splash. Adler will set up tents and barbecues, and we'll make your favorite double patty meat pies with cheese!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC008_009: Shouldn't we watch Taygedo's show from a bit further away? I mean, only a dummy like him wouldn't find it suspicious to see so many similar faces in one day!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_002: When did this tiny alley by my stall turn into private parking for some extravagant boss? Don't forget to pay your fees!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00401_001: I think I heard Fons calling.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_032: Now, on the count of three. Three, two, one…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_047: Hey, I'll go first! I want old man to put cheese eggrolls in my lunch tomorrow!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_120: Hey, I'll go first! I want old man to put cheese eggrolls in my lunch tomorrow!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC009_004: My friends in BAC told me your shop isn't doing too well…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_187: Let me hand them over to Nanally.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_060: I'll go visit Blackbird at the Witch's House. Maybe she can help.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_051: No way, did it really work?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_040: I'm just a taxi driver who's always been alone. How could I be connected to some strange family…?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_003: I just didn't want you to see those people too early… to witness the greed, foolishness, and ugliness of those who long for so-called immortality.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC020_008: I was just trying to check why the costs weren't being paid yet.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_019: I water flowers like a normal person.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_011: I can only confirm whether the item is an anomaly and its general intensity fluctuations. As for specific abilities…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02201_013: My name is Boomboom, and I came to Hethereau to look for my dog—Dandelion, that is. I found Dandelion on my way home from a convenience store. He was trying to fish a cookie out of the trash can, but then the can flipped and landed right on its head…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00910_006: Not that I go around telling everyone I used to be a quarterback or anything.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_027: I doubt Ebisu sends invitations to all upstanding citizens.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC021_014: I could do a divination for Renee. Maybe we can find something.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC01001_014: I can double the payment! Please handle it properly, I'm counting on you all!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_016: I consider myself to have the Disguise of the Year! With today's look, even <TypingTitle titlename="Detective Manga Protag" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">Mr. Ten</> from <TypingTitle titlename="Manga" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">Case in Point</> wouldn't suspect a thing out of me!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC008_007: I didn't say I wanted to go!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1018_017: I promise, other than those unnecessary burdens, everything else will remain unchanged.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC067A_019: Me…? Yohoho, as long as she remembers me…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_064: Taygedo and I met Mismo in Moby-Dick.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC019_003: Mismo and I… for certain reasons, we've been drifting from city to city.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC011_058: I'm returning to Eibon with the Appraiser. Let's go back together!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC020_016: Otro said that those… Everything in this pawn shop has its destined owner.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009_040: As for me, I'll be waiting at Eibon for your good news.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC011_072: I'm going back to my room.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_014: I'm learning from my master! Integrate every bit of training into daily life! Using the weight of the watering can to increase the training intensity. How's that? Pretty clever, right!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_049: I'm thinking, if she was put on the Bureau's watchlist like Adler said before, would the Bureau have a better idea of what she's up to?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_226: I'm looking for a little pink tiger.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_157: Did I steal Mom's love away from the other siblings? Did I even take away their lives…?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_056: I think I saw that too.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_104: I think I'm starting to remember… she was the sister who caught me when I fell from the tree…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_114: I've got zero interest in cleaning up others' mess.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_082: In any case, these things aren't on the same level as that censer that could spit out a bird!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00401_012: I've done my best, Jenson. I won't be able to use my ability again for a week…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_009: I did not think too much at the time, so I signed and took it into to the shop.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_202: I'm so sorry, I'm so sorry…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_016: I must correct this mistake. And the catalyst for that change is you, my dear. My little petal.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_040: How should I repay you? Hmm, let me think, how about I give you some free manga?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC020_019: How would I know anything about your wish? Go ask him yourself if you don't want it.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_037: How was I supposed to know it would respond?!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC008_019: I feel like I've heard that many times before.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_238: For me… the Eternal Present negated the meaning of time. I gradually lost touch with my past, and became unaware of everything happening around me…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC011_023: The kind of connection I'm looking for is… one and only, undeniable and untouchable…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_001: I don't think it's part of Hotori's collection.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC021_022: I think that was because she lived for far too long.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_181: I don't think Mom did this.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC009_009: Let me think… I'll tell you what, how about you give us a group photo when it's all done? We can display it in our shop, free advertising for you!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_102: I don't think the Bella we met is a real person. Remember how this is an Anomalous Realm?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_022: I think the puppets should be ordinary puppets. They were simply in proximity to an anomaly…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_068: I want a pair of <TypingTitle titlename="Anomaly" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">Ora Punchers</>!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_150: I remember many, many things now. I had tea with my siblings. We also played hide and seek at home.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_201: I don't have an answer, and I may not be qualified to respond…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC009_027: Let's see… where did I put it…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC010_026: The worst case scenario… is that Nanally rushes into danger alone to look for Daffodill.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1018_011: You can take away the other Nanally, but not the real one.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02501_015: Our request is simple—find him, and fast.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_099: I can't say I know how you feel, but I think in your last moments, you should live free and do what you want.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_066: I understand. As you wish, Mother.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC001_007: Got it, got it! There's nothing good about the city anyway! Commutes are crowded, rent is high, and these big things are ugly, ugly, ugly, and not interesting at all!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC02502_002: I'm an agent from First Agency, and your arrival with Sterry Express has caused quite a stir around here.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_100: I'm an agent from First Agency, and your arrival with Sterry Express has caused quite a stir around here.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1054_012: I'm messed up. I can never be the head of the family. Was I swinging my fists for justice? Never. I was just… just scared that you'd leave me because I was weak.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC028_002: My name is Iroi. I'm in charge of taking care of you today.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_279: Am I the last one to be found? Hehe! That means… I almost won, right? Next time, I'm going to hide somewhere no one can find!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1018_036: Who am I…? It's been a while someone asked me this question. Call me Thyme.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1055_017: I once met a strange person under this tree. She said she needed me, so she took me back home.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC015_011: I like dealing with straightforward, clever people. I think we'll get along—
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC04306_001: I absolutely love cats, so I wanted some cat-themed decorations. I molded the Imaginadough into little cat shapes.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC009_020: I have a feeling Eibon is going to get busy…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00201_005: I thought it was a scam at first, until… we saw the giant door up in the mountain and we pushed it open…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_052: I'll tell you! Renee came to our shop because she wanted us to deal with some weird thing that appears every night at nine o'clock to attack her.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_044: Let me see if there's a good angle to climb. It's been a while, I'm not sure if I can do it…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_100: So I really am part of the Constantine family? I'm her daughter…?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_145: I'm fine, but Daffodill… are you okay?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_134: No! I didn't forget you on purpose, big sis… It's not like that…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_015: Can I take a look at it?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC086A_008: I don't want to answer that right now! You should realize that what you just told me is a truly terrible thing! You are hinting at the tragic fate that awaits my dear, poor Mistress and her companion…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_118: My dear treasure, wearing your heart on your sleeve might not win you any fans, you know.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1055_008: My parents were archaeologists. When I was younger, they said, "If you want to see the true nature of things, you need to look from different angles, as if using a kaleidoscope."
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02201_010: I'm talking about my dog! It looks like… it's the dog from the last chapter of your manga! It looks exactly the same as my Dandelion!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_019: There goes one of my reliable side gigs! The Coluccis' funds are running low…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_049: You're gonna get cursed and hit the pity every time!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC011_017: Let me see… <blue>"Dear Mr. Adler, thank you so much for risking your life to save me that day"</>… pfft!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_088: Oh, I got it, I got it! The pawnshop owner must have regretted the deal, so he coaxed Dandelion into stealing the censer!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC011_009: I know her! She also sponsored the TV show we were watching! She's got a good eye for these things!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC011_032: I know adolescents aren't allowed to serve as guarantors, but I promise I'll be absolutely responsible and take care of my anomaly!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1043_005: I know! It's a world where you're all alone. No Mommy, no big brothers or sisters, just a world that's always dark.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_213: I promised the Ichi-daime to bring her back, so please step away.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_187: I came back here, because there was something I can do, right…?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_090: I can sense Lady Dolores's sincere feelings as she cared for her children. Though they are puppets, she treated them as real children. In contrast, the other "Mother" simply manipulated the children she collected into decorative pieces for her own fancy…
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Zero_00016: I can feel it's different from the surroundings.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_237: I was tossed outside the flow of time, and taken away from this world, where the years still pass and the seasons still change.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_040: I'll be mingling with some regulars shortly. Before the auction kicks off, feel free to get comfy, appraiser.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_116: I'm going to see Lady Dolores now…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_083: My brain is getting fried from what the guests are saying. So many conversations…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC021_002: Fog—I see all things in a mirror.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC008_010: The Nanally I knew would never think like this! You don't believe in your master?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_069: I remember hearing someone at DSD say there was something odd about Imaginadough, but I didn't think much of it at the time…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_091: Could I have been… their driver? I'm pretty confident in my driving skills.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_223: I told her I wanted to grow up fast.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_066: I thought he was just being cautious.
