ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC011_014: Who could've seen this coming? We were just winging it ourselves!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_050: A rising star in the bartending world presents this exclusive brew specially crafted for the appraiser—the limited edition Blinky Super Walker!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_088: The perfumer, Dandelion, the manga artist, the cook, and us… more and more people are getting involved with Pawn Moonlight…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_062: If you didn't kidnap the perfumer, then what's up with Dandelion?
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC009_016: Thanks, boss. If you come to Eibon, we'll give you a friendly discount, half off!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_042: Thank you. We'll ensure everything is taken care of.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_233: Thank you, Appraiser, Nanally, and… Daffodill's not here? Please send her my gratitude…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_079: Thank you for your understanding, Appraiser.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_272: Mom, thank you for giving me life.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_146: Thank you for helping me remember all of this, big sis.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_073: Thank you, appraiser. Let's go all out and snatch it.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_052: Thank you, Mr. Pay, my friend. I hope the agreed reward will be satisfactory.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02201_037: Thanks for all your help. Dandelion and I will be heading home in a few days.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_023: Thank you all so much! I'll treasure these!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_Player_043: Thank you all. As for communication, Director also gave me Chuppa.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC02303_001: Thank you for shopping with us. The red rose is a passionate choice of flower… may the passion be understood by the special someone.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_Player_024: Thank you, Adler, and thank you, Taygedo.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_064: Blackbird, thank you for helping us. We'll go find the others now, and we'll pay attention to the leads you shared with us.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_085: (thinking) Bella… that sounds familiar. Very familiar… extremely familiar…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_293: Bella told me I'd feel better if I cry.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_069: Greed will make you sink deeper into the mire…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC021_003: Greetings. Welcome to the Witch's House.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC021_001: Greetings. Welcome to the Witch's House.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02501_007: Your shop's utility bills, insurance, and fines for unauthorized ads are overdue.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_008: I'm terribly sorry to bother you in the morning, but I do have something to ask…
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_Player_012: Just walking here makes me want to leave as soon as possible…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC011_077: Let's go! Appraiser, back to Eibon!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC009_010: Come on, let's go. I'll try to get some Fons out of her.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_038: Let's go! It's been a while since I had Food First. I'm craving for their hamburger steaks! Hey, old man! We won't be back for dinner tonight!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC067A_014: The more she holds that childlike spirit, the easier it is for her to bypass the rules. She really hasn't changed much, yohoho.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_007: The more tricky something is, the more it's worth handling. Since it's a wine tasting, let's start with some "appetizers" to whet our appetite.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC0160_001: Did they run away? Check over there!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC028_038: Ran away already…? Well, have fun visiting the island.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_103: It's the same time as Kenneth's second entry into the pawnshop… That's what Edgar is trying to tell us.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC010_004: Keeping up with anomaly trends is part of Eibon's operations, so I'm an avid reader of <blue>Anomalies Guide</>.
ST_MainDialogue.MT_DMP01_01_0018_05: Dance, dance, the curtain stays up like a dream.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_099: The audience, forgetting they were part of the play, denies their sins… as if forgetting would make it all go away.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_EC_NPC034A_005: Dealing with huge anomalies, bringing balance to chaos, rescuing people in need, gaining fame, fortune, and love!☆
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_082: Thank you for your effort in bringing it here.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_036: Thanks for your hard work, you two.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_193: Daffodill would be back, and she'd want to teach you about sand boxing.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_248: Daffodill isn't great with words, but you can always tell what she really means.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_028: Daffodill, you couldn't have expected this to happen!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC012_022: Did Daffodill really go back to the Scarlet Letter?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1049_022: Daffodill, you may be thorough, but you always get obsessed with details… same old habits.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_158: Daffodill! Nanally's been looking for you!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1013_033: Daffodill, as I promised, you're allowed to spare that little, dream-walking tiger. As for the other one—you know what to do.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_012: You insisted on taking that sculpture from the shop!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC009_008: Alphard woke me up this morning and invited me for a little chat. I thought it was about Ebisu.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_082: We're not sure yet. We suspect the bear shapeshifted and abducted Nanally. I'll let you know if we make any progress.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_092: Two more left. The mission is more important. Let's go.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_035: Still feeling sad about the Mighty King?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC008_021: Still faking it? Tell us where Nanally is!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_051: Luckily, someone caught me… Huh? Was it my sister… or Mom…?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00201_015: Thank God Mismo came to my rescue…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_051: Thank goodness for Adler. He's really reliable.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC001_021: I'll bring it back from the Bureau later…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1054_009: …or just a bad imitation of other people, like this bottle cap, naively thinking that I'd be able to hold onto my precious "family."
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_010: Let's discuss the deal, Lady Jiuyuan.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC009_001: The kids are full of energy… Which photo studio commission did we take?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC011_065: Or… was it because… I let Master injure herself, and she's disappointed in me…?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_286: Or maybe he's just in a bad mood, like me.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_049: Or maybe ordinary people can't see it?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_022: Or was the kind of "happiness" you were looking for nothing but drifting through life in a daze, barely conscious?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_056: And the report for the puppetization case… Tch, that's going to be a lot of paperwork.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_013: There's one more person we haven't checked.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_030: Another member, Hathor, is currently handling a delivery. I'll introduce her later.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_032: It's two minutes before nine o'clock.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC021_013: Some are saying that when these missing people return after a few days, they act strange, as if they became different people. This must be an anomaly's doing.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_242: And you. Nanally has always been waiting for you.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_065: And I've got something even better, ta-da!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_054: And here's the limited edition candy the boss asked me to buy.
ST_MainDialogue.MainUI_Prologue_Mint_00012: Oh, and! We heard some voices, mumbling… It's getting clearer now!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_086: Plus, these pawn tickets clearly state the cost, and the cook isn't as clueless as he claims…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02501_005: You're rejecting our commission without hearing the details?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_061: Ahh, man, after running around so much today, getting home, relaxing for a bit… and now that Master mentions it… oof, sleepiness just hits you like a truck. Goodnight, Master! Goodnight, Appraiser!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC009_014: Quite the nostalgic anomaly. Alright, let's look for anything related to film.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC011_003: What are we waiting for? Let's help him out!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_041: Remember the grand opening photo of Film Orbit we saw on the second floor? It was taken with a film camera.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC010_012: Don't worry. Daffodill is tougher than we know. I'm sure she's fine and she'll return to us in no time.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1018_009: Also, beware of those who devour dreams. They resent how you walk without dreams, and they are ready to make a move on you.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_010: Was that… the same person… I saw?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_044: Are you sure this isn't some hallucination…? Like maybe she ate some weird shroom at dinner or something…
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC01001_003: That… that's just terrible… We have lots of appointments this week. We'll be in big trouble if we can't open…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_103: Wait, does this mean… fifty years ago, Renee should have…?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_006: Wait, doesn't this look just like the one in our shop? Are they from the same collection?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_012: This time I've got to outdo Haniel!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC009_009: The Director's tea is going to taste… even more bitter.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_060: I get it now! You mean that this is all a misunderstanding!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC01309_001: Isn't this Mr. Cordelein from Puka Group? I didn't expect to run into you here! If you have a moment, could I treat you to dinner? My parents are interested in…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_062: Isn't this the card from last night? That anomaly is back again?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_028: They seemed pretty nice, though, and they didn't turn me down, so I ended up taking a walk there with the brothers and your dog.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_098: Hasn't he been told everything clearly? Unless the cook was… forced to make the deal…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_033: Well… I'm just trying to put my thoughts together here… Alright, see, I stumbled into the place by pure luck. It was pitch black back then, so I don't really remember anything…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC02303_002: This… this is fake, it's a product I made with <blue>Imaginadough</> during my breaks, it's not a real diamond.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC021_010: This juncture can lead you to drastically different outcomes: either a triumphant comeback or an unexpected loss.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC019_010: There's no such thing as an Esper Ability that grants any wish in the world.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC067A_001: This girl, familiar. Like I met, before.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00038: That noise—ugh, what's that ugly thing?!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC012_007: OP claimed that one of his relatives was a victim, and if the anomaly isn't handled soon, Hethereau will become a city of puppets…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_069: Love-hate relations in this family are more complicated than you can imagine. But no matter how much you doubt it, you can't deny that everyone here has done so much for you.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00015: This should be… the nexus, right?
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00010: This anomaly has strong spatial abilities. Finding the nexus in such a large area… Ugh, I'm getting a headache!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC008_015: This room is dark, and the anomaly photos are clearer here than anywhere else. The culprit must be this room!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_060: Look at the time! I could zip back and catch "Gen Z's" new episode!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC019_007: This space exists according to Dandelion's will. The whole idea that a strong enough wish can open the door to Pawn Moonlight? That's something it put in place—like a sort of passkey.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_079: This is easy! I'm quite the hand at demolishing houses!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_022: Where did this bird come from, and where can we find it? And whose dog is it—
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_247: Don't worry. I have a solution.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_080: This one? No, not this… What about that one? Hmm… also not quite right!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_030: Well, then the gift is settled. Let's head back to the shop.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_012: Sounds like we could have it ready by tomorrow… What about the price?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_083: With so many transactions completed successfully, why breach Toshi's…
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC011_010: So many photos… I can't tell what they originally were anymore, can't be my glasses, right?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_023: You called us over with such a commotion. This commission must be quite challenging.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_014: That's amazing! You must get to try all the new candies as soon as they come out, right? Taygedo?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_028: That was… oddly kind of you?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_025: You found out about our treasures' ability so quickly, it's quite unpleasant.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_058: Nanally must have either went to the Sunward Resort, or went to look for Daffodill.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC008_020: Can't that be a good thing?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC01201_002: In that case, best to steer clear.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_009: Such a fat dog yet so nimble! What did it grab?
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_033: That being said… combining what we've seen so far, I have an idea of what it could be.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_068: I guess I should give it a proper try.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC009_003: Some of these missing people just vanished for days and then showed up out of nowhere, while others were never found. The ones who did come back had no memory of where they'd been. On top of that, they were oddly cheerful, almost suspiciously so.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_105: These wish-fulfilling items are like pawnshop loans. According to the pawn ticket, the contract officially takes effect the moment they are used.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00013: These things are called <blue>bio anomalies</>, a.k.a. <blue>oddities</>. They often appear with other types of anomalies.
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC006_Nelly_00005: Anomalies of this type are abundant and easy to miss, so the Bureau has authorized legal hunter groups to eliminate them.
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC003_Zero_00001: Are these numbers related to the anomaly fluctuation in the city?
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_Player_035: The photos here are very clear, with no signs of overexposure… Chuppa—
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC001_012: The headquarters of the direct branches are scattered in the big cities… Except for the Ghroth Island. Only a very few selected people know where they are.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC01302_003: These observations might inspire my next masterpiece on the news… or paper in the trash.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC015_019: This person was an obscure author a couple of months ago, with no contact info.
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC005_Alphard_00013: This contract is both a shackle and an opportunity for you—
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_090: Could this be related to the rules it follows? Let's go check the entrance hall..
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_029: This young lady was attacked by the puppetization anomaly tonight.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_041: Miss, let me escort you home.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02201_004: She doesn't seem to be here, though…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_012: See, as long as you're still alive, life is full of bottlenecks!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_042: They say that being a creator isn't about having creative streaks, but about having one long creative block. Anyway, two months ago, on the 15th, I was wandering around all night, avoiding my editor, hoping to stumble across some inspiration.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC010_006: These are Eibon's finest anomaly hunters. Feel free to share with them any troubles you have. I'll make some tea for you. Please wait a moment.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC010_007: These are our shop's best anomaly hunters. Feel free to share with them any troubles you have. I'll be back soon with some tea for you.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC011_014: I have been flustered in the past few days… I probably haven't slept well.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC019_015: Thank you for being such a good pal for the last six months.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_016: This lucrative commission was my negotiation…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_005: This pathetic charade… will soon be over.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_020: This dummy isn't leaving Eibon, stop trying!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_051: One night, the old carpenter sat at her workbench, designing the blueprints for her next child. All the puppets quietly stood by her.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC067A_015: That child has been trying to "protect" those around her to permanently "connect" with them.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_130: This thing… got back up again!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_037: This guy's lock-picking ad is plastered all over my delivery route!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_132: This is… my life right now. All this time, what have I been living for…?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_262: Perhaps this is the "flavors of life" people talk about.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC010_034: That's why it's strange. The staff couldn't find any related info in their database.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_242: That was the secret, or rather curse, of the "eternal life" Mom and I possessed.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_088: This is the crooked tree we saw when we first got here!
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Alphard_00002: This should be our first official meeting. Let's skip the boring pleasantries and get straight to the point.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_048: Does this mean we got one?
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_Player_002: Does that tower have some sort of monitoring function?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_093: This knife! Hmm… doesn't seem too handy as a weapon…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_234: I think I've seen this Goldfish at Sunward. Was it called… Bonzita?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_011: This is my special partner <TypingTitle titlename="Esper Ability" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">E.A.R</>. With it, we can communicate on a private channel during the auction!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_Player_004: This is my first time in Hethereau…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_036: This was Mother's miracle. She gave life to the wooden bodies of her puppet children…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_121: That's what the girl in the garden said.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_060: Is there a specific reason for doing it this way?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_024: Nothing beats living like this! Gotta say I really like this manga artist!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC009_002: I see… Let's all go together.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_Player_016: I'll go to Eibon first. You can go get your stuff.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_117: I'm so happy for you, Renee!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_Player_037: That explains the difference between the photos here and elsewhere…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00401_004: This is tricky and risky to replicate—
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC008_018: That must mean if the Teehee Bear did something to Nanally, it was at a location other than the resort.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_034: Looks like they might be at it for a while longer, huh…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_093: In this case, Kenneth has been to Pawn Moonlight more than once.
ST_MainDialogue.MainUI_Prologue_Zero_00004: Looks like we're getting closer to the nexus.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_042: Yup, pretty sure this Pawn Moonlight has got something to do with the perfumer.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC04439_003: A lot of effort went into the promotion. I heard a famous philanthropist, Inanna, was the sponsor.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_089: This time, you have to find all of us… We'll be waiting for you.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_011: This is starting to affect the citizens of Hethereau. Take me for example, I have a neighbor who never misses her daily dog walks, rain or shine, but she's scared of getting caught by the anomaly, and began to ask me to run errands…
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_004: My apologies. You must be the <blue>Appraiser</> our lady requested from the Director, right?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_065: Is this really a door? It feels so strange.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC009_024: This happens… more than you can imagine.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_045: This is kind of dangerous. I'm not sure whether to let the BAC know.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00029: This little guy is called Chuppa. It is also an oddity, but it is a friendly one!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_059: Looks like we're cleaning up Ebisu's mess. Follow Nantanì.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_007: Psh, just wait until I give you one each a house like this when we go big!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_222: These unexpected earnings… are from the ones who got robbed.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_010: Take it as a tribute from your lackey.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_034: Rare anomalies will differ from common ones. We trust your abilities will help us make the right call.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_015: And then I suddenly walked into a huge door!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_043: I was walking around when I bumped into this big door. Having ran out of ideas, I didn't want my editor to find me. So I opened the door and took a chance to find inspiration.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC001_001: This is Bridge Crossings, the old town area, with many famous old shops!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC008_020: She hasn't even had a drink… Who's going to wake her?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_056: This is all a token of Sir Taygedo's appreciation.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_067: Was there really a big mansion here before?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_002: Is this where Toshi was working from before he disappeared?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_011: All the clothes on display here are for humans. We'll need to ask if they have sizes that would fit Taygedo.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_077: The items here barely have any anomaly presence. Some are even entirely ordinary objects…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_013: My dear sister, this is the Constantine mansion trapped in the past.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC008_011: This is a photo studio. The anomaly is turning items into photos, so the culprit must be… the camera!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1018_019: Here, Dreamwalkers are drawn to the whirlpool and swept into the Corridor of Echoes, because they carry beliefs and ideals similar to mine.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_175: Everyone here believes her, especially Nanally.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_028: There are indeed more than three of us here.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC015_018: This bird and censer aren't documented anomalies. They appear in a manga called "Tales of Nil".
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_041: Let's go in to investigate. It's best if we regroup as soon as possible.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_005: Come on in! Chop chop! Before my editor comes for me!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC015_022: Without these skills, I wouldn't be Sterry Express's Top Courier.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_073: One of these days, I'll bring Nanally and Taygedo to clean this place out! And Mint, too. She's got an appetite on her.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC012_014: Fog, echoes of waves, and… a giant object? Is that where Nanally is?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1018_021: Here, those who flee from work become carefree children; those who flee from relationships live freely in solitude; and those who flee from their own weakness chase their heroic dreams for an eternity.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC021_002: I should be able to glimpse at their fate… through divination… and understand what they've been through…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_032: No need to drag Hotori into a petty crook roundup.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_009: Don't worry about the invitation. Jenson and his crew always find a way.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC11701_005: Then… I want to gobble canelés and play instruments in my own way.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_035: D-Dandelion…? It's in "Tales of Nil", too?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_074: D-Dandelion…? How is it mentioned in the "Tales of Nil"?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_071: …then Teehee Bears shapeshift to deceive children in seek of revenge. No wonder Nanally saw the bear as a tiger.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_007: That day, every guest witnessed the extraordinary commotion you caused. You completely ruined Mother's salon.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_085: When you started wailing that day, we came out of our hiding places… Do you remember what we told you?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC021_001: Um… if we can determine the identity of the names written on the cards, I may be able to help.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_046: Umm… a manga artist once said "If you're willing to pay the price, any wish can come true." So I was wondering… whether the condition of entering this Anomalous Realm is related to our wishes.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_025: The manga artist said… that all your wishes can come true as long as you're willing to pay the price, right? So I was thinking… that maybe we need to make a wish or something?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_054: Well… we aren't certain at this moment.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1018_028: That isn't something you can take away. Give it back.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC011_063: Could she also be a member of the Scarlet Letter?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1055_018: That one's scent is still lingering here… Nanally would have liked her a lot.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC009_017: I can't believe that one is still alive.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_067: That address belongs to the now defunct Constantine family…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC01308_001: That woman is finally stepping down from the stage… Tut-tut, shamelessly enjoying eternal youth… just because she had a deal with the devil!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_106: We should be able to approach Lady Dolores then.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_309: By then, I'll be sooooo tall, that Mom will be surprised! I'll be able to reach whatever Mom needs to reach!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009_012: I know of that perfumer. Young but quite skilled.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC027_004: Umm, we were just going in the same direction.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_144: Here, take a look at this. Turn the kaleidoscope, and it will show you the nature of things. Nanally, look at your own heart.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_184: Then what was this "game" she was talking about? Inanna seemed to know about it. Could it be related to the Scarlet Letter's plans?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_247: So, Nanally, what is your nature?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_042: Well then, shall we get going?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_022: Now then, we should prepare the gift for Tako tomorrow.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_066: So, about this big surprise in the plan, what exactly are they planning to…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC01401_005: Let's start with our first lot—
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_040: I think our time is up. Shall we head out?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC002_016: Very well, let's adjourn. Thank you very much for your assistance.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_009: So, what do you need us for?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00301_009: Just know YOU'RE making me do this!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_121: That's so weird…! Oh, but isn't that not too different from the Constantine family?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_066: What's the point of that? If I had such powers, I would totally… hehehe…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC015_014: Looking forward to working with you, Eibon's appraiser…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_034: I did try to look for it after, but I never found the door again no matter how hard I tried.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC019_002: The chef has been here before. He was here last time because he had a burning wish, but he… turned down the deal last time.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_077: That lady… oh, there she is.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009_021: Well, why did you choose our store, then?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009_030: Then go ahead and sue us. Let everyone see that the head chef of <TypingTitle titlename="Restaurant" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">Delichemy</> is a no-good, friend-kidnapping, and treacherous scoundrel.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_037: Where did you see Dandelion, though? This dog in the manga looks exactly like Dandelion, doesn't it?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_100: If the cook came to us, he obviously was having second thoughts!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1055_002: But that tiger… what is she like?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1054_018: Then what… does she swing her fists for?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1013_027: That was a fun one. I had more uses for the bear, but you just had to break it.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC009_003: That studio… is so hard to book! After we settle the commission, we can use their facilities for a new family photo… We have a new member, after all—
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_076: Alright then… Let's be gentle… Hellooo there…!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC008_011: Then don't say things like that!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_048: Alright. We just have to find someone who has an answer. Let's go.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_182: That's good to know. But what about the Dreamwalkers in the Corridor of Echoes? They were the missing persons. What happened to them?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_057: That's good to hear. Thank you.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC01001_016: The studio is counting on you!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_084: That's called a "reenactment" of the past.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC009_018: Thanks a lot! We'll be on our way then.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_005: Then that must be it… Allow me to introduce myself formally. I'm Adler, Eibon's caretaker, and this is our restorer, Taygedo.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00033: Then this must be it! Imagine… if I, nullify an anomaly even the seniors couldn't…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC01104_003: Let the underlings deal with that headache. Any interesting anomalies among today's selection?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_042: We'll make sure it's flawless. Special times call for special measures.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_EC_NPC034A_012: Isn't that even cooler than what's shown on TV?!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_093: So do you know who took the target item?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC022_007: The garden, the clean and marvelous rooms… that was our home. We used to sleep on the same bed when we were young…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC009_005: Well, the business of the BAC matters more than ours, so we'll comply.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC028_014: I think that was just the effect of Wakeybee collecting from your head.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_108: Then I… really am part of this family?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_037: Blackbird, thank you for your time. We'll head back now.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_014: We'll leave you to rest now. Hope you enjoy your time at Eibon.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_104: We'll be on our way then… Do you need a ride?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC008_015: We'll have to find this Boss Tiger to ask some questions. What does it look like?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_056: What do we do now, then? Are we supposed to start making wishes to this mountain like there is no tomorrow?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_022: Then I shall await your arrival at my store.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00035: Thanks in advance! You're as warm as a cup of hot cocoa on a winter day!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02501_010: I'll cut to the chase. We need you to find <blue>Toshi</>.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_065: Mismo was probably looking for Toshi at the time, but he was disguised as someone else.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00401_011: Then it becomes a real invitation, bound to the holder.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_257: It's a family restaurant, so maybe… it tastes similar to the food big brother made? They both have that homemade taste.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC009_022: The name refers to an ancient nautical astrolabe, used to find one's direction across different dimensions. The human form she takes is from her last contracted partner, Thyme.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_108: What's that? So many eyes in up there!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1049_020: That's because I later realized Renee must have gotten herself into trouble with some anomaly, so I thought of you…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_080: Of course. Or perhaps a newcomer to Sterry?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC00113_002: Of course. The BAC will provide reasonable compensation for losses incurred from taking up your time.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_035: If that's the case, shouldn't the recipient be you?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_268: In that case, the laws of nature will remain contradicted… and the Debt Collector would still come for me every night.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_161: I remember… it was getting late, but the house was so quiet, so empty. I remembered the ghost stories you told me, and suddenly felt the paintings were staring at me, and the tables and chairs were slowly moving.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00803_006: That incident dealt quite a blow to Ebisu. Today's grand setup isn't just about the well-known reasons—I'd say it's also their way of showing they've still got what it takes.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_086: That feeling is back again. Just hearing that name brings up this… nostalgia.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_027: Should we… bust the door down?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_115: That's the secret that granted eternal life… the secret that froze Mother's body and soul at that very moment…
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_Player_015: Then tell the car to come back. We'll go back and get it.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_096: And he played dumb in front of us!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC028_035: The large forest was unusually foggy… but since colleagues have told me that the longer one worked, the foggier one's memories gets, so I didn't think it was a big deal.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC010_005: Why not join Taygedo for a walk?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_020: Is the appraiser okay with that?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_059: Were you able to help her make a change?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_048: Well then, let's head inside and enjoy ourselves while we wait.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC011_050: We followed the requirements of signing on the manual and documenting the date. Nanally and Boss Tiger make a great team!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_031: Everything's all set. When we get to the signing event, you just need to check if the target is carrying the invitation.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00601_001: I shouldn't have spent two hours on makeup! What kind of true fan am I if I can't get Settyn's autograph…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_068: It's all based on relationship advice Edgar found in magazines.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_041: It's an adult's gathering, no place for wet-behind-the-ears kids.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02201_020: It's all my fault. I… I shouldn't have left Dandelion there!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_019: They are all good kids. If it's not too much trouble, could you get to know them a little?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1018_038: They're all dead. A long time ago. I've always, always, always been thinking…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_275: I already told you I'd win this time!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC011_004: I told you to call me Ichi-daime! This is my secret weapon—"Modern Moments, Time to shine, One Spray to Victory, Fluffy Tail Care Spray"!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_032: They say it's amazing for night photography, with a lovely sea breeze. It even ranked in the top three for the Bridge Crossings' annual best date spot poll…
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC008_004: We've got a customer? Let's check it out!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_038: As the invitee, I must be present…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC010_028: I will assist the shopkeeper in managing Eibon more carefully, so you can live with peace of mind. Since you joined Eibon, business has gradually improved. Thank you for your concern.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_046: Sir Taygedo and I… were once business partners. When my own enterprise fell on hard times, he came to my aid. I was so impressed by his character that I voluntarily became his butler to repay his kindness.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_001: I have an inkling of what this is about… but it's best if Taygedo explains it himself.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_051: I understand, Sir. This claw machine is likely rigged. Given your dislike for injustice, I know you're tempted to use your abilities to teach them a small lesson…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_010: The Appraiser and I will go with Taygedo now, to prepare what's needed. Edgar, can you handle the planning part?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_010: My name is Jenson. I manage the Sterry Express. I am honored to meet the appraiser of Eibon.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_008: Cool! I've never seen an ability like that!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_035: Were there… any monsters in there?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_060: They must be related…! What could be the missing link….?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00911_006: For hundreds of years… nothing's ever changed…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00702_003: An important guest has gone missing…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_077: What matters the most is not its physical form, but its <blue>rules</>. If an Ebisu auction item is taken away before it's sold, the rules represented by the anomaly will activate.
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC005_Alphard_00012: Due to your unique connection and keen perception of Anomaly Nexuses, we hope we could join efforts in containing Code Zero.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_036: The appraiser, Jiuyuan, and I will attend as guests.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_036: Appraiser, why don't you turn in early and recharge your batteries?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC011_053: Appraiser, don't you think his ears are cute?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC010_002: You're up early. It's nothing urgent, just the latest issue of the <blue>Anomalies Guide</>. I asked Taygedo to pick it up.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_013: The appraiser joining Eibon wasn't exactly a quiet event.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_045: Feel free to tour around. Make yourself at home.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_072: Do you think Renee and the Appraiser already went ahead of us?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_043: Appraiser and Mr. Adler, you're both so incredible! With you around, there's nothing to fear when the unexpected happens. This is the true power of Taygedo's Anomaly Hunters!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_017: Thank you, appraiser. We have no customers today, Nanally and the other two are on the second floor.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_048: If you're interested in us, that's even better.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC010_008: Appraiser, I assume you know that anomalies deemed too dangerous or too hard to control are contained at the Celaeno Compound.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_011: Your accommodation has been arranged. Please follow me.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_076: If you enjoy your time here, appraiser, feel free to visit us more often. Perhaps we could chat over some delicious food.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_081: Appraiser, you've done a lot for me! I have to step up! Besides, this is the first time I want to figure things out!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_028: The appraiser needs to come with me to confirm if he has the invitation.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC008_024: Appraiser? Hey! Can you hear me?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1054_005: Appraiser, you once asked me what this blue badge on my clothes meant. I said it was an important family token.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC021_014: Take extra care, Appraiser. Hope you have a safe trip.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_044: Appraiser, take a look at this.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_110: Oh… Appraiser, have you seen Master?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_055: Appraiser, try my newly learned craft!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_036: What do you think, Appraiser? Master? This is our first commission of the day! We'll help figure this out and see if there's really an anomaly causing trouble! Let's not disappoint this very tasteful person who recommended us!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_221: Appraiser, could we go see her? I just need to see her a bit more…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC010_032: Appraiser, we already arrived at Sunward, but we couldn't find Nanally. Neither did the staff members see her.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_015: Well, let's see what he's up to then. Shall we, Appraiser?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC011_046: Appraiser, you know it's fate when Spikey Hair meets Scar Beard, when Eyepatch meets Dog Tag, and when Nanally meets…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_042: Appraiser, is Sakiri with you guys?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_070: Knew I can count on you, Appraiser!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC010_014: Appraiser, can you go to the resort with Nanally? I need to sort out a few things with the boss…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_056: Appraiser, any other issues with the invitation?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_089: Bell chimes…? When the Debt Collector appeared, it also sounded like this…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_018: It's just money! When this is done with, I'll ask for a bonus for you from Boss lady.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC01001_006: Money is not an issue… I just need it done as soon as possible! Do I sign here?
ST_MainDialogue.MainUI_Prologue_Alphard_00002: If you still can't nullify the anomaly after locking onto the nexus, try to contain it. Don't waste a second.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_045: Ask if it can let us out of here!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC011_001: Since we're free, why don't you listen to my grand plan for our gang?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC010_003: You're right, but it's about low threat anomalies approved by the Bureau of Anomaly Control. The content is basic but very informative.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_019: Mr. Adler knows how to speak.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_006: Adler's coffee is just as fine.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_063: I understand what you're getting at, Adler. You want us to keep a close eye on Tako's reactions, right?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC012_023: Mr. Adler has always been quite popular with oddities, hasn't he?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_013: Let me go to the auction, then it's a deal.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC015_023: Complimentary service, I'll be delivering nearby. Want a ride?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC028_004: The natural scenery of the island is mesmerizing, and there are special anomalies to guide you.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC010_019: In addition to selling newspapers and books, White Whale also regularly holds book events.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02501_025: Besides the much-anticipated perfumer, the content of the consultation just now is all the information I have.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_259: Apart from trying interesting new things I'd enjoy, I also made sure to try a green pea flavored ice cream.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC011_069: Is there really nothing else we can do?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC074A_010: I tricked them. I tricked them all. They're all gone, every single one of them. And not just my guarantor, but the grownups and the children, too. TEEEHEEEEE!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_066: There's nothing here except for some skinny, crooked tree. How is there nothing else?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02301_009: Besides the passionate, popular "Gen Z" in Hethereau, there is also the youthful "Isekai? A Tennis Journey Starting from High School!"
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC001_011: Besides that, there's the <blue>Yggash Court</> in charge of intelligence, the <blue>Celaeno Compound</> for containment, the <blue>Zerogon Laboratory</> leading the research, and the <blue>Ghroth Island</> overseeing detention.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_078: That aside, Blackbird also told me that she's been handling cases of missing people related to anomalies. Could the "giant object" have something to do with this? Could it have affected Nanally?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_038: Are there any other strange things going on besides that?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02301_011: Besides that, "Monthly Romance" also just arrived.
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC006_Nelly_00002: Besides the Bureau, there are various groups and individuals handling anomaly containment and nullification, known as <blue>Anomaly Hunters</>.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC021_005: And afterwards, did you discover that the anomaly left the same kind of card for Renee?
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC008_006: No wonder Mint left so quickly yesterday. She wasn't running from Hotori; she was genuinely busy—
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_013: What about <blue>Puka Candy</>? I love Puka Candy!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_009: Wait, was the puppet still human not long ago…?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_026: Could it be the same person who delivered the puppet to Eibon?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_063: Huh, could Boss Tiger have forgot to submit the manual…? Adler, please wait there for a bit. I'll be right there with Edgar.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_057: Is that how that child expresses affection? Or do you find love or joy in her tantrums? We don't understand… but we do know one thing: that selfish child never loved her older siblings, despite all the care we gave her.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_008: What do you need help with?
ST_MainDialogue.MT01_04_NPC01111_001: Do I need to remind you about what "first come, first served" means?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_005: We need to understand the connection between the bird and the censer… and the dog's whereabouts…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_101: About your payment… Since the mission didn't pan out, we hope you understand…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_011: A young woman, not particularly tall. Short hair, in a Kool Express uniform. I didn't get a good look at her face, since her baseball cap was in the way.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC021_005: Against all will, ensnared there still.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_055: The thief timed it perfectly. As they left with the item, the empty boxes were unlocked, and then Picky opened the containment devices, triggering the security.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_054: Prophetic abilities… such a vague statement. Although such anomalies… are indeed rare.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC009_023: The wheel of fortune has turned… and it's about time fortune favored us!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_027: Thank you… You always take care of me.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC09001_004: First, a professional oddity image consultant will take detailed measurements. Then, based on these measurements, your requirements, and the designer's suggestions, we'll decide on fabric and style options…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC1013_011: First, Nanally, I appreciate you for pitching yourself. This means you trust what I'm doing here and you expect me to do well.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02501_028: Perfume needs to be stored at low temperatures. If the temperature is too high, perfume will evaporate quickly, causing subtle differences in the scent. To ensure the purity of the fragrance, a perfumer's studio is often colder than outside.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_007: High-end auctions make me feel like the protagonist of <TypingTitle titlename="Drama" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">Gen Z</>. Ha! Perfect infiltration, and I'm taking it all!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_073: Kiroumaru! Stop eating that! Keep your eye on that door!
ST_MainDialogue.MT_DMP01_01_0021_08: They're arguing, The wren said, just like us.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC016_008: Michael Pay's ability has a time limit. Once it's up, forged invitees lose their protection.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_076: The security anomaly has been triggered…
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC008_016: The dark basement… it's likely where Adler said they developed films.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_EC_NPC004A_018: So many eyes in the dark, targeting Taygedo's life…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_081: Darkness is swallowing the space, run!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1050_001: Blackbird was unable to attend today's meeting in person, so I'll be covering for her. Greetings to the people of Eibon.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_047: Blackbird once mentioned that rule-based anomalies follow established patterns strictly. It would be a good idea for us to pay close attention to "time."
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_102: (<blue>Blue Place</>, the best night view in Hethereau!!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC004A_003: (Sunward Resort! Family ticket package raffle! Taygedo! Sometimes lucky!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_169: (No, Daffodill hated her, but she still returned to the Scarlet Letter… It just doesn't add up.)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_127: (So this is what a "rising star" makes… The taste is… rather complicated.)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_048: (ETD-6 lives up to their name… They are true anomaly crime experts…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_055: (Don't want to remember! Taygedo don't want to think about it!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_130: (I can't get to Renee… she's completely lost in the past.)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_113: (For you, to make this day unforgettable… to create a memory that will be etched in your heart! Behold!)
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_Player_030: (Why does this thing get so much screen time…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_091: (Alright then… My capable lieutenants, to battle!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_021: (And to repay last time's favor so quickly…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_170: (When did I … Wait, Twisties share memories, and I met some at Sunward Resort!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_138: (Also, why does the puppet Renee carries also have a red letter on it?)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_021: (But Tako is so happy and excited…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_018: (But! Taygedo has no one to command!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC081A_001: (Henlo! Nice to meet you! I am… I am who?)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_135: (But if that's the case, why does the anomaly only appear when Renee wakes up? Shouldn't the anomaly that enforces the laws of nature have appeared with the first child?)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_126: (I should talk to Renee about what just happened.)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_131: (Let me organize the clues I've gathered so far…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_116: (Kenneth… the head chef at Pawn Moonlight?)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_134: (It does make sense… to be targeted for that reason.)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_029: (Let's go! Taygedo and his loyal crew, let's go!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_004: (Nanally must be worried out of her mind. The master she loves became someone she didn't know, got injured, and even disappeared…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_008: (So the Bureau suspects that this isn't the work of anomalies alone…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_040: (Time to put these crafty hands to work!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_125: (There's only two hours left, I need to find a solution soon.)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC012A_001: (Cursed humans. I am invincible here! Gahaha!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_089: (Ugh! But Taygedo made a fool of himself…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_125: (Phew… Big shots really do attract drama wherever they go!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC012A_003: (But why… I devoured so much, but I still feel so empty?)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC012A_004: (Hmmm… that's right. I must leave this place!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC004A_015: (Back to Eibon to read some manga!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_123: (Tako in her new home, and sent this to Taygedo!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_088: (Just a moment, Tako! Taygedo will crack this open as easily as a shell!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_100: (Tako can look forward to it too!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_037: (Tako's way of speaking is a bit odd, but quite fluent… And like us, she seems to have no trouble understanding Taygedo's language.)
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC004A_006: (Taygedo likes appraisers! Taygedo is a good friend!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_019: (Taygedo's cool guy act is about to crumble…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_095: (Taygedo thought, you'll surely make a name for yourself someday…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_116: (Did Taygedo give it too much life…?)
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC004A_010: (Taygedo's room is right next door, you can also tell Taygedo!)
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC004A_024: (The more Taygedo read, the stronger Taygedo get!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC004A_050: (Taygedo knows! You want to grow taller!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_054: (They tried to make Taygedo learn money-magic!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_010: (Taygedo, a chance meeting… a racing heart… head over heels…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_071: (Taygedo really did give it his all, didn't he…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_039: (Taygedo is a genius! Taygedo got an idea!)
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC004A_005: <male=>(Great! Sounds like a reliable person! Let's recruit him as my minion before Nanally and Sakiri get back!)<male><female=>(Great! Sounds like a reliable person! Let's recruit her as my minion before Nanally and Sakiri get back!)<female>
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_021: (Strange, they're talking about an ordinary dog…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_101: (Seems like she's got the wrong idea…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_028: (It doesn't seem she's going to… answer my question…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_017: (She wants to see a real Anomaly Hunter! Taygedo seized the chance and set up a date for tomorrow!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_068: (Alright! Butler Adler and Bodyguard Appraiser, let's roll!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_062: (Nanally and Sakiri helping Taygedo… For real?)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC004A_009: (Nanally, no mention she's Ichi-daime. Taygedo, not used to.)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_205: (I don't recall running away from something… but…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_049: (You can mold gems with your hands?)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_132: (Could the curse in this family be the rule-based anomaly that attacks Renee every night?)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_179: (Family… Since when did I see Eibon as my anchor too?)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC004A_036: (Taygedo wishes for a deep and meaningful relationship!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC004A_035: (Hopefully, Taygedo's secret money stash won't get busted next time.)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_093: (Well done! You've truly proven worthy of Taygedo's trust!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC078A_001: (Get owwwt! Nice visitor who fed coookies, go nauuu!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_040: (Why do I feel like this whole thing is falling apart before it even starts…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_142: (Anyway, I should catch up with Renee.)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_092: (Are we the audience, or are we unwitting participants?)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_NPC012A_002: (I poke! I bite! I devour! Your Fons are mine now!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_037: (The dog I saw… Is this what it looked like before it went missing?)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_094: (The day Taygedo brought you to Eibon, when Taygedo saw your eyes…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_138: (Speaking so openly about slacking off and drinking…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_022: (A guarantor…? I think I should ask Hotori about this. But since Nanally is in high spirits, I should ask about further details.)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_011: (The old Nanally would have gotten excited at being the Ichi-daime. This is going to take some work…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_180: (My past is a blank slate, yet I can still find the courage to face current and future challenges.)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_087: (Can't grab anything at all! Broken machine!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_156: (So Zankou went through all this trouble just to get the Bureau's attention?)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_095: (It seems to me that they're moving backwards…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_133: (After all, Renee and her siblings likely aren't entities that abide by the laws of nature…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_053: (No response… I'll leave her alone for now.)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_012: (Hethereau has so many curious things. Maybe it's another anomaly at work.)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_065: (Eureka! Let's add this to the plan!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_044: (That's right. She acts like she's nice, but when her friend was in trouble, she didn't seem to be concerned or help her…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_118: (Seems they don't know about the switched invitation yet…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_075: (Absolutely! It's a headache for Taygedo too!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_122: (Is that right? Something doesn't add up…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_107: (Butler Adler and Bodyguard Appraiser, stand by here!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_208: (Inherit the looks and the name of the family member and live for her…?)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_009: (Destined encounter, thanks to <TypingTitle titlename="SNS" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">Bagel</>!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_008: (Hope it works out! With your help!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_165: (Someone needs to take care of Thyme and Nanally. If Daffodill joins me to fight, we might have a chance, but now…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_119: (The confession didn't work out, but we're still good friends!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_096: (Please, accept this! The spoil of our victory over the evil claw machine.)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_146: (Daffodill seems to be in the backyard. I should check on her…)
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_Player_009: (Maybe it's best not to tell her I was on Ghroth Island before.)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_203: (I still don't get this… If the Corridor of Echoes only opens itself to those with something to avoid…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_016: (It's a miracle the shop hasn't gone under.)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_028: (And leave Tako with… an unforgettable memory!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_171: (Now I know who the painting is about…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_048: (This one! How much is this one?!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_139: (Are these things caused by the Anomalous Realm? Or perhaps… someone, an Esper, orchestrated all of this…?)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_111: (Those names… are the same as the puppets found by the Bureau.)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_111: (This is… Taygedo has prepared something really special…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_053: (This is some character arc I've never heard of…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_080: (This place! Taygedo once had a fierce showdown with other gangs and won this turf!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_027: (A present! To show how Taygedo feels!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_070: (There was no one at this corner when we encountered the bear. Was he waiting at this particular location?)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_087: (That lady… if she's from a memory, how could she make eye contact with us, who are in the present…?)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_168: (That little girl was Daffodill? The "mother" she mentioned was… Inanna?)
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Zero_00005: (I must have destroyed the Hypervortex's Nexus at that time…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_140: (Is that "Bella" really a shadow from the past…?)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_112: (That must be the Esper Ability of Lady Dolores.)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC004A_003: (Appraiser should come too! Taygedo will show you around!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_064: (Adler is so thoughtful, considering even Tako's feelings…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC004A_081: (All the snack shops around here are secretly funded by us!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_155: (No wonder Chaos spoke like that. He must have known that Daffodill was a member of the Scarlet Letter, the criminal organization he's pursuing…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_036: (Could it be the same anomaly Nanally mentioned before? But how did she lose her memory?)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_05_Player_075: (Could this unusual fog be related to the fog Blackbird mentioned?)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_031: (The censer and bird being taken must mean something…)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC004A_032: (That's one hell of a collection. You go, Kiroumaru!)
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_048: Did I just tell you all of that?

ST_MainQuest.q110022_QuestPanel: …I hope this is the last batch.
ST_MainQuest.q110119_QuestPanel: Pawn Moonlight… Another new clue. Let's head back to Eibon and go over what we've found.
ST_MainQuest.q110124_QuestPanel: The structure inside Pawn Moonlight is incredibly mysterious. It appears to be multiple spaces intertwined…
ST_MainQuest.q110127_1_0_QuestPanel: Pawn Moonlight's business comes with a price… It's not safe to stay here. Let's find Sakiri and the others quickly!
ST_MainQuest.q110420_QuestPanel: The Debt Collector left a card? Let's hear what Chaos has to say.
ST_MainQuest.q110023_QuestPanel: A worn picture frame hangs on the wall. Is this the Nexus of this Anomaly?
ST_MainQuest.q110013_QuestPanel: Some strange creatures appeared in front of me. Let's take them down.
ST_MainQuest.q110137_QuestPanel: Boomboom and Dandelion are heading home…
ST_MainQuest.q110436_QuestPanel: A grand banquet is in full swing…
ST_MainQuest.q110437_QuestPanel: A grand banquet is in full swing…
ST_MainQuest.q110001_0_QuestPanel: After a bumpy ride accompanied by rap music, we've finally arrived at the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Looks like someone's already waiting here…
ST_MainQuest.q110022_1_QuestPanel: In all this darkness, there's one corner with a light on. Maybe that's where the nexus is…
ST_MainQuest.q110111_1_QuestPanel: A strange bird suddenly burst into the room! Catch it!
ST_MainQuest.q110021_QuestPanel: A strange feeling is coming from up ahead. Maybe the Nexus is on the other side of this alley…
ST_MainQuest.q110014_QuestPanel: Made quick work of the Anomalies that appeared. Let's continue searching for the Nexus.
ST_MainQuest.q110426_QuestPanel: There's a door up ahead… but you know it won't be that simple.
ST_MainQuest.q110427_QuestPanel: There seems to be a door up ahead… but you know better than to think it'll be that simple.
ST_MainQuest.q110129_QuestPanel: There's a misunderstanding between me and the Twins… If I can clear it up, I might be able to avoid a fight…
ST_MainQuest.q110005_QuestPanel: After exchanging a few pleasantries with the girl named Mint, the elevator arrived. I should go find the Director first.
ST_MainQuest.q110438_ObjDes_None: Talk to the <blue>Guests</> at the banquet
ST_MainQuest.q110006_ObjName_1: Talk to the Person in Front
ST_MainQuest.q110459_QuestPanel: The study might just hold the answers you're looking for…
ST_MainQuest.q110460_QuestPanel: The study might just hold the answers you're looking for…
ST_MainQuest.q110003_QuestPanel: Now that I've learned about the Wertheimer Index, it's time to continue with Nelly to find the Director.
ST_MainQuest.q110422_QuestPanel: This is far from over. But it's getting late—let's head back to Eibon and get some rest for now…
ST_MainQuest.q110414_QuestPanel: That's way too much info for one day… I'm exhausted…
ST_MainQuest.q110015_QuestPanel: Still haven't sensed the Nexus. Let's keep moving forward.
ST_MainQuest.q110401_QuestPanel: Looks like everyone in Eibon is buzzing about something…
ST_MainQuest.q110133_QuestPanel: Hold out against Morphix's attacks until Boomboom gets here!
ST_MainQuest.q110127_1_3_QuestPanel: There are many things worth looking into. Let's investigate them one by one.
ST_MainQuest.q110467_ObjDes_None: Listen in on the conversation between <blue>Dolores</> and <blue>Bella</>
ST_MainQuest.q110412_QuestPanel: Let's kick things off with the physical evidence.
ST_MainQuest.q110112_QuestPanel: First, a strange bird circled around the room, then flew into the censer. Suddenly, a fat dog appeared and ran off with the censer… This is really something…
ST_MainQuest.q110122_0_QuestPanel: An entrance has appeared. Sakiri, Edgar, and Taygedo might have already gone in. Let's catch up with them.
ST_MainQuest.q110134_QuestPanel: Boomboom appeared and got Morphix to stop attacking. Now we can have a proper discussion.
ST_MainQuest.q110453_QuestPanel: The withered cherry blossom tree… it mirrors the fate of the Constantine family…
ST_MainQuest.q110454_QuestPanel: The withered cherry blossom tree… it mirrors the fate of the Constantine family…
ST_MainQuest.q110455_QuestPanel: The withered cherry blossom tree… it mirrors the fate of the Constantine family…

ST_Manual.ManualVision_2014_des:
F times D equals OPEN!

Anomaly Story
At a certain research facility, a containment breach caused the entire facility to go into lockdown. All power and water to the entire facility were completely cut off, and the Anomaly that had breached containment blocked rescue teams from entering. If this continued, the research team inside would suffer significant losses… At that moment, one of the researcher team's doctors picked up an unremarkable crowbar from a toolbox and began his story: First, he pried open the vents. Then he pried open the sealed laboratory doors. Next, he pried open the facility's security passages. And finally, he even pried open the entire realm itself… Heaven knows how he managed that! His heroic actions allowed the rescue team to enter, re-contain the breached Anomaly, and save the research team. Strangely, after this incident, the savior mysteriously vanished! Even more odd, his colleagues forgot what he looked like and what his name was, and the facility's personnel roster showed no record of him ever existing. And it was after his disappearance that the Anomaly "Picky" began to appear…

T-0847(Ob) Picky. Its appearance is that of a plain, unremarkable… crowbar. The kind you could pull out of any toolbox. As an Anomaly, its ability and instinct are to "open." As long as Picky exists, it will continuously attempt to pry open anything "locked" around it, whether it be a suitcase, a safe, or an Anomaly containment unit. Given enough leverage, it can pry open anything. When someone witnesses it opening objects around it, it becomes extremely aggressive and begins attacking the witness, though its strength is no different from an ordinary crowbar. Getting hit will hurt, but it is not lethal. Defeat Picky and stop it from continuing to open objects around it, and Picky will undergo nullification.

I would rather believe that this "Dr. Freeman" was merely a product of collective imagination. After all, how could anyone possibly break through an entire realm with just a crowbar? But scattered records confirm that this actually happened, and the legendary crowbar in the legendary doctor's hands carved out a path to survival for the research team. Picky, however, does not care about the meaning behind actions. It only retains that sense of urgency and obsession with opening things.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Appears as a metal crowbar partially painted red, floating at approximately one meter above the ground.
· This Anomaly will continuously "open" any "locked" objects within a certain range.
· After its "opening" behavior is witnessed, this Anomaly will attack the witness. Its strength is no different from an ordinary crowbar.

Anomaly Nexus
After witnessing this Anomaly's "opening" behavior, defeat it to stop its intent to "open."

Risk Assessment
Low hazard.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Private guarantee not permitted. A small number are contained within the Celaeno Compound.

Containment Measures
Contain it together with locked objects. The Celaeno Compound has prepared a "self-locking device" for containing Picky, which automatically returns to a locked state a period after being opened. Note: This device must be kept fully powered at all times, otherwise it may trigger a chain containment breach!

Experiment Records
Experiment on the Performance of Anomaly Picky
Experiment 1: Picky was placed together with a cardboard box, a simple combination lock, and a vault safe, respectively.
Conclusion: There was a significant difference in the time Picky took to open different objects. The more complex the locking mechanism, the longer it took to open.

Experiment 2: Picky was contained in a standard containment unit.
Conclusion: Picky opened the containment unit on its own after approximately 15 hours, and caused structural damage to the containment unit.

Experiment 3: Picky was contained in a standard containment unit along with a self-locking device.
Conclusion: The required time to open the self-locking device is longer than its self-locking interval. This containment measure is effective.

Derivative Anomaly
/
ST_Manual.ManualVision_2002_des:
"Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet!"

Anomaly Story
Deep into your desk drawer, you might find a notebook buried among old papers. It probably has a dark cover (most likely cheap synthetic leather), decorated with cryptic symbols or pretentious quotes. Flip through the yellowed pages, and you'll find records of adolescent fantasies, embarrassing incantations you would never want anyone else to see. Most people go through a phase in their teens when they believe they are unique, a chosen one burdened with a special destiny, but they are too self-conscious to tell anyone… and so they stay up late at night, pouring their hearts out to a notebook.
…If you know what I'm talking about, then you probably already have a good idea of what the Anomaly known as the "Black Tome" looks like.

C-7111(Ob) Black Tome typically appears as a book with a black cover, and a piercing purple eye in the center. Legend has it that the Black Tome contains powerful spells that allow one to cast "magic." In reality, most of what's written inside is nonsensical teenage rambling, and reciting these so-called "incantations" does nothing at all. However, the claim that the Black Tome can grant magical powers isn't entirely false… which brings us to its abilities.
The Black Tome thrives off the power of belief. The more someone believes the Black Tome has powers, the more powerful it actually becomes. Stronger faith grants greater power to the Black Tome, and in turn, this power flows back to its believers: after reciting the incantations written in the Black Tome, believers can achieve nullification of some low threat anomalies. However, it is not the person reciting the spell who nullifies the Anomaly, but the Black Tome itself. The stronger the Black Tome becomes, the more powerful the targets it can nullify.
After first using an incantation from the Black Tome, another ability gradually manifests. It applies mental suggestion to users, causing them to treat their faith in the Black Tome as absolute truth. In pursuit of greater power, they are compelled to attract more people to believe in the Black Tome, eventually becoming a puppet with the sole purpose of spreading the Black Tome's faith. Those influenced and converted to believing in the Black Tome are also subjected to this blind faith, but do not gain the Black Tome's power. Additionally, the Black Tome sometimes uses its abilities to enslave and control low threat anomalies to serve itself.
When the Black Tome is opened by a non-believer, it generates an Anomalous Realm called the "Library," pulling the reader inside to face the Black Tome's true form. Its appearance within is a black humanoid figure, with the original book forming the head, surrounded by twisted limbs. Its behavior seems driven by wrath against non-believers, and it attempts to eliminate anyone who enters the Library. In battle, the Black Tome employs various magic-like methods, such as chains, flames, and beams appearing out of thin air, mostly stemming from believers' imagination of its power. Additionally, the Black Tome's close-range attacks using its own limbs should not be underestimated.
When the Black Tome is nullified, its mental influence disappears along with it. Based on current observations, no lingering aftereffects have been found. However, whether long-term belief in the Black Tome can cause permanent psychological distortion or even encroachment remains unknown. Anomalies that manipulate minds are undoubtedly among the most dangerous and insidious types.

Believing you are unique is a good thing, but being unique does not mean possessing extraordinary abilities, nor does it require pursuing great power. Ordinary yet unique… that probably sounds like something from a self-help book. However, if you equate "unique" with "powerful," you will embark on a tedious and endless path. The Black Tome exploits the confusion that people, especially young people, experience in understanding themselves, deceiving them in ways that are nearly impossible to guard against. I hope everyone can understand: we don't need to be powerful, we don't need to be geniuses, we don't need Esper Abilities to be irreplaceable individuals to those around us.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Appears as a black book. Its true form is a twisted humanoid object with a book for a head.
· Can absorb the power of "belief" to strengthen itself and apply mental suggestion to its believers.
· Can nullify or control low threat anomalies.
· The contents recorded in the book are mostly phrases born from adolescent fantasy and have no practical meaning.

Anomaly Nexus
The faith of believers is shaken. Suppressing and defeating the Black Tome within the Anomalous Realm can significantly weaken its mental influence on believers.

Risk Assessment
High hazard. Due to its inherent covertness, involvement of mental suggestion, and strong capacity for spreading and growth, it poses extreme potential danger to society. If discovered, it should be nullified immediately.

Containment/Guarantee Status
The only known specimen has been nullified.

Containment Measures
/

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly
/
ST_Manual.ManualVision_1016_des:
"Tayge? Tayge… Tayge! Tayge Tayge!"

Anomaly Story
U-5291(Or) Taygedo is an Oddity of unknown origin, taken in by Hotori, owner of Eibon Antique Shop. Its appearance is that of a sea otter wearing a yellow jacket, with its head replaced by a TV where its face is displayed.
Taygedo is capable of living in human society, and can understand human language and behavior. It can communicate normally, though ordinary people cannot understand Taygedo's speech. Taygedo possesses considerable knowledge of electronics and machinery. Its ability to dismantle and reassemble matter, combined with this inherent knowledge, makes it an excellent Restorer. According to investigations, Taygedo's ability has certain limitations. Its power cannot affect matter it does not fully understand, and forcing its use may lead to uncontrollable consequences.
Taygedo seems very interested in inventing and often creates unique little gadgets. Some of these have a degree of destructive potential, but after assessment, the destructive capacity is quite minor and does not exceed the range of daily household items. Combined with the guarantee from the owner of Eibon, we believe Taygedo poses no threat to society.
Currently, Taygedo is guaranteed by Eibon Antique Shop and works there as a Restorer.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Appears as a sea otter with a TV for a head. The Anomaly's face is displayed on the screen.
· Has the ability to dismantle and reassemble matter, but only if it has sufficient understanding of said matter. Uses this ability for various inventions.
· Some of Taygedo's inventions have minor destructive potential.
· Taygedo shows no aggression toward people.

Anomaly Nexus
Unknown.

Risk Assessment
Harmless.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Guaranteed by Eibon Antique Shop.

Containment Measures
/

Experiment Records
/

Derivative Anomaly
/
ST_Manual.ManualVision_2028_des:
"…The tears we gulped turned into rivers, our weeping into song. Ah, do not mourn, for it is guiding us to everlasting peace."

Anomaly Story
R-4321-1[Ob], or the "Helm of Theseus," looks no different from any other weathered, battered ship's wheel after years of storms. The origin of its existence is unknown. It is believed to have appeared in the same Anomalous Realm when the Corridor of Echoes was created. Obeying the will of the Dimension Visitor, this worn-out wheel carries out its duty, like a clock running in reverse, guiding the vessel ever backwards into the past.
For the dreamwalkers in the Corridor, the Helm of Theseus is the very law of their world and everything they could ever wish for. It brings them happiness, peace, and a pain that will never arrive. With a beautiful past to lose themselves in, why would they ever need to face a future filled with uncertainty? Here, they can smooth over old scars with sweet dreams, forgetting the memories that brought them sorrow one at a time. They can cast aside all cumbersome emotions and fill their bodies with joy. At least, this is what the Dimension Visitor believes in, as the Visitor guides those who have suffered similar fates and those who long to break free of their chains, onto this drifting, restless solitary vessel.

It is only human nature to romanticize the memories of the past as a way to push back against the cruelties of life. However, blindly following the guidance of the Helm of Theseus like the dreamwalkers, becoming a part of the past, may not be the foolproof choice it seems. Dreams are called dreams precisely because we will eventually wake up. What's more, since both the Helm and the Corridor stem from the will of the Dimension Visitor, what would become of those affected by them, if one day, that will wavered and shifted? To where, then, would the Corridor and the Helm of Theseus carry its passengers?

——Updated Records——
The Corridor has collapsed, and the Helm now exists beyond the Corridor, having fallen into the possession of the Scarlet Letter, location unknown.

Characteristics
- Likely created along with the spatial anomaly known as the Corridor of Echoes. The Helm takes the form of a massive, worn-out ship wheel.
- Follows the will of the Dimension Visitor, enforcing the rules of the "past" within the Corridor.
