ST_MinimapiconDec.minimapicon_dec_0038: BOMB! BOOM! BANG! Tri-Blast Hotdogs! Bringing explosives to your senses! (No real explosives invovled!)
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_004_desc:
"Forget-me-not? Isn't that a better name for a flower shop?"
Besides asking for prices, this is the question the owner hears most often every day.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00103_Title: "As long as the money's right, we'll deliver anything!"
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_006_desc:
"Seasonal flavors, a once-in-a-lifetime encounter."
A well-known izakaya on Hankaku Street. Granny Chiyo's culinary skills are beloved by local residents, and the new Taishou, Budori, continues to win the trust of regulars, offering delicious and affordable meals.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_020_desc:
"Man I hope I have a cat looking after me too…"
"Hey, this a ramen shop, not a cat cafe. Also, stop touching our chef."
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00604_Name: With every cycle, the vehicle isn't the only thing soaring—your spirits are, too.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_LotteryShop_desc:
A newsstand where clerks are cats. Its main business model is to use cute cats to sell magazines and books that don't sell well. But compared to the cute cats, the vouchers that come with the other items are more attractive to customers.
"One newspaper selling for one dried fish…! Dumb kitty, we'll shut down sooner if we do business like that!"
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00904_Title: A natural stone arch rises at the mouth of the bay, with an old boat resting beneath it. The boat is badly worn, and no one knows how long it has waited there.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_Pukaland_03_desc: A cup of coffee, a quiet moment—let your wishes awaken with the aroma.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_WishingTree_desc: A giant tree that grows atop a small hill. People believe that such a remarkable tree possesses the power to grant wishes, and so they often come to make wishes beneath its branches. Over time, the tree has become a popular attraction.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00501_Title: A calm sea without waves. The perfect haven for boats and visitors alike.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00504_Title: A giant egg; yet within lie hatched dreams.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_002_desc: An old shop with years of history, the top choice for nearby residents to buy meat. Because of this, every Tuesday's discount day feels like a battle…
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_016_desc: Work or school can be crazy! How can you not have crazy milk tea at crazy times like these? Crazy Cat is perfect for your mental state!
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_GameCenter_desc: A large arcade that includes everything from side-scrollers popular 30 years ago to today's hottest arcade games. Legend has it that if you can clear all the games in one go, your name will be carved onto the ultimate leaderboard as the "Invincible Player"!
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_Pukaland_05_desc: Whether it's a special occasion or just another day, there's always room for the perfect treat. After all, a cake is a little amusement park all its own.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_034_desc: A shop focused on takoyaki, comparable even to Budoriya in terms of takoyaki! The signature Taishou Takoyaki is selling hot!
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_031_desc: A gift shop run by an individual, where the owner is always eager to surprise everyone. "Oops! Chest" successfully realizes the owner's idea, making everyone receiving a gift exclaim with joy.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_021_desc:
A pizza shop that takes the affordable route, a great place for young people to dine together.
"Five-star recommendation for their signature pizza! The pasta side dish is also better than expected and worth a try. But when visiting, be careful: never ask the staff why you can't put fruit on pizza… don't ask even if it's for content!"
ST_MinimapiconDec.minimapicon_dec_0014: A butler cafe focusing on exquisite service, where each staff is professionally trained to provide every guest with the best experience. "Welcome home, our dear guest."
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Leon_desc: Leon takes care of all your property concerns. Quality assured, no collapsing houses! Penthouse mansions, calming manors! Various properties, all at Leon!
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_MaidCoffee_desc:
Little Sparrow is an extremely popular maid café known not only for its lively maids and delicious food and drinks, but also for its rave reviews across the board.
Mahjong is the café's signature attraction. Bring your friends for a relaxing time, and if you ask nicely, the maids might even join your game. Be warned: the moment they sit down at the mahjong table, those sweet smiles vanish, replaced by the steely focus of seasoned, ruthless players…
ST_MinimapiconDec.minimapicon_dec_0059: Eibon's warehouse. In reality, it's basically only used by Taygedo, filled with his weird and wonderful inventions. You might be able to find something useful in there.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_WeeklyClone_Boss05_desc: The pawnshop that mysteriously appears under moonlight every month is said to be a place where "any wish can be fulfilled at the right price". Following the terrifying howls inside, and you realize… it is a good place for stories to begin.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_013_desc: In a record shop, of course the owner provides service to every music lover… although sometimes his cat does the job.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_009_desc: As the largest fast-food chain… Sorry, just thinking about fried chicken and fries… Clicky Fast Food has long been an irreplaceable part of citizens' lives… Sorry, thinking about fried chicken and fries again…
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Cinema_desc:
As a high-end cinema, Floe Cinema is equipped with top-tier sound systems and massive high-definition screens, ensuring an ultimate audiovisual feast for every audience member.
"Even if the movie itself isn't quite up to par… at least our seats are more comfortable to sleep in than your couch at home."
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00506_Title: You rose higher, wishing to see the tree. Now you have seen it.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00301_Title: Nacupeda has heard your wish. As for whether it can come true… that depends on how strong your own aspirations are!
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00407_Title: Of the two towns nestled between mountains and water, this is the one with more residents.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00408_Title: Of the two towns nestled between mountains and water, this is the one with more shops.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_Pukaland_01_desc: Step into a fairy-tale look and set off on an adventure. You're the hero now—go write the rest of your story!
ST_MinimapiconDec.Shop_PukaTicket_desc:
Redeem your favorite gifts and discover limited-time surprises.
Embark on your very own park adventure!
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Eibon_desc:
The most reliable antique shop in all of Bridge Crossings, bar none!
"Precious antiques, rare anomalies, no counterfeits, fake items refunded five times… wait no, three times… We also accept anomaly case commissions, honest reputation, fair prices for all!"
The above content is the sole responsibility of the Eibon shop owner.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00304_Title: Hethereau's best prices. We hope you save more money than you spend getting here.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_029_desc: An unremarkable used electronics store. The store's decor might make you question its reliability, but the store not only delivers to your doorstep, but also allows question-free returns within 7 days.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_027_desc: Originally a long-established shop in Bridge Crossings, it has now opened multiple branches throughout the city and offers citywide delivery service. Even cooked ducks can fly!
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Sterry_desc: As long as the money is right, anomalies are not a problem! Sterry Express guarantees your delivery will arrive on time, anytime, anywhere!
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_005_desc: A name that sounds like a convenience store, but it's actually a seafood shop. The owner used to babble about "having a name that keeps up with the times", and hence "Nanami Seafood" became "7-Oceans".
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_LiveHouse_desc:
Spend City Stamina to perform and earn Fons based on your results. Business Hours: 03:00 – 15:00.
A livehouse that's been in operation for many years. Although the venue has limited capacity, the affordable prices make it quite popular with up-and-coming bands.
"Connecting scattered stars across the sky into a brilliantly shining constellation might only take the time of a single song."
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_LiveHouse_UnlockDes:
Spend City Stamina to perform and earn Fons based on your results. Business Hours: 03:00 – 15:00.
A livehouse that's been in operation for many years. Although the venue has limited capacity, the affordable prices make it quite popular with up-and-coming bands. You can spend City Stamina to hold performances and earn Fons based on the results. 
"Connecting scattered stars across the sky into a brilliantly shining constellation might only take the time of a single song."
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_028_desc: The ideal growing temperature for coffee beans is between 15°C and 24°C. 9°C Coffee provides the best seasonal coffee beans to every guest who visits the shop.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_032_desc:
A coffee bean shop with an exceptionally comprehensive selection. The brand's founder seems to have been researching coffee beans for many years now, and not only do Hethereau residents love to visit, but some anomalies from the mountains outside the city are also regular customers.
"Respect time, and the years will reward you."
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_010_desc: A flower shop opened by two close friends who love poetry and flowers. Visit Hillside Blooms for a poem and take a bouquet with you… the indispensables in life.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00406_Title: In inland cities, lakes are often seen as substitutes for the sea. Fortunately, this is Hethereau, so Caltrop Lake stands on its own merits.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00602_Name: In another unknown realm, I exist only in memory.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Manor_desc:
Long ago, a model noble family, graceful like flowers, lived here. Rumor has it they masked their fractured family ties with an elegant lifestyle… While maintaining a near-perfect facade without any "family scandal" being exposed… the family just silently collapsed.
Due to the abandonment by the last heir, the meticulously crafted manor has now fallen into ruin. However, recently, some have caught a whiff of a rich floral scent emanating from its depths…
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_015_desc: In the bustling city, we all move forward exhausted. Sometimes we might get lost, and when that happens, come here for a drink, as this is a haven for the lost.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00505_Title: Here, even legendary golden apples are hardly considered rare treasures.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_FilmOrbit_desc: Located on Hankaku Street in Bridge Crossings, Film Orbit Studio is a locally renowned photo studio, attracting people from near and far with its exquisite craftsmanship. The surrounding neighborhood has long been accustomed to its presence. As seasons change, different faces leave gentle imprints here. Each photograph is like a page in an old book, telling stories of growth, reunion, parting, and encounter.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_VortexBucket_desc: Going on a trip and don't want to return with dirty clothes? Just arrived and no washing machine available? Continuous rain making it hard to dry clothes? "V.i.B" solves all your problems! Low cost, high efficiency, clean, and removes all stains, leaving no worries behind!
ST_MinimapiconDec.Volleyball_Rank_Desc: An indoor volleyball court built by the Orichalcos Group. Its professional-grade facilities and amenities make it quite a popular venue for volleyball events of all kinds.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00205_Title: Now, the overgrown vegetation has become the true ruler of this place.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00104_Title: Take in all of Bridge Crossings at a glance.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00202_Title: Where the mountains end, the ocean begins.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_019_desc: Bigmouth Baozi, praised by locals! Start your morning with a fresh Bigmouth Custard Baozi, what a taste! But be sure it's "calm" before eating, or it might "bite" you!
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00302_Title: Simple happiness fills this ordinary street.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00106_Title: For your first ride, choose Novus.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_017_desc: Happiness is a bite of delicious ice cream! Felicità Gelato, bringing you happiness at -15°C!
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_038_desc: Bedsheets become royal robes, candy apples become glittering swords, and even a rocking horse can gallop a thousand miles. Here, every childhood fantasy earns a delicious reward.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_LogisticsCenter_desc: Kool Express's Logistics Hub handles cargo sorting, fleet dispatch, and strategic planning. Its goal? To dominate Hethereau's logistics industry!
ST_MinimapiconDec.minimapicon_dec_0001: Though small in size, this old-fashioned newsstand has a complete selection and is a great spot for niche publications and used book enthusiasts. If you can become friends with the owner, you might hear some long-buried tales of the city from him.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Volleyball_PVE_Desc: A well-established beach volleyball court, a popular leisure spot for Hethereau residents.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00902_Title: An Anomaly Charity House where visitors can tour the grounds, learn about Anomalies, or serve as guarantors. With elegant grounds and well-equipped facilities, it often welcomes parents and children on weekends.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00610_Name: Beyond the bends, the road ahead is well-traveled.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_PrisonFight_Desc: The strong need no outside aid. Lay down your weapons—only raw strength will carry you through.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00402_Title: The bridge on the other side is a scenic view. You can even imagine that you're the one who those on the other bridge are gazing at.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_Pukaland_06_desc: Happiness comes in many temperatures. Here, it's best served ice-cold.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00509_Title: How we long for those days hundreds of millions of years ago, when we could glide freely through the ocean depths without the need of these passages…
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00101_Title: Someday you'll find yourself longing to return here.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00609_Name: May your happiness blossom like fields of blooms, radiant as the golden summer sun.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_Pukaland_02_desc: Bring home a little souvenir, and whenever you miss the Puka, just take it out for a look.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00508_Title: Own a Regalia, and you'll own every destination you could ever want to reach.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_035_03_desc: A century-old luxury sports car brand whose proudly soaring griffin emblem has become a symbol of noble status and ultimate luxury. Its high-performance racing cars are the darlings of Tempestas racers—every seasoned racer dreams of owning their very own Regalia!
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_Regalia_desc: Mods? Repairs? Rampage Players got you on your seat! Knight One fulfills all your need for speed!
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_017_03_desc:
Years ago, Hethereau was home to an anomaly ice cream cart named Blizzi. She was lively and cheerful, loved telling stories, and could always make the most delicious ice cream. Every child in the city adored her. However, one day, to answer the hopes of children in a distant city, Blizzi and her brother—a hot dog cart named Sunni—drove away from the city together, disappearing beyond the horizon. That day, Hethereau's streets and alleys were filled with heartbroken children everywhere.
And so, an ordinary ice cream cart called "Blizzi" was born. Though the ice cream here is handmade and not all the staff are good at telling stories to kids, that familiar sweetness still fills the emptiness in the children's hearts. Perhaps someday, the real Blizzi will return to this city… or maybe she never will. But one thing is certain: on every hot day, this city will be blessed by the cool refreshment of Blizzi Ice Cream.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_001_02_desc: A newly opened tofu shop with fresh tofu made daily. The owner is the most skilled driver among chefs, and the most talented cook among racing drivers.
ST_MinimapiconDec.minimapicon_dec_0004: Cubox Phone guarantees you the same discounts as online, with even better service in our storefronts! Come and pay us a visit!
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00303_Title: NO UNAUTHORIZED ENTRY. STUDENTS MAY NOT LEAVE WITHOUT PERMISSION.
ST_MinimapiconDec.minimapicon_dec_0024: A storefront for Falcon, a fashion brand known for their stylish and unique designs which has successfully led the trend with its sports watches and bracelets, loved by young people.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_003_desc: A common vegetable chain, there's always one nearby. Though some may never have entered, they remember—"Eat more vegetables."
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00404_Title: A familiar atmosphere, reassuring in its quiet peacefulness.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00606_Name: Rain or shine, Lakeside Mart's doors are always open!
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Prison_desc: In accordance with the Hethereau Public Safety Ordinance, individuals who disturb public order and refuse to comply with repeated warnings may be transferred to a detention facility by the Security Office for punishment.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_014_des: A well-known ornamental fish shop in Bridge Crossings. Luna Bay welcomes every guest who loves and wants to learn about aquatic life… so long as you are not a hungry cat.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00102_Title: The busiest intersection in Bridge Crossings, and the perfect spot for a leisurely stroll.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_011_desc: A renowned bakery in Bridge Crossings, striving to create cakes that bring smiles to everyone. It has already garnered a loyal customer base in the nearby streets. Feeling down? Come around!
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00607_Name: Every grain of rice dreams of serving the people.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00201_Title: An outdoor theater with no seats. Remember to bring your car or a folding chair.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Locker_dec:
Street storage lockers launched by Hethereau to meet citizens' daily storage needs, praised for the convenience they offer.
The operators are currently trying to launch various derivative services based on the "Griddy" such as delivery and laundry services with ever-expanding coverage.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_PoliceStation_desc:
Hethereau's grassroots security patrol agency, primarily responsible for security incidents and civil affairs unrelated to anomalies and espers. Whether it's fraud and scams, traffic accidents, or pets running away from home, forgetting keys when going out, takeout orders missing utensils… the security officers will fulfill their duties and give their all for the citizens.
In short, please remember: when in trouble, find the Security Office.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_SecondHandStore_desc: A well-known vintage shop in Hethereau selling various vintage items, like clothing, bags, furniture, tableware, and crafts. While "Good Joe" runs the place, the guy might just have some questionable ethics and business practices…
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Bank_desc: A commercial bank under the Dvořák conglomerate in Hethereau.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_CentreBank_desc:
The headquarters of the commercial bank under the Dvořák conglomerate in Hethereau.
Ever since Vault Heist became a huge hit, many unknown criminals began coveting access to the vault of Pink Paws Bank… Though no one has yet seen the vault's entrance, there was nonetheless a business opportunity.
Dvořák teamed up with renowned film director Cinema Lee to launch the reality show, "Pink Paws Heist," featuring a one-to-one recreation of the movie's sets for an immersive experience, with generous rewards prepared for winners! However, rumor has it that some particularly capable performers might find their own names on a rather insidious list…
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_008_desc: Hethereau's most popular candy brand's locations now offers a chance to win tickets to Ellie's latest puppet show with the purchase of the newest Puka Chocoa!
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_030_desc:
Hethereau's largest home goods boutique. A rich variety of home essentials that turns a house into a home.
"It's not expensive, it's DeLuxur!"
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_025_desc: Hethereau's largest bookstore chain offers a wide range of books, from popular monthly manga to obscure non-fiction, ensuring almost every customer a beloved piece.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_012_desc: Hethereau's largest pharmacy chain, the century-old brand of the Zhu family, now offers more than just medicine! "Clear Skies in Summer" facial masks are selling like hotcakes!
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_001_desc: A famous tofu chain in Hethereau, known for its highly praised tofu set meals. Customers looking for a hearty meal won't be disappointed! However, if you're looking for the Bridge Crossings Drifter, you might be in the wrong place…
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_School_desc:
A local comprehensive educational institution of Hethereau. On top of traditional subjects and a variety of club activities, they are also the pioneers of anomalogy education.
However, due to the severe physical impact of an anomaly incident, the staff often adopt a strict attitude towards student safety issues. Compared to the overall trendy and open city atmosphere, the school's ethos appears cautious and conservative.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_026_desc: Hethereau's plant shop chain. The founder is a passionate plant enthusiast and designer. In the bustling city, the plants in Lively Greens grow peacefully and quietly in their own unique ways.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Q3_desc: A well-known fast-fashion brand chain store in Hethereau, committed to providing consumers with modern, simple, natural, and high-quality products.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_007_desc: Hethereau's convenience store chain. Offers everything from bentos, drinks, to manga! Open 24 hours, lights up your nights!
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Museum_desc: The private collection hall of Hethereau's wealthiest family, the "Dvořák Family," displaying various collections ranging from antique treasures and artistic masterpieces to mysterious anomalies. Due to the family's dedication to charity, the collection hall is open to all citizens free of charge, and has now become a famous tourist attraction and photo spot in Hethereau.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_TaxiCompany_desc: The largest taxi company in Hethereau, operating the online platform Swift Cab, providing professional transportation services to Hethereau residents.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Hospital_desc: The largest general hospital in Hethereau, providing quality healthcare services to the citizens with its state-of-the-art facilities and exceptional medical expertise.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shipyard_01_desc: Hethereau's most renowned boat shop. Its proprietor, Hiiragi Hikari, was once a professional vehicle modification technician. After growing tired of the trade, he turned to shipbuilding and eventually founded a boat brand bearing his own name.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00306_Title: Hethereau's largest hospital, a safeguard for citizen health.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_006_02_desc: A Hethereau chain izakaya that carefully selects the freshest seafood of the day, pursuing the richest flavors in sashimi cuisine. Paired with specially brewed draft beer, it strives to bring each guest a dual healing experience for both taste and soul.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00601_Name: What lies beyond the sea? A beach, seafoam, and you—shimmering in the sunlight.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_PetHouse_desc: A pet store loved by anomalies. Ran by a human who can understand anomalies, and an anomaly who can understand human. Two outsiders working together to provide a warm home for many.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00901_Title: A docking point for cruise ships, and the first stop for visitors to the island. The pier may be short, but the view opens wide. As the boat comes ashore, the whole stretch of sea comes into sight.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_018_desc: Barbecue and music, Rolling Stone & Rock and Roll! Come to Rolling Stone for a wild night!
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_033_desc:
A specialty food store with great quality at low prices, so affordable that customers question reality. The owner seems exceptionally enthusiastic about holding sales events, with discount "reasons" that leave competitors speechless.
"The weather's so nice today, worth celebrating! Everything 50% off!"
"The weather's bad today, need some cheer! Everything 50% off!"
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_SkyTower_desc:
A landmark of Hethereau, initiated by the city government and primarily funded by the Dvořák family. The tower also serves as a signal transmission facility.
Hethereau Skytower is open year-round. The lower floors feature dining and cultural creative spaces, while the top floor boasts an observation deck and restaurant. It is a popular leisure destination for citizens and a must-visit attraction for tourists.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_035_02_desc: TerraX Off-Road, founded by the mysterious explorer "Iron Knight," is renowned for its ultimate performance. Its vehicles are built specifically for extreme terrain and once dominated the top ten rankings of Hethereau's dangerous terrain off-road challenge, achieving fame in one decisive victory.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Shop_CatchDoll_desc: Line it up, drop the claw, and wait—your dream plushie is right there. Wait… wait… what?!
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_035_desc: An authorized dealership of the famous car brand "Novus", where you can enjoy all the benefits that Novus offers to customers.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_023_desc: A well-known pop toy brand store with many collabs with popular IPs like "Gen Z" and "Fleeting—A Gala under the Moonlight". But folks, remember, don't go broke just because you wanted every piece of merch from your favorite show!
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00409_Title: An automotive brand founded by the mysterious adventurer Iron Knight, beloved by hardcore car enthusiasts.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_037_desc: A vendor near the Fortune Shades, selling wishing plaques and related merchandise.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00204_Title: Echoes of a cheering crowd linger beneath the sky and above the sea.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00403_Title: Rise above the clouds, and you'll find it's always sunny.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00105_Title: A caged bird peers through crystal, glimpsing your destiny.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_Pukaland_10_desc: A surprise Puka plushie is waiting! Your perfect match might be just one grab away!
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_WishingFountain_desc:
The pool where Nacupeda dwells.
Long, long ago, this park and its fountain pool each had their own names.
After Nacupeda settled here, everything became mere extensions of Nacupeda.

Nacupeda is everything!
—Nacupeda Fans Club
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00507_Title: Testing confirms that New Herland's air contains no cooking oil fumes whatsoever.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_Pukaland_08_desc: The food is ready, and every adventure needs fuel!
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_Pukaland_09_desc: Good food is made for sharing, and happiness is better together. Come enjoy a meal with someone special!
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_036_des: Old bicycles can be repaired, but the old times and memories cannot be recovered.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00608_Name: Let your ears drink in the creek's melody, and your eyes feast on its glimmering beauty.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_DivinationHouse_desc: If you ever feel lost… the witch can show you the way.
ST_MinimapiconDec.minimapicon_dec_0060: Mint's office at the Bureau of Anomaly Control—though that doesn't mean the entire office belongs to Mint, her workspace is just a small section of it. But in any case, Mint welcomes you to visit her office.
ST_MinimapiconDec.minimapicon_dec_0013: A not-so-famous quiet bar hidden deep in the alleys of Bridge Crossings. Screw Driver embodies unspoken thoughts. Could it be that the patrons here also harbor stories deep within their hearts?
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_Pukaland_04_desc: Rest your feet and treat yourself to a cup of milk tea.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00503_Title: Please teach me how to get down without Chuppa.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00401_Title: Step into Ginkgo Street, escape the world. Just don't forget to go home for dinner.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_Core_7_desc: The dealership owner is a gifted storyteller. Every car on the lot has a story, true or not. But people are even more curious about the man himself.
ST_MinimapiconDec.MapExploreCustom_Dec:
The world is full of Anomalies of every kind—
some have been recorded, while others still wait to be found.
Some reveal the whole truth; others offer only a narrow glimpse.

No matter how hard people try to collect them all, the archive is always missing a few pages.
Not out of negligence. Some things take root in forgotten corners before anyone has time to classify them.

If, on your journey, you happen to look up and catch sight of such a branch, pluck it.
Then this curious encounter will not have been in vain.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_TrainStation_desc: This train station pulses with the city's heartbeat. It is the starting point of stories and a transit station for return journeys. On the platform where steel and light interweave, each whistle injects new rhythm and melody into the city.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_PukalandTicketShop_desc: This little stopover keeps your Pukaland adventure on track. Whatever you need, we're always here to help!
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00903_Title: The highest point on the island. Moonview Tower has a long history. Once collapsed and abandoned for years, it was recently restored. Islanders used to gather here to watch the stars and moon, saying it stood close to the heavens and was the perfect place to make a wish.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_Pukaland_07_desc: With so many sweet treats to choose from, every adventure is bound to taste a little better.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00605_Name: There are even higher mountains to climb on the horizon.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_024_desc: An anomaly technology company affiliated with Zerogon Laboratory. Their patented technology ranges from professional equipment like Arcs and Containment Devices to stress-relief toys like the Imaginadough, not only reshaping the lifestyle of Anomaly Hunters but also bringing anomalies into every household.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00305_Title: What's on your mind when the rain falls from the pavilion's eaves?
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00603_Name: The valley wind soars indiscriminately, today and forever.
ST_MinimapiconDec.WP_00203_Title: Just kidding! You'll definitely be able to hear these waters.
ST_MinimapiconDec.Map_Shop_022_desc: A popular family restaurant, it is the top choice for nearby students to gather and relax. Nothing like some affordable delicacy!

ST_MonsterManual.boss_16_BP_Found:
A Pop Toy from DSD's "Anomaly Products" line. Its shape and material vary depending on the creator's imagination and the way it is molded. When formed into a creature, it appears to become unstable.
"Great art isn't made only by great artists."
ST_MonsterManual.mon_17_BP_Unfound: Hethereau Urban Survival Guide, Rule 26: If you unfortunately forget to bring an umbrella on a rainy night, quickly find the nearest shelter and wait for the rain to stop. Do not approach the black-clad "individuals" carrying black umbrellas on the street. If they notice you and start approaching, immediately flee and call for help.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_13_BP_Found:
An Object Anomaly in the form of a Cursed Blade that appeared at an unknown time.
A pale mist emerges when approached. Linger too long, and through the ominous haze, a hand can be seen grasping the blade…
ST_MonsterManual.boss_18_BP_Found:
A Meme Anomaly born from rumors surrounding ETD-4 member Lacrimosa. Its face is nearly identical to hers, while its body is made of a red, jelly-like substance resembling Tomato 100. It is especially prone to attacking Tomato 100 vending machines.
"I heard… the truth… Is it real, or is it fake? It's only hearsay, so don't take it too seriously."
ST_MonsterManual.boss_13_BP_Unfound: Legend has it that on midnight city streets, when you slam the gas pedal, you'll see the headless rider on a blue-flame motorcycle, joining a chase where only losers exist.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_35_BP_Unfound: A one-legged tin soldier born from an author's pen, who became the protagonist of his own adventures after the original story came to an end.
ST_MonsterManual.boss_13_BP_Found:
A headless rider who appears only in the dead of night, roaming the city streets on a black motorcycle. Legend says it targets high-speed street racers, challenging them to races and harvesting their reckless psyches with a terrifying scythe after victory.
"Bone-chilling blue flames will burn away all passion."
ST_MonsterManual.mon_041_BP_Unfound: A helpless fledgling—every plaintive chirp is a mute accusation aimed at its mother.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_011_BP_Unfound:
Hiss, hiss, hissing away
What's in Mary's garden today?
Gone, gone, gone away
Where did Mary's little dog stray?
ST_MonsterManual.boss_26_BP_Found:
An Anomaly born from the theft of time. It erases the effects of stolen time and reclaims what was gained through deception. Even the once-mighty Constantine family was ultimately brought to ruin by its relentless pursuit.
"Ashes to ashes, dust to dust."
ST_MonsterManual.boss_07_BP_Unfound: The master of the garden, confined by words, will find his liberation through them.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_041_BP_Found:
The Nestbound Bird's Derivative Anomaly, looking like a cheap children's toy.
Their mother feathers, random toys lost by children, tattered balls of yarn, and shredded old newspapers are stitched together into hollow "Feather Puppets".
"My Mother made my bones, my siblings are my flesh, and my love is my blood."
ST_MonsterManual.boss_05_BP_Found:
An Oddity that appears in different biological forms depending on the observer, controlling an Anomalous Realm that it can construct and transform at will. Rumor has it that on the night of the 15th each month, if one harbors a wish and determination strong enough, there might be a chance to receive a response from Morphix.
"Clever people are always happy to make equivalent exchanges."
ST_MonsterManual.boss_19_BP_Found:
Within this Anomalous Realm, a massive, constantly-suffering whale is bound by whaling ship chains. The whale searches for someone powerful enough to help destroy its bindings.
"Its song is a cry for help."
ST_MonsterManual.boss_09_BP_Unfound: Brand your name upon the pitch-black pages, and surrender the full weight of your spirit to me.
ST_MonsterManual.boss_33_BP_Unfound: She haunts bustling districts, seeking out hidden corners to build her nest, biding her time for the chance to finally become a mother.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_14_BP_Unfound: Garbage sorting is every citizen's duty, and sometimes that includes certain Anomalies as well.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_40_BP_Unfound: When going out, always watch your belongings and beware of pickpockets and Pouch Mosquitoes.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_029_BP_Unfound: If you happen to hear an electronic remix of a song that was never released, you might want to check if a peculiar visitor has moved into your record player…
ST_MonsterManual.boss_26_BP_Unfound: Those who try to escape time are still just hamsters running on a clock face.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_019_BP_Unfound: The inseparable companion of childhood slowly faded from one's life, until it no longer appeared… not even in dreams. And so the abandoned doll began to dream on its own, dreaming of being close with its owner once more.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_015_BP_Found:
A Bio Anomaly that dwells within an old trailer.
It occasionally appears on highways throughout Hethereau. As the conditions that trigger its attacks remain unknown, citizens are advised to keep their distance upon spotting any trailer sporting octopus tentacles.
ST_MonsterManual.boss_07_BP_Found:
A silent boy who had closed off his heart wandered into a greenhouse tainted by harmful words. Vines took root in the boy's flesh and blood, drawing nourishment and forming cocoons of flowers. From this, all the words never spoken transformed into the shapes of all things.
"Scolding and discord become silent stillness, a garden of words."
ST_MonsterManual.boss_08_BP_Unfound: The girl's vivid, beautiful thoughts were so heavy they nearly drowned the butterfly's instinct to fly.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_016_BP_Unfound: When you stare at a vending machine, the vending machine stares back.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_08_BP_Found:
An Object Anomaly resembling an elegant gentleman's formal evening wear.
It prefers to appear in lavishly decorated or classically atmospheric locations. Accompanied by whispers and dance steps, a waltz of hunting is quietly underway.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_020_BP_Found:
An Object Anomaly resembling ancient, weathered armor.
It attained self-awareness after its master died in battle. Its movements are somewhat sluggish, its memory is hazy, and it prefers using polite speech. It never refuses photo requests from museum visitors. Currently serves as a guard at the Hethereau Museum.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_14_BP_Found:
An Object Anomaly resembling an ordinary trash can.
Decomposers of different appearances have different preferences for trash. When disposing of garbage, it's best to know their tastes.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_030_BP_Found:
A gentle Bio Anomaly shaped like a cleaning tool.
The Rain-Sweeping Maids absorb and store rainwater from rainy days, releasing it when the sun returns. Once, they were practical solutions for flooding, but polluted rainwater has left them confused and, sometimes, even aggressive. There have been reported incidents of Rain-Sweeping Maids partaking in violent behavior. Only by clearing away any contaminated water can they be restored to their normal state.
"Drenched in the rain—lost and lamenting."
Only appears on days with rain or snow.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_19_SadBear_BP:
An Object Anomaly resembling a large, tattered plush toy.
Once inseparable from its owner, an abandoned and neglected doll may transform into a caped, weapon-wielding Saddy Teddy. There are stitching marks over its heart, where the forsaken doll now resides.
"Sleep now, sleep now, and stay in your carefree dreams…"
ST_MonsterManual.mon_48_BP_Unfound: Opened a pop-up book and found yourself tumbling into a castle? In a world of fantasy, anything is possible.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_025_BP_Unfound: A colorful koi, obsessed with leaping over the Dragon Gate. It has existed in this world since the age of ancient legends.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_030_BP_Unfound:
Sweep, sweep, whether rain or shine.
Only appears on days with rain or snow.
ST_MonsterManual.boss_10_BP_Found:
Possessing the most magnificent ball gown and captivating, graceful dance moves, she is the soul and ruler of the dance floor; a true Prom Queen. When this attention-grabbing star invites you to dance, join her in completing this grand performance. After all… while life ends for even the finest dancers, the ball will never take its final bow.
"Dance! Dance!! Dance!!!"
ST_MonsterManual.mon_011_BP_Found:
A plant-type Bio Anomaly with snake-like tendrils.
According to existing records, it can grow up to 12 meters tall. Excels at camouflage and prefers dark, humid environments. Has cannibalistic habits, with animals, plants, and some low threat Anomalies all on its menu.
ST_MonsterManual.boss_15_BP_Unfound: Legend has it that in the plaza on the east side of Clement Academy, there exists a mysterious Anomaly that DJs…
ST_MonsterManual.boss_09_BP_Found:
The sins hidden in the dark abyss will finally face judgment. To become my master, you need only write down… your name. What is your name? What is your name? What is your name? What is your name? What is your name? What is your name? What is your name?
"What is your name?"
ST_MonsterManual.mon_33_BP_Unfound: Monsters that wander without consciousness, revealing their cruel nature once they sense any disturbance.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_02_BP_Unfound: Monsters that wander without consciousness, easily enraged by even the slightest movement.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_03_BP_Unfound: Monsters that wander without consciousness, using their brute strength to destroy everything they despise.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_04_BP_Unfound: Monsters that wander without consciousness, harboring intense hostility toward any creature that approaches.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_01_BP_Unfound: Monsters that wander without consciousness, roused only by the instinct to attack.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_05_BP_Unfound:
A monster that wanders without consciousness, launching the most vicious attacks without hesitation when disturbed.
Only appears at night.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_022_BP_Unfound: No matter who you are, having a passion for knowledge is never a bad thing.
ST_MonsterManual.boss_05_BP_Unfound: Whether it's an unspeakably savage beast or a gentle, fluffy companion depends entirely on your eyes.
ST_MonsterManual.boss_33_BP_Found:
The mother bird, nesting deep in the shadows, calls out to lost children with its gentle, sweet female voice, asking if they would like to become her children. If the poor child agrees, they will remain in the it's nest forever.
"Don't take my children away from me…"
ST_MonsterManual.mon_013_BP_Unfound: Originally just an ordinary long blade forged by an ordinary swordsmith, it became tainted by a dreadful curse and has since slain master after master by its own edge.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_03_BP_Found:
A Bio Anomaly that has not found its stable form.
A Protocore that relies on an exceptionally sturdy arm for battle. Its aggression and danger level are significantly higher compared to ordinary Protocores.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_01_BP_Found:
A Bio Anomaly that has not found a stable form.
The most basic creatures within the Protocore. They lack autonomous consciousness, but battle instincts are deeply ingrained in their flesh and blood.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_33_BP_Found:
A Bio Anomaly that has yet to find its stable form.
Protocores influenced by factors such as "knowledge" and "the unconscious" secrete an ink imbued with "stream of consciousness" properties. Often appears in knowledge-dense areas or near Anomalies associated with knowledge.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_02_BP_Found:
A Bio Anomaly that has not found a stable form.
One of the few Protocores with ranged attack capabilities. When its range is breached, it will begin relentlessly trying to drive away enemies.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_04_BP_Found:
A Bio Anomaly that has not found a stable form.
A hunched Protocore. It moves slowly and carries a short blade, acting purely on instinct. Indiscriminately attacks any target in sight.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_05_BP_Found:
A Bio Anomaly that has not found a stable form.
A beast-shaped Protocore. Upon spotting a target, it automatically considers them an enemy and will relentlessly attack until either the enemy is driven away or it is nullified.
Only appears at night.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_38_BP_Found: A common street gang found throughout Hethereau. They harass vehicles, speed recklessly, and vandalize public property. A significant number of members fanatically worship the Headless Rider. While they typically don't cross any serious lines, leaving them unchecked can still cause considerable trouble for public safety.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_38_BP_Unfound: Street gangs of Hethereau, often found lurking in streets and alleyways. A constant headache for the Security Office.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_24_BP_Found:
An Object Anomaly resembling a triangular kite.
The upward-facing side has patterns similar to human faces. Close observation reveals they display different grotesque expressions. Spine-chilling…
ST_MonsterManual.mon_023_BP_Found:
An Object Anomaly with a humanoid shape and a torso resembling a traditional light bulb.
When it appears, it steals electricity and causes power outages in the surrounding area.
Only appears at night.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_037_BP_Found:
An Object Anomaly resembling a phone booth.
It belongs to the Yggash Court and has teleportation capabilities, allowing Espers to quickly travel around the world.
Phone booths that consume unknown food will become aggressive.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_48_BP_Found:
An Object Anomaly resembling a pop-up book.
If you spot a strange wax seal on the ground and walk toward it, you'll find the earth beneath your feet gradually unfolding… into an open pop-up book? Have you stepped into a fairy tale world? Come to think of it, can you actually go inside this castle?
ST_MonsterManual.mon_26_BP_Found:
An Object Anomaly resembling paper planes.
Comprised of three types: red, white, and red-and-white patterned. They appear in swarms, slowly rotating nose-to-tail in their normal state. When entering battle, they speed up, swirling into a tornado formation.
"How can you make a paper plane fly farther?"
ST_MonsterManual.mon_025_BP_Found:
A Phenomenon Anomaly that resembles carp swimming through the air.
Obsessed with finding and crossing the Dragon Gate, these carp continuously descend from the heavens, just to return to the sky after failure. No matter how many times they fail, their pursuit of the Dragon Gate remains unchanged, and they will still actively challenge anything that might be Gate…
ST_MonsterManual.mon_029_BP_Found:
A Bio Anomaly, taking the form of a Haunted Record Player.
It dwells inside the record player and will angrily attack when humans attempt to touch or approach it. If you see yellow tape marked "Do Not Touch" on any electrical device, it's best to stay away.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_016_BP_Found:
A Bio Anomaly, taking the form of a Haunted Vending Machine.
It dwells inside the machine, using the screen on its body to observe surrounding enemies. If enemies disappear from its line of sight, however, it will lose track of them entirely.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_023_BP_Unfound:
The purpose of an electric light is to shine, but there are exceptions.
Only appears at night.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_037_BP_Unfound: A phone booth that can't make calls may sound like a prank, but the one telling the joke isn't laughing.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_18_BP_Unfound: A fluffy Anomaly that looks gentle and adorable, and actually is gentle and adorable… probably.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_020_BP_Unfound: The hollow armor strives to mimic the words and deeds of the one who once wore it, as if still living in an age of glory.
ST_MonsterManual.boss_08_BP_Found:
A massive, lumbering butterfly drags a trail of movie ticket stubs, forever yearning for the sky, yet doomed to wander here day after day.
"Run away… but is escape even possible?"
ST_MonsterManual.mon_26_BP_Unfound: From the moment a paper plane is born, its mission is to fly forever.
ST_MonsterManual.boss_10_BP_Unfound: Center stage… beneath the spotlight… gowns swaying, fabric rustling softly… The most magnificent ball you'll ever witness in your lifetime is about to begin.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_012_1_BP_Unfound: A flashy Anomaly that roams among the equally flashy street graffiti, fancying itself a part of the art.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_012_BP_Found:
An Object Anomaly that hides within street graffiti.
Its body is composed of vibrant color blocks. Its hobby is startling citizens, but it's also passionate about leaving its own imprint throughout the streets and alleys with spray paint.
"I want all the info on this graffiti artist in three minutes."
"Wait, wait… Are those… two arms reaching out from the wall?"
ST_MonsterManual.mon_015_BP_Unfound: Please maintain a safe distance from other vehicles while driving, even if it's just an unassuming old truck.
ST_MonsterManual.boss_04_BP_Found:
An Oddity of unknown origin. Its skin resembles a sea otter in a yellow coat, with a TV for a head and its own image displayed on the screen. It currently works as a repairman at Eibon Antique Shop.
"Taygedo?"
ST_MonsterManual.mon_Unfound: This enemy has not been found yet.
ST_MonsterManual.boss_15_BP_Found:
Follow the beat, press buttons when the time is right… And there you go. You're now a rhythm gamer.
"Congratulations, you achieved 99 Perfects and 1 Great in this challenge."
ST_MonsterManual.mon_017_BP_Found:
An Object Anomaly that generally takes the form of an umbrella.
It drags anyone who tries to pick up the umbrella into the "rain alley" and attacks them.
On rainy nights, it manifests as a Rainman, a figure clad in black and holding a black umbrella.
Rainmen often operate alone or in small groups. During unusual weather events, they may appear in swarms.
"If you see an unattended umbrella outside, please do not approach it."
ST_MonsterManual.MM_mon_018_BP_Found:
A Bio Anomaly that typically resembles a rabbit.
Soft throughout with a pleasant texture, it loves basking in the sun. Though, if someone starts a fire nearby, you might be surprised to see the hidden side of these little creatures.
"Fluff… Fluff…"
ST_MonsterManual.mon_08_BP_Unfound: The one who invites you to dance may not be human, but is certainly a gentleman.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_27_BP_Found:
A deer-like Bio Anomaly that must be fed with Fons.
Its unique feeding requirements and elegant appearance have made it a favorite among the wealthy. In reality, it is quite ferocious by nature, revealing sharp bone spikes from within its body when attacking. It requires massive amounts of Fons annually to remain obedient.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_27_BP_Unfound: A beautiful monster that feeds on money, far less docile and harmless than it appears.
ST_MonsterManual.mon_24_BP_Unfound: The kite soars through the sky, yet seems to be watching every movement on the ground below…
ST_MonsterManual.boss_19_BP_Unfound: Who knows what kind of encounter awaits you when you hear a strange song echoing through the tunnels…?
