ST_Player.Role_Name_019_des: Bureau of Anomaly Control, CSU-2 Member

ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1076:
…I baked a cake.
Mint wanted to help, but I didn't let her. I think I made the right call. At least she was happy to be a taste tester. Baking is more complicated than I expected. Though dumcat liked the trial samples a lot, I still didn't feel quite confident enough… That's why I prepared a gift on top of it.
It's nothing special, and there aren't any interesting stories behind it, but maybe next year, we'll see if it will have acquired some special meaning… I'm sure there will also be a new gift to accompany it. I mean, that's what I guess would happen.
Anyway—happy birthday.
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1003:
A few days ago, Nanally dragged the local idiot and me into some "special ops meeting" and made us promise not to tell you. You're clever—I bet you've already guessed what it was about, right? Happy Birthday!! Honestly, Nanally was such a headache about the whole thing… she had zero clue what you wanted, so she had us running all over the New Herland District for the entire afternoon!
Of course, I personally got a birthday gift for you, too. Don't worry, I can attest that it hasn't been inside Kiroumaru's stomach… yet. Keeping that pig from eating it these past two days was a full-time job!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1019:
Knock, knock! Mint Logistics here, running like the wind to deliver something for Coco! Please make sure you're at home to receive the gift and sign for it (the delivery fee will be billed to your account)!! I'd better see your biggest, brightest smile today!
Chop chop! Draw a smiley face on this 'Happy Birthday' card and open the exclusive surprise I got just for you, Coco!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1039:
Happy Birthday, sweet thing~
On this day, however long ago, the world robbed you of your decision to decide on whether you wanted to be born or not—congratulations! So, what's it gonna be? What kind of wish are you cooking up? Don't be shy, spill everything. I want to all of it.
Also, I might've… gotten you a little something. Guaranteed to be unlike anything you've ever seen. Swing by tonight, and it's yours.
Ooh, I can't wait to see the look on your face~~!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1010:
HAPPPPPPPY BIRTHDAAAAAY!!! I was the first to message you, right? I stayed up all night to make sure…
Everyone at Eibon got you a whole bunch of stuff—cake, books, some weird new tech… I didn't actually see our Boss's present, just a tiny little box with your name on it. As for Sakiri's gift… she wouldn't tell me she got you. She said if I'd knew, I'd totally spill the beans. AS IF!!
I couldn't sleep trying to come up with a gift for you, so I left it in the hands of the universe! Whatever you get, you gotta' let me know, OK? I'm dying to know!!!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1055:
Happy birthday, Appraiser.
Sterry Express prides itself on its brand image—just sending a voicemail on your big day isn't enough. Since today's all about you, I had to personally oversee the delivery of your gift. The gifts themselves are already on their way. All that's left is the letter.
If you're free, why not come over and see it for yourself?
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1073:
Happy Birthday!
I saw on your Bagel profile that today's your day—Hopefully I got the date right… If I didn't, consider this a belated happy birthday… or an early one! Even if my little message doesn't mean much, I still wanted to let you know!
Actually, I baked a cake and even got you a gift. I only found out after moving to Hethereau that everyone here does the cake-and-presents thing for birthdays. I was super excited planning and prepping your gift—who knew you could be this happy for someone else? As for the gift, I'm gonna keep it under wraps for now. I'll tell you once we meet up!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1025:
Route locked, package loaded, engine on—that's my daily mantra, day in, day out. Today was supposed to be the same… except this delivery's a little different. It's not headed for a bunch of different addresses on a list. It's going to one place, for one very specific person…
I'm not great at celebrations, and I don't care for those 'feel-good' lines. I prefer actions over words. So,
—Happy Birthday, Appraiser.
If I didn't fear that showing up in person might bother you, I would've already been right in front of you, saying these words to you myself.
Hopefully your future is full of clear skies and smooth sailing. If you ever need anything, just let me know—Sterry's Elite Courier is on call for you, anytime.
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1020:
Appraiser, I've got a super-duper top-secret to tell you—this morning, while I was out delivering packages, I passed a big tree with a bunch of birds chirping, and I suddenly realized… I could actually understand what the birds were saying! Isn't that crazy? I couldn't bear to walk away from something so magical, so the brilliant Haniel slammed on the brakes, perked her ears, and listened carefully to what each little birdie had to say. Unsurprisingly, they all had the same message—
"Happy birthday, Appraiser!"
Naturally, Haniel also yelled, "Happy birthday, Appraiser!"
Now the Appraiser's got twice the amount of "happy birthday" messages. But well-wishes alone aren't enough, hmph. The great Haniel has also prepared a huuuuge gift just for you!
"What if the Appraiser doesn't like the gift?" one of the little birdies asked.
"Oh? Are you doubting the all-knowing, all-powerful Haniel?" I responded. "No need to worry—today, Haniel will grant your every wish. If you want it, I'll make it happen!"
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1033:
Happy birthday, Appraiser.
As this is your first birthday in Eibon as our Appraiser, I have prepared a few gifts for you. They were put together somewhat in haste, so I hope you'll overlook any shortcomings. Everyone in Eibon has prepared gifts as well, so please, take the day to truly relax. I shall handle any of your commissions in your stead.
And, of course—welcome to Eibon.
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1004:
Happy Birthday, Appraiser… Lacrimosa didn't get the date wrong… right? Huh… Lacrimosa made sure to write it down in her phone… It… should be right.
Birthdays are really nice… You get to take the day off. And give gifts to good friends. The Appraiser is a good friend, so lacrimosa had to get a gift. But… Lacrimosa didn't know what to get. She went to the team for help, so we went out to pick out a gift together. There was so much stuff to choose from at the store… Lacrimosa started to get dizzy. But we finally picked something out. Appraiser, wanna take a look?
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_1090_Content:
*Happy birthday to you~ Happy birthday to you~*
All the messages and little gestures from people who care about you today must be filling your heart with warmth and giving you wonderful memories. And I'm here to add a little more warmth to the mix!
I picked out your gift based on what I calculated you'd like. I had a few other options ready too, but where's the fun in giving away every surprise? Maybe one will be next year's gift, or the year after!
Come on! Blow out the candles on a huge frosted cake and make a wish, surrounded by all your friends! You're the star of the day!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Haniya_Content_2026:
00:00, happy birthday to Haniel!!!
Hehe, I even set an alarm just for this—I'm going to celebrate every single minute from midnight today until midnight tomorrow! A day such as this only comes once a year, after all. No matter how old you get, birthdays are always worth celebrating, and you can never have too many gifts, cakes, or birthday wishes!
According to my schedule, from now until breakfast is just enough time to re-watch all my favorite anime. I already pressed play right at midnight, so the first part of the plan is already going perfectly. After breakfast, I'm meeting up with some friends to go shopping, and I want to try baking myself a cake too. Appraiser, do you want to come with? Please, please come with! With your blessing, it's sure to be the best birthday ever!
Ah, I almost forgot—the Appraiser is probably already asleep at this hour. Then my birthday wish this year is that when the Appraiser wakes up and sees this email, you'll come celebrate Haniel's birthday with me!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1075:
>w< Appraiser, happy birthday!!
I never got the chance to ask—what kind of birthday gift would you like?
My first thought was to give you a sweet dream! But the more I thought about it, the stingier it sounded. I'd just be using my Esper Ability like I always do, so how could that count as a special gift? So if there's anything else you want, just tell me! Of course, I'll still save you a spot on the "Dream Day Trip"!
Or, Appraiser, would you be interested in seeing the Ivory Gate in my dream? On your birthday, getting to experience the feeling of slowly growing from an embryo into a person all over again… That sounds pretty on-theme, OwO
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1071:
[Recording…]
Appraiser, happy birthday!
Of course, on such an important day, just a "happy birthday" isn't enough. That's why I got you a Super VIP for Xtreme99. Let's go and celebrate like crazy!
Ah, I'm not sure you have many other friends along or birthday parties scheduled already. Umm, this invite might be too sudden… Anyway, let me know if you want to join me!
I hope you have a great day! Not just today, but may your days be ever great!

Send
Send
Why it no send
Is it this button
[Message sent]
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1054: I noticed your weapon was looking a bit dull during our last training session. Make sure you're keeping up with the maintenance—I don't want you to get hurt. Actually, uh… Is there anything special you'd like to eat today? I'm not exactly a pro in the kitchen… but I can pick up some stuff from the store and maybe get some pointers from Mr. Adler. Also, I heard that the moon is going to be out in full tonight—the kind of night perfect for making a couple of wishes. Anyway… Happy Birthday. I'm looking forward to what the future brings.
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_1090_title: The world is celebrating your special day!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_1057_title: Just a Sunny Day for You
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Xiaozhi_Content_202:
This morning, when I went to buy a rice ball at the convenience store, the owner said they were running a promotion, and I could use my store points for a lottery. I actually won a rice ball! It was my first time winning anything, so I felt really good about myself. At noon, I got a lot of gifts from my coworkers, and Kolinsna even reserved an entire floor of the Firmament to celebrate. In my hometown, only children actually celebrate birthdays, as a way of marking another year of growing up. But… Birthdays really are wonderful days.
I'd like to invite you to my birthday celebration—not that I'm demanding it! I just hope you can come. I want to give you the rice ball. That way, maybe I can share a little of my good luck with you, too?
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Adele_Content_2026:
It wasn't until Little Buni brought me a bouquet this morning that I was reminded what day it was. Before coming to Eibon, I rarely paid attention to occasions such as these—but as Nanally says, birthdays are important to celebrate!
As it just so happens, the flower jam I made last night is ready to open. I'll use it to make some pastries and tea. If you have the time, Appraiser, do stop by for a taste!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Nannali_Content_202:
Today is the Coluccis' big founding-day bash, so we've gotta celebrate it properly!
I asked Adler yesterday, and he said today's probably gonna be nice and sunny! Good weather's great and all, but man, it's really hot out there… So we should go to the beach! The ocean, barbecue, and beach volleyball—don't you think that's the recipe for a fun day?! As expected of the Ichi-daime of the Coluccis—another perfect solution!
It's settled! As an honorary member of the Coluccis, you absolutely have to come!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Hasuoer_Content_202:
Ever since I started working at Sterry, I've been getting packages sent to me, even on holidays. Since I took the day off for my birthday, getting up early to sort through everyone's gifts leaves me a little overwhelmed.
After I finished replying to all the messages, I did my usual maintenance on my motorcycle. I didn't have any special assignments today, so I just took a leisurely ride through the countryside. Compared to the efficiency I usually have at work, a joyride with no destination lets me notice things I normally never would. It's a pity there wasn't anyone around to enjoy the scenery with. I saved the coordinates, though the mountain roads are winding and the place isn't easy to find. If you're interested, I can take you there.
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Haiyue_Title_2026: If I Were to Make a Wish…
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Exe_Content_2026:
Members of ETD-6 sent some extra data and items.
If you've got storage space to spare, feel free to take some.
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_YeerMu_Content_2027:
You know, everyone seems to have their own idea of when my birthday is, so I could end up celebrating it with different friends again and again throughout the year! It sounds a little exhausting, sure, but if it's fun, why not do it more than once?
But if I had to choose just one date, I'd pick this one: the anniversary of the day I joined the Bureau as a "person"!
Huh... I guess that's a little like the day you make your first friend at the start of a new school year, isn't it?~*
So I think I'll have a tiny, secret birthday celebration today! Hehe, don't tell anyone!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Canhong_Content_202:
To be honest, I don't really know when my birthday is, or even how old I am. Instead, this is the day Inanna found me and gave me my name. In past years, aside from a few people from "The Scarlet Letter," no one knew about this day, nor did anyone care.
But when I think about the amount of living I still have to do, spending so much time without anything to mark it by always feels… wrong. So, I decided to tell you—if only to keep myself from forgetting this date, too. If I remember by this time next year, I'll come remind you. Just think of today as an unfortunate day, or forget about it entirely. After all, you have plenty of other days to remember.
Still, if you really are willing to wish me well, then thank you, Appraiser.
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Zhenhong_Content_20:
When I first came to Hethereau, I never imagined birthdays would become something I'd look forward to this much. Having friends by your side really does make all the difference. Mint kept saying that weather like this absolutely requires an outdoor BBQ party, and Iroi said she'd come too—even if she still had to trade a few barbs with me like usual. But it still feels like it's missing a little something, or, well, that's what Mint said. After all, gatherings like this are way better when there are more people around.
I guess I'm rambling a bit. Thanks for your gift and birthday wishes… If you could come too, that would be wonderful!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_1036_Content:
I trust you've been well, dear birthday celebrant so beloved by all. Regrettably, the congratulations you've received are from me, so I hope you won't mind too much.
To make amends for the good mood I've spoiled, I can accompany you anywhere, or we can spend a serene, quiet day at home as usual, if you wish. Or, if it is your desire, I can disappear from your sight and thoughts for a time… As for how long, that depends on when you would wish to see me again.
Do you have a wish? Or rather, what is it you've always wished for? At least for today, I am willing to grant it.
No matter what you may think: Happy Birthday, Appraiser.
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Title_1019: Special Delivery! An Awesome, Incredible, Fantastic Surprise Just for Coco!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Bohe_Content_2026:
Heh heh heh! There's a super big secret baking in the oven—a chiffon cake made with an entire vanilla bean! I followed a tutorial on Bagel to the letter! Deliciousness guaranteed—I definitely, definitely didn't mess it up! Once it's fresh out of the oven, I'll top it with some mint leaves. Hehe, I can't wait!
You'll come, right, Coco? I've already got your plate and fork on the table!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Aidejia_Content_202: Another birthday with everyone… I'm so excited! I feel all warm and cuddly, just like the scarf my mother once knitted… Thank you, everyone…
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Xun_Content_2026: Oh, birthday wishes and a gift from my Precious… it must be brimming with good-fortune energy! What's the story behind this ordinary-looking little thing? By my standards, it must be something special. You've got a good eye. Hmm~ I'll think about putting it in the spot with the best feng shui in the shop. As for your wish, well… I'll accept it for now—but if it doesn't come true… hehe~ then my Precious will have to work a bit harder to make it happen, right?!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Baicang_Content_202: Hm? But today isn't my birthday. Did you get the date wrong? Or did you mix me up with someone else…? (clutches chest) That's really hurtful! To make it up to me, how about giving me another birthday gift? Just kidding. Thank you for the birthday wishes and the gift. I really like it. Believe me, I'm putting today down as one of the one hundred beautiful things in life worth living for! The other ninety-nine… hmm, I'll need to start a list~
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Tajiduo_Content_202: The day Sakiri found Taygedo in a pile of old appliances! Taygedo is soooo happy!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1052: It's your big day, so I'll let you off the hook. Enjoy your day off. In this day and age, a manager who actually cares about her employees is basically nonexistent. So appreciate me while you still can! Don't let those food delivery gigs delude you with all that talk of "work-life balance". I've had Adler prepare a ton of food—even the expensive stuff. I tried some of it, and it's pretty good. The little rascals will get to enjoy the day because of you. While you're at it, throw a coin in the fountain for the shop!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Yi_Content_2026:
When work gets busy, it's easy to forget my own birthday. My teammates were the ones who reminded me, and they even suggested I take the day off.
Taking a day off for your birthday is pretty common, but hearing that from those two, I couldn't help worrying that if I stayed away from the office for a day, something bad might happen…
And sure enough, ha… the moment I walked in, I got a face full of confetti.
They'd even planned for me to turn around and leave… Looking back, it was actually rather amusing, so I thought I'd share it with you.
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Fadiya_Content_2026: My birthday? If you make me think about those pretentious dresses and all those spit-flinging old fossils at formal dinners again, I'll throw up everywhere. There are way more fun things to do~ Why not come celebrate with me instead? The streets are packed with fang-baring monsters—how many people do you think are using "costumes" as an excuse to drag out the darkness they normally keep hidden, deep down? Now and then, you can even get your hands on some fresh, tender flesh, with such an alluring scent that you can't help wanting to lick and taste… Huh? I'm talking about the candy and cupcakes everyone buys. What were you thinking?
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Jiuyuan_Content_202:
Sterry has been unusually lively since this morning.
The little ones keep calling it "routine decorating," but they're making far too much noise for something they're planning as a "birthday surprise". I was going to sort out the next few days' work in advance, but they stopped me, saying that on a day like this, I shouldn't be burying myself in work—much less spending it alone.
If the Appraiser has some time today, stop by the shop for a bit. Let's catch up over a cup of coffee. It'd help me catch my breath amid all this "surprise" business.
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Kaesi_Content_2026:
A new year's started—happy New Year! And actually, today's my birthday too!
My birthday just happens to fall on New Year's Day, so I've never had a birthday party all to myself. Still, I get a more lavish New Year's meal. Too bad the Bureau doesn't have a tradition of dining together on New Year's, so for the past two years, I've spent both my birthday and New Year's alone. Without any celebration, wandering the streets by myself makes it feel like just another ordinary day.
There's nothing wrong with an ordinary day, but the important thing is that I'm off today, and doing nothing would be way too boring!
So… um, are you free today? Want to go wander around together? I'll cover everything!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_1042_Content:
Last night, a particularly bright star shone overhead. I had a feeling that today might be a very special day for you.
I'm glad I can wish you a happy birthday and take this chance to tell you how grateful I am. I once felt lost, shackled to a fate shrouded in fog, but with you by my side, every unknown has now become a surprise to look forward to.
And what about me? In the brief time our paths have crossed, have I meant something to you, too?
…But we already know the answer, don't we?
In the coming year, and for many years after, may bright starlight guide you as your story unfolds, one new chapter after another. Continue on, without fear. The birds will watch over your dreams, and you'll always have my heartfelt blessings for the brave soul you are.
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Haiyue_Content_2026:
For a long time, I didn't really like making wishes. I always felt that anything I wished for would end up coming true in some twisted way, like a bad joke.
But little by little, I started to understand. Maybe my wishes were just too big, too extravagant, and it was my own greed that came back to bite me. If I only wish for little things—the kind I can bring about myself with effort—then fate won't have a cruel joke to play on me, right?
Today is my birthday, so I finally have a perfectly good excuse to make a wish. My wish is… Ah, if I say it out loud, won't it cancel out? Still, if you'd be willing to come share birthday cake with me, then I think a small part of that wish will have already come true.
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Heiyu_Content_2027:
Birthday…? Hehe, that's a pretty unfamiliar word to me.
To tell you the truth, I don't know whether today is my actual birthday or not. During my years of wandering, I chose this day to mark the passing of each year on the human calendar, just so I wouldn't lose track of time. On that otherwise ordinary day, I'd weave myself a flower crown, name a star, or set off on a little journey with a flock of birds… Ah, but that was a long time ago.
Since I've made this day special, I suppose I should do something special as well. Let's see… Should I stay in and watch movies all day? Or finally get out and explore the city?
It'd be even better if you joined me.
And no saying no! Today's my day, so every wish I have today must come true, right?
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_1057_Content:
Happy birthday, Appraiser. On this special day, may every day bring you joy, may your wishes come true, and may peace and happiness be yours.
…
Okay, I copied that from a Bagel search result for "101 Birthday Wishes for Friends." I'm not exactly a wordsmith, so I honestly had no idea what to say on a day like this, okay?
I've asked a lot of you lately. Still, we've also been through a ton together. Getting to join "THE WHOOTS!!!!" and be in the same band as you honestly makes me the happiest person alive. People always say my golden hair is like the sun. I don't know if that's really true, but… if I could be the band's "sun," bringing clear skies, and chasing away the rain, that'd be the best.
Uh… was that a little too sappy? Ahem. Anyway, I really do wish you a happy birthday. If you've got time, come by the live music venue and have a drink with me. Ha, that's more like my usual self, huh?
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1021: Happy birthday, Appraiser. Would you happen to know what the best possible gift to get someone is? I hope the one I got for you is good enough. If it wasn't exactly what you wanted, then… I'll just have to get a better one next time. :D
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Anhunqu_Content_202:
To me, birthdays mean: a day off. Lacrimosa doesn't remember her birthday, but… Lacrimosa remembers wanting a day off… And, um… "A birthday's meaning is something people give to it… So, Mosa, you can just pick any day you like as your birthday~"—that's what Baicang and the others said to me.
So Lacrimosa's birthday is today!
… Everyone said it was very sudden. But Lacrimosa got… tomato ice-cream cake. Delicious. Birthdays make Lacrimosa very happy. Appraiser, you'll come too, right?
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1008:
On your birthday, I'd like to extend my sincere congratulations on behalf of the Bureau of Anomaly Control ETD-4.
Not everyone would say something this formal, so I'll take the honor… We've always felt fortunate to have someone as dependable as you outside the Bureau.
Here's to continuing our strong collaboration in the future.
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Zaowu_Content_2026:
Seriously, how do you all manage to remember birthdays so clearly? Nanally was badgering me about it before, and I was like, who even remembers that kind of thing… a day only little kids get hyped for? Then she went and asked Adler, and he actually gave her a date… He must've just tossed out some random number to get Nanally off his back, but she actually took it seriously and started treating it like my real birthday. So every year around this time she ends up making a huge thing out of it, and I really have no idea what she's planning this year…
It's not like I'm looking forward to it. I just don't want to kill the mood. Anyway, it's probably the same old routine no matter what—one giant cake and a bunch of little odds and ends she dug up from who knows where… Anyway, you'd better not be late tonight. If you are, then you can eat whatever Kiroumaru leaves behind!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Title_1004: Is the Gift More Important Than the Meaning Behind It?
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1070:
Dear Appraiser,
Greetings.
This is to inform you that this Committee has verified today as your birthday. Please be advised.

Given that the Appraiser's birthday is a day of utmost importance, this Committee recommends the following measures to ensure the day proceeds with no issues:
1. Please refrain from going to work as usual. If circumstances do not permit, please leave early and spend the day with important friends and loved ones.
2. Please ensure adequate intake of sweets. Should you have no access, this Committee is able to provide a sufficient supply of desserts. Kindly reply at your earliest convenience with your preferences and desired amount.
3. Please do not forget to make a wish before the day ends. Specifics need not be reported, and this Committee will not interfere, but we sincerely hope your wish comes true.

Should any unforeseen issues arise during your celebrations, please feel free to contact Committee staff at any time. We will respond immediately.

Sincerely,
Appraiser Birthday Committee (temporary name)
Aurelia

p.s. I'm really, truly glad you were born into this world. Happy birthday!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Misimo_Content_2026:
I hope this letter finds you well.
After leaving Hethereau, my brother and I drifted at sea for a few days. It's a supposedly "luxury" cruise ship, but the cook's skills don't do these ingredients justice, and the noisy seagulls keep circling the ship—why am I even writing this██████████
My brother just told me to write and let you know I'm safe and sound. I have nothing else to say. No need to write back. I'm not really interested in birthdays, and I'm not expecting any birthday gifts. Just wanted to let you know.
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Mingyin_Content_202:
Birthdays feel both familiar and unfamiliar to me. I used to think birthdays deserved a proper celebration. But as I got older, I gradually started treating mine like any other day. So when Haniel and Nanally burst into the live music venue today carrying a birthday cake, they really caught me off guard. I only found out later that they'd planned the surprise with the manager. I'd be lying if I said I wasn't touched. Right then, I was so glad I hadn't given up on music or playing in a band, and that I'd joined "THE WHOOTS!!!!" I heard they even contacted Aurelia and Suzuha… That little bird and cat just love getting everyone involved, don't they?
So… you're coming, right? I haven't celebrated my birthday in ages. Maybe making a bit of an occasion of it wouldn't be so bad?
I'm looking forward to seeing you.
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Dafudier_Content_20: Thank you for your birthday wishes and the invitation. I still have training scheduled today, so perhaps I shouldn't use my "birthday" as an excuse to slack off… At least, that's what I thought, but Hotori told me, "You should relax once in a while, especially on days worth celebrating". Perhaps… a birthday does count as a day worth celebrating. At the very least, I'm very glad to have met you all. Oh, and Hotori gave me a few tickets for some flower viewing. It seems there are enough tickets for all of us? I wonder what's blooming this time of year…? (thinking)
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_1072_Content:
Appraiser, Appraiser! Happy birthday!
I've been thinking since this morning about how to give you a huge birthday surprise—like making a galaxy-sized birthday cake! Or spending the whole day at Pukaland together! Or having Xiaozhen wear cat ears and sing Happy Birthday to you in cat language (she only agreed to wear the cat ears, though)! Or do ab-so-lutely nothing—we could play games, watch movies, and just space out together—as long as we're having fun, it doesn't matter to me!
I wonder what kind of wish you'll make this year, Appraiser. I really want to know… For us, being on the same frequency means every wish becomes one we share, right?
Happy birthday, Appraiser—next year, ten years from now, even ten thousand years from now! Every birthday must be a happy one!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Lingke_Content_2026:
Appraiser, Appraiser, this might be sudden, but today's my birthday!
Every year on this day, I bring a birthday cake to the top of Hethereau Skytower. I light one candle for every star in the sky, then wait, and wait, and wait. If a comet passes by, I take a deep breath and make a wish! By doing so, the comet will carry my wish all around the galaxy! That way, every star in the universe gets my invitation!
After joining ETD-6, I invited everyone, and even Xiaozhen, to a cosmic-themed birthday party, but they seem to prefer celebrating in the office. Still, I'm happy regardless of where we celebrate, because birthdays are supposed to be fun~
If you're free today, Appraiser, will you come hang out with me? We could go to the beach, or walk around the Harbor District… Oh! Let's go to Pukaland! I've always wanted to explore Pukaland with you! Can we? Can we?!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_CharacterBirthday_Yiluoyi_Content_202:
Appraiser, it's my birthday today, OwO. I was going to throw a birthday party and invite you, but it just so happens to be my regular checkup day at the hospital, UwU.
Now that I think about it, it was like this last year too. And the year before that. And the year before that… I… I think it's always been like this. Oh, right—the last birthday party I had was nine years ago, and it was at the hospital too!
Because the checkup happens every year, it always falls on the same day as my birthday.
Aha, I understand now… ><!!
Anyway! If there's still time after the checkup, I'll come find you and hang out, OwO. We can grab a meal together—my treat! It'll be our little celebration~
Oops, time's up! I have to go into the exam room now. See you~~~~
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1023: No wonder my sleep's been garbo lately. I've even been skipping work, totes convinced that something huge was about to go down… turns out it's just because it's *someone's* birthday today!! Having birthdays is actually great for your health, by the way. Research shows that the more birthdays you have, the longer you live (factual, by the way). As for the well-wishes… I'm not really the type to say things like 'stay young' or 'keep that chin up'. Life's a long road—since when was it ever a smooth ride? I'm just hopin' that you continue being you. No deeper meaning, just good vibes!<(￣︶￣)>

ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_6_Desc:
DSD is holding a fan works convention. Outstanding creators have the opportunity to work with Bichir Whites on the next pop toy! Come and unleash your imagination!
"Pop toys are a classical discipline. Next, let's talk about the first chapter, the origin of philosophy…"
ST_Quest.s111100_HideItemDesc: A mysterious Arc, seemingly connected to some story…
ST_Quest.s111800_BlackWheel: Blackbird and I rode the Puka Wonder Wheel thirteen times in a row, and… nothing happened.
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_15_Desc:
An expedition team is looking for new members to explore new frontiers in the Leisure Corridor.
"Program sponsored by Falcon, our trendiest exclusive partner in sports."
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_3_Desc:
Generally speaking, Beetle Coins are not aggressive creatures… but there are special cases. Nurse your swollen forehead and battle the super-evolved Beetle Coin!
"I'm so gonna be rich with this huge coin… Wa-wait… ouch!"
ST_Quest.s110604_01_Picture: A wall covered in layers of overlapping spray-painted graffiti designs.
ST_Quest.q110136_Dlg_Des: Meanwhile, on the other side of the city, Boomboom and Dandelion are also preparing to head home…
ST_Quest.q110192_Blackfade_02: Later, the guarantor takes Miss Tako home. Due to scattered Imaginadough, Azure Vista is in disarray, forcing us to spend the next few days…
ST_Quest.CR_Battle_AirWallMessage: Nullify the Oddities to secure evacuation
ST_Quest.s110611_01_BlackScreen: After enduring several rounds of bewildered stares from passersby, you waited until dawn…
ST_Quest.s110626_01_BlackScreen: You told Ethan everything about your investigation process and showed him the photos. His expression changed like a revolving lantern—from shock to disappointment, and finally settling into calmness.
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_12_Desc:
Grandpa Issac at the Mechanic Shop is a bit hard of hearing, so when you are checking! The billing info! With him!! Please! Speak! Louder! Other than sorting out financial records, Grandpa Issac seems to have a knack for vehicle repair…
"Time flies like an arrow, and the past can only… What? Speak louder! I can't hear you!"
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_11_Desc:
The Backstreet Boxer longs for a fight! Temper your strength in the white hot crucible of the ring, fist against fist!
"Left! Right! Too slow! Harder… phew, that was a nice massage for the shoulders, thanks!"
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_8_Desc:
Help Nydia, the manager of Jingle Wrangle find a new home for the oddities. Good deeds never go unappreciated.
"Jingle, jangle, and a brand new home."
ST_Quest.s111800_BlackMaze: After wandering around Flora Maze with Blackbird, we somehow ended up at the same intersection for the fourth time…
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_14_Desc:
In front of you is a pile of trash and three Trash Cans, now make the right choice and escape from the tedious trash sorting work!
"Ding dong ding dong ding! Congratulations on becoming recognized by the Trash Can!"
ST_Quest.s111135_ItemDescription:
Solifugae Vita withers in summer, and blooms only in snow.
So the snowman who dared not even cry, gathered the courage to shake a city and reverse a season—
Creating an "eternal winter" for their friend.
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_7_Desc:
Little Buni makes highly praised goods, to the point that she struggles to keep up with demand! Oh kind fella, please go show some care for the busy Little Buni.
"Buni is always here for others, but who will be there for Buni?"
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_4_Desc:
There is a bottle of soda constantly vibing in the square. The soda could burst out of the bottle cap at any moment! Fight and stop it before that happens!
"I must stay bubbled, carbonated, energized! Don't you dare take it from me!"
ST_Quest.SpiralDreams_AirWallMessage: The edge of the Anomalous Realm is unstable. Do not get any closer.
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_5_Desc:
Crazy Cat Milk Tea is trying to come up with new milk tea flavors and needs a creative partner to brainstorm along!
"A bit of Weather Vine sap, some Boom Boom Cloud, and maybe some Fungus Child spores?"
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_9_Desc:
Luna Bay has recently imported a batch of ornamental fish. If someone meets the store owner's standards in aquatic species breeding knowledge, they might just win the opportunity to breed the fishes themselves.
"Well, all you have to know about taking care of fishes is the cycle of 1-3-5-7: feed every day, change the water every 3 days, clean the tank every 5 days, and uh… change the fishes every 7 days."
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_2_Desc:
Delivery orders are surging in Bridge Crossings and we are in urgent need of part-time delivery personnel. Save the hungry Bridge Crossings!
"Bridge Crossings' legendary speed! From kitchens to your tables in eight minutes, none shall starve under our watch!"
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_1_Desc:
Lively Greens has recently imported a batch of large plants, some prefer shade while others prefer sunlight. We need strong movers to manage their positions and let the greens thrive.
"Come on newbies, the sun has moved again! On me… One! Two! Three! Move!"
ST_Quest.DunnerHouseAirMsg_B: Approaching the edge of Paradise. Adjust your course promptly.
ST_Quest.DunnerHouseAirMsg_A: Approaching the edge of the Anomalous Realm. Adjust your course to avoid getting lost.
ST_Quest.s111110_Item_Description: Due to the seafood shop owner's distrust, I need to pay a 30,000 Fons deposit first before getting the truck key fob… I'm not sure if I'll actually get this deposit back in the end. I hope I won't end up paying out of my own pocket to work here!
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_10_Desc:
The reading area in Moby-Dick needs to be organized! For that, we are looking for profound scholars… or people with a reading habit… or at least someone who can read…?
"Every book an ocean and every read an adventure… and I need a life jacket on this adventure."
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_13_Desc:
Who on earth threw trash into the river! It's hard work cleaning the waters, but guess it ain't all bad with cute lil' kappas by your side, eh?
"The kappa burst out of the river, blubbed, then chucked away the person littering in the river…"
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_16_Desc:
There are many legends scattered around the corners of the city. The owner of Oops! Chest thinks this is a great way to get inspiration.
"Great warriors, fear not! Explore, and discover!"
ST_Quest.needGetoffCar: Exit the vehicle to continue the quest.

ST_ReactionDes.Reaction_guanglingxiang_des: Grants the active character <NumGreen>10</> additional <bule>Ultimate Energy</> when <bule>Vita Pistils</> hit targets affected by Remora.
ST_ReactionDes.Reaction_zhouanhun_des: Deducts a percentage of the target's <bule>Break</> when they are simultaneously affected by Nova and Scorch.
ST_ReactionDes.Reaction_lingzhou_des: Deals an additional instance of <bule>follow-up attack DMG</> to the target equal to <NumGreen>20%</> of <bule>Anima or Incantation DMG</> taken within <NumGreen>12s</> after triggering Esper Cycle.
ST_ReactionDes.Reaction_hunxiang_des: Increases the target's <bule>Psyche and Lakshana DMG</> taken by <NumGreen>20%</> for <NumGreen>12s</> after triggering Esper Cycle.
ST_ReactionDes.Reaction_zhouan_des: Upon triggering Esper Cycle, inflicts Scorch on the target for <NumGreen>15s</>, dealing DoT.
ST_ReactionDes.Reaction_guangxiang_des: The target enters Remora for <NumGreen>5s</> after triggering Esper Cycle, slowing their movement and attack speed. The effect decays over time, and will have a shorter duration if repeatedly applied.
ST_ReactionDes.Reaction_anhun_des: Inflicts Nova on the target for <NumGreen>5s</> after triggering Esper Cycle. When the effect ends, the target takes massive <bule>Mental Damage</>.
ST_ReactionDes.Reaction_guangling_des:
Generates <NumGreen>1</> <bule>Vita Bud</> near the target after triggering Esper Cycle, which blossoms <NumGreen>5</> <bule>Vita Pistils</>.
<bule>Vita Pistils</> then fly toward targets within range, exploding every <NumGreen>2s</> and dealing DMG to an area.
Up to <NumGreen>3</> <bule>Vita Buds</> can exist on the field at once.

ST_RoleReviewQuest.Main_1_5_des:
After the events of Eternal Present, Daffodill was taken away by the Bureau of Anomaly Control for questioning and observation due to her deep past involvement with The Scarlet Letter. Many days passed without her return, and the atmosphere in Eibon was no longer the same. Nanally was especially worn down—not only because her master had been injured while saving her, but also because there had been no word from her since. As luck would have it, Taygedo won a family event package for Sunward Resort, and everyone suggested that you take Nanally there to help her clear her mind.

Sunward Resort was an Anomaly Charity House jointly established by the municipal government and the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Iroi, a volunteer at the resort, introduced you to many Anomalies, and Nanally gradually began to brighten up. Although she was too young to directly sponsor an Anomaly and bring it home, she received permission from the resort's investor, Ms. Inanna, to remotely sponsor a small bear-shaped Anomaly. Nanally and the little bear immediately hit it off. They signed the contract on the spot and agreed that she would return to the resort the next day to visit it.

At the pier on the way back, you unexpectedly encountered Daffodill, whom you had not seen in days. Nanally was overjoyed, but Daffodill treated her with coldness and hostility before following The Scarlet Letter member Poinsette through a portal. Nanally was devastated and believed she must have been the reason her master left. After a brief conflict with Sakiri, she shut herself in her room. It seemed Nanally was carrying pain she had never fully resolved. You knocked on her door, but received no response.

The next day, Nanally was nowhere to be found. Perhaps she had gone to the resort for her appointment, or perhaps she had left on her own to search for Daffodill. Everyone split up to look for her. You and Edgar asked Blackbird to divine Nanally's whereabouts and received three keywords: mist, the sound of tides, and a colossus. Blackbird also mentioned that disappearances had become frequent recently, with many people being drawn into a strange Anomalous Realm. Just then, Adler called with unsettling news: the resort had no sponsorship records under Nanally's name.

It turned out that the little bear who had signed the contract with Nanally was actually a dangerous Anomaly known as Teehee Bear, and the contract had been nothing more than a calculated deception. Following the clues, you tracked down Teehee Bear and exposed its true nature. Enraged, you and the others defeated it, but a strange, dense fog suddenly separated you from the group. You were drawn into an Anomalous Realm.

This was the place where Nanally had disappeared: the Corridor of Echoes. Guided by Thyme, you identified the pink tiger mascot in the parade as Nanally’s transformed form. You chased after her and entered the Dreamwalker's room. Meanwhile, Daffodill appeared to have changed sides completely and accepted a mission from The Scarlet Letter. In a garden, you met a girl who felt strangely familiar, as though the two of you had met before. With her help, you entered Nanally's Dream Room. Through a picture book, you passed through layer after layer of Nanally's dreams, learned about her past, and began to untie the knot in her heart.

You brought Nanally out of the room, only to be stopped by Thyme. She would only allow you to take away Nanally's copy—the Nanally who had cast aside evasion and obsession. Was the Ship of Theseus still the same ship once all of its parts had been replaced? You realized that Thyme, as the creator of the Corridor of Echoes, had also been running from her own past. She did not seem to understand that, all this time, she had been waiting for someone to break the rules and lead her forward. You fought Thyme to the very end. Moved by your will, the colossus representing her consciousness slowly began to change form. Just as you stopped, the colossus was suddenly nullified. Looking closer, you saw that the one who had arrived was Daffodill.

The Scarlet Letter tore through space and appeared. Their leader was revealed to be none other than Ms. Inanna, the resort's investor. She took the Anomaly that governed the rules of the past within the Corridor of Echoes: the Helm of Theseus. The mastermind behind everything finally revealed herself. Everything that had happened to Nanally was a conspiracy meticulously orchestrated by The Scarlet Letter from beginning to end. What was most baffling was that Daffodill seemed to have returned to The Scarlet Letter. With Thyme's consciousness nullified, the Dreamwalkers gradually disappeared. Through her own will and your efforts, Nanally managed to preserve only half of her soul before falling into a deep sleep. The Corridor of Echoes collapsed, and you escaped the space with Nanally and Thyme.

Back in Eibon, after Nanally and Thyme had been settled in, everyone wore a grave expression. What was the true reason behind Daffodill's betrayal? Hotori's attitude remained ambiguous, and you sensed that there had to be more to the story. The Scarlet Letter had seized another Anomaly—but what was the "game" they claimed was about to begin? After everything that had happened, Alphard contacted Hotori with new intelligence from the Bureau. The mystery deepened, and the operation against The Scarlet Letter finally reached a critical stage.
ST_RoleReviewQuest.Main_1_3_des:
Jenson, the owner of Sterry Express, suddenly paid a visit, hoping to invite you to participate in an auction hosted by Ebisu Auction House to help authenticate an anomaly lot. After some negotiation, Hotori proposed the additional condition of "going along herself" and struck a deal with Jenson.

To successfully infiltrate the auction, you used Esper Michael Pay's ability to duplicate and swap singer Settyn's invitation. On the day of the auction, Haniel and others disguised themselves as waitstaff to sneak into the venue, while you and Hotori entered officially as guests alongside Jiuyuan and Jenson.

When the target lot—the anomaly "The First Branch," said to possess precognitive abilities—was presented, a mysterious girl suddenly appeared. Using the freeze effect of the anomaly "Cheese," she forcibly acquired the lot for just 1 Fons and left immediately. After Hotori lifted the freeze effect on you all, you discovered that the girl had used the anomaly "Picky" to release several anomaly lots, triggering the security anomaly "Nantanì" and trapping you all in the auction house. Once the duplicated invitations expired, you would no longer be protected by Nantanì's rules. Therefore, you had to act quickly to re-contain the breached anomalies.

Afterward, Ebisu tried to shift the blame to Sterry and Eibon, but through Jiuyuan and Hotori's maneuvering, you managed to escape unscathed. Hotori avoided discussing your many questions but informed you that you could collaborate with Sterry's people in the future.

However, this incident seems to hide a deeper conspiracy—Ebisu Auction House's true intentions remain unclear, and the mysterious girl's motives for stealing the lot are still unknown… More mysteries have yet to surface.
ST_RoleReviewQuest.Main_1_7_des:
Several days have passed since your escape from the Corridor. One evening, after visiting Nanally, you run into Hotori and Adler by the sea. During a heartfelt conversation, Hotori reveals that both The Scarlet Letter and the Bureau will make their move that night—and that you will be taking part as well.

Deep within The Scarlet Letter's stronghold, you successfully rendezvous with Chaos and Nitsa of ETD-6. A mysterious black coffin—the Anomaly known as Fog Coffin—remains at the scene, but Ms. T and her guests have already entered the Anomalous Realm. After discussing the situation with Alphard, you learn just how dangerous the Anomaly is. Even so, you decide to enter and investigate.

The Anomalous Realm is known as Fogden, and anyone who enters is automatically drawn into the Fogden Game.
Within Fogden, three stories unfold at once. Daffodill defeats several formidable guests before reuniting with Chaos. Guided by clues hidden in the rules, they venture into the fog, where Daffodill ultimately defeats Zankou and obtains the Helm of Theseus. Linko and Nitsa encounter a massive, serpent-like Oddity in a valley. Turning the tables on the creature, they defeat it and enter the fog, where they withstand the Encroachment of Eternal Present and rescue Adler. Meanwhile, Zero crosses a blood-soaked battlefield and enters the fog, encountering several future versions of Eibon. After seeing through Poinsette's deception, Zero finally discovers The First Branch.

Once everyone reaches the arena, the Fog Coffin Colossus announces the final rule: there can be only one victor, who may claim any one "item" belonging to a defeated contestant as their prize. Ms. T's true target is Hotori's Esper Ability. She confronts the group using powers granted by her contract with the Fog Coffin, but in doing so draws the attention of Code Zero. The Fog Coffin Colossus is effortlessly destroyed, and Fogden begins to collapse. Amid the chaos, Zankou betrays Ms. T, while Code Zero continues its assault on the others. Just as all hope seems lost, the Ship of Theseus tears through the sky and takes everyone aboard. With a single strike, Hotori stops Code Zero's pursuit, allowing the ship to pass safely through the portal and return to Hethereau.

You awaken in your dormitory bed to find everyone there—including Nanally, now fully recovered. Daffodill apologizes to everyone, prompting Eibon to burst into tears and apologies of their own. It is an ordinary day—and all the more precious for it.
ST_RoleReviewQuest.Main_1_1_des:
Eibon received a commission from Bianca, PR manager of Landric, to search for the genius Perfumer Toshi who had suddenly disappeared. While searching for clues in his apartment, a strange bird and dog appeared and made off with Toshi's Censer.

Following intel from Jiuyuan of Sterry Express, you tracked down "Cake Sweeper," the author of manga Tales of Nil, and met a young man named Boomboom outside her home. His dog Dandelion, who had been missing for a long time, had appeared in the manga. Cake Sweeper told you about her encounter with Pawn Moonlight, claiming that "any wish could be granted there for the right Price," and revealed that the dog and bird that inspired her work were both in the pawnshop.

As fate would have it, chef Kenneth commissioned you to retrieve his sense of taste, which was taken by the pawnshop owner without reason, and pointed you to Green Wall Slope. You headed there immediately. Inside the pawnshop, you met the owners—twin brothers Otro and Mismo. It turned out Kenneth had kidnapped Toshi—who had accompanied him to the pawnshop before—fearing exposure after regretting his Pawn Contract. Mismo had rescued Toshi.

In the end, the cunning Kenneth's scheme failed, Boomboom reunited with his beloved dog—who was actually Anomaly U-5228 "Morphix"—and Otro and Mismo left Hethereau, taking their unsolved mysteries with them. On Green Wall Slope, Pawn Moonlight vanished without a trace.
ST_RoleReviewQuest.Main_1_4_des:
Eibon receives an anonymous package—a mysterious puppet. Simultaneously, there are rumors being spread on Bagel of citizens being turned into puppets by an Anomaly. You and Daffodill follow Hotori to the Bureau of Anomaly Control to assist with the investigation. Working alongside ETD-6, and using intel from Yggash Court, you discuss the case. After some investigating, you all conclude that this "puppet" was not initially a human. The clue that led to the discovery of the actual Anomaly lies in the black cards hidden in the Anomaly's pocket: each one has a name and is labeled with the number "0".

That same evening, a taxi driver named Renee comes to Eibon with a commission: every night at exactly nine o'clock, a cloaked, scythe-wielding Anomaly called the "Debt Collector" appears and attacks her—yet shockingly, she feels no pain at all. You, Nanally, and Daffodill take the commission and go with Renee to "Food First" to get more details from one of her regulars: Fuuka.

At nine o'clock that very night, the Debt Collector appears as planned. After a brief scuffle, it retreats, dropping a card that reads "Renee" and the number "-20088". You recognize it as identical to the cards from the earlier puppet case, and immediately contact Chaos. Everyone then agrees to head to The Witch's House, where Blackbird performs a divination for Renee. Strangely, the result of the divination is entirely blank, similar to the case years ago with Dolores, the head of the Constantine family. Blackbird concludes that the Debt Collector must be a Rule Anomaly, and that its nullification hinges on breaking the rule it follows.

The next day, someone drops a forged card into Renee's mailbox, with the address of the old Constantine estate printed on the front. Chaos guesses that Fuuka and the disguised courier who sent the puppet to Eibon must be operating under the same mastermind's orders. They invite Renee to walk to the family estate, as long as she's willing. When the group arrives, Renee stares at the cherry tree in the yard, recalling that she had once fallen from that same tree as a child. Suddenly, everyone is pulled into an Anomalous Realm.

The Anomalous Realm recreates the Constantine estate as it once was, years ago. You and Renee watch a farewell party, and piece together the family's history from the guests' conversations. Meanwhile, Nanally and Daffodill discover the Debt Collector hidden in the estate's study, along with a "register" that lists the family members' names with a number next to each. Every name has "0" listed next to it, except for Renee's, which is "-20088". Daffodill realizes that this must mean Renee has long overstayed her welcome amongst the living.

The eldest daughter, "Bella", appears before Renee and reveals the Constantine family's secret: Dolores was a unique Esper. To ease her loneliness, she used her own lifeforce as fuel to awaken a group of puppet children, letting them share an "eternity" granted by her contract with an Anomaly and stay by her side. All of these children were once puppets, and their lifespans began to count down from the moment Renee was born. They all hit zero over fifty years ago. Renee was the last to awaken and also Dolores's most favored child. Renee seemingly was able to escape death because her mother gifted her the Anomaly "Eternal Present", which was the source of her own endless life.

However, everything that was revealed of this "past" turned out to be an illusion, instrumented by Zankou, the actor performing "Bella". Zankou twisted the memories of the family, casting Renee as the sinner whose selfish betrayal brought misfortune upon the family. Through the mockery of children's voices and display of false illusions, Renee's sanity was slowly whittled down. It only took a few moments for Renee's mind to finally break, accepting the lie of her identity, and, on the verge of collapse, decide to give up the Eternal Present to atone for her "sins". At that crucial moment, you shout for her to stop—only for Zankou to snatch the Eternal Present. As you and Zankou go head to head, the nine o'clock bell tolls, and the Debt Collector returns. At that same moment, Chaos tears open space-time and steps through, with Nanally and Daffodill arriving in a spectacular, wall-breaking fashion. Just before retreating, Zankou turns to Daffodill and passes along "Mother's" regards. Afterwards, everyone at Eibon, together with Chaos, drive the Debt Collector back to where it came from.

After the battle, Chaos reveals Zankou's true identity: a core member of the criminal organization, "The Scarlet Letter". Actually, it seems that all characters in this play—the fake courier, Fuuka, and Bella from the party—were performed by her and her alone. Her goal was to force Renee to surrender the Anomaly "Eternal Present", while also using the entire incident as a way to announce the presence of The Scarlet Letter in Hethereau.

Back at Eibon, you and Daffodill discuss her past—she once was a member of The Scarlet Letter herself, and that her "Mother" was the group's leader, the very person she should have ended years ago.

Several days later, Renee returns to Eibon to thank everyone in person. Having lost "Eternal Present", she is finally released from immortality, and her missing memories and past have gradually been returning to her. She says that she has finally concluded that being alive is a blessing, precisely because life is fragile and fleeting. She bids Eibon farewell and sets off on a journey around the world, determined to experience all of life's ups and downs with the time she has left.
ST_RoleReviewQuest.Main_1_6_des:
You accept Mint's invitation to play an anomaly board game called "999 Nights" with three of the members of CSU-2. You enter the game to challenge the Crimson Dragon as a Swordsman along with Mage Iroi, Barbarian Mint, and Villager Shinku.

Your epic journey begins at the Fuzzy Village. You listen to the stories of the past from the elder: An evil Crimson Dragon once ruled the land. A brave team led by a heroine defeated him, yet somehow, the Crimson Dragon came back. The Fuzzies suffer again, and to defeat the dragon and restore peace, you decide to collect the armor fragments left by the heroine.

After overcoming trials and tribulations, you finally retrieve the last armor fragment from the Crimson Dragon's castle. Only then, do you learn the truth behind the legend: the heroine lost her mind after wearing the armor and turned against her team. Shinku's reaction makes you realize this might be more than just a story.

With the other three encouraging her, Shinku gradually comes to trust her companions and her own powers. She wears the heroine's armor and successfully defeats the evil dragon. And so, true peace is restored to the Warren Continent, with Fuzzies singing songs of the heroine's deeds to honor the "Dragonfruit Knight" and her three precious companions!
ST_RoleReviewQuest.Role_1023_1_des:
You received a missing person commission from a married couple—their son Maiyue, who had a speech impediment, had gone missing after school.

After a chance encounter with Captain of ETD-4—Baicang, he joined your investigation. The clues led you to an abandoned manor that once belonged to the Serenetti family. The squad's lieutenant Skia noted that the location showed abnormal Wertheimer Index fluctuations, which the Bureau was investigating. In the manor's courtyard, you found Maiyue trapped. He was being parasitized by plants affected by Location Anomaly C-3624 "Silent Garden," and in his dazed state, he resisted rescue attempts.

Baicang used sign language to wake Maiyue from his stupor, then activated his Esper Ability. In an instant, all the plants in the manor withered as if fall had come early, and the Anomaly was successfully nullified.

Though Maiyue permanently lost his ability to speak due to the Anomaly's nullification, he was otherwise unharmed. Later, he made flower cards by hand to express his gratitude to you all. Perhaps sincere feelings need no words to be conveyed.
ST_RoleReviewQuest.Main_1_8_des:
You receive a special commission from Lavinia. Blackbird, owner of The Witch's House, has received a strange letter asking for help. The letter claims that there is a "commission only she can handle," sent by a mysterious person named Merula. Determined to find out what is going on, Blackbird decides to go there, and your commission turns out to be accompanying her and ensuring her safety.

Upon arriving at the island mentioned in the letter, you and Blackbird encounter a girl named Valmona. She tells you that a ritual to execute witches is being held near the island's fire trial tree. At the site of the burning, you discover that the trial is controlled by an anomaly known as the Inquisitor. After defeating it with the ETD squad who have already been investigating the island, you and Blackbird learn about the island's strange circumstances and decide to investigate further.

Just as your investigation gets underway, Valmona tells you that something unusual has happened near the tree. You and Blackbird rush there, only for Blackbird to begin acting strangely. She insists that she can hear someone calling for help, and walks toward the flames. As the fire engulfs her, you fear for her safety and follow her in.

When you regain consciousness, you somehow find yourselves inside another layer of Anomalous Realm. There, a girl who looks exactly like Valmona, but calls herself Annie, mistakes you for abandoned slaves and takes you back to the place where she lives—St. Arbor. To find the true culprit, you and Blackbird decide to stay in the town for the time being and continue your investigation.

Before long, strange things begin happening in town. A poisonous miasma appears in the forest outside the town, and ominous clouds loom over the skies of St. Arbor. Just as the townspeople grow increasingly worried, a human Inquisitor arrives in town. He claims that St. Arbor has been cursed by a witch, and that starting today, witch trials will be held until the witch's soul is found and burned.

The first two trials fail to find the witch's soul, but the scope of the search gradually expands to the townspeople themselves. Meanwhile, you also notice that Blackbird's memories are frequently becoming confused. She seems to keep mistaking herself for one of the townspeople. During the third trial, someone is burned to death, and Annie is likely to be the next victim. Unable to tolerate this any longer, you and Blackbird decide to put an end to this madness.

With your help, Annie is spared from being burned in the fourth trial, but the trials continue. Tormented by her conscience, she decides to step forward during the next trial and confess to being a witch. Just then, Blackbird offers to take Annie's place as the witch to be executed. She completely forgets who she is, while Annie finally reveals her true identity—Merula.

Everything Merula has done was intended to lure Blackbird back here and help her imprison the Inquisitor. What Merula does not know, however, is that the world has changed, and there isn't space for the anomaly Inquisitor to survive any more. After you explain the situation to her, she realizes what she truly needs to do: break the Fleshbound Cage that has imprisoned the Inquisitor for hundreds of years and completely nullify it.

Once everything is over, you return to Hethereau. The Oracle Stones on the island are purified, and Blackbird regains her lost memories. Back at The Witch's House, with Blackbird once again full of energy, Lavinia gives you another commission. This time, however, the commission is to take Blackbird around Hethereau and show her a good time…?
ST_RoleReviewQuest.Role_1020_2_des:
With Clement Academy's centennial celebration approaching, Akane Rin finally agreed—after Haniel and Nanally's multiple pleas—to return to her alma mater as a special guest alumna, with everyone else tagging along to celebrate. Before that, though, you first had to get a proper school uniform. While on a shopping trip, Akane Rin also brought along her old classmate, Aurelia, and introduced her to the other members of "THE WHOOTS!!!!".

On the day of the celebration, the group arrived on campus and met Suzuha, who had once been Akane Rin's bandmate in the band "Lines," as well as an old classmate. After many introductions, you all immersed yourselves in the lively celebratory atmosphere, wandering through all kinds of stalls and tasting all sorts of food. At the Prize Redemption booth run by the Dvořák siblings, you learned that performing onstage could earn you a large number of Draw tokens. After some encouragement from Haniel, "THE WHOOTS!!!!" decided to sign up to perform.

However, before the show, Akane Rin sought you out alone and spoke about her past with Lines. She revealed that she had once buried a time capsule somewhere on campus, and had promptly planned to dig it up after the performance. The show turned out to be a great success, and as promised, Akane Rin and the crew dug up the time capsule together. Within the Anomalous Realm created by the time capsule, long-buried memories were unveiled one by one, and the full story of Lines was revealed. Elsewhere in the Anomalous Realm, Nanally and Suzuha were sent back to the day Lines encountered Swallowtail. The other members arrived just in time, and with everyone's help, they overcame their fears and united to defeat Swallowtail.

In the end, the trio—Akane Rin, Aurelia, and Suzuha—were finally able to move beyond the past, and set out once more with renewed resolve.
ST_RoleReviewQuest.Role_1020_1_des:
Haniel invited you to come watch a performance at Livehouse "StarSign," where you met her friends Akane Rin and owner Kiyosawa. Infected by the atmosphere of live music, an excited Haniel decided to pick up the guitar she had once taught herself, while Kiyosawa generously provided a practice space.

Soon after, Nanally proposed forming a band and enthusiastically invited you and Haniel to join. Moved by your enthusiasm, Akane Rin began supporting you all as a mentor. With Akane Rin's help, the band started serious rehearsals.

After some time and effort, your band completed its warm-up debut at StarSign. Despite some mistakes due to nerves during the performance, Akane Rin stepped in to save the day, and the show was completed successfully to audience applause. Encouraged by this, you decided to take on an even greater challenge: the legendary music festival, the Location Anomaly "Night of Moondog."

To achieve a high score at the Night of Moondog and find a way to resonate with anomalies, Haniel and Nanally decided to risk challenging the graffiti anomaly "Bopp" with music. When you discovered the two had gone missing, you and Akane Rin immediately rushed to find them. Akane Rin, in a rare display of anger, scolded them for their reckless behavior.

Finally, Akane Rin decided to officially join the band, and the group, now named "The Whoots!!!!" successfully took the stage at the Night of Moondog. Though they didn't win first place, they achieved a score of 60 points on their debut performance. After the show, Akane Rin reunited with Aurelia, a former bandmate from "Lines," and a long-held grudge was finally resolved. Even when starlight scatters across the heavens, it never truly disappears, and the music that resonates on stage will continue forever…
ST_RoleReviewQuest.Main_0_2_des:
Accompanied by Mint, you arrived at Eibon Antique Shop on Hankaku Street in Bridge Crossings. After a small commotion caused by Anomaly T-1377 "Hospitable House," you finally met the antique shop's members properly and became part of Eibon.

That evening, you received your first commission as an Anomaly Hunter: Kodak, the owner of Film Orbit Studio in Bridge Crossings, reported that an Anomaly had appeared in his photo studio, turning the interior fixtures into photographs. Eibon accepted the commission and went to investigate.

After some investigation, you pinpointed the culprit: a film roll forgotten by time. In the darkroom, you found Anomaly R-5791 "Film - MANISH" and successfully contained it.

Kodak was very grateful and promised to take photos for you free of charge. As the newest member, you took a group photo with everyone. Soon after, these photos would be developed and displayed on your desks and bedsides, bearing witness to more stories yet to come.
ST_RoleReviewQuest.Role_1004_1_des:
Taygedo took on a bounty commission: nullify the "Tomato Devil"—an anomaly that specifically destroys tomato jelly vending machines. You accompanied Taygedo to investigate, but learned from other Anomaly Hunters tracking the case that the Tomato Devil's true identity wasn't an anomaly at all, but rather Lacrimosa, a member of the Enforcement Tactical Division Squad Four under the Bureau of Anomaly Control.

Through Mint's introduction, you officially met Lacrimosa and learned the whole story: due to her lack of common sense, Lacrimosa had accidentally destroyed a vending machine. Although she compensated for the damage and apologized afterward, photos taken by passersby spread widely online, attracting a flood of malicious rumors. These false statements about Lacrimosa gradually fermented and eventually evolved into a Meme Anomaly—the Tomato Devil. This anomaly, born from rumors about Lacrimosa, resembled her in appearance, dragging Lacrimosa even deeper into public opinion.

To clear up the rumors, you and Taygedo planned a live stream, broadcasting footage of the real Lacrimosa battling the Tomato Devil anomaly, letting the truth speak for itself. As public opinion gradually shifted, the Meme Anomaly born from rumors was significantly weakened and finally dissolved into tomato jelly and disappeared.

Although new trending topics quickly diverted public attention, it was precisely because you and Taygedo took action that you were able to clear up the public's misunderstanding of Lacrimosa, restore her reputation, and truly protect her. Even if the truth gets buried temporarily, persisting in speaking out is never in vain.
ST_RoleReviewQuest.Main_1_2_des:
Taygedo fell head over heels for an anomaly named Tako whom he met on Bagel. He bragged to Tako that he was the "boss of an anomaly hunter organization" with countless subordinates. Recently, with Tako about to leave Hethereau, they arranged to meet before her departure. At Taygedo's earnest request, you all decided to orchestrate a grand "love operation" for him.

After accompanying Taygedo to buy new clothes and the anomaly toy N-0132-4 "Imaginadough" as a gift, the date officially began. Everything proceeded according to Edgar's plan: you played the bodyguard to "Sir Taygedo," Adler played the butler, and Nanally and Sakiri… also provided plenty of assistance along the way. Despite frequent mishaps during the date, your stellar acting skills saved the day multiple times.

Finally, you arrived at the scenic destination, Azure Vista. Taygedo molded the prepared Imaginadough into a sculpture of himself and Tako holding hands as part of his performance, planning to confess his feelings. Just then, the Imaginadough sculpture suddenly went haywire for some unknown reason, wildly attacking everything around it. In the critical moment, you stepped in and restored the Imaginadough to its original state, resolving the crisis. Adler also promptly rescued Tako, ensuring her safety.

A few days later, Eibon received a postcard that Tako sent after moving to her new home. However, the letter wasn't addressed to Taygedo, but was a thank-you note to Adler for stepping up to help. Amid laughter and cheer, Taygedo's first love seemed to come to an end…
ST_RoleReviewQuest.Main_0_1_des:
When New Helios was struck by a Level VII anomaly disaster, you appeared out of nowhere and assisted the Bureau of Anomaly Control in locating the "Hypervortex" Nexus, greatly accelerating its natural nullification process. At that moment, an unidentified anomaly with undetectable Wertheimer Index readings appeared—"Code Zero"—attempting to interfere with your actions. In the end, "Code Zero" was nullified along with the "Hypervortex." Afterward, you were temporarily detained at Ghroth Island prison for observation.

Seven weeks later, you were released to Hethereau, where you signed a contract with BAC Director Alphard, agreeing to participate in future "Code Zero" containment operations. She then assigned you to the Anomaly Hunter team "Eibon Antique Shop."

Before your departure, an unexpected incident occurred: CSU operative Mint reported that Anomaly R-3707 "Picture Frame" had suddenly breached containment. Once again, you demonstrated exceptional sensitivity to Anomaly Nexuses, helping Mint nullify the threat.

With everything wrapped up smoothly, you set out for Eibon. Are you ready for your new life to begin?

ST_SideQuest_QQ.SUW_TBS_CSFW001_Anomaly080_004: Umm… Are you sure you really understand cats or your captain?
ST_SideQuest_QQ.Bike_WLSD_NPC032_WJ1073_011: Do you know how to get to my place…?

ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_WJ1080_Player_010: Alright then… Thank you. I'll keep it safe.

ST_TeachAndIllustrater.BidKing_OutGame_01_des: In the Treasure Ship Auction, your goal is to build your fortune by bidding wisely and earning more Gold Shells. Any collectibles you win will be added to your Collectibles Warehouse.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Tetris_Page2_Des:
1. A four-player competitive puzzle game. <Red>Team up with friends</> or <Red>match online</>.
2. Players can <Red>stack</> and <Red>clear</> blocks in their own play area.
3. Each successful clear sends <Red>attack blocks</> to all other players. After a short time, attack blocks turn into <Red>garbage rows</> in other players' play areas.
4. Use techniques like <Red>chain clears</> and <Red>special clears</> to increase the strength of attack blocks during each phase.
5. <Red>One winner</> is determined at the end of each match. Rewards are distributed based on <Red>final rankings</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.BidKing_InGame_03_des:
1. When a collectible's <red>silhouette</> is revealed, a gray block appears in the corresponding slot.
2. When a collectible's <red>rarity</> is revealed, one section displays the matching rarity color.
3. When both its <red>silhouette and rarity</> are revealed, the corresponding slot appears with a shimmering effect.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Tetris_Page1_Des:
1. Move block left/right: <Red>← / →</> arrow keys or <Red>A / D</> keys
2. Soft drop: <Red>↓</> arrow key or <Red>S</> key
3. Hard drop: <Red>Spacebar</>
4. Rotate clockwise: <Red>↑</> arrow key / <Red>W</> key / <Red>K</> key
5. Rotate counterclockwise: <Red>J</> key
