ST_TeachAndIllustrater.BidKing_Cabinet_des:
1. The Collection Showcase has display slots of different sizes where you can store and display high-quality collectibles.
2. Collect the required number of certain collectibles to exchange them for exclusive furniture for your home.
3. Furniture exchanges are limited each month.
4. Certain Special Life Skills change the requirements for furniture exchanges.
5. Spend Gold Shell to upgrade the Collection Showcase and enhance its displays.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Boss_34_Teach_Skill04: <orange>Break the crystals</> to stop the Corridor Projection from absorbing energy.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Boss_34_Teach_BeginBattle: <orange>Reflect</> the Corridor Projection's energy attacks, or trigger a <orange>Critical Dodge</> to charge up your Ultimate.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Boss_34_Teach_GainEnergy: <orange>Touch</> the energy blocks left behind by the Corridor Projection's attacks to charge up your Ultimate.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Boss_05_Teach_FeiLun: <orange>Melee Attacks</> can <orange>deflect</> the <orange>discs</> fired by Morphix!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_09_4: The tasty <red>Goodheart Crispy Mouse Cookie</> is great at pulling Officer Whisker's attention away. Use it while wanted to significantly <red>lower your Warrant Value</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_04_2: <red>Cartridges</> grant characters special abilities. Placing the required <red>Modules</> in the <red>Console</> can activate <red>Advanced Effects</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_08_3:
<red>Overall Work Progress</>: Each successfully cleaned stain affects the progress bar accordingly. When it reaches 100%, all cleaning work for this session is complete.
<red>Stain Cleaning Progress</>: When a stain is discovered, this progress bar appears above it. Cleaning the stain affects the progress bar accordingly. When it reaches 100%, that stain has been completely removed. Each cleaned stain rewards 1 Fons.
<red>Work Countdown</>: Cleaning work must be completed within the allotted time. When the countdown ends, regardless of progress, the work session will immediately terminate, and you'll proceed to the next scheduled phase of the daily routine:
After morning labor: lunch time
After afternoon labor: lights out
<red>Pressure Washer</>: The primary cleaning tool. Take out the pressure washer to enter <red>cleaning mode</> and begin cleaning work. Spray water at stains to clean them.
The pressure washer requires a nozzle attachment to function properly.
<red>Switch Nozzle</>: Changing the pressure washer's nozzle adjusts cleaning intensity and range.
<red>Rotate Nozzle</>: Rotating the nozzle adjusts the spray direction (horizontal/vertical).
Put away the washer to exit cleaning mode.
Press the <red>Close</> button in the interface or <red>go directly to the area exit</> to end the work session and return to your cell.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_11_02:
<red>Total Progress</>: Removing stains can increase your progress. Reach 100% to finish the task.
<red>Stain Removal Progress</>: Remove a stain by reaching 100%. The reward of removing a stain is 10k Fons. 
<red>Work Countdown</>: Finish within the time limit. Once the activity ends, proceed to lunch time or curfew.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_32_2:
<red>Arcs</> increase damage.
Some may grant <red>Arc Effects</>, adding active skills and tactical options.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_11_03:
<red>White Nozzle</>: The water stream covers a wide area, but its cleaning speed is low, and it can only remove ordinary stains.
<red>Red Nozzle</>: The water stream has a narrower coverage area, but higher cleaning speed, making it suitable for removing stubborn stains.
<red>Detergent Nozzle</>: Comes with a storage tank that can spray detergent on stains for more efficient cleaning. When used with detergent, water streams of any intensity can remove stains quickly.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_32_3: <red>Consoles</> combine <red>Cartridges</> and <red>Modules</>. Mix and match to optimize <red>each character</>'s attributes.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_08_5:
<red>Red Nozzle</>: Wide coverage, but lower cleaning speed and intensity. Can only remove common stains.
<red>Yellow Nozzle</>: Narrow coverage, but higher cleaning speed and intensity. Suitable for handling stubborn stains.
<red>Soap Nozzle</>: Equipped with a storage tank that can spray soap solution onto stain surfaces to reduce cleaning difficulty. When used with soap solution, water streams of any intensity can quickly remove stains.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.TreasureBox_Des: <red>The gambler "21"</> has scattered winning chips throughout the city, since as a digital life form, it doesn't need them. <red>However, sometimes getting the reward requires dealing with some trouble first…</>
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_04_3: <red>Modules</> provide Basic Attribute bonuses and must be fitted into the corresponding empty shapes in the <red>Console</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.BidKing_Cabinet_name: Going, Going, Gone! — Collection Showcase Guide
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.BidKing_OutGame_02_name: Going, Going, Gone! Collectibles Warehouse & Display Case
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PropBox_Des:
"We only made the packaging boxes look the same for aesthetic and tidiness. Mystery Boxes? We would never make such devious things!"
Kokoro Rider series figurines, a bestselling product with enduring popularity. Different figurine boxes contain different figurine designs. Collecting them will increase your <red>Collection</> value.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.RealEstate_shoucang_5: Collectible Furniture can enhance your collection attributes, so be on the lookout for them.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.HunterBox_Des:
"All my years of experience and lessons learned as an Anomaly Hunter are written in here. Consider it a gift for whoever finds it!"
Scattered throughout the city are <red>Hunter Guides</> written by a veteran Anomaly Hunter.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.CharacterUpBox_Des:
"Whether you're ready or not, the show has begun. Let the curtains rise!"
This is a surprise easter egg prepared by the greatest magician of all time, Mr. Houdinii, hidden in corners throughout the city and wilderness for his fans.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.FurnitureBox_Des:
"Nobody wants this, right? If nobody wants it, I'll take it! Really, nobody? Alright, I guess I'll reluctantly take it then!"
Abandoned furniture left on the streets. Collecting it will increase your <red>Collection</> value.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.SafetyBox_Des:
"The boss said to put valuable stuff in this safe, but every time I put money in, it disappears soon after. Is this some kind of item teleportation Anomaly… What? This is just a regular safe? Huh? Then where's my money?!"
Careless members forget to lock their safes, so <red>opening these safes will net you some valuable items</>. Don't feel bad about it! You're just learning from them.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Defend_NS_Title_2: Coal Lump Coins & Coal Lump HP
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_09_5: Getting caught by a Security Officer sends you to the Hethereau Detention Facility. You can leave after serving the detention time or paying the fine.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.combination_des: In most circumstances, characters will accumulate <red>Cycle Gauge</> during combat. When <red>Cycle Gauge</> is full, team members who can form an <red>Esper Cycle</> with the current character will display an indicator on their avatars.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.OracleStone_Des:
Gems carried by blind ravens, lost and unable to land, their origins unknown to all.
Rumors say that those who pick up Oracle Stones will be struck by misfortune, but don't worry if you happen to find one—<red>The mysterious lady from the Witch's House is collecting these Oracle Stones.</> If you hand her your Oracle Stones, not only will they dispel your misfortune, but also provide rewards.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.RealEstate_shoucang_3: Talk to the <red>Butler</> to collect the current house's style and layout.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.RealEstate_zhuangxiu_7: Talk to the <red>Butler</> to purchase and change the current house's decor style.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.GarudaBox_Des: An expensive suitcase that stands out from its surroundings, this is a trophy belonging to the <red>infamous Garuda.</> Want to steal from Garuda? You'd better see if you have what it takes!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_11:
The memories of battling powerful foes are still vivid—why not set forth and begin a pilgrimage to sacred sites!
Defeating powerful Anomalies will grant you <red>rare materials</> needed to enhance <red>Character Esper Abilities</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_14_1: Touching items in the shop can alert the staff. Wait for the right moment <red>before making your move</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Steal_Des: After interacting with shop items, your character enters <red>Alert Status</>, and staff will pay extra attention to your actions.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.mon_01_Illustrate:
A Disoriented Entity that fights on instinct.
Oddities that destroyed their own dimension and were stranded in the fragments become Disoriented Entities. When certain Anomalies appeared, they came to our world through fragments that briefly overlapped with reality. The Whisper Spawns, the most basic of the Disoriented Entity, have had their consciousness worn away by eons in the fragments, driven only by the battle instincts etched into their flesh and a longing for a normal dimension.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.mon_04_Illustrate:
A self-destructive Disoriented Entity.
Even in their ignorance, each one yearns for a Normal Dimension. But for the Lost Spawns, being lost is an endless predicament.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.BuildingDrawing_Teach_03: After using a <red>Dimension-Shift Blueprint</>, you can rotate the direction of the projection plane around yourself while in planar view. Observe the object projections from different planar perspectives and use them as platforms to move and jump, allowing you to reach positions that would be difficult to access in three-dimensional space.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.BuildingDrawing_Teach_02: After using a <red>Projection Blueprint</>, objects within the Anomalous Realm will be projected and overlaid onto the same plane. You can use the projections of various objects as platforms to move and jump within the plane, allowing you to reach positions that would be difficult to access in three-dimensional space.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Boss_04_Illustrate:
An Oddity that fights using a wide range of gadgets.
Taygedo stands out among his kind—kind-hearted, lovable, and seemingly harmless. A three-time "Eibon Best Repairer" winner, and a name you can trust. Though he sits at the bottom of Eibon's food chain, Taygedo is no easy target. Against smaller foes, his unpredictable tricks and bouncy, resilient body make him surprisingly dangerous.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_14: Use <red>Carrota</> earned in the Anomaly Zone <red>Rabbit Hole</> to perform <red>rewind</> operations and obtain various <red>Modules</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PukaLand_5_2_Desc:
Lollipop Goggles reveal the location of the exit, but also make the timer run faster. Pick up other items to gain more time. Approach special bushes to uncover hidden paths—but be careful, some bushes move on their own!
If you fail to escape before time runs out, the challenge will end early with a low rating. Good luck out there!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.dodge_common_des: Dodge incoming attacks. Dodging consumes Stamina, which recovers over time. Cannot Dodge when Stamina is low.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Boss_01_Illustrate:
An Object Anomaly that fights with paint.
Famous paintings can be passed down through generations, but frames often get swapped according to the owner's taste. Those abandoned masterpiece sidekicks have grown the ability to protest in moments of chaos cradled in profound silence.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_08_4:
Use the pressure washer to remove the stains.
The water stream can only clean stain areas that match its width. If you want to adjust the cleaning range for different types of stains, try switching the washer's nozzle.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Boss_06_Illustrate:
An Object Anomaly that battles by projecting items.
The mission of film rolls is to capture those shining moments, but shining often means fleeting, leaving the outdated film roll behind in time. Waiting isn't the only interpretation of being forgotten. Covered in the dust of the darkroom, it still honors the promise of capturing in its own way.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PukaLand_14_Desc:
When you first arrive at Pukaland, you'll receive a Wonderlog.
Open it to take on Check-In Quests and earn rewards, including Puka Stars.
Visit each attraction's ticket seller to check in and light up its entry in your Wonderlog.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_10: Join the strangers' art party! The world belongs to us! After defeating strangers, you can spend Character Pixels to exchange for various <red>upgrade materials</> for <red>Characters</>, <red>Arcs</>, and <red>Consoles</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.BidKing_Report_des: Player reporting is now available in Going, Going, Gone! Following this update, confirmed reports of abusing multiple game instances, deliberately going AFK, or repeatedly obtaining rewards through suspicious activity will result in bans. Ban durations depend on the severity of the violation.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_32_1:
Boost combat power by <red>leveling up</>.
Also equip <red>Arcs</> and <red>Consoles</>, upgrade <red>Esper Abilities</>, or <red>Awaken</> characters for major boosts.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.ZhanDou_Des_03_1: Additionally, casting attribute-matching <red>Support Skills</> further reduces the enemy’s <red>Break</>, helping expose them faster.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.RealEstate_7: Your properties will be marked on the map.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Danzaburou_Des: The oddity <red>Danzaburou</> will transform into anything to try and steal what it wants! But, Danzaburou's favorite remains its <red>red scarf</>. No matter the form, Danzaburou always wears a red scarf, which could be a good way to identify it.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Xitong_Des_36_4: Bagel has launched the <red>Creator Incentive Program</>. Post engagement data will be converted into <red>Praise Jams</> at a fixed rate. Praise Jams can be exchanged for rewards at Bagel Shop.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.RealEstate_5: Real estate agents have all the latest listings. Choose your desired property and sign the contract.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Danzaburou_Des2: Danzaburou is skilled in escape techniques, using decoys to scatter and confuse opponents when nearly caught. <red>Identify its true form multiple times to see through Danzaburou's tricks.</>
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_31_1: Access and participate in City Modes through <red>City Tycoon</>. Participating in <red>City Modes</> increases your City Tycoon level, which unlocks and enhances <red>perks</> related to City Modes.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_06_1: In <red>Owner's Selection mode</>, you will personally prepare food for customers, facing various demands and challenges. Working hands-on is both mentally and physically taxing, so it's best to open for business when you're well-rested. Don't forget that customer patience isn't unlimited either—once their waiting time is up, they'll turn around and leave.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_32_4:
Upgrade <red>Esper Abilities</>—<red>Basic Attack</>, <red>Redirect Skill</>, <red>Ultimate</>, and <red>Support Skill</>.
Upgrades improve skill effects like <red>increasing DMG Ratio</> or <red>cooldown reduction</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Robbank_Teach_02: Collect as many <red>Collectibles</> as possible on the map before <red>time runs out</>. <red>Evacuate</> to convert your earnings into Fons. Rewards will no longer accumulate once the cap is reached.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_16_1:
Four fighters enter the arena and battle <red>until time runs out</>. Final rankings are based on elimination order.
If no champion is crowned before the timer ends, rankings are based on each fighter's remaining HP.
Depending on your final rank, 15, 12, 8, or 6 City Stamina will be consumed, granting different amounts of Fons and Strong Painkillers.
You can still enter with no City Stamina. You will still earn Strong Painkillers based on your rank.
Your <red>Stamina cap in Fight Club matches your open-world Stamina cap</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_16_2:
Weapons are not allowed in Fight Club. Every match is fought bare-handed.
Use <red>Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Block, and Grapple Throw to fight your opponents.</>.
<red>Elimination Recovery</>: Restores HP once whenever you eliminate an opponent.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PukaLand_3_Desc:
In Candy Jar Raid, press the corresponding Movement keys to rotate your view, and hold the Shoot key to fire. Switch between Cannonballs and Forks depending on the situation.
Use Cannonballs to knock back approaching octopus tentacles and protect the cup's Durability. Use Forks to collect Treasure Chests and Treasure Maps for points. Be careful—if the cup's Durability reaches zero, the game will end early with a low rating.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_15_1: Time <red>Block</> correctly to <red>negate damage and greatly reduce Tornado's Break</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PukaLand_11_Desc:
In Star-Struck, the crosshair sways unpredictably. Time your throw carefully and land your dart in a high-scoring area.
Darts that land in the double ring score twice the segment value, while darts in the triple ring score three times the segment value. Darts in single areas score the base value.
The outer bull is always worth 25 points, while the bullseye is worth 50.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Store_guanli_des_1: Interact with the bar counter to bring up the interface and manage your shop.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Store_guanli_des_2: You can manage your employees and items here.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PukaLand_7_Desc: In Pukaboo Stack, the gun platform moves left and right automatically. Hold the Shoot key to charge your shot, aim carefully, then release it to fire and knock down cans for points.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_05:
Violations in the city will accumulate <red>warrant</>. When the warrant exceeds a certain threshold, you will become <red>wanted</>. As warrant accumulates, wanted level will further increase, reaching a maximum of level three. When you are wanted, certain actions will be restricted.
In the early stages of being wanted, security officers will pursue you. As the wanted level increases, Officer Whisker will be dispatched to pursue you. According to rumors, if the warrant becomes too high, it may trigger dangerous Anomaly incidents. Methods to clear your wanted level include: escaping pursuit by security officers; taking temporary shelter inside buildings, after which the accumulated warrant will gradually decrease over time; returning to your residence, which will immediately clear all warrant.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_09_2:
The following actions in the city will increase your <red>Warrant Value</>:
<red>Attacking</> pedestrians or vehicles in the city.
<red>Attacking</> law enforcement officers or related Anomalies.
<red>Forcibly taking</> other people's vehicles.
<red>Damaging</> public property while driving.
Other actions that threaten city safety.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_09_1:
Any illegal action in the city accumulates <red>Warrant Value</>. When your <red>Warrant Value</> reaches a certain threshold, you become Wanted.
While in the Wanted state, some of Appraiser's actions will be restricted.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.CityEvent_Crime_Des:
Occasionally in the city, you may witness others breaking the rules.
When this happens, you can choose to <red>step in and stop them in the name of justice, or simply ignore it.</> After all, the Security Office may be late, but they will show up eventually.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_23: Throughout the city, whether encountering Anomalies by chance or accepting related Commissions, you may face powerful Anomalies. Some may leave behind Anomaly Residual after being defeated, which you can capture and craft into equipable Arcs.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_04: In every corner of the city, many adorable little animals make their home. The Appraiser can interact with them and enjoy moments of relaxation.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_02: Throughout the city, you can find various <red>lost items</> like keys and wallets. These items can be turned in to the <red>Lost & Found</> at any Security Office. After turning them in, the Security Office will reward this honest act with prizes and praise.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.BidKing_InGame_01_des:
During each match, keep an eye on these three panels:

1. Left: Player List
Shows each player's <red>bid history</> and <red>device usage</>.
2. Center: Intel Panel
Shows all <red>intel</> you have gathered.
3. Right: Collectibles Warehouse
Shows all known <red>collectible details</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_15: Taking commodities without permission in shops will increase your <red>warrant</> if caught. Shops in Hethereau don't welcome rule-breakers!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.BossSupport_Des: In Anomaly Hunt, you may encounter familiar companions who will assist and fight alongside you.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_14_3: Taking it will put you in <red>Stealth mode</>. Don't linger! If a staff catches you while in stealth, you'll be <red>forced to pay</> Fons.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_16_3: <red>Soap</> and <red>Pinecone Bomb</> can also appear during battle as special mechanics, helping you defeat opponents faster. View their details in the mode instructions on the <red>Matchmaking</> screen.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PukaLand_10_Desc:
In Whack-a-Puka, hit Pukaboos as they pop out of their holes to score points before time runs out.
Some special Pukaboos are worth more points, but hitting a Pinecone Bomb will cost you points.
Hit the Bonk Hammer to knock back all Pukaboos on the field.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.dodge_des: Use <red>Dodge</> before an enemy attack lands to successfully evade it. Dodging consumes Stamina. When Stamina is insufficient, you cannot Dodge. Stamina recovers over time. A successful Dodge triggers <red>Critical Dodge</> and grants brief invincibility.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PukaLand_4_Desc: In Lavaton Gold Rush, use the Movement and Jump keys to control the mine cart. Switch between adjacent tracks to dodge obstacles, pick up weapons to destroy them, and collect coins to earn points.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PukaLand_12_Desc:
In Plushie Shootout, shoot the moving dolls to knock them down and score points.
Keep your eyes on the targets, time your shots carefully, and rack up as many points as you can. Take aim and go for the high score!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PukaLand_1_Desc:
In the Punchulum Ride, press the corresponding Movement key when each circle appears to earn points.
There are three types of inputs: press, hold, and repeated press. Watch the colors carefully to know which one to use.
Pink Candy Ring: Press once
Blue Candy Ring: Hold
Orange Candy Ring: Press repeatedly
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_16_2: While in Parole, some of the Appraiser's actions will be restricted until the Parole time ends.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PukaLand_8_Desc:
In the Secret Match challenge, memorize the items hidden under the jars, then match identical items in pairs.
Match all the pairs before time runs out. Otherwise, your rating when time runs out becomes your final result. Put your memory to the test and give it your all!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_27: Use Ctrl or lightly push the analog stick to toggle between <red>walking</> and <red>running</> while moving.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Bonfire_des: Bonfires allow you to rest, identify equipment, salvage equipment, access the Warehouse, and use other features. You can also use the Map to teleport to lit Bonfires.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PukaLand_2_Desc:
In Pixies Waltz, press the corresponding direction when the green cursor reaches the center of the button to build Firepower.
Your timing will be rated <red>Perfect, Normal, or Miss</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PukaLand_13_Desc:
In Candy Carousel, switch between Pearl and Star ammo to rack up points.
Use Pearl ammo while the shell is open to score points. When it closes, use Star ammo to open it again.
You can also reverse the carousel's direction. Choose the right ammo and strategy to score as many points as possible.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_10_02:
You can ask the Guard about the daily schedule or sign up for <red>facility labor</>.
Warning: Any <red>misconduct</> will <red>extend</> your detention.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PukaLand_5_Desc:
In Flora Maze, players spawn at random locations, and the maze layout changes each round.
Explore the maze, find the exit, and escape! Collect all the scattered playing cards and rescue every trapped Pukaboo to earn additional rewards.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Store_guanli_des_3: The recipe interface allows you to upgrade items and develop new products.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Steal_Des02: Forcibly taking items while being watched by staff will force you to pay Fons. If staff aren't watching, you can successfully obtain the item and enter <red>Concealed Status</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PukaLand_6_Desc:
Explore Spooky Cookies in first person and use your special flashlight to find a way to unlock the exit and escape.
The flashlight drains battery power while in use and has several lighting modes.
UV mode drains the battery faster, but reveals hidden Ghost Butlers and concealed mechanisms. You can also consume some battery power to unleash a powerful flash that briefly stuns most Ghost Butlers. The flash can activate certain mechanisms around the house as well, but has a short cooldown.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_12:
In Races mode, collision damage to your vehicle is <red>heavily reduced</>:
<red>Challenge</>: <red>95%</> less durability loss
<red>Online Battle</>: <red>100%</> less durability loss
<red>Friends Challenge</>: <red>95%</> less durability loss
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_13:
Rain and snow reduce tire grip, making vehicles harder to control.
Restore handling by equipping rain or snow tires in the Garage.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Vehicle_Des_3: When driving, you can toggle between Sport Mode and Comfort Mode. Comfort Mode limits the vehicle's maximum speed, making it easier to drive in city traffic.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PukaLand_9_Desc: In The Magic Spin, spend Puka Stars to spin the wheel for a chance to win even more Puka Stars. Try your luck!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Robbank_Teach_04: <red>ReroRero Phone Booths</> appear on the map. Evacuate through any activated booth before time runs out. <red>If all characters are down or time expires, all earnings are lost.</>
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Robbank_Teach_08: The map contains valuable Collectibles as well as functional items like <red>Clearance Cards</> and <red>Vault Access Cards</>. They don't grant earnings directly but can unlock rooms rich in Collectibles or be <red>carried</> into future runs if unused or if evacuation fails.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Defend_NS_Content_3:
Item Vending Machines are located around the arena.
Spend Coal Lump Coins dropped by enemies to redeem items.
You can hold only one item at a time. Picking up another item automatically replaces your current item.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_12_1:
Hidden within the city lies a mysterious subway line—<red>Beyond the Rails</>. Its route constantly shifts, and no one knows where its final destination leads.
The Appraiser can board the <red>Ghost Train</> at anomaly stations to challenge the powerful anomalies lurking at each stop. Defeat enemies under specific conditions to earn <red>generous rewards</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_13: Different delivery commissions appear daily throughout the city. Players can review <red>cargo type, delivery time, route, and the commission reward</> info before heading to designated locations to accept commissions. Based on delivery performance, players can earn different professional ratings—the higher the rating, the greater the reward!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Boss_04_Teach_Weak: Taygedo is in a Broken state. <orange>Touch the items he drops</> to deal bonus damage.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PObⅠS-13_Teach: Replication and growth, the Proliferative C has never and will never stop <red>proliferating</>. When anyone tries to approach it, countless cardboard boxes will appear to protect it. Although these boxes seem fragile, they are harder than steel and will not break even if someone steps on them. When the Anomaly Hunter finds the <red>correct path</> in the <red>labyrinth</> of boxes and finally stands before the Proliferative C, simply <red>sealing the unsealed part of the box</> will cause its obsession with expansion and proliferation to dissipate.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Defend_NS_Content_1:
Enemies will attack Coal Lump in relentless waves. Protect Coal Lump's Treasure!
Each enemy deals damage over time while within Coal Lump's range, and certain enemies can deal additional damage.
Use items strategically, choose your buffs wisely, and stand your ground against the horde.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_09_3:
Here are a few ways to bring your Warrant Value down if it gets too high.
1. Lose the pursuing Security Officers by putting <red>some distance</> between you and them.
2. Head back to your <red>Properties</> and step into the effect area of Anomaly Furniture that lowers Warrant Value.
3. Use <red>Goodheart Crispy Mouse Cookies</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_10_01:
If you're detained at Hethereau Detention Facility, you'll be released only after your<red> detention period ends</> or <red>all fines are paid</>.
During detention, follow the daily schedule and take part in activities based on the current time block. Different areas are only accessible during certain periods. To move to the next block, interact with your <red>bed in the cell</> or <red>the exit of the activity area</>.
Want out early? <red>Fast travel</> via the map or speak with the <red>Guard</> and pay the full fine.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.ZhanDou_Des_01: Dealing damage to enemies accumulate <red>Ultimate Energy</>. Cast a powerful <red>Ultimate</> when the Ultimate Energy reaches maximum capacity.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Mon030Snow_Teach: Attack an enemy into a <orange>Broken state</> to greatly reduce their DEF.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Boss_06_Teach_Sagiri: Defeat the copies of <orange>Sakiri</> to expose Film - MANISH.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_08_2:
During work, your activity area is strictly limited to within the wire fence surrounding the watchtower.
There are multiple arrow-marked stains around the watchtower. Take out the pressure washer to begin the cleaning work.
During the cleaning process, you can move freely, but jumping or dashing is prohibited. Guards patrol the watchtower above, so keep your movements restrained.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_16_1: When <red>warrant</> accumulates to a certain level, the city's security forces will come to arrest the Appraiser and impose a fine. If the Appraiser refuses to pay the fine, they will be given <red>Parole</>. Once in Parole, a corresponding notification will appear on the left side of the interface until Parole ends.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_15_2: Use <red>Grapple Throw</> on the <red>Broken</> Tornado to deal <red>massive damage</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.BidKing_InGame_04_des: Not sure how much to bid? Click any <red>known intel</> in the Collectibles Warehouse to open the Collectibles Index. Its automatic filters will help narrow down the possibilities. You can also use the current estimated value as a guide. When in doubt, matching your opponents' bids can be a viable strategy.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.combination1_des: Cosmos and Anima Espers trigger <red>Esper Cycle</>, inflicting <red>Blossom</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.CharacterTeach_Chuangsheng: Cosmos and Anima Espers trigger <red>Esper Cycle</>, inflicting <red>Blossom</>.Generates several <red>Vita Buds</> near the target after triggering Esper Cycle, which blossoms <red>Vita Pistils</>. Vita Pistils periodically fly toward targets within range, exploding and dealing AoE DMG.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.combination3_des: Cosmos and Lakshana Esper Abilities trigger <red>Esper Cycle</>, inflicting <red>Remora</>, slowing the target's movement and attack speed for its duration. Frequent Remora speeds up the target's recovery.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.combination_des2: When the current character's <red>Cycle Gauge</> is full, switching to another character who can form an <red>Esper Cycle</> with them allows the new character to perform an <red>Entry Attack</> and reset the <red>Cycle Gauge</> of the previous character. <red>Entry Attack</> applies corresponding <red>Esper Cycle</> effects to damaged enemies.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.combination5_des: Incantation and Chaos Esper Abilities trigger <red>Esper Cycle</>, inflicting <red>Scorch</>, dealing DoT for its duration.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.MotorboatCollect_04_des: After salvaging Floating Cargo, return to the landing point to turn in your haul. You can also find upgrade materials at sea to improve your Jet Ski and Harpoon Gun.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.BidKing_OutGame_04_des: When you are on the verge of bankruptcy, click the Safety Fund button to receive emergency funds and get back in the game. The Safety Fund can be claimed up to 5 times per day.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_34_1: While in <red>First-Person View</>, you can <red>switch between first-person and third-person</> views in <red>Settings</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_33_1: Multiple vehicles available. Configure them via <red>Inventory</> using <red>Quick Equip</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.ZhanDou_Des_02: When an enemy prepares a special move, a <red>Warning Indicator</> appears. Hit the enemy at this moment with a Basic Attack, Redirect Skill, Support Skill, or Critical Dodge Counter to trigger a <red>Parry Attack</>, blocking the incoming strike and stunning the target. After a successful parry, your character gains <red>Cycle Energy</> and automatically chains into a <red>Critical Dodge</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.combination4_des1: Chaos and Psyche Esper Abilities trigger <red>Esper Cycle</>, inflicting <red>Nova</> on the target for its duration.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.combination2_des: Anima and Incantation Esper Abilities trigger <red>Esper Cycle</>, inflicting <red>Hexed</>. For its duration, the target takes an additional instance of <red>follow-up</> damage equal to <red>20%</> of the Anima or Incantation damage taken.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_32_5: Acquire duplicates to <red>Awaken</> characters, granting significant growth and power boosts.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_25: When you use a Wertheimer Tower, a ReroRero Phone Booth, or the bed in your room at Eibon, injured or unconscious characters will automatically recover.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.ZhanDou_Des_04: Having Cosmos, Anima, and Lakshana attributes in the team triggers Esper Cycle <red>Charge</>. <red>Charge</> combines <red>Remora</> and <red>Blossom</>. Hitting·<red>Remora-marked</>·targets·with·<red>Vita Pistils</>·triggers·<red>Charge</>,·granting·the active character<red>Ultimate·Energy</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.ZhanDou_Des_05: Having Chaos, Psyche, and Incantation attributes in the team triggers Esper Cycle <red>Discord</>. <red>Discord</> combines <red>Nova</> and <red>Scorch</>. Triggers <red>Discord</> by affecting targets simultaneously with <red>Nova</> and <red>Scorch</>, reducing a percentage of their <red>Break</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.combination6_des: Psyche and Lakshana Esper Abilities trigger <red>Esper Cycle</>, inflicting <red>Stain</>, increasing enemies' damage taken from these Esper Abilities for its duration.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Defend_NS_Content_6:
Enemies will attack across a limited number of waves.
Each wave features enemies with different special abilities.
That's all for the basics.
Now go protect Coal Lump's Treasure!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_07: The packages carelessly left on the streets by Chameleon the Thief are still guarded by an invisibility trick, silently protecting the treasures within. To claim the loot, you must stay out of its line of sight. Perhaps approaching from behind is a good idea.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.RealEstate_3: To own property in Hethereau, visit <red>Leon Estate Group</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_06_3: After successfully providing food to customers, the shop's revenue will increase accordingly. If you can achieve <red>consecutive successes</>, you can also earn additional <red>revenue bonuses</>. Once you reach the specified revenue target, you can unlock busier, more challenging stages.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_11_01: Chores are part of the center's daily routine. Detainees may participate in chores twice per day, using high-pressure water cannons to clean stains from watchtowers within the assigned time period. Upon completion, detainees may receive a small amount of Fons.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_08_1:
Labor within the facility is an important part of daily operations at the detention facility. You may work twice daily during your detention.
During designated working hours, use the pressure washer to clean dirt from the watchtower surfaces. Upon completion, you will receive a small amount of Fons as compensation for your labor.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_24: Insert coins to start the Claw Machine, adjust your view, aim precisely, and win your very own plushie!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PukaLand_2_2_Desc:
Reach the top of the tower to enter first-person shooting mode. Spend Firepower to shoot down airborne candy and earn points!
If <red>half</> of the Firepower you gain in a single run is earned with a <red>Perfect</> rating, a special challenge stage will unlock. Clear it to reach the special ending. Give it your best shot!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.RealEstate_zhuangxiu_5: Drag furniture icons to their designated spots, then press Confirm to place them.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.RealEstate_zhuangxiu_9: Wait a short time for renovations to complete before changing the style.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.mon_11_Illustrate:
An Object Anomaly of boxing.
Boxing gloves are a badge of courage and a tombstone for cowards. Engage in a boisterous showdown or a thorough massage amidst jeers, taunts, rage, and fury! Face the scorching winds of punches and cast out your timid self, shouting the long-suppressed cry from deep within your soul, "Oraoraoraoraora—!!!"
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.RealEstate_zhuangxiu_11: Explore various <red>Anomalies</> to collect and place <red>Anomaly Furniture</> in your house. Each piece of Anomaly Furniture possesses unique abilities that provide different effects.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Boss_06_Teach: Several intertwined film rolls can project recorded items into reality and initiate attacks with them. Like regular films, they fear bright light. <red>Under strong illumination, the projected items vanish and the source becomes weakened.</>
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.RealEstate_shoucang_7: Collection: Collecting furniture increases your Collection Level and earns <red>Collection Rewards</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Name_19: Scarborough Fair - Rainbow Bridge & Secret Fair
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Boss_15_Teach_4: Follow the chart and use <orange>Basic Attack</> at the right timing!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Boss_15_Teach_2: Follow the chart and <orange>Jump</> at the right timing!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Boss_15_Teach_3: Follow the chart and <orange>Dodge</> at the right timing!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Teach_DivinationHouse: Welcome to <red>The Witch's House</>, where you can hand in <red>Oracle Stones</> to the witch. If you find yourself lost, the witch will also divine your luck and show you the road ahead.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.BidKing_InGame_06_des: You've completed your first auction! The mystery collectibles will now be revealed one by one, along with the winner's profit or loss. If the winner suffers a loss, each of the other three players receives a bonus equal to 10% of that loss.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_04_1: Each character has a uniquely shaped <red>Console</>, where the Appraiser can place <red>Cartridges</> and <red>Modules</> to enhance the wearer's attributes.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Defend_NS_Content_2:
Defeated enemies drop a certain number of Coal Lump Coins.
Spend Coal Lump Coins at vending machines to redeem items.
Coal Lump loses HP whenever it takes damage.
When Coal Lump's HP reaches 0, it self-destructs, immediately ending the run and calculating your final results.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Store_guanli_des_4: Ensure you have enough inventory to keep all items in stock.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.MotorboatCollect_01_des: The sunken cargo ship has scattered cargo all across the sea. If you spot Floating Cargo, get close and salvage it! The nearer you are to the cargo ship, the more likely you are to find high-value Floating Cargo.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.BuildingDrawing_Teach_01:
<red>Architectural blueprints</> that refuse to submit after being discarded will pull people into the Anomalous Realm on the paper, where the intricate buildings they designed exist.
Participants can explore the buildings to collect <red>Scattered Blueprints</>. These include <red>Projection Blueprints</> and <red>Dimension-Shift Blueprints</> with special abilities. Using <red>Projection Blueprints</>, you can project yourself and objects in the space onto a flat plane. Using <red>Dimension-Shift Blueprints</>, you can adjust the direction of the projection. By skillfully utilizing these blueprint abilities, you can use object projections as platforms to move and jump, reaching various locations throughout the buildings.
When participants <red>collect all the scattered blueprints</>, they can complete the challenge and exit the Anomalous Realm.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Boss_37_Teach: Warning! The Boss is about to unleash a powerful attack. Take cover!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Boss_09_Teach_Trap: Warning! The Black Tome is summoning chains to attack! You will be <orange>Restrained</> if you touched the chains!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PukaLand_14_2_Desc:
You can also spend Fons to play attractions and earn Puka Stars based on your score.
Take your Puka Stars to the Star Ticket Counter on Puka Street and redeem them for all kinds of fabulous rewards. Fill up your Wonderlog and make the most of your trip to Pukaland!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Defend_NS_Content_5:
You can pause the game at any time.
Select Quit & Save to save your completed waves and resume from there next time.
You can also select Quit & Settle to end the current run immediately and receive the corresponding rewards.
Note: Quit options are only available after the run has started.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_30:
After activating a ReroRero Phone Booth or Wertheimer Tower, check the Map to fast travel to any activated spot.
If you own personal property, visit it once to unlock it as a fast travel destination.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.mon_04_Teach: A Whisper Spawn on the cusp of dissipation. It fights similarly to its kin but <red>self-destructs upon fading</>, damaging characters within a certain range.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PObⅠS-7605_Teach: The Spacetime Projector is keen on projecting <red>accident footage</> at the locations they appear in. Some <red>segments</> of the <red>progress bar</> of its videos can be unstable, and certain indistinguishable <red>clues</> are hidden there. Participants can explore different points in the video. Once they follow the clues and track down the Nexus of the video—often the <red>origin of the accidents</>—the Spacetime Projector will naturally become nullified.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_02: You can claim rewards corresponding to your Hunter Level after it increases.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_07: Complete <red>Ascension Quests</> after reaching certain Hunter Level milestones to increase your <red>Hunter Level Limit</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.BidKing_InGame_02_des: The Player List shows the <red>devices</> each player used and the <red>bids</> they placed in previous rounds. Click a device icon or an Auction Assistant portrait to view the full history.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_08: Players can increase Affection levels by <red>giving gifts</> to characters they've met. Each Affection increase may unlock <red>Exclusive Messages</> and <red>Special Encounters</>. Completing these encounters further increases Affection levels. As Affection grows, you'll also unlock <red>limited gifts</> as rewards.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PukaLand_6_2_Desc: Running out of battery power or getting scared by a Ghost Butler increases your Fright. If Fright reaches its maximum, the game will end with a low rating. Look for Batteries to restore battery power and Courage Spray to reduce Fright.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Boss_019_Skill07Tips: Interrupt the Sea Prisoner's Dash Attack with a well-timed <orange>Parry Attack</>!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PukaLand_4_2_Desc:
While airborne, you can steer the mine cart left or right to choose which track to land on, though your movement will be limited during lava eruptions. On steep tracks, press the Speed Up key to make it up the slope.
Hitting obstacles or derailing will cost you points. Lose too many points, and the game will end early with a low score.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.mon_01_Teach: As visitors from shattered dimensions, even without consciousness, their deeply ingrained battle instincts allow them to <red>dodge attacks and counter</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_26: Accumulating Hunter EXP increases your Hunter Level and unlocks more Quests and Modes. Earn Hunter EXP quickly by completing <red>Daily Objectives</>, <red>spending Character Pixels</>, <red>completing Quests</>, and <red>City Exploration</>
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.BidKing_InGame_05_des: The tide of an auction can turn at any moment. Make good use of your selected Device Set, watch your opponents closely, and adjust your strategy as needed. If an opponent suddenly acts out of character, they may have uncovered valuable new intel.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Boss_34_Teach_Ultra: The Ultimate is fully charged. <orange>Press to cast Ultimate</> and attack the Corridor Projection.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.MotorboatCollect_03_des: The specially modified salvage Jet Ski consumes energy while in use. The moving marker on the Energy Bar shows the danger threshold. If your energy falls below it, head back immediately or look for Power Crates on the water.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Boss_06_Teach_Unbal: Film - MANISH has been <orange>Broken</>, <orange>Ultimates</> are ready!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.mon_02_Illustrate:
A Disoriented Entity capable of ranged attacks.
Among the few with this ability, their engulfing darkness seems to forever speak of all they've endured in the dimension fragments.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Shop_Vehicle_des2: If you want to own a vehicle, you can head to <red>Novus</> and shop for one.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_14_2: If they <red>don't notice</>, you can grab the item safely.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PukaLand_3_2_Desc:
If a powerful tentacle grabs you, quickly repel the other attacking tentacles to avoid losing a large amount of points and durability.
Collect all Treasure Maps to unlock a special challenge stage. Defeat all Golden Tentacles to clear the challenge and unlock a special ending. Give it your all!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Appraisal_des: Unidentified Equipment you obtain can be identified by Appraisal Fuzzy using Warren Gold Coins.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.BidKing_OutGame_02_des: The Collectibles Warehouse holds every collectible you have won at auction. Sell them to gain more bidding funds, or place your favorite high-value pieces in the Display Case to admire your prizes and earn income over time.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Store_des: Shops for sale can be purchased to open your own store. Visit <red>Leon Estate Group</> to buy shops, then find the right employees and items to increase your revenue. Remember to keep inventory too!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_33_2_Phone: Equipped vehicles can be switched from the main screen by holding the <red>Item Bar</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_33_2_PC: Equipped vehicles can be switched from the main screen by holding the <red>Item Bar shortcut</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.BidKing_OutGame_03_des: To gain an edge at auction, choose the right Auction Assistant and Device Set. Each Auction Assistant has their own specialty, while Device Sets can uncover valuable intel that may turn the auction in your favor.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Robbank_Teach_06: <red>Taking damage</> <red>may</> cause you to lose earnings. <red>Plan your route</> and watch your characters' status.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.combination1_des2: <red>Vita Bud</> will spawn near the character. Periodically, some <red>Vita Pistils</> will fly toward targets and explode, dealing damage to an area.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_29: You can invite a character to your home after unlocking them. They will go about their daily routines there.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Mon030Rain_Teach: Trigger a <orange>Parry Attack</> to counter enemy attacks and deal damage.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.dodge_des2: A <red>Critical Riposte</> can be performed by using <red>Basic Attacks</> shortly after triggering <red>Critical Dodge</>. <red>Critical Riposte</> can effectively Break an enemy.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.mon_60_ice_teach: Destroy the ice crystal and rescue the trapped allies as quickly as possible!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_34_2: Switch perspectives to explore Hethereau's scenery as the Appraiser.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Vehicle_des: After buying a vehicle, use the <red>Key Fob</> by the roadside to summon it.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_12_2:
Beyond the Rails contains multiple mysterious <red>routes</>, each composed of several <red>stations</>.
Every station harbors powerful anomalies, and the Appraiser can only board the Ghost Train to proceed to the next station's unknown challenges after defeating the anomaly at the current station.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.PukaLand_1_2_Desc:
Mistakes increase your character's Fear, while successful inputs reduce it. If Fear gets too high, the game will end early and you'll receive a low rating.
Land multiple Perfects to unlock a special challenge stage. Clear it to reach the special ending. Give it your best shot!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WishWell_Des:
This is Nacupeda's Pool, the sacred grounds of the Nacupeda Fans Club.
<red>After offering shiny new coins—Nacupeda's favorite food—to it, pray sincerely to receive Nacupeda's blessing.</> Whenever someone makes a wish, Nacupeda appears. According to enthusiasts, simply seeing Nacupeda brings good fortune, though this claim remains unverified.
Just for good luck, toss a coin into the wishing pool. Who knows? Something good might happen!
Wait—this pool is absolutely filled with coins!
If one or two, or even a handful went missing, surely no one would notice…?
What's this chill running down my spine? If I take Nacupeda's food supply, something terrible might happen…
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Steal_Des03: If discovered by staff while in <red>Concealed Status</>, you will be forced to pay Fons. Leaving the shop will remove <red>Concealed Status</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.MotorboatCollect_02_des: Once you enter Aiming Mode, you can fire the Harpoon Gun. Targets within its maximum towing capacity can be successfully salvaged. If you're having trouble aiming, try slowing down your Jet Ski.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.balance_des: Enemies lose <red>Break</> when damaged. Their <red>Break</> shows under HP. When <red>Break</> reaches zero, they become <red>Broken</>, cannot act, and take <red>Break Damage</> based on your team. They recover from <red>Broken</> after a short period.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTon_Des_01_2: Through the <red>Anomagram</>, the Appraiser can track accepted <red>Anomaly Commissions</> and explore the map.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_03: You can improve an Arc's attributes through <red>Enhancing</> and <red>Mixing</>, effectively boosting the wearer's stats.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.MapTransfer_Teach: <red>Teleportation devices</>, scattered across the globe and managed by the Circle's direct agency, the Yggash Court. Urban legends in the streets of Hethereau tell of eerie rings from abandoned red phone booths, causing innocent passersby to vanish into black fog… Of course, urban legends always have a bit of artistic flair. However, many Esper users have suggested to the Circle that they improve the method. After all, being swallowed, digested, and then… regurgitated, is quite unpleasant. The Yggash Court has yet to respond.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_01: <red>"Griddy" storage lockers</> are scattered throughout Hethereau, with compartments that open using keys. Sometimes, lost storage locker keys can be found on the streets. With these keys, you can locate the corresponding locker and access the appropriate compartment.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Defend_NS_Content_4:
Items provide powerful effects.
Examples include Burn, Freeze, Slow…
Use items wisely and combine them with different buffs to create powerful synergies.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Vehicle_des_2: Safety first! If your vehicle gets damaged, <red>Rampage Players</> offers repair services! The shop also provides appearance and performance mods for your vehicle.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_06: The companions you meet along your journey will occasionally send you messages, sharing what they've seen and heard, along with glimpses of their daily lives.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_28: Some Arcs have <red>Arc</> effects. Equip to a character to use these effects in battle.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.ZhanDou_Des_03: Target enemies with <red>weaknesses</> shown as icons above their heads. Use Esper Ability attacks matching their weakness type to deal increased damage.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.balance_special_des: Some enemies may experience special effects when <red>Broken</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_27_3: You will take fall damage when falling from great heights. To prevent characters from getting injured or knocked out, deploy the glider in time.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Xitong_Des_36_2: You can choose images from the album to create posts on Bagel. Once approved, these posts will be visible to other players.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Xitong_Des_36_1: You can browse posts shared by other players on Bagel.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.RealEstate_zhuangxiu_3: As an Appraiser, you can customize your home's interior layout, invite characters to visit, and previously contained Anomalies will also put their abilities to use around the house.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_27_2: You can use <red>Jump</> again while mid-air to deploy the glider.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_12_4: The Appraiser can use <red>Ghost Feathers</> earned from <red>Beyond the Rails</> challenges to exchange for various enhancement items with special effects at the <red>Otherworld Supply Stop</>, and use these items during Beyond the Rails exploration to boost combat power.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Xitong_Des_36_3: You can view <red>engagement data</> for your posts in Creator Hub, including views, likes, saves, and more. Engagement data is updated daily at <red>00:00 server time</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_09: The Appraiser can use the Dashboard to view their <red>Shops</>, <red>Properties</>, and <red>Vehicles</>, and participate in various <red>Commissions</> and <red>Racing Events</> throughout the City.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_03: When the Appraiser temporarily <red>requisitions vehicles</> in the city, Mint will provide assistance. However, not all drivers will comply with requisition requests. If you choose to <red>requisition by force</>, it will be considered a violation that not only increases your <red>warrant</> but may also result in being <red>wanted</> by security forces.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_12_3: When boarding the <red>Ghost Train</>, the Appraiser can not only form a battle Character squad, but also select an additional <red>Companion</>. Different companions will provide Team members with unique <red>bonus effects</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTon_Des_01_1: Areas investigated by the Appraiser will be marked on the map. You can switch to the <red>Anomagram</> in the bottom-right corner of the map.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_30_2: Investigated areas appear on the map. <red>Anomaly Commissions</> are shown in the bottom-right corner.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Xitong_Des_35: Each day, the Appraiser may meet familiar characters around the city. Adjust Hethereau's time to encounter different companions.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_05: In addition to progressing through Episodes, the Appraiser can complete quests to explore daily life and the world's evolving dynamics.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.XiTong_Des_30_1: Activate a Wertheimer Tower to enable fast travel and retrieve stored information, revealing map data for the surrounding area.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Redar_Des: Approaching Anomaly Awaiting Containment: Minimap radar activates when nearby. Radar color changes as distance decreases: Blue → Green → Yellow → Red.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Boss_15_Teach_1: Beat King has initiated a <orange>Rhythm Challenge</>!
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.WanFa_Des_06_2: The kitchen is divided into three <red>different types</> of cooking areas. Facing the flood of incoming customers, you will need to operate in multiple areas and respond to different order requirements to ensure everyone leaves satisfied.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.Boss_10_Teach_Light: Darkness will cause your body to <orange>freeze</>. Please stay in areas with <orange>light</>.
ST_TeachAndIllustrater.combination4_des2: The target suffers significant <red>Mental DMG</> when Nova ends.

ST_Ui.LotteryDes_Jishishuoming_AnHunQuDes:
1. <Orange>Fading Reverie</> is a <Orange>Limited Board</>.
2. This board uses Solid Dice. Roll to move 1–6 tiles (equal chance), land on a tile, and claim the displayed reward.
3. All limited boards share S-Class Character pity, Points Gift progress, and Board Modification progress.
4. Fading Reverie Skin Perks are <Orange>time-limited</> and exclusive to this board. Progress does not carry over to other Limited Boards. Skin Perks include: Daily Outfit, Mod Up! (Livery), and Fashion Center.

ST_Ui.ui_equipmentlottery_16:
<Black>Basic Mode</>
Rewind is divided into three difficulties. Each difficulty allows you to obtain Modules of corresponding rarity by spending Carrota.
Easy: Spend Bronze Carrota to randomly draw Blue Modules from the full shape pool.
Normal: Spend Silver Carrota to draw Purple Modules from a custom shape pool.
Hard: Spend Gold Carrota to draw Orange Modules from a custom shape pool.

<Black>Custom Pool</>
Normal/Hard difficulties require selecting Module shapes before drawing. You can choose 8 Modules of any shape (duplicates allowed).

<Black>Draw Rates</>
Easy: Random draw from all Blue Modules of every shape, with equal chance for each shape.
Normal & Hard: Each selected Module has a fixed <Orange>12.5%</> draw rate (chances stack for duplicate shapes).
Example: If all 8 slots contain the same shape Module, the chance of obtaining that shape through rewind becomes <Orange>100%</>.

Common S-Class Characters

ST_Ui.MangHe_shinku_Des_rule:
<Black>Draw Method</>
There are 15 Mystery Boxes in total. For each single draw, you may spend either Annulith or Fons. The required amount of Annulith or Fons varies by draw, and the cost increases with each draw.
<Black>Weight Details</>
As draws are made and items are removed from the prize pool, each reward's probability is calculated in real time based on its weight. The formula is as follows:
Chance to obtain a specific reward = remaining quantity of that reward × that reward's weight / sum of (remaining quantity of each item in the prize pool × that item's weight)
<Black>Reward Delivery</>
Rewards obtained from draws are sent directly to your Inventory. Please check your Inventory to view them.
<Black>Notes</>
<Orange>Draco</>, <Orange>Glory Days</>, Glory Days - Braveheart, Glory Days - Starfall, and Ember Trail are available for a limited time in the Neon Rift event. After this limited-time Gacha ends, there are currently no other ways to obtain them.
<Black>Example</>
After 5 draws, if you have obtained "Beetle Coin ×100,000" ×2, "Elite Hunter Guide ×10" ×2, and "Dreamless Seed ×10", the chance of obtaining "Draco" on the 6th draw is:
= 1 × 1 / (1 × 1 + 1 × 3 + 1 × 5 + 1 × 10 × 2 + 1 × 99 × 5) = 0.19%
After 12 draws, if only "Draco," "Glory Days," and "Fabricated Dice ×10" remain undrawn, the chance of obtaining "Draco" on the 13th draw is:
= 1 × 1 / (1 × 1 + 1 × 3 + 1 × 5) = 11.11%
As draws continue, the probabilities of all items fluctuate in real time.

<Title>Owner's Selection</>
In Owner's Selection, customers will place orders and players make commodities according to these orders to earn Fons. You need to complete at least 1 management target during the challenge to succeed and obtain the Fons earned in the mode. The amount of Fons earned through mode can be viewed in the completion rewards for each stage.

<Title>Making Sandwiches</>
Sandwich making consists of 3 steps:
1. Slice the corresponding bread.
2. Select the corresponding bread slices.
3. Select the corresponding ingredients.
Remember to replenish bread slices promptly when they run out.

<Title>Making Cakes</>
Cake making consists of 3 steps:
1. Press the cake batter to make a cake base.
2. Select the prepared cake base.
3. Select the corresponding ingredients.
Remember to replenish cake bases promptly when they run out.

<Title>Making Coffee</>
Coffee making consists of 4 steps:
1. Press the Coffee Machine to brew Coffee Concentrate.
2. Select a cup according to the customer's needs.
3. Press the Coffee Concentrate to pour it into the cup.
4. Select the corresponding ingredients.
Remember to replenish Coffee Concentrate promptly when it runs out.
ST_Ui.BPUI_WorldLevel_Des:
<Title>Hunter Level and Appraisal Level</>
1. Hunter Level is how the Anomaly Hunter Association evaluates an Anomaly Hunter. Accumulate Hunter EXP to increase your Hunter Level. After leveling up, visit the <Orange>Hunter Rewards</> interface to claim your rewards. At Hunter Level 10/20/30/40/45/50/55, your Appraisal Level is increased by 1.
2. When Hunter Level reaches 20/40/50, the corresponding Hunter Level Breakthrough Quest will unlock. Complete it to continue increasing Hunter Level.
3. Once you reach the level limit, any excess Hunter EXP can be converted into Beetle Coins at a ratio of <Orange>1:10</>. The current Hunter Level limit is 60, and the Appraisal Level cap is 7.
4. After reaching Appraisal Level <Orange>3</>, the Appraisal Level adjustment feature unlocks. You can manually lower your current Appraisal Level by <Orange>1</>. When you reduce your Appraisal Level, enemy strength and drop rewards will also decrease to match that Appraisal Level. Character Level limits and Arc Level limits are not affected.

<Title>Appraisal Level Effects</>
1. Appraisal Level is the level of Zeroth Sense unique to Esper Zero and determines Encounters and Discoveries. Enemy strength and dropped rewards will increase with Appraisal Level.
2. Appraisal Level will determine your Character and Arc Level limits, which can be unlocked with a specific Appraisal Level. These limits are not affected by the Appraisal Level adjustment feature.

<Title>Appraisal Level Adjustment</>
This feature can lower Appraisal Level by at most <Orange>1</>. After using the lowering feature, you cannot lower it again; you can only restore it. After using the Appraisal Level Adjustment feature, you cannot adjust again for <Orange>24</> hours. Whether restoring Appraisal Level after lowering it, or lowering it again after restoring, you must wait <Orange>24</> hours.

ST_Ui.FinalTower_des:
<title>999 Nights Event Rules</>
Your Hero Party is assembled! Set your sights on conquering the entire Warren Continent!

<title>Participation Requirements</>
Available after completing the Episode Quest <orange>Fighting with a Dragon</>.

<title>Event Rules</>
1. Complete the Episode Quest <orange>Fighting with a Dragon</> to unlock <orange>Story Difficulty</> in <orange>999 Nights</>.
2. Clear <orange>Story Difficulty</> to unlock <orange>Challenge Difficulty</>, then clear <orange>Challenge Difficulty</> to unlock <orange>Nightmare Difficulty</>. The higher the difficulty, the better the rewards.
3. When a new difficulty is unlocked, your level and equipment from the previous difficulty will carry over.
4. After clearing <orange>Challenge Difficulty</> or <orange>Nightmare Difficulty</>, you can replay the current difficulty before the next stage is unlocked.

Note: Once you unlock a higher-tier difficulty, you cannot return to the previous difficulty. Please choose carefully based on your needs.
Story Difficulty cannot be replayed after it has been cleared.
If your character's level is much lower than the monsters' level, the greater the level gap, the less damage your character deals and the more damage your character takes. Conversely, if your character's level is much higher than the monsters' level, the greater the level gap, the more damage your character deals and the less damage your character takes.

<title>Reward Rules</>
1. You can obtain up to 99,999,999 <orange>Warren Gold Coins</> per day. Any amount beyond this limit cannot be obtained that day.
2. You can hold up to 99,999 <orange>Mystery Buttons</> at a time. Once this limit is reached, no more can be obtained.
3. In <orange>999 Nights</>, Character Skills, Awakening effects, and certain other effects may differ from their normal versions.
4. As your playthrough count increases, monsters grow stronger and drop more <orange>Mystery Buttons</> and <orange>Warren Gold Coins</>.
ST_Ui.Rechargeshop_Des:
<title>Purchase Information</>
During this paid-content data wipe test, all purchases made by Appraisers will be rebated after launch according to the <orange>Co-Ex Test Purchase Rebate Rules</>.

<title>Purchase Rebate Rules</>
Total purchases made during the test will be rebated based on 1 yuan = 10 Riftcrystals, with multipliers applied as follows: 
1. If total purchases ≤ 3,600 yuan: receive 150% Riftcrystal rebate.
If total purchases > 3,600 yuan: The first 3,600 yuan receives 150% rebate;
Any amount above 3,600 yuan receives 125% rebate, with no upper limit.
<tips>Example: If an Appraiser spends a total of 4,000 yuan during the test: (3,600 × 10 × 150%) + (400 × 10 × 125%) = 59,000 Riftcrystals. </>
2. During the test period, Appraisers who purchase the <orange>Riftcrystal Mining Permit</> will: a) Receive Riftcrystal rebates for the purchase amount according to <orange>Purchase Rebate Rule 1</>; b) Receive a free <orange>Riftcrystal Mining Permit</> of the same duration as a rebate. The free permit will be saved to your inventory after official launch and must be manually activated. (Note: Each <orange>permit</> rebate is limited to 2 times, with a total effect duration of 60 days.)
<tips>Example: An Appraiser purchases 3 Riftcrystal Mining Permits at 30 yuan each (total 90 yuan) during the test. The 90 yuan counts toward total purchase amount, and Riftcrystal rebates are processed according to Purchase Rebate Rule 1. In addition, the Appraiser receives 2 free Riftcrystal Mining Permits (total effect duration of 60 days). (Riftcrystals obtained from activating Mining Permits and daily Annulith rewards do not count toward Purchase Rebate Rule 1.)</>
3. During the test, Appraisers who purchase and unlock <orange>Hunter Supplies</> will: a) Receive Riftcrystal rebates for the purchase amount according to <orange>Purchase Rebate Rule 1</>; b) Receive a free <orange>Hunter Supplies</> usage right as a rebate. The free usage right will be saved to inventory after official launch and must be manually activated. (Note: Each <orange>Hunter Supplies</> rebate is limited to 1.)
<tips>Example: An Appraiser purchases and activates Hunter Supplies worth 128 yuan during the test. This amount counts toward total purchase amount, and Riftcrystal rebates are processed according to Purchase Rebate Rule 1. The Appraiser also receives 1 free Hunter Supplies usage right. (Annulith contained in Hunter Supplies do not count toward Purchase Rebate Rule 1.)</>

<title>Purchase Rebate Important Notes</>
1. Appraisers can obtain Riftcrystals through purchases. Riftcrystals obtained through purchases can be exchanged for Annulith at a 1:1 ratio in-game. Any existing Annulith balances will remain unchanged.
2. Purchase rebates are limited to the same platform and account that made the purchases during the test. Purchases made via mobile or PC will be accumulated, and rebates will follow the standard Purchase Rebate Rules.
3. Rebates are sent through in-game mail. After official launch, log in with the same platform and account used for test purchases to claim your rebate once the Mail is enabled. Mail is valid for 365 days from distribution. 
4. Both <orange>Riftcrystal Mining Permit</> and <orange>Hunter Supplies</> are delivered as items. Both <orange>Riftcrystal Mining Permit</> and <orange>Hunter Supplies</> items have no expiration and can be stored indefinitely in your inventory.
5. Using a <orange>Riftcrystal Mining Permit</> item grants 30 days of <orange>permit</> time. Using a <orange>Hunter Supplies</> item grants upgrade eligibility for the current <orange>Hunter Supplies</> period.

ST_Ui.DT_GameplayDescription_EliminateCubeCont:
<title>Tetrominoes</>
1. A four-player competitive puzzle game. <orange>Team up with friends</> or <orange>match online</>.
2. Each player stacks and clears blocks in their own play area.
3. Successful clears send attack blocks to a <orange>specific player</> in sequence. After a short time, attack blocks become <orange>garbage rows</> in other players' play areas.
Clearing 2 rows creates 1 attack block.
Clearing 3 rows creates 2 attack blocks.
Clearing 4 rows creates 4 attack blocks.
Triggering a <orange>chain clear</> also creates attack blocks equal to the number of consecutive clears. These attack blocks are added on top of those created by regular clears
4. Use techniques like chain clears and special clears to increase the strength of attack blocks in each phase.
5. One winner is determined at the end of each match. Rewards are distributed based on <orange>final rankings</>.

ST_Ui.TeachGuideDataTable_Baoxiangge_Des:
When moving your character to a Chest Tile, you have a chance to immediately obtain an S-Class Character from the current board depending on the chest type.
<red>Apprentice Chest</>
0.2% base chance to immediately obtain an S-Class Character from the current board, 99.8% base chance to obtain a B-Class Arc.
<Orange>Hero Chest</>
Guaranteed 2 Warp Pieces, 3% base chance to immediately obtain an S-Class Character from the current board, 97% base chance to obtain a B-Class Arc.
ST_Ui.LotteryDes_Ewaijianglijichongfuhuode_cha:
S-Class Character Duplicates: Obtaining the same S-Class Character for the 2nd–7th time converts each duplicate into 1 Mind Shard of that character and 40 Warp Pieces. From the 8th duplicate onward, each converts into 80 Warp Pieces.	
A-Class Character Duplicates: Obtaining the same A-Class Character for the 2nd–7th time converts each duplicate into 1 Mind Shard of that character and 6 Warp Pieces. From the 8th duplicate onward, each converts into 12 Warp Pieces.	
A-Class Arc Bonus: Dropping an A-Class Arc on the Standard Board grants 4 extra Warp Pieces.	
B-Class Arc Bonus: Dropping a B-Class Arc on the Standard Board grants 20 extra Lost Pieces.
ST_Ui.LotteryDes_Ewaijianglijichongfuhuode_Des:

A-Class Character Duplicates: Obtaining the same A-Class Character for the 2nd–7th time converts each duplicate into <Orange>1</> Mind Shard of that character and <Orange>6</> Warp Pieces. From the 8th duplicate onward, each converts into <Orange>12</> Warp Pieces.
A-Class Arc Bonus: Dropping an A-Class Arc on the Limited Board grants <Orange>4</> extra Warp Pieces.
B-Class Arc Bonus: Dropping a B-Class Arc on the Limited Board grants <Orange>20</> extra Lost Pieces.
ST_Ui.TeachGuideDataTable_Qipanbiange_Des:
When obtaining non-S-Class items through dice rolls on the current limited board, you will gain 1 <red>Trace</>. When you accumulate 70 Traces, <red>Board Modification</> will be triggered. The Board will change and the acquisition rates for Rare items and Characters in certain tiles will increase.
All Apprentice Chests will upgrade to Hero Chests, and Hero Chests will be replaced with Journey Together.

ST_Ui.UI_Race_Fleet_999_01_Desc: After defeating the Anomaly "Don't Stop Me Now!", it was satisfied and underwent nullification. Now, whenever I see the remnants it left behind, I'm reminded of the passion we shared racing side by side back then. Deep in my memory, "The Midnight Ghost Racer" still seems to linger on the track, waiting for its destined challenger.

ST_Ui.UI_Race_Fleet_09_01_Desc: They say Kurokawa, captain of First Sense, was exceptionally gifted in his youth. Everyone expected him to become the future "God Racer of Hethereau." But Kurokawa was such a perfectionist that he consistently blamed himself for his teammates' performance or the races themselves. He found that these results never quite matched what was expected of him. Disheartened, he sat in his family's rice fields, basking in the aroma of rice grains, and finally realized he had gone down the wrong path. Later, he formed an amateur racing team in search of those who also sought genuine fun from racing.

ST_Ui.DT_GameplayDescription_VisionContent:
Official Quests issued by the Anomaly Hunter Guild, divided into <orange>Common Commissions</> and <orange>High-Risk Commissions</>.
<title>Common Commission</>
Appraisers patrol, investigate, and handle various routine Anomalies throughout the City. Corresponding rewards are granted upon successful completion.
<title>High-Risk Commission</>
Challenges against more powerful anomalies, only unlocked after meeting target conditions. High-Risk Commissions feature multiple difficulty tiers, with generous rewards upon completion.

ST_Ui.ui_map_icon_desc_01: Teleportation devices, scattered across the globe and managed by the Circle's direct agency, the Yggash Court. There is an urban legend in the streets of Hethereau about an abandoned red Phone Booth that sometimes emits a spooky ringtone, and just like that, innocent passersby vanish into the vast black fog… Of course, urban legends always have a bit of artistic flair to them. However, those who have experienced teleportation have repeatedly suggested to the Circle that they improve the method. After all, being swallowed, digested, and then… ahem, regurgitated, is quite an unpleasant experience. The Yggash Court has yet to respond.

ST_UI_C.DT_realEstate_LLL2_des: Fenglin Villa, Leon Estate Group's flagship luxury villa. Stands proudly at the highest point of Green Wall Slope. Featuring an open-concept layout with spacious, magnificent design, Fenglin Villa allows you to enjoy life with effortless elegance. Floor-to-ceiling windows capture the full splendor of Green Wall Slope's seasons, while the master bedroom on the top floor offers exclusive views of Hethereau's unique skyline. The villa comes equipped with an oversized above-ground Garage and a resort-level outdoor swimming pool, perfectly delivering on every aspect of what you imagine "luxury" to be.
ST_UI_C.DT_RealEstate_003_L_1_Des: Wiener Apartments – Smart Living by Leon Estate Group. A practical, loft-style apartment right next to the city's bustling commercial street. Designed for comfort and value, the open layout makes the most of your space while meeting everyday needs with ease. Fully equipped with essential home appliances—just move in and start living. Whether you're shopping, dining, or just enjoying city life, it's all just steps away. Wiener Apartments offer the perfect launchpad for your next chapter in modern urban living.
ST_UI_C.BPUI_RealEstateDetails_3: One of the high-end apartments under Leon Estate Group, premium housing in Bridge Crossings. Whether you're here to host a party or for private leisure, this place is sure to meet all of your expectations for a quality life!

ST_UI_C.DT_realEstate_LLL1_des: Golden Capital—Leon Estate Group's premium apartment selection—is located in the heart of New Herland. Golden Capital meticulously crafts elegant high-rise living spaces with open and spacious layouts that embody sophisticated urban living. With elevators providing direct access to Kyllene Promenade, residents can immerse themselves in New Herland's trendiest offerings, while the surrounding major arteries of Camelot and Keno Boulevards place the splendor of Hethereau's metropolitan landscape just steps away.
ST_UI_C.DT_realEstate_LL2_des: Skyview Halls—Leon Estate Group's premium apartment selection—is situated in the heart of Miguel District's commercial hub, within view of the iconic Hethereau Skytower. The exceptional space efficiency ensures value in every square inch, while the unobstructed design welcomes natural light and scenic views year-round. With diverse commercial amenities within walking distance, it perfectly accommodates quality lifestyle needs including pet care, dining, and cultural activities.
