ST_VisionArchives.PObⅡS-39_RecordBefore3:
(Hot Post on Bagel)
Yoko Sama's Dating Adventures: This time's guest is—Bopp the Anomaly!

Hey, everyone, I'm your Yoko! In this midnight hour, the Dating series has finally updated again! (≧▽≦)

(A photo: A girl stands at the street corner in the early morning light, her hair disheveled by the cold wind, covering her face)
Don't ask how the wind blew me in the east alley of the square. For the sake of the date, I'm all in!

This time, the target… yes, it's that—Bopp! Clap clap clap! ヽ(✿ﾟ▽ﾟ)ノ 
Bopp is a street-fashion guy who skateboards around doing graffiti, mischievous but not very harmful? Us "brave citizens" are always chasing it! Speaking of which, it's quite elusive… Many have heard the name but never seen it! (ﾟдﾟ)
Just last night, I saw on Bagel that someone found Bopp graffiti with fresh paint! Checked the location: 0.9 km from me??? I'm saying, isn't this the best CHANCE!? I changed my clothes in a flash and ran out, hoping to get lucky!

(A photo: Under dim streetlights, Bopp's graffiti)
Though I don't understand street art, standing under a large wall of vibrant colors is still quite awe-inspiring! The graffiti appeared near my home, a signal of fate, maybe? Just as I was posing for photos, I saw the wall behind me moving in the camera! I turned around, and there was Bopp right in front of me?! Ahhh… my brain… is crashing… I'm so close to Bopp…! It could pin me against the wall with barely any effort! While I was lost in thought, it suddenly glanced at me, eyes cold and disdainful, as if asking "Who are you?" Hey, I'm your number one fan! In a heated moment, I shouted: "Bopp! Can I get an autograph!"

Actually, I didn't have much hope for a response, but what if there's a miracle! The guest made a beautiful leap, person and skateboard, flying over my head…! I was completely stunned, just watching it disappear at the end of the alley, leaving only a face full of colorful paint…(˘̩̩ε˘̩ƪ)
Sigh, at that moment, my heart shattered into bits…

Alright… followers, don't go away, because it's not over yet!
After returning home, I looked in the mirror and found the "makeup" on my face quite nice? Eh? Eh, isn't it! Bopp is truly an artisan! This can totally be considered a signature, right? Right??? Woohoo, happy! Gotta share with you guys! (ˊᗜˋ)
(A photo: Indoors, the girl has a fluorescent paint pattern on her face, happily making a peace sign)
ST_VisionArchives.TeruTeruBoZu_RecordBefore_1:
(A dog-eared page from a diary, written in neat and clear handwriting)

Today, Eibon received a commission via Hyelp: A black and white cumulonimbus cloud appeared above the forest near the Witch's Cottage, with heavy rain falling beneath it. The Client suspected it was the work of the Anomaly known as the Rain-Sweeping Maid. Nanally, Sakiri, and I took the commission, confirmed the Anomaly in question was indeed a Rain-Sweeping Maid, and completed its nullification. Adler has collected the commission fee.
This was the first time Sakiri and I personally handled an Anomaly Commission involving the Rain-Sweeping Maid. Nanally had dealt with one before and complained the whole way back about how her ears and tail got soaked and what a hassle it was to dry them. So before we set out this time, I prepared raincoats and rain gear… but they turned out to be useless. The Anomaly's attacks were far more dangerous than its appearance suggested. Stepping into their curtain of rain… was like walking into a typhoon. My umbrella nearly snapped, and my raincoat was instantly soaked through. Both Sakiri and Nanally said it really hindered their movements. I will be better prepared for the next assignment similar to this.
I have always been interested in this Anomaly's behavior and have researched it extensively. My father once told me that the Rain-Sweeping Maid he saw as a child looked different from today's. Back then, each one had a slender wooden pole on its head, like a broom or mop, making their striped bodies look even more like absorbent cleaning cloths. However, their bodies are not made of fabric, even if they feel soft, light, and fluffy like cotton to the touch. This description reminds me of clouds, though I have never actually touched either clouds or a Rain-Sweeping Maid myself. In their uncontrolled state, the Rain-Sweeping Maid are highly aggressive. No one can approach them without subduing them first, and the subduing process itself is no easy task. I witnessed their combat prowess firsthand today. I had guessed they would use the fangs at the end of their tails to bite their enemies, but their primary method of attack was actually whipping their entire tail to drive away anyone who tried to approach. This behavior indicates they do not truly bear malice or wish to harm others. Perhaps the tainted water inside them causes them immense pain, making it difficult for them to remain calm. If I had a stomachache, I probably would not have the capacity to be friendly to others either.
Apparently, the Celaeno Compound contains a Rain-Sweeping Maid that still retains its wooden pole form. If I ever get the chance, I'd love to see her with my own eyes.
ST_VisionArchives.PObⅡS-39_RecordBefore1:
(BAC recording)
Miss… Madam, can we start?
The story begins the evening before last. I was having dinner with my buddies, and those ass… uh, guys, were taking turns challenging my drinking capacity. The Heitwein bottles we finished were piled up like a small mountain by the table, scaring the store owner.
In the end, I don't remember who won or what time we dispersed. All I know is I encountered it in that alley.
At the time, I was stumbling through the mud, my head pounding as if it would explode. The streetlights were sometimes two, sometimes four… After a few glances, I leaned against the wall and vomited. Then… then that thing appeared.
I saw two pairs… three pairs of arms suddenly extend from the wall, reaching for me. "How cute! I just threw up, and you're here to collect the fine this quick?" I suddenly felt energized and wanted to pull it down from the wall and give it a beating, but my foot slipped… and then I remembered nothing.
You ask how I remember the exact location despite being so drunk? Haha, I really don't. When I woke up, I was already in the hospital. I checked my phone and saw the fine message from the Security Office. Look, it even states the time and place I was found, along with a photo of the vomit… Oh, the picture is a bit small. Let me see… tap to enlarge!

ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_Dlg_002_NPC: Ah, you're an Anomaly Hunter, right? You saw that anomaly hitting people just now, do your job!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Scaled_Anomaly024_Request_3: Hmm… I've been craving something spicy lately. "Spicy Beef Stir-Fry" sounds like it'll do the trick.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.BuildingDrawing_01_Fragments_Dlg_01: Hmm…? You actually made it up here, looks like I underestimated you…
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Scaled_Anomaly024_Finish_1: Mmm… so, so good! I've never had anything this tasty before! Kind human, this is for you, as my thanks. It's a treasure I've been saving, so please take it!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Scaled_Anomaly024_Finish_2: Mmm, so delicious… but my guard duty… uh… forget about it. It should be fine. Eating good food takes precedence!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Scaled_Anomaly024_Leave_3: Hm? Could it be you've got something good to nibble on?
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Hospital_Entrance_Line_Ending_04: Oh… that wretched mortal, forever trapped in an endless nightmare.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Hospital_Entrance_Line_Ending_03: Oh… that so called innocent genius, in the end, saved no one.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Hospital_Entrance_Line_Ending_01: Oh… That selfish one, who reported the colleague that took the fall… all to save themselves…
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Hospital_Entrance_Line_Ending_02: Oh… That wicked servant, a villain no different from a mere tool…
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Hospital_Entrance_Line_02_Player: What lies deep within the nightmare?
ST_WorldActorDialogue.BuildingDrawing_01_Fragments_Dlg_07: Out of all the people I brought here, you're the only one who truly grasped my design philosophy!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_BB_006_NPC: Tell us more, we want to know! How did you deal with that combo punch?
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_003_NPC_Dlg_001: Kind passerby, I implore you, please help us.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Scaled_Anomaly024_Request_2: If only I had some "Tomato and Potato Stir-Fry".
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-0026_Tip_005_Player: The anomaly mentioned in the commission seems to be nearby.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-0026_Tip_O01_Player: The Anomaly mentioned in the commission seems to be nearby.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PPhⅠS-13_Dlg: After sealing the box, the presence inside seemed to have sensed its fate, struggling and twisting. You could feel its unwillingness through its violent reaction. Yet, resistance is futile, and after another period of helpless twisting, the Proliferative C came to a stop…
ST_WorldActorDialogue.CWO_Before_Son_Talk_02: The thief went into my coloring book! Stop!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.BuildingDrawing_01_Item_02_Dlg_01: To think you could find this place… truly impressive! I declare that you are worthy of knowing the true essence of spatial art!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_002_Player_DB_003: I hope there are no vending machines in the BAC.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_002_NPC_Dlg_001: What do you want!… Ahem. Don't you know it's first come, first served? I've already claimed this vending machine!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_BB_002_NPC: Just kidding! I just wanted to try massaging, nothing else!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅠS-7605_003_Player:
Traces of anomalies… something caused the explosion?… 
<blue>If you move to an earlier point on the Video</>, you might see its true form.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_002_Player_DB_002: I'm not buying. Sorry to bother you.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.CWO_Before_Mom_Bubble_02: My child is a rising star, the future pioneer of Hethereau art! A trendsetter!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_001_NPC_Dlg_001: I was just passing by and noticed a loose screw on this car, so I kindly helped tighten it. I didn't have time to do anything else… Who are you anyway?
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Hospital_Entrance_Line_Outro_02: I only remember… the truth you believe in.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Scaled_Anomaly024_Greet_4: I, Danzaburou the Warrior… will not let hunger strike me down…
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Scaled_Anomaly024_Leave_1: I'll be here waiting for you, kind stranger!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.CWO_Before_Mom_Talk_03: My child is a prodigy destined to become a master artist of the next generation! And now this brilliant talent has been devoured by that parasite!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.CWO_Before_Player_Talk_05: I'm an Anomaly Hunter from the Eibon Antique Shop. Is there anything I can help you with?
ST_WorldActorDialogue.CWO_After_Son_Talk_02: I want to draw! Right now! This instant!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Scaled_Anomaly024_Request_1: Man, I could really go for a delicious "Fried Egg"… mm, just thinking about it makes my mouth water.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_003_Player_DB_003: I have other matters to attend to.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_BB_003_NPC: I was wondering why it got so quiet around here, turns out you defeated the Backstreet Boxer!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.CWO_After_Player_Talk_02: I'll need some time to think this over…
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_004_Player_DB_002: Pardon the intrusion. I'll take my leave.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_001_Player_DB_006: Sorry, I mistook you for someone else.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_Msg_004: The railing of the arena is loose. <orange>Be careful not to get knocked off the stage!</>
ST_WorldActorDialogue.CWO_Before_Mom_Bubble_01: You shameless thief! You criminal who stole my child's inspiration!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.BuildingDrawing_01_Item_01_Dlg_01: Since you're so interested in my design, I'll allow you to experience it firsthand! Let me show you what architectural artistry truly means!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.BuildingDrawing_01_Fragments_Dlg_10: Since you've collected all the blueprints, this masterpiece shall be yours forever! No need to thank me~!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Scaled_Anomaly024_Leave_4: Time's running out… please hurry back…
ST_WorldActorDialogue.BuildingDrawing_01_Item_01_Dlg_02_Player: So you're the one who dragged me in here… Wait, this messy building is what you call your artistry?
ST_WorldActorDialogue.CWO_Before_Mom_Bubble_03: It could have been a masterpiece worthy of Dvořák's collection! Now look what's become of it!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_Dlg_006_NPC: Ahh, that's you! Remember when we defeated that Ora Puncher together? We make a flawless team!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_001_Player_Dlg_001: Yes, Danzaburou with the red scarf.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_Dlg_001_NPC: Are you kidding me? What gives the Ora Puncher the right to hurt so much?! I thought I could take it, so I said that word and…
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_003_NPC_BB_001: Is there anyone who can lend a hand…
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_Msg_005: The Ora Puncher has assumed a defensive stance. <orange>Defeat it within 60s!</>
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Scaled_Anomaly024_Greet_2: Ugh, I just wanna clock out and grab a bite to eat. Why am I even babysitting some busted fan?
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Scaled_Anomaly024_Finish_3: Uh… this feels kinda wrong to accept… but it smells so good! Fine, I'll dig in! Oh, right—watch out for the fan over here. One strong gust and you might get blown to who-knows-where.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.WishWell_Leave_001: There are already too many coins in the pool. It doesn't need one more.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.CWO_Before_Son_Talk_03: I can't draw… I can't draw anything at all!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.CWO_Before_Mom_Talk_04: Do you know what this means? This will set Hethereau's artistic progress back by twenty—no, fifty years!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.BuildingDrawing_01_Fragments_Dlg_02: So it wasn't just a coincidence… Seems like you have quite the artistic talent…
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-0026_Tip_006_Player: The chaotic aura is getting stronger.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-0026_Tip_O02_Player: The chaotic aura is getting stronger.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.WishWell_Finsih_Dlg_001: Nacupeda is already full. If you want to make a wish, please come back tomorrow.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.BuildingDrawing_01_Item_01_Dlg_04: A-And besides! Architectural design is an art that combines planes and space, you can't see the essence of my design from just a common view!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.CWO_Before_Mom_Talk_05: And that… that vile parasite is to blame for all of this!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_001_Flee_BB_001: I've been spotted! Farewell, my beloved car!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_001_NPC_Dlg_002: Thank you, I hadn't noticed on the napkin…
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Mammon_Museum_Bellmancolumn: Praise the great Lord Ladon for once again vanquishing the wicked Mammon!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_003_NPC_Dlg_003: Go on, get going, hee hee…
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Scaled_Anomaly024_Request_4: Passing adventurer… if you could bring me a bowl of "Tomato-Egg-Veggie Soup", I'll tell you about a secret passage that no one else knows about.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅠS-7605_005_Dlg:
Bomb Spawn
Profile Number: BOrIIM-8451
Class: II
An aggressive Oddity that conducts indiscriminate attacks by creating C4 Phantom Bombs.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅠS-7605_006_Player: A Bomb Spawn, huh… At the current point of the Video, the explosion has already occurred, so it should have <blue>appeared earlier on in the Video</> and created these Bombs.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_003_Player_DB_004: Remember, fortune smiles upon the kind-hearted.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-0026_Tip_001_Player: I might want to tread very carefully here…
ST_WorldActorDialogue.CWO_After_Mom_Talk_02: I know it's not much, but please accept this… Oh! How about an autographed photo of my child? I assure you, it'll be priceless in the future!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅠS-7605_004_Player: Is this… the Bomb Anomaly? Chuppa! Do you have any related files on that?
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Hospital_058_Opt: Are there any more clues here?
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅠS-7605_002_Player: Explosions, strange <blue>time-space fluctuations</>… seem to be somewhat connected with the <blue>Nexus in the film</>…
ST_WorldActorDialogue.BuildingDrawing_01_Fragments_Dlg_04: You even found this place? Looks like nothing can stump you, haha!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.CWO_After_Mom_Talk_03: That Anomaly was called the Inspiration Terminator, right? It nearly ended my child's bright future in painting!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.CWO_After_Mom_Talk_07: Do you know any reliable Anomaly Hunters who could come right away? My child might get targeted again on their way home!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_001_NPC_Dlg_003: That's good… I suppose. Be more careful next time.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_002_NPC_Dlg_003: Then hurry up and leave, don't hold me up from taking… buying stuff.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_Dlg_005_NPC: When the anomaly got angry, its punches got chaotic. I timed it right and landed a left jab…
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-0026_Tip_003_Player: That red door might be the key.
ST_WorldActorDialogue.CWO_Before_Player_Talk_02: What kind of Anomaly was it…?
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_Dlg_002_Player: So you are willing to cooperate by being the sandbag?
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Hospital_Entrance_Line_04: Close your eyes. Seek for me. Bear witness for me…
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Scaled_Anomaly024_Leave_2: Got food?! Hurry up and bring it here! I'll be waiting!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.CWO_After_Mom_Talk_06: How long do you need? Five minutes? Ten minutes? Can you decide right now?
ST_WorldActorDialogue.CWO_After_Son_Talk_03: No time to talk! I just want to draw!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.CWO_Before_Mom_Talk_01: A mere inconvenience?! This is an outright crime! That wretched Anomaly has stolen my child's unique artistic talent!
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5702_Dlg_004: (H-how dare you say that word to me? This is the greatest insult!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_04_Basketball_Dlg_05: (Wait… that expression on your face… Could it be… that I, the Basketball Court Boxer, have been making assumptions?)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅠS-7605_003_1_Player: (No other clues can be found in the Video at this point. Go back and <blue>move forward on the progress bar.</>)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5702_Dlg_008: (A spirited challenger, I see. All right, I don't mind testing the results of my recent rigorous training on you.)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_BB_002: (If you don't wanna get a beating, go on and run, <blue>coward</>!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_03_Party_Dlg_03: (No one's dance moves can keep up with my punching rhythm! Humans should know when to back off—and that includes you!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.CWO_Before_Player_Talk_03: (This isn't working… I can't get through to her at all…)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_Dlg_005: (It's just that I won't get to add a star to my records unless the opponent I defeat is worthy. That's why I need to be picky when it comes to my opponents, that's all!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_004_Jutsu_BB_002: (Behold, the Undead Guardian Apocalyptic Holy Knight of the World's End Paradise! I await your challenge!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.CWO_Before_Player_Talk_07: (Can't communicate with this one either… I should examine the coloring book first.)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_03_Party_Dlg_07: (I hope you're prepared for what's coming! Otherwise… this'll all be over before the party even gets started!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_Dlg_004: (W-what did you just say now? I'm no <blue>wuss</>!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_04_Basketball_Bubble_Flee: (So you don't want to play basketball anymore!? What a coward.)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_04_Basketball_Dlg_07: (If you think you've made me angry, you're dead wrong! Bring it on! This is exactly the kind of showdown I've been waiting for!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5702_Dlg_009: (A star that is not burning is no more than a mere rock! Defeating a rock means nothing to me, so you'd better give your all!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_03_Party_Bubble_NoBuff: (Put your heart and soul into this battle dance! Let's heat up the ring! Woohoo!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_004_Mon_BB_001: (The blades know no mercy, be on your guard!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_004_Dan_Dlg_005: (Beware, brave one. Lord Don Saburou is about to show his true prowess now.)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_003_Jutsu_BB_002: (They're catching up again, time to clone!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_03_Party_Dlg_08: (Challenge takes courage!<TypingImg id="Text_yinfu_01"/>If you can't make it to my party, I never wanted you here anyway!<TypingImg id="Text_yinfu_01"/>)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_04_Basketball_Dlg_03: (But where are all the passionate young fighters eager to challenge me? I don't see any around here.)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_04_Basketball_Bubble_NoBuff: (Damn it! How dare you waste my emotions! I got all worked up for nothing! Take this punch, RAAAHHH!!!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_002_Flee_BB_001: (Darn it, I'll have to come back for it later!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_003_Flee_BB_001: (Darn it, I'll let you off the hook this time!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5702_BB_003: (Brace yourself! I'll punch you until you see stars!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_004_Dan_Dlg_007: (Ahem, victory and defeat are common in battle… I'll let you borrow the name Don Saburou for now, but mark my words, I'll reclaim it fair and square one day!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_04_Basketball_Dlg_06: (Hahaha, YES! You said it! The destined word! I knew you would!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_002_Jutsu_BB_003: (Ha! This time it's a transformation technique!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Abyss_Train_Tips_001: (Oh dear, the Anomalous Realm ahead is too dangerous for you right now… Don't rush! Come back and take the ride when your <blue>Hunter Level</> is higher.)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_Dlg_002: (I can't find a decent opponent anywhere. Where will I finally meet my fated match?)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_Dlg_001: (Hmph… no matter how many frail-looking weaklings I fight, it means nothing.)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_03_Party_Dlg_06: (Hmph!! This is MY party, MY ring, and I will not tolerate such disrespectful guests!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_Dlg_010: (Hmph, once you're mentally prepared to suffer… straighten your back and <blue>follow me</> to the ring!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5702_Dlg_010: (Humph, looks like you are looking for a duel as a fighter. Come, <blue>if you dare</>!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_002_VehFlee_BB_001: (Hey, hey! Follow the traffic rules, will you?)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS_Boxing_Common_BB_002: (Hey, get back into the ring now!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_BB_005: (Hey, why the rush? I haven't gotten ready yet!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_Dlg_009: (Well, fine, as you wish! It's time you experience the might of the Backstreet Boxer!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_BB_001: (Hey! I'm here to find out if you're actually stronger than you look.)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_001_VehFlee_BB_002: (Danzaburou doesn't want to become a paper cutout!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_003_Mon_BB_002: (Danzaburou's bandit gang is the best in the world!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.CWO_Before_Player_Talk_04: (That must be her child over there.)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5702_Dlg_003: (If you can't become a shining five-pointed star that's as bright as the ones I have… you should just get out of here.)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_Dlg_008_NPC: (Whispering) Shh… Do me a favor, don't let the others know…
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_04_Basketball_Bubble_Buff: (Watch out! When my fist connects with your jaw, it'll hit harder than any slam dunk!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_004_Dan_Dlg_006: (Impressive skills, young warrior! Lord Don Saburou acknowledges you!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_BB_003: (I could take on ten of the likes of you without breaking a sweat!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_002_VehFlee_BB_002: (Even clones can feel pain, you know!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_04_Basketball_Dlg_08: (Let's kick this off with proper dramatic flair! The battle for the basketball court begins!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_Dlg_008: (Moved closer instead of running away? This challenger is really something…)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_004_Dan_Dlg_001: (To think you've come this close before I sensed you, brave one. You must be quite formidable.)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_004_Dan_BB_001: (Well done, brave one. You've successfully caught my attention.)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_Dlg_006: (In any case… you'd better be prepared! You'll soon get to experience the absolute force of the legendary Backstreet Boxer!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_004_Dan_Dlg_002: (I presume you've come to challenge Lord Don Saburou. To think that even in my seclusion, I cannot escape… Very well, brave one. If you're prepared, I accept your challenge.)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5702_BB_005: (Want to seize the initiative, huh? Interesting…)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_002_Dan_Dlg_001: (I'm just taking something from the vending machine and they want to catch me… Nullification? No way!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_001_Dan_Dlg_001: (My beloved car… sniff… I only had it for a moment…)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_04_Basketball_Dlg_04: (I understand! You wanna reclaim this basketball court that holds everyone's memories, practice together, and then head off to the big tournament, right?)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_002_Flee_BB_003: (I'm the real one, pick me, pick me!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5702_Dlg_005: (I see it's high time you find out why I'm known as the legendary Rooftop Boxer!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_002_VehFlee_BB_004: (I'm going to report you to the traffic department!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_BB_004: (I haven't given my all yet, let's go again!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_04_Basketball_Dlg_02: (Wherever there's fair competition, there's a ring. And wherever there's a ring, there shall be fighters!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_03_Party_Bubble_Buff: (ORA-ORA!ORA-ORA-RA!My fury fists dance! Raining down on you!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_03_Party_Dlg_04: (O-O-RA-RA<TypingImg id="Text_yinfu_01"/>Your courage is admirable<TypingImg id="Text_yinfu_01"/>but I'm still gonna<TypingImg id="Text_yinfu_01"/>knock you flat!<TypingImg id="Text_yinfu_01"/>)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_03_Party_Dlg_01: (O-O-ORA<TypingImg id="Text_yinfu_01"/>ORA-RA-RA<TypingImg id="Text_yinfu_01"/>The Party Boxer<TypingImg id="Text_yinfu_01"/>fears no trouble!<TypingImg id="Text_yinfu_01"/>)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5702_Dlg_001: (Every clear night when the stars are visible, I train my punching speed and hone my strength here.)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5702_Dlg_007: (There's no need to take a <blue>coward</> seriously.)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5702_BB_001: (Show me what you've got! I'll judge whether the brilliance of this new star is bright enough!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_001_VehAppear_BB_001: (You sly hunter, you won't catch Danzaburou that easily!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_002_VehAppear_BB_001: (You crafty hunter, but Danzaburou will triumph!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_004_Dan_BB_002: (Sharp eyes you have there, brave one!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5701_Dlg_003: (Look at you… it doesn't seem like you have what it takes to become a new star symbol on my gloves. Stay back… consider it a warning.)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_001_Dan_Dlg_002: (R-Really? Thank you! You're not only telling me about the oil stain on my napkin, but you're also letting me go. You're a good person! I promise I won't steal anything!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5702_Dlg_002: (Real stars can't be touched no matter how you try. The honor and merit earned with my own might are the only stars I can wish to own.)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.PObⅡS-5702_Dlg_006: (Stand firm! Don't get blown away by my fierce jabs before my fists even hit your nose!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_003_Dan_Dlg_001: (Just my luck to run into someone like you.)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_04_Basketball_Dlg_01: (The basketball court is just another kind of fighting ring!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_03_Party_Bubble_Flee: (Cowards can leave now, you weren't invited in the first place.)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_004_Dan_Dlg_004: (To see through Lord Don Saburou's exquisite ninjutsu… Not bad, not bad at all. You've earned the right to formally challenge me.)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_03_Party_Dlg_02: (A party with no one here? ORA! Don't question it! I rented the whole place to myself!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_04_Basketball_Dlg_09: (This means you've voluntarily accepted defeat without even trying. Hmph, what a boring coward.)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_004_VehFlee_BB_001: (Could this be the legendary vehicle iaido technique?!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Danzaburou_CityA_003_Appear_BB: (Running away? No, no, no, that's MY special move!)
ST_WorldActorDialogue.Boxing_03_Party_Dlg_05: (The rhythm of the music is the rhythm of the ring! Think you can handle my ring?!)

ST_WorldDescription.SW_Int_Dlg_001_002: Yesterday's Ghost Train departing from this station at 07:45, a red emergency alarm assistance button appeared mid-journey. A passenger disappeared after pressing it, and Miss Levi is currently searching for them.
ST_WorldDescription.SW_Int_Dlg_001_003: Yesterday's Ghost Train departing from this station at 12:08, affected by unknown interference, opened a door at the top of the car mid-journey. A passenger left through the roof and was trapped in an Anomalous Realm. Miss Levi has now rescued them.

ST_WorldDescription.AM_Trinity_Trinity_024_interact_001:
1. Pre-Mission Prep: Study the subject's file for insights into its nature, weaknesses, and risks.
2. Equipment Check: Ensure Containment Devices are ready and reliable.
3. Area Recon: Assess the mission zone for safety and mission success.
4. Team Coordination: Know your role, stay in touch, and stick with the team.
5. Public Interaction: Limit public contact and prioritize their safety.
6. Vigilance: Keep an eye on the subject and be ready to act.
7. Anomaly Reporting: Report any unidentified entities and irregularities to the command center immediately.
8. Personal Safety: Use protective gear and Esper combinations for safe containment.
9. Regulatory Compliance: Adhere to protocols for on-site testing.
10. Control Measures: Handle non-hostile subjects with minimal force, respecting laws and humanity.
11. Emergency Response: In case of subject incidents, such as breaches or damage, respond and report for support.
12. Hazard Protection: Guard against harmful substances.
13. Post-Mission Protocol: Assist in cleanup to revert the area to its original state.
14. Confidentiality: Safeguard subject information and maintain professionalism.
15. Subject Integrity: Avoid disrupting the subject's natural state during containment and transfer.
16. Transfer Procedures: Verify subject status and adhere to transfer protocols.
17. Maintenance Checks: Regularly inspect containment conditions and perform upkeep.
18. Release Protocols: Follow guidelines for safe release or nullification.
19. Ethical Standards: Uphold ethics and avoid personal gains.
20. Documentation: Accurately record mission details and results.
21. Equipment Upkeep: Return and maintain devices post-mission.

ST_WorldDescription.AM_Trinity_Trinity_007_interact_001:
<grey>Anomaly Rating Classification</>
Based on the Anomaly's Wertheimer Index, the Bureau of Anomaly Control classifies destruction caused by Anomalies as follows:
Class I - Wh. between (-1, 0), no impact on human society.
Class II - Wh. between (-2, -1], may cause minor injuries to individuals.
Class III - Wh. between (-3, -2], may result in individual casualties.
Class IV - Wh. between (-4, -3], may cause multiple casualties in non-densely populated urban areas.
Class V - Wh. between (-5, -4], may cause mass casualties in urban areas.
Class VI - Wh. between (-10, -5], may cause mass casualties throughout the city.
Class VII - Wh. between (-20, -10], may lead to the stagnation of the entire city.
Class VIII - Wh. between (-50, -20], may lead to the destruction of the entire city.
Class IX - Wh. between (-100, -50], may lead to the destruction of several cities.
Class X - Wh. between (-∞, -100], represents a threat of world destruction and human extinction.
When the Fluctuation at Class IV or below, the threat is within a controllable range. Please seek help from the Bureau of Anomaly Control or a certified Anomaly Hunter organization after ensuring your safety.
For Classes V and VI, please follow the Bureau's directives, choose the nearest temporary shelter, and wait patiently for official rescue.
For Classes VII and above, carefully follow the Bureau's instructions and evacuate the area swiftly and orderly. Rest assured, the BAC will not abandon any citizen!

ST_WorldDescription.SW_Int_Bs_125_002:
Dear passengers, welcome aboard Hethereau's Anomaly Metro, the Ghost Train.

The Ghost Train Anomaly Metro and its stations all appeared in the wilderness on the outskirts of Hethereau one midnight several years ago, their origins unknown.

Though it is a rail-based train, the Ghost Train does not need to travel on actual existing tracks, but instead travels within Anomalous Realms of its own creation. The internal conditions of Anomalous Realms are complex, and to ensure stable train operation, daily passenger loads must reach a certain number, otherwise it may cause some troubles for surrounding areas.

After evaluation by the Bureau of Anomaly Control, citizens can safely ride the Ghost Train while holding Train Tickets developed by Zerogon Laboratory and issued by the Bureau of Anomaly Control, and strictly following the Ghost Train Passenger Manual. The Bureau therefore signed a guarantee agreement with the Ghost Train and opened the Ghost Train to the public.

Now, the Ghost Train has been operating safely for several years, with the number of licensed passengers steadily increasing each year. While becoming Hethereau's unique transportation option, the Ghost Train has also greatly relieved the load pressure on conventional transportation systems.

Thank you to every passenger who chooses the Ghost Train and strictly follows the "Passenger Manual". Whether you're doing morning exercises or night tours, whether you're human or anomaly, as long as you are a Ghost Train passenger, the Ghost Train, stations, and Train Manager will do their best to provide you with a safe, comfortable, and efficient travel experience. Whenever you arrive at the platform, we will immediately appear for you—except when the full moon falls on a Wednesday.

ST_WorldDescription.SW_Int_Bs_124_002:
Regarding this month's research subject selected in the last club meeting, the Oddity administrator "Miss Levi" of the "Ghost Train" Anomaly Metro, investigation results are recorded as follows: 

Miss Levi is an Oddity with an owl-like appearance. Apart from Hethereau, no other regions have recorded her existence. "Miss Levi" is her self-given name. According to records, Miss Levi is an Oddity that flew out from the driver's cabin window of the Ghost Train, and her relationship with the Ghost Train remains a mystery to this day. 
Miss Levi possesses high intelligence and holds Hethereau citizenship, with the Bureau of Anomaly Control as her guarantor. However, she cannot use human language, and only a few Espers can communicate with her fluently. When communicating with passengers, she uses a speaker device worn on her body to play recorded phrases. The speaker device is not a machine, but part of the Oddity's body. 
(Some of the above information comes from online sources) 
(But that speaker looks really useful, are there any manufacturers making replicas? I really want one…) 
According to field observations, Miss Levi can appear in multiple locations simultaneously while engaging in various activities. Our experiments have proven that Miss Levi consistently exists at any station where human observation is present. Further confirmation: Miss Levi at experimental location A can share information from experimental locations B and C in real time, and react based on known intel. 
(That's not fair! The vice president was the one talking bad about her right to her face, so why did I get pecked at a completely different station?!) 

As for local rumors: when no one is observing within a station, she apparently disappears from that station as well. Since the Occult Club unfortunately lacks access to an authoritative Wertheimer Meter and cannot verify this firsthand, there is currently no other evidence for this claim. 
In any case, she seems to be an enthusiastic and cheerful Oddity lady. Although the number of complaints she handles seems consistently high, she appears to have no hostile intentions toward humans (though you'll still get pecked if you talk badly about her to her face). Regarding whether we should attempt other observation measures going forward, I personally recommend discussing this separately at next month's club meeting. 
(Note: If Miss Levi finds this in person… wait, I mean "in owl", please have mercy on us! We really, really, really are just curious!!)

Complaint Description:
This isn't a complaint! I just heard that the Train Manager personally replies to complaint forms… So I'm taking this opportunity to ask: would the lovely Miss Levi be willing to come to Clement Academy and participate in our Occult Club activities? Our club specializes in researching all kinds of anomalies and espers, and everyone is extremely interested in the Ghost Train and its manager—we'd love to learn more!

Complaint Processing Record:
Oh my, it's so rare to see such sweet-talking kids. Thank you all—both the Ghost Train and I are very happy! Though the answer is still no! If you're really that interested, why not become Ghost Train passengers instead? Sign up for the Ghost Train Qualification Test now, and you can even attend my personally taught "Ghost Train Passenger Manual" explanation course!
ST_WorldDescription.SW_Int_Bs_118_002:
Complaint Description:
Your train must be malfunctioning! I applied for my passenger license ages ago but barely used it. These past few days my cat got sick, so I took the train twice to make convenient trips to Jingle Wrangle. Every single time the train car shook violently for no reason—it nearly made me throw up! Fix whatever's wrong as soon as possible, this safety hazard is way too serious!

Complaint Processing Record:
No malfunction detected. Go back and read Section 5, Clause 5 of the "Passenger Manual" a couple more times. Caring for the Train Manager is everyone's responsibility.
ST_WorldDescription.SW_Int_Bs_120_002:
Complaint Description:
The Train Manager keeps harassing me, forcing me to study foreign languages every day. Please do something about this.

Complaint Processing Record:
You got the wrong owl. You don't need language lessons, you need vision correction.
ST_WorldDescription.SW_Int_Bs_121_002:
Complaint Description:
This morning I saw someone walk straight through the middle of the platform wall! I went and felt it myself—the wall is completely solid. Did some Anomaly with spatial abilities or an Esper sneak in? It feels really dangerous, please investigate immediately!

Complaint Processing Record:
Investigation complete. Don't worry, nothing abnormal detected. Bottom line: we recommend pretending you saw nothing. Do not ask questions, and do not attempt to imitate.
ST_WorldDescription.SW_Int_Bs_119_002:
Complaint Description:
I want to file a complaint against the Train Manager! I had a question for her, so I called out from behind her. She immediately turned her head 180 degrees on the spot—it scared me so badly I accidentally fell and cracked my phone screen! Shouldn't you compensate me for this?

Complaint Processing Record:
I can turn 270 degrees. Next time remember to call me from the front.
ST_WorldDescription.SW_Int_Bs_122_002:
Complaint Description:
The manager has a terrible attitude toward passengers! I was on the train playing on my phone earlier, got distracted and wasn't paying attention, so I got off at the wrong door and ended up trapped in some bizarre Anomalous Realm… In there, the ceiling was the floor, blue was red—basically it was absolutely terrifying! I was scared out of my mind, but the manager still had such a bad attitude, saying the same few lines over and over, basically blaming me for breaking the rules and threatening to revoke my passenger license. When I asked more questions, she said her database doesn't support replying with more custom content. What right does an Oddity that only responds to passengers with canned responses have to be a Train Manager!?

Complaint Processing Record:
Because I'm the one who can fish you out of Anomalous Realms. Also: Due to your consecutive violations of "Passenger Manual" Article 7, Section 1 and Article 9, Section 1, according to Article 13, the Ghost Train refuses to provide you with further service. Remember to schedule your Train Ticket revocation process for next week through the administration system.

ST_WorldDescription.AM_Trinity_Trinity_017_interact_001:
Profile Number: PObIS-78
Anomaly Type: Object
Common Alias: Boom Boom Cloud
Security Clearance: P (Public)
Encounter: Numerous and widespread, these entities do not cluster and have caused citywide disruptions. A Hethereau citizen once corralled a large group of Boom Boom Clouds with a metal fence, attempting to build a dream space atop them. Eventually, the fence burst, and the Clouds scattered in all directions with parts of the house, causing a morning of traffic congestion in the city.
Characteristics: They resemble colorful, marshmallow-like clouds, about two square meters in diameter, floating about one meter off the ground and emitting positive energy. They can support an adult's weight and nourish plants like soil.
Class: I
Anomaly Nexus: Expands by 50% when wet and shrinks rapidly when exposed to fire, emitting a burnt marshmallow scent until it's the size of a compressed face mask.
Containment: Equip JTF personnel with flamethrowers for containment.
ST_WorldDescription.AM_Trinity_Trinity_016_interact_001:
Profile Number: POrIIS-45
Anomaly Type: Organism
Common Alias: Inspiration Terminator
Security Clearance: P (Public)
Encounter: Six months ago, hundreds of artists experienced a collective loss of inspiration, with no physical ailments detected. Two weeks later, significant fluctuations in the Wertheimer Index led to a Class II classification and a bounty for containment by Anomaly Hunters. During capture, hunters reported a loss of inspiration upon hearing a buzzing sound. A total of 127 were contained with catching nets by three hunters working together, but the observable population has since increased to 8,145 and identified in other districts of Hetherau.
Characteristics: Fly-like appearance with a round, glowing abdomen. Feeds on and depletes human inspiration, causing mental blockages and headaches in victims. It follows delicious inspiration and multiplies after consuming high-quality inspiration more than ten times, swarming the victim. Victim gradually recovers their inspiration after the Anomaly's nullification.
Class: II
Anomaly Nexus: Class I when isolated. Eliminated with standard pest control protocols.
Containment: To prevent mass occurrences, JTF regularly sprays insect repellent in artist gathering areas, such as 144 Street and Art Avenue.

Welcome to Eibon, we value your discerning taste. For effective service, please note our terms.

1. Nagging? Exit and turn right. This applies to commissions involving family disputes, marriage restoration, etc. Have a wonderful day.

2. This shop is not a charity institution. Commission fees vary based on the commission's nature and difficulty, and the shop owner's mood. A 50% deposit is required at signing, with the balance due upon completion.

ST_WorldDescription.SW_Int_Bs_132_001:
To my dear little Patty:
Please don't cry. I'm writing this as my first sentence, and if you can hold back your tears, then please forgive mommy for being so wordy.
I love you, and this love won't fade away even after I'm gone.
Just like in the fairy tale books we used to read together, I'll be in the wind and in the rain.
When you taste the sweetness of cream, you'll remember the days we baked cakes together. When you smell flowers, you'll think of the days we turned the soil and planted seeds together…
Every moment you think of me, that's when I'm right there beside you.
I still feel sad that I can't be there as you grow up, but the time we spent together was so happy.
It's just like when you add sour lemon juice to a cake. All that sweetness covers up the tiny bit of sourness completely.
So little Patty, please don't cry. Just like that lullaby that belongs only to us, this is a long game of hide and seek.
I'm sorry mommy isn't very good at games and hasn't found you yet.
So swing happily on your swing, Patty. Year after year, someday we'll meet again.
Let's pinky promise!

ST_WorldDescription.SW_Int_Bs_127_002:
Ingredients:
3 eggs, 35g corn oil, 40g milk, 50g cake flour, 30g granulated sugar, half a lemon
Instructions:
1. Separate egg whites and yolks into two bowls.
2. In a new bowl, add corn oil and milk, whisk until yogurt-like consistency.
3. Add egg yolks and cake flour, mix until smooth.
4. Take egg whites from refrigerator, add lemon juice, gradually add sugar in three portions and whip thoroughly.
5. Take 1/3 of the meringue and fold into the egg yolk mixture until evenly combined.
6. Pour the mixed cake batter into the meringue bowl and fold until evenly combined.
7. Pour cake batter into mold, use a toothpick to pop surface bubbles.
8. Bake in oven at 150°C for 60 minutes.
